name: Ilu Ruiz
review_text:
En primer lugar agradecer al personal su trato servicial y amable en todo momento. Llegamos en unas circunstancias muy especiales con un apagon en toda Espana. Se adaptaron para darnos de comer como pudieron porque obviamente sin luz no podia prepararse las cosas ya que ni horno, microondas, cortadoras etc funcionaban. Igualmente ocurrio en la cena. Las habitaciones estaban limpias, el colchon y almohadas comodas. Lo unico el acceso es un poco complejo ya que esta en la parte mas alta del pueblo y las cuestas son muy inclinadas con la complicacion de la estrechez de las calles. El pueblo es precioso pero he de decir que, al menos, entre semana no funciona ningun restaurante-bar en condiciones, lo unico abierto era el bar del hotel en donde puedes disfrutar tomando un refresco tranquilamente en su terraza en plena naturaleza y con unas vistas unicas. La carta del bar excelente calidad-precio. Los desayunos muy completos. En general la experiencia de 10.

P.D: No se si seria casualidad o que por defecto no lo ponen, pero una escobilla en el bano estaria genial
response_from_owner_text: Muchas gracias por vuestra resena, nos alegra haber estado a la altura, sobre todo en ese dia tan dificil.
review_translated_text:
First of all, thank the staff for their helpful and friendly treatment at all times. We arrived in very special circumstances with a blackout throughout Spain. They adapted to feed us as best they could because obviously without light things couldn't be prepared since neither the oven, microwave, slicers, etc. worked. The same thing happened at dinner. The rooms were clean, the mattress and pillows comfortable. The only thing is access is a little complex since it is in the highest part of the town and the slopes are very steep, complicated by the narrowness of the streets. The town is beautiful but I have to say that, at least, during the week there is no proper restaurant-bar, the only thing open was the hotel bar where you can enjoy having a drink quietly on its terrace in the middle of nature and with unique views. The bar menu is excellent value for money. Very complete breakfasts. Overall experience of 10.

P.S: I don't know if it would be a coincidence or if they don't put it by default, but a toilet brush would be great

Es logico que con el calor humano subiera a 21 grados.Lo del WIFI pues si les hace felices decir que funcionaba pues me parece muy bien. QUE LASTIMA QUE EN VEZ DE INTENTAR MEJORAR SE DEFIENDAN CON MENTIRAS. La reclamacion ya esta puesta y espero que la junta tome medidas.
La peor experiencia de toda mi vida. Nos hospedamos en la habitacion 25 y ha sido un infierno. Empezamos con que los radiadores no calientan y la unica solucion que la habitacion que tiene buena temperatura. Despues de hacer 600 kilometros y estar todo el dia por ahi, terminamos de cenar ( que es lo unico que merece la pena) y no hay agua caliente, su solucion que esperemos media hora ( somos 5 y son las 22 hrs) estamos agotados. Seguimos sin agua caliente y no nos dan solucion. El water no traga el papel, imaginate siendo 5.... La red wifi no funciona, apenas tenemos 3G con nuestra fibra y tampoco nos dan solucion. El bano es abuhardillado y tenemos que entrar agachados  ( saldremos alguno con lumbago), las camas duras no, lo siguiente.
El desayuno espectacular ( al menos algo bueno)
La atencion de la manana nada que ver con la de la tarde, los de la manana han sido muy amables.
El secador tampoco funciona 
Esto es una tremenda pesadilla, no se como seran las demas habitaciones pero ni se os ocurra quedaros en la 25.
Indignados es poco. Te amargan unas agradables vacaciones.

It's logical that with human heat it would have risen to 21 degrees. As for the WIFI, if it makes them happy to say it was working, then that's fine by me. WHAT A SHAME THAT INSTEAD OF TRYING TO IMPROVE, THEY DEFEND THEMSELVES WITH LIES. The complaint has already been filed, and I hope the board takes action.
The worst experience of my entire life. We stayed in room 25, and it was hell. We started with the radiators not heating up, and the only solution was to use the room, which has a good temperature. After traveling 600 kilometers and being out and about all day, we finished dinner (which is the only thing worthwhile) and there's no hot water. Their solution is to wait half an hour (there are 5 of us and it's 10 PM). We're exhausted. We still have no hot water, and they haven't given us a solution. The toilet doesn't flush the toilet paper, imagine there being 5 of us... The Wi-Fi doesn't work, we barely have 3G with our fiber optic cable, and they haven't given us a solution either. The bathroom is in the attic, and we have to go in crouching (some of us will come out with lumbago), and the beds aren't hard, which is the next best thing.
The breakfast was spectacular (at least somewhat good).
The service in the morning was nothing like the service in the afternoon; the morning staff was very friendly.
The hairdryer doesn't work either 
This is a tremendous nightmare. I don't know what the other rooms are like, but don't even think about staying in room 25.
Outrageous is an understatement. It ruins a pleasant vacation.

Les preguntamos por sitios cerca y nos dijeron que no habia ningun pueblo mas. Les pedimos un bocadillo y no fue posible. Habia mesas libres tanto en el comedor como en la terraza pero, obviamente, la decision de cuanta gente pueden admitir es decision del restaurante y no me meto, pero me parece insolidario y de bajo nivel para un local de hosteleria dejar a gente sin comer algo (bocadillo, embutido, etc) sabiendo que no hay nada en los alrededores. Me pregunto si hacen lo mismo si hay ninos.
review_translated_text: I can't speak to the accommodations since we weren't staying there, but we went there for dinner since there were no other places open in the rest of the town, so we were told to go there instead. We arrived at 9:30 a.m. and were told they couldn't serve us dinner because they were fully booked. We explained that nothing was open in the town, but we couldn't find any. We asked about places nearby, and they told us there were no other towns. We asked for a sandwich, but it wasn't possible. There were free tables both in the dining room and on the terrace, but obviously, the decision on how many people they can admit is the restaurant's decision, and I don't get involved. But I think it's unsupportive and low-level for a restaurant to leave people without food (a sandwich, cold cuts, etc.), knowing there's nothing else nearby. I wonder if they do the same if there are children.

review_translated_text: I stayed in a lower deck room, very spacious... even more than necessary; it would have been nice if they had made space available for service. What I did think could be greatly improved, and I wouldn't recommend it, was the breakfast (included with the stay, at least in our case), consisting of cold cuts (which I don't eat, but it was obvious they weren't of good quality), fruit skewers (I don't know when they were cut, but the impression wasn't good), toasted baguette, and the typical mini-packages of jams, butter, Nutella, etc. Oh, and orange juice and some slices of square cake. And, of course, coffee with milk or Cola-Cao... but they put all that stuff in there which might seem to have something for everyone, but what happens is that whoever likes to have breakfast like muffins, cereal, croissants, etc... well, I had breakfast because I had to satisfy my hunger, but it didn't do me any good... and there will be those who leave the toast, and those who leave the cold cuts (which was our case), and those who leave the juice, etc... because the only way to really suit everyone's tastes is by giving options or asking, not just throwing something out for breakfast and part of it ending up unused.

El coche lo tienes que dejar fuera del pueblo (puedes subirlo para descargar y luego volver a bajar, aunque las calles son muy estrechas) y el hotel es el que esta mas arriba (repechitos majos, en escaleras o cuestas, a elegir) y si a eso le anades un nino de ano y medio... Pues imaginate la combinacion! Al volver a casa me desapunto del gimnasio, ya he hecho todo el deporte del ano estos dos dias.

Tampoco tienes aire acondicionado que seguro durante el resto del ano no ha hecho falta pero estos dos dias sin duda!
Abrimos la ventana para que entre el fresco por la noche? Fuera esta la terraza del bar con sonido ambiente (perro incluido) y el foco que alumbra la terraza, pegado a nuestra ventana, concertando la verbena de bicholandia.
Opciones:
A) ventana abierta, sonido ambiente y cuerpo con picotazos (pero fresquito).
B) ventana cerrada, calma absoluta, sin picotazos, pero sudando con 29 grados en la habitacion.

Frigorifico tampoco.. lo mismo que antes, igual no es necesario el resto del ano, pero estos dos dias si!
Tendra agua fria en el bar? Si, el primer dia a 2.5EU la botella y el segundo a 2.1EU.

Lo siento de verdad, no me gusta poner malas criticas, pero es lo que nos ha pasado a nosotros y es asi. Igual con 15 grados menos, la cuesta no es tan cuesta, el dejar el coche fuera del pueblo no duele tanto y el aire acondicionado no lo vemos tan necesario.

El responsable del hotel un 10! Muy atento y dispuesto a ayudar en todo momento!
La habitacion muy comoda, amplia, limpia... Muy bien!
Los desayunos? Muy completos, muy bien atendidos, los puedes tomar en la terraza junto con el amanecer.. muy contentos!
El pueblo, muy bonito! Con la cascada que tiene, lo hace aun mas espectacular, aunque en otra epoca del ano es aun mas espectacular, baja muchisima mas agua!

Yo creo que podemos repetir, pero en primavera/otono!

Muchas gracias por todo!
review_translated_text:
We probably had the two worst days of the year in terms of heat (38 and 40 degrees), and that's going to make my opinion a bit more negative.

You have to leave the car outside the town (you can drive up to unload and then drive back down, although the streets are very narrow), and the hotel is the highest (nice little hills, stairs, or slopes, your choice). And if you add a one-and-a-half-year-old to that... well, imagine the combination! When I get home, I quit the gym; I've already done all the exercise I need for the year in these two days.

You also don't have air conditioning, which I'm sure you wouldn't need during the rest of the year, but these two days definitely are!
Should we open the window to let in the cool air at night? Outside is the bar terrace with ambient sound (dog included) and the spotlight that lights up the terrace, right next to our window, orchestrating the bicholandia festival.
Options:
A) window open, ambient noise and body aching (but cool).
B) window closed, absolute calm, no aching, but sweating with 29 degrees in the room.

No refrigerator either... same as before, maybe it's not necessary the rest of the year, but these two days are!
Will there be cold water at the bar? Yes, the first day for EU2.50 a bottle and the second for EU2.10.

I'm really sorry, I don't like giving bad reviews, but that's what happened to us, and it's true. Maybe with 15 degrees less, the hill isn't as steep, parking the car outside the town isn't as painful, and we don't find air conditioning as necessary.

The hotel manager was a 10! Very attentive and willing to help at all times!
The room was very comfortable, spacious, clean... Very good!
The breakfasts? Very filling, very well served, you can have them on the terrace with the sunrise... very happy!
The town is very pretty! The waterfall makes it even more spectacular, although at other times of the year it's even more spectacular, with much more water flowing down!

I think we can go back, but in spring/fall!

Thank you so much for everything!

name: Marc-Oriol Casas Quintana
review_text:
Un hotel para relajarse y sentir la naturaleza. Eso si esta lejos y en un pueblo remoto.
Nosotros paramos una noche de camino y nos encanto. Arriba de todo de una montana rocosa con la dificultad y aventura q conlleva llegar hasta la puerta del hotel para descargar. Cuestas, calles estrechas del pueblo.. una vez te instalas y dejas el coche aparcado (tuvimos suerte y lo dejamos al lado de la puerta) entrad en las calles y te pierdes en la belleza del pueblo y su naturaleza.
El servicio del hotel y la cena fueron genial y el personal amable. El cachopo estaba riquisimo con queso de burgos..
Eso si nosotros llegamos un jueves y nos fuimos un viernes..y en fin de semana se llena de gente y se nota. Pero es visita obligatoria.
review_translated_text:
A hotel to relax and experience nature. It's far away, though, and in a remote village.
We stopped for one night on the way and loved it. It's at the top of a rocky mountain, with the difficulty and adventure of getting to the hotel door to unload. Slopes, narrow village streets... once you settle in and park your car (we were lucky and left it next to the door), you walk into the streets and lose yourself in the beauty of the town and its nature.
The hotel service and dinner were great, and the staff was friendly. The cachopo (a type of sandwich) was delicious with Burgos cheese. 
We arrived on a Thursday and left on a Friday... and on the weekend it gets very crowded, and you can tell. But it's a must-see.

name: Trip.com Member
review_text: This hotel is in a beautiful and quiet area in Valle de Sedano, near a waterfall. The hotel itself is quaint and rustic. The staff are very nice and friendly. The younger staff, the young men, speak English, which is really appreciated as it's not always the case in Spain, and not all of us speak Spanish. The room we were given was a bit smaller than the photos, but still comfortable. The ceilings are low on the top floors, so watch your head. The only thing I can say negative about this hotel is that there is no parking possible nearby as it it up on a hill with very narrow uphill streets to get there. You have to leave your car at the bottom of the hill outside the village and climb up by foot to the top. Yes, their website stipulates this but not on the Trip.com website. As my husband is a civil handicapped person, we were exceptionally able to arrange to leave our car near the hotel for our short stay, but it was REALLY exceptional. If you are handicapped or mobility reduced, you shouldn't stay there, unfortunately. Anyway, the drive up to and down from the hotel on those unbelievably narrow maze of streets is really too stressful. I don't recommend it. But if you are otherwise young and fit, I highly recommend it. It's peaceful, beautiful, amazing scenery, good food and friendly staff.

review_translated_text: I've only been to the restaurant and it was really, really good. Great service and very good food. The oxtail was very delicious.

name: nostalgia
review_text: Hotel rural situado en un enclave maravilloso, con vistas espectaculares desde la habitacion y una muy buena atencion por parte del personal. El restaurante situado en el propio vestibulo tambien cumple con creces. Ademas, el desayuno esta incluido y tiene bastante comida.
review_translated_text: Rural hotel located in a wonderful location, with spectacular views from the room and very good attention from the staff. The restaurant located in the lobby itself also more than complies. Plus, breakfast is included and has plenty of food.

name: Javier Molina rodriguez
review_text:
Todo un acierto!!!
Hemos estado un fin de semana,
El lugar PRECIOSO,tranquilo y respiras buena energia y paz.
La atencion genial,buena limpieza y la comida calidad precio y cantidad tambien muy bien.
El equipo servicial desde recepcion hasta cocina.
Destaco a las chicas Maria Carmen y Fani encantadoras!!!
(Servicio de desayunos y limpieza de habitaciones)
Sin duda hemos disfrutado de las vistas del pueblecito y todo su encanto en general.
RECOMENDABLE 100%
review_translated_text:
A total success!!!
We stayed for a weekend.
The place is BEAUTIFUL, quiet, and offers a sense of peace and good energy.
The service is fantastic, clean, and the food is excellent value for money and quantity.
The staff is helpful, from reception to the kitchen.
I highly recommend the lovely ladies, Maria Carmen and Fani!
(Breakfast service and room cleaning)
We definitely enjoyed the views of the village and all its charm.
100% RECOMMENDED

name: Antonio Moriel
review_text: La estancia muy bien. Pero que te cobren 4 euros por un vino tinto con una copa casi media.... Me parece una pasada
review_translated_text: The stay was very good. But being charged 4 euros for a red wine with almost half a glass.... It seems amazing to me

name: MA F
review_text: En general bien. Estuvimos en un apartamento, bien de espacio y buenas vistas. Falta algo mas de equipamiento, como tazas, platos, mas cubiertos. El restaurante del hotel muy bien.
review_translated_text: Overall, it was fine. We stayed in an apartment, with plenty of space and a good view. It needs some extra amenities, such as cups, plates, and more cutlery. The hotel restaurant was very good.

name: Cristina Ceballos
review_text: Le doy 5 estrellas porque aunque no funcionaba el radiador del bano, la verdad es que no se noto nada de frio y ademas intentaron arreglarlo, y el hotel es muy bonito y esta en una ubicacion increible. La atencion que hemos recibido, estupenda y el desayuno y la cena muy bien, como se notaba que el dueno es asturiano, que raciones, madre mia!!!! Genial todo!!
review_translated_text: I give it 5 stars because although the bathroom radiator didn't work, the truth is that it didn't feel cold at all and they also tried to fix it, and the hotel is very nice and in an incredible location. The attention we received was great and the breakfast and dinner were very good, as you could tell that the owner is Asturian, what portions, my goodness!!!! Everything is great!!

name: Eva Gi
review_text:
Un pueblo magico, ideal para descansar y hacer senderismo.
La habitacion limpia, bien equipada y cama comda.
El restaurante genial, la terraza un lujo sus vistas, todo rico y cantidades abundantes.

Pero lo mejor de todo ha sido la gente, el personal, desde el primer momento con amabilidad y una sonrrisa. Atentos y detallistas.
Ademas tuvimos la suerte de celebrar el ano nuevo con la gente del pueblo y nos hicieron sentir como de casa.

Desde luego 100% recomendable.
Nosotros vamos a volver seguro.
review_translated_text:
A magical town, ideal for relaxing and hiking.
The room was clean, well-equipped, and the bed was comfortable.
The restaurant was fantastic, the terrace was luxurious, and everything was delicious and in plentiful quantities.

But the best of all was the people, the staff, who were friendly and smiling from the very first moment. Attentive and attentive to detail.
We were also lucky enough to celebrate New Year's with the townspeople, and they made us feel right at home.

Absolutely 100% recommended.
We will definitely return.

name: Elizabeth
review_text: Primero que nada quiero resaltar que es 1 de enero un puntazo ya que todo esta cerrado , el lugar acogedor , calentito y la comida calidad precio estupendo . El cachopo  estupendo y una grata sorpresa ya que al estar en Castilla un trocito de Asturias no esta nada mal .
review_translated_text: First of all, I want to highlight that it is January 1st, a hoot since everything is closed, the place is cozy, warm, and the food is great quality and price. The wonderful cachopo and a pleasant surprise since being in Castilla, a little piece of Asturias is not bad at all.

name: Guada Lu
review_text: Hotel rural perfecto en un pueblo de ensueno. El hotel es correcto, limpio y con buenas vistas. Se puede llegar en coche pero hay que entrar por una calle muy estrecha. Se puede dejar el coche en el parquing del pueblo. Las habitaciones muy limpias. Desayuno incluido, muy bueno ( zumo natural, embutido, bizcocho, pan tostado y cafe con leche). El personal del hotel es muy muy amable. Si quieres puedes quedarte a cenar. Nosotros lo hicimos. Precios correctos.
review_translated_text: Perfect rural hotel in a dream town. The hotel is correct, clean and with good views. You can get there by car but you have to enter through a very narrow street. You can leave your car in the town parking lot. Very clean rooms. Breakfast included, very good (natural juice, sausage, cake, toast and coffee with milk). The hotel staff is very very friendly. If you want you can stay for dinner. We did it. Correct prices.

name: OLGA GAMARRA
review_text: Muy bonito el lugar, la habitacion y el bano limpios, buen servicio y realmente muy buen desayuno.
review_translated_text: Very nice place, clean room and bathroom, good service and really good breakfast.

name: German Valderrama
review_text: Perfecto para visitar el pueblo y comer o hacer noche en este sitio, muy buena relacion calidad-precio gente amable, repetire seguro.
review_translated_text: Perfect for visiting the town and eating or spending the night here, very good value for money, friendly people, I will definitely come back.

name: MaJo ST
review_text: Hotel muy agradable, limpio, bonitas vistas y personal amable. Lo recomiendo.
review_translated_text: Very nice hotel, clean, nice views and friendly staff. I recommend it.

name: Clare
review_text:
2nd time here in apartment A. So warm and cosy, enjoyed the beautiful autumn colours. Ate both nights in the restaurant La Puebla, always a good idea to book.
There's washing up liquid, a tea towel and a Nescafe Dolce Gosto machine with a few capsules, you can get more for 50 cents. Nice little fridge and vitro, microwave too. Lovely hot shower.
The views are breathtaking.
Highly recommend the breakfast.
We were able to park near the Hotel, there was space everyday.

name: gerente kirosam
review_text: Excelente, el sitio, la comida, la atencion, hacen que se pase un momento gratificante. Recomendamos este sitio. Con seguridad volvemos.
review_translated_text: Excellent, the location, the food, the service, make for a truly rewarding experience. We recommend this place. We'll definitely be back.

name: jcywest
review_text: Ok!

name: elvi gil
review_text:
La cama muy dura..
. Por lo demas un 10
review_translated_text:
The bed is very hard.
. Otherwise a 10

name: Maolo Rodriguez
review_text: Buen sitio en un lugar privilegiado.El servicio y atencion del personal perfecto.Amabilidad y muy buen trato.El desayuno muy muy bueno,sin problema para pedir alguna tostada mas,otro cafe...Las cenas,no comimos alli al pasar el dia fuera,tienen buena relacion calidad precio.Platos combinados normalillos pero a precios muy asequibles.Lo unico que no me convencio fue la insonorizacion tanto interior como exterior,se podria mejorar algo.En general,un sitio para pasar un buen fin de semana en noviembre.Tranquilidad,buen ambiente y trato muy agradable...me imagino que en verano sera otro cantar en cuanto a la tranquilidad.
review_translated_text: Good place in a prime location. The service and attention of the staff were perfect. Friendliness and very good treatment. The breakfast was very, very good, no problem ordering more toast, another coffee... The dinners, we didn't eat there as we spent the day out, are good value for money. Average mixed platters but at very affordable prices. The only thing I wasn't convinced about was the soundproofing both inside and outside; it could be improved somewhat. Overall, a place to spend a good weekend in November. Peace, good atmosphere and very pleasant treatment... I imagine that in summer it will be a different story in terms of peace and quiet.

name: David Reyes Jimenez
review_text: Esta en todo lo alto del pueblo...ambiente montanero...lla buardilla con su techo madera..cama amplia.anatomica..se ve todo el pueblo...el pueblo no es k sea la cana...es pequenito...pero tiene la cascada y la cueva (x detras de la cascada.. vale 2EU) pero para hace laGr 99 ideal..para hacer la ruta circular valdelateja..canones del Ebro pesquera. .ideal..para ver las iglesias rupestres ideal...el restaurante del hotel rural.  Pocos platos . Pero tienen menu. Y platos del dia estaba todo bien
review_translated_text: It is at the top of the town... mountain atmosphere... the attic with its wooden roof... large bed... you can see the whole town... the town is not exactly that great... it is small... but it has the waterfall and the cave (behind the waterfall... it costs EU2) but for doing the GR 99 it is ideal... for doing the Valdelateja circular route... Ebro canyons fishing... ideal... to see the cave churches ideal... the restaurant of the rural hotel. Few dishes. But they have a menu. And daily dishes were all good

name: elena vazquez
review_text: El ultimo hotel del pueblo pero con unas vistas espectaculares. Personal muy amable y comida rica. Hay que dejar el coche en el parking de la carretera por eso es recomendable subir solo una mochila con lo necesario
review_translated_text: The last hotel in town but with spectacular views. Very friendly staff and delicious food. You have to leave the car in the parking lot on the road, so it is advisable to only carry a backpack with what you need.

name: Javier Izquierdo
review_text: Me gusto la ubicacion, complicado el aparcamiento
review_translated_text: I liked the location, parking was complicated.

name: Laura C.
review_text: Alojamiento muy acogedor, con vistas preciosas y un personal muy amable. El restaurante tambien ofrece muy buena comida, y tiene una terraza agradable. Volveremos seguro, muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Very cozy accommodation, with beautiful views and very friendly staff. The restaurant also offers very good food, and has a pleasant terrace. We will return for sure, highly recommended.

name: David Diez
review_text: Todo genial. Buen precio, se come bien. Buen trato
review_translated_text: Everything great. Good price, eats well. Good deal

name: Yesica Gonzalez
review_text:
Buenas vistas, el desayuno es abundante y optimo para los montanistas o ciclistas. Buena ubicacion aunque esta en la zona mas alta del pueblo.
Se supone que en el pueblo solo pueden estacionarse los vecinos asi que nos dijeron que nuestro coche lo teniamos que dejar en uno de los aparcamientos de la carretera, no temo por la seguridad del coche, lo unico malo es tener que bajar y subir toda la cuesta... Hemos olvidado las llaves en dos ocasiones y bueno... Veniamos a hacer un poco de ejercicios. Bien logrado!
Hicimos una ruta de bici bastante canera que vimos en Wikiloc, no encontramos mi un alma en los 30 kms (excepto en los pueblos)
review_translated_text:
Good views, breakfast is abundant and optimal for mountaineers or cyclists. Good location although it is in the highest area of   the town.
It is assumed that only residents can park in the town, so they told us that we had to leave our car in one of the parking lots on the road. I'm not afraid for the safety of the car, the only bad thing is having to go down and up the entire hill... We have forgotten the keys on two occasions and well... We came to do a little exercise. Well done!
We did a pretty cool bike route that we saw on Wikiloc, we didn't find a single soul in the 30 km (except in the towns)

name: yedra vicente
review_text: Maravilloso.
review_translated_text: Marvelous.

name: Gorka Martinez
review_text:
Un hotel precioso con una vistas espectaculares y con una cena en el restaurante de 10!
Sin duda que repetire
review_translated_text:
A beautiful hotel with spectacular views and a dinner at the 10 restaurant!
Without a doubt I will repeat

name: Jose Juan
review_text: Tienen una vista sobre el pueblo y sobre el canon estupenda, pero hay que subir andando
review_translated_text: They have a great view of the town and the canyon, but you have to walk up

name: Andrea Marcos Sanchez
review_text: Muy agradable tanto el lugar como el servicio.
review_translated_text: Very nice both the place and the service.

name: Mode Reina Barquero
review_text: Precioso lugar para conocer
review_translated_text: Beautiful place to visit

name: Yolanda Sanchez Jimenez
review_text: Volveremos!
review_translated_text: We'll be back!

name: claude_monnier
review_text: Stayed one night with a cycling group in the Pueblo.  It is at the very top of a perched village which makes it a very quiet place in a majestic setting.   We also had dinner and breakfast on premises.   Dinner was plentiful, tapas style.  Breakfast was good but we would have liked more protein for the bike ride that followed.

name: Nuria
review_text:
Todo muy bien, vistas impresionantes, lugar muy tranquilo ideal para desconectar.
Personal muy amable y atento, comida muy buena y sin pasarse con los precios
review_translated_text:
Everything very good, impressive views, very quiet place ideal to disconnect.
Very friendly and attentive staff, very good food and without going overboard with the prices

name: C G
review_text: Hotel rural sin lujos pero muy limpio, con un personal muy atento y amable. Con la habitacion sirven un desayuno estupendo, en el bar dan comidas y cenas, con platos abundantes y muy ricos. Dispone de terraza donde comer o tomar algo al sol. Tambien hay WiFi disponible para los clientes.
review_translated_text: A rural hotel without luxuries but very clean, with very attentive and friendly staff. A wonderful breakfast is served with the room, and the bar serves lunch and dinner, with hearty and delicious dishes. It has a terrace where you can enjoy lunch or a drink in the sun. Wi-Fi is also available for guests.

name: Joaquin Santos
review_text: Estuve en una vivienda de uso turistico, destacar la vista espectacular desde la misma, el trato del personal fue muy bueno, recomendable.
review_translated_text: I stayed in a tourist accommodation. I would highlight the spectacular view from the property. The staff was very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend it.

name: Alex Navajas
review_text:
Se me hizo caro (70EU) porque iba yo solo y solo habia una habitacion triple. Aparte de eso, el hotel esta bien, con unas vistas extraordinarias. La habitacion era amplia y comoda, con buenas camas. Lastima que, en todo el hotel, han apostado por luz fria, lo que deja todo mas desangelado y menos acogedor. En los pasillos, la luz se acciona mediante pulsador en lugar de sensor de movimiento, por lo que pasas unos segundos de incertidumbre en la oscuridad hasta que lo encuentras.
La cocina es buena. Me tome unos estupendos filetes rusos, aunque el postre, una tarta de queso casera, era muy flojita.
Personal muy amable.
review_translated_text:
It seemed expensive (EU70) because I was traveling alone and there was only one triple room. Apart from that, the hotel is fine, with extraordinary views. The room was spacious and comfortable, with good beds. It's a shame that, throughout the hotel, they've opted for cold lighting, which makes everything feel more bleak and less inviting. In the hallways, the light is activated by a push button instead of a motion sensor, so you spend a few seconds in the dark trying to find it.
The food is good. I had some excellent Russian steaks, although the dessert, a homemade cheesecake, was very weak.
Very friendly staff.

name: Rafa Fernandez
review_text: Hotel con mucho encanto la atencion al cliente excepcional la comida excelente y a muy buen precio para repetir
review_translated_text: Hotel with a lot of charm, exceptional customer service, excellent food and at a very good price to repeat

name: jose andres gonzalez garcia
review_text: Sitio acogedor limpio con buen trato y comida abundante a buen precio.
review_translated_text: Cozy clean place with good service and abundant food at a good price.

name: Victor Moreno Pena
review_text:
Un sitio de 10. Buen servicio, habitaciones amplias, buenas vistas, no se puede pedir mas. Ademas, cenamos y desayunamos en el restaurante, y la comida muy buena y a buen precio.
El unico "defecto" que tiene es que, con un coche grande es dificil acceder para dejar maletas y asentarse, pero es parte del encanto del pueblo de Orbaneja, mas que un defecto es un consejo.
review_translated_text:
A place of 10. Good service, spacious rooms, good views, you couldn't ask for more. In addition, we had dinner and breakfast at the restaurant, and the food was very good and at a good price.
The only "defect" it has is that, with a large car, it is difficult to access to leave suitcases and settle, but it is part of the charm of the town of Orbaneja, more than a defect it is advice.

name: Garcia
review_text: Seria perfecto si no fuese porque al pueblo no se puede acceder con coche y son muchas cuestas para acceder al hotel ademas el coche lo mas cercano que se puede dejar es en la carretera y al lado del rio,la verdad es que tuve la sensacion de que lo dejaba abandonado y estuve intranquilo.por lo demas perfecto unas vistas espectaculares
review_translated_text: It would be perfect if it weren't for the fact that the town cannot be accessed by car and there are many hills to access the hotel. Furthermore, the closest thing you can leave the car is on the road and next to the river. The truth is that I had the feeling that I was leaving it abandoned and I was uneasy. Otherwise perfect, spectacular views

name: Maria
review_text: La casa esta bien, tiene buena ubicacion pero hay escasez de cosas. Papel higienico justo, no hay servilletas, ni panos, la limpieza brilla un poco por su ausencia. Para 4 personas se queda justita, solo hay un sofa, no tiene horno y la ducha es agobiante.
review_translated_text: The house is good, it has a good location but there is a shortage of things. Just enough toilet paper, there are no napkins or cloths, cleanliness is a bit conspicuous by its absence. For 4 people it is tight, there is only one sofa, it does not have an oven and the shower is overwhelming.

name: Estefania Gutierrez
review_text:
Cogimos 3 dias en este hotel y sin duda fue todo un acierto. El trato de todo el personal ha sido excelente tanto con nosotros como con los ninos 
Habitaciones super limpias, camas muy comodas y con unas vistas preciosas. Es un lugar muy tranquilo y acogedor. Las comidas son de calidad y de raciones generosas.
Repetiremos seguro!!
review_translated_text:
We spent 3 days in this hotel and it was undoubtedly a success. The treatment of all the staff has been excellent both with us and with the children 
Super clean rooms, very comfortable beds and beautiful views. It is a very quiet and cozy place. The meals are of quality and generous portions.
We will repeat for sure!!

name: Esteban Gonzalez Garcia
review_text: Excelente servicio de restaurante. Da gusto con chavales tan jovenes y atentos. El cachopo esta muy bueno.
review_translated_text: Excellent restaurant service. It's nice to have such young and attentive kids. The cachopo is very good.

name: Andres Illera
review_text: Mucha cantidad de comida y muy buena.
review_translated_text: Lots of food and very good.

name: Nacho Alonso Vinas
review_text: Los alojamientos super comodos, limpios y completos. La comida exquisita y el trato inmejorable. Las vistas, las instalaciones todo de 10. Muy recomendado.
review_translated_text: The accommodations are super comfortable, clean and complete. Exquisite food and unbeatable service. The views, the facilities, all 10. Highly recommended.

name: Mariyzq2 Iz
review_text: Tiene buenas vistas desde las habitaciones. Si aparcas el coche abajo del pueblo, sube lo necesario en una mochila.Cama y almohada comoda. No esta insonorizado, pero por la noche no se oye nada si tus vecinos de habitacion son silencios, lo que me molesto fue la luz de emergencia de la habitacion, pero suele pasar en algunos hoteles. Personal amable
review_translated_text: It has good views from the rooms. If you park your car below the village, pack the essentials in a backpack. The bed and pillow are comfortable. It's not soundproofed, but at night you can't hear anything if your roommates are quiet. What bothered me was the emergency light in the room, but that's common in some hotels. Friendly staff.

name: Belen Gutierrez
review_text: Fuimos a Orbaneja y tuvimos la suerte de sentirnos con animo para explorar el pueblo cuesta arriba. Encontramos esta joyita de lugar, donde comimos muy bien y con una vista estupenda. Y ademas, atendidos con simpatia.
review_translated_text: We went to Orbaneja and were lucky enough to feel up to exploring the town uphill. We found this little gem of a place, where we ate very well and had a wonderful view. And we also received friendly service.

name: Txomin Iturbe
review_text: Maravilloso si tienes buenas piernas
review_translated_text: Wonderful if you have good legs

name: Jose Agudelo Perez
review_text: Maravilloso hotel y maravilloso pueblo,volveria sin duda,ni un pero a poner
review_translated_text: Wonderful hotel and wonderful town, I would definitely return, not a single but to put

name: Natalia gozalo
review_text: Sitio muy tranquilo. Muy bien ubicado. Limpio y con bastante menaje en la cocina.
review_translated_text: Very quiet place. Very well located. Clean and with plenty of kitchenware.

name: Adolfo Moreno
review_text: Bien, casa rural sencilla , personal amable
review_translated_text: Good, simple rural house, friendly staff

name: Javier Martin
review_text: Personal muy amable, instalaciones bastante nuevas y limpias, buen desayuno.
review_translated_text: Very friendly staff, fairly new and clean facilities, good breakfast.

name: Carlos cano
review_text:
Sitio que merece realmente la pena! Ubicacion espectacular, instalaciones cuidadas, limpieza minuciosa, atencion cercana y calidad en sus desayunos y cenas!! Todo ello comandado por Ivan, gran persona dispuesta a ayudar en todo momento.
Volveremos sin dudarlo!!
review_translated_text:
Site that is really worth it! Spectacular location, well-kept facilities, meticulous cleaning, close attention and quality in their breakfasts and dinners!! All this commanded by Ivan, a great person willing to help at all times.
We will return without a doubt!!

name: Pasion Perez
review_text: Buena comida, a buen precio y con unas vistas inmejorables.
review_translated_text: Good food, at a good price and with unbeatable views.

name: David Rodriguez McDonough
review_text: Valoro muy positivamente nuestra estancia en este alojamientos. Nos gusto mucho el trato y la disposicion siempre amable y cercana de sus gestorxs y trabajadorxs. Disfrutamos del apartamento en el que nos alojamos, que contaba con todo lo necesario para una estancia de cuatro noches. Mencion especial para la comodidad de los colchones. No puedo terminar sin mencionar el notable servicio de restauracion del que disponen, cuya relacion calidad/precio es imbatible en la comarca, por lo que pudimos comprobar.
review_translated_text: I value our stay in this accommodation very positively. We really liked the treatment and the always friendly and close disposition of its managers and workers. We enjoyed the apartment we stayed in, which had everything we needed for a four-night stay. Special mention for the comfort of the mattresses. I cannot finish without mentioning the remarkable restaurant service they have, whose quality/price ratio is unbeatable in the region, from what we were able to verify.

name: Ubim
review_text: Lugar espectacular.  El apartamento muy completo  con unas vistas maravillosas. El personal  muy amable, la unica pega que no tiene acceso  para silla de ruedas,  pero por la estructura  del local,
review_translated_text: Spectacular place.  The apartment is very complete with wonderful views. The staff is very friendly, the only drawback is that it does not have wheelchair access, but due to the structure of the place,

name: Jeremias Perez Fernandez
review_text:
El hotel esta en un lugar magico, tanto, que es una aventura llegar. Recomiendo que dejen el coche abajo, en el parking y suban solo lo necesario. Pense que me empotraria en una casa.

La habitacion limpia, comoda, vistas espectaculares, con su secador y todo. Parecia recien reformado. Muy chula. La pega, pues no esta muy insonorizado, lo que no me molesto para dormir.

La gente del hotel super amable y atenta.

El desayuno es muy rico, con zumo de naranja natural. Y te lo sirven en tu mesa con vistas.

Gracias por todo!!!
review_translated_text:
The hotel is in a magical place, so much so that it is an adventure to get there. I recommend that you leave your car downstairs in the parking lot and only go up as necessary. I thought I would get stuck in a house.

The room was clean, comfortable, spectacular views, with its hairdryer and everything. It seemed recently renovated. Very cool. The downside is that it's not very soundproof, which didn't bother me when I slept.

The people at the hotel are super friendly and attentive.

The breakfast is very rich, with fresh orange juice. And they serve it to you at your table with a view.

Thanks for everything!!!

name: Fancisco Nogaledo
review_text: El lugar es maravilloso, tranquilo y muy fresco para pasear por el pueblo
review_translated_text: The place is wonderful, quiet and very cool to walk around the town

name: JOSE ANTONIO SERRANO
review_text:
Hotel muy confortable, tranquilo y ubicacion inigualable.
El personal muy amable y atento en todo momento.
Variedad de comida y bebidas.
review_translated_text:
Very comfortable, quiet hotel with an unbeatable location.
The staff was very friendly and attentive at all times.
A variety of food and drinks were available.

name: Ane Rojo Pereda
review_text: Vistas increibles de un pueblo precioso. Atencion increible y familiar. Recomendable 100% . Repetire seguro.
review_translated_text: Incredible views of a beautiful town. Incredible and familiar attention. 100% recommended. I will repeat for sure.

name: Paul Eins
review_text:
Freundlicher Empfang und gutes Essen.
Saubere Zimmer. Toller Ausblick.
review_translated_text:
Friendly welcome and good food.
Clean rooms. Great view.

review_text: Vistas increibles, el apto muy bien y muy limpio, nos atendieron muy bien. Cenamos el dia que llegamos y deberiamos haber cenado tb al dia siguiente. Fenomenal calidad y precio. La panceta Puebla muy buena.

review_text: Habitaciones correctas, buena atencion, buena cocina a precios razonables y lo mejor las diversas rutas para hacer caminando y disfrutar de la naturaleza. Recomendable.
review_translated_text: Decent rooms, good service, excellent cuisine at reasonable prices, and best of all, the various hiking trails to enjoy nature. Highly recommended.

name: Lucia Barcia
review_text: Mucha calidad y muy buen servicio.
review_translated_text: Very high quality and very good service.

name: Elena P
review_text:
Hotel muy acogedor en un sitio precioso. El personal amabilisimo y muy rica la comida.
Sugeriria algun gancho mas para colgar las cosas en el cuarto de bano. Y algun tipo de vehiculo pequeno portaequipaje a disposicion de los clientes, pues llevar el coche hasta el hotel es muy complicado; nosotros ni lo intentamos ya que llevabamos mochilas. Pero ascender con una maleta es dificil. Por lo demas, es un estupendo lugar.

Very cozy hotel in a beautiful place. Very friendly staff and very delicious food.
I would suggest some more hooks to hang things in the bathroom. And some type of small luggage vehicle available to clients, since taking the car to the hotel is very complicated; We didn't even try since we had backpacks. But ascending with a suitcase is difficult. Otherwise, it is a great place.

name: Cristina Aragon

review_text: Comimos muy bien con precio razonable, el camarero amable y agradable. Recomendado

review_text: Amabilidad, comida buena para desayunar y cenar, buenas vistas en la terraza y en las habitaciones. Only one drawback, if you take an attic, keep in mind that the taller the people are, the more uncomfortable they will be and from 25 degrees outside you will be hot inside. review_text: Una ubicacion estupenda, con vistas maravillosas. El apartamento muy comodo y el personal muy atento. Volveria sin dudarlo. Ademas,  admiten mascotas.
review_translated_text: A great location, with wonderful views. The apartment is very comfortable and the staff is very attentive. I would return without hesitation. Additionally, they allow pets.

name: Juan Riva
review_text: Increible sitio, trato genial, vistos espectaculares y habitacion perfecta para una estancia en pareja o familiar. Sobre todo recalcar el trato de una chica de recepcion que era encantadora. Un placer volveremos!
review_translated_text: Incredible place, great treatment, spectacular views and perfect room for a stay as a couple or family. Above all, I would like to highlight the treatment of a girl at the reception who was charming. A pleasure we will return!

name: M. Carmen Luque
review_text: El pueblo que se bonito, pero a nivel de servicios 0
review_translated_text: The town that is beautiful, but at a 0 level of services

name: Arturo Gomez
review_text: El trato por parte de los empleados ha sido exquisito. El servicio ha sido muy bueno en todo momento y la ubicacion en lo alto del pueblo y las vistas impresionantes. Hay que tener ojo en el acceso, la carretera es algo estrecha. Sin duda volveremos
review_translated_text: The staff was exceptional. The service was excellent throughout, and the location at the top of the village offers breathtaking views. Be careful when accessing the road; the road is somewhat narrow. We will definitely return.

name: INES
review_text: Un lugar idilico. El personal de hotel y restaurante muy amables. El pueblo de los mas bellos de ver. La primavera es un momento ideal de ver la cascada.
review_translated_text: An idyllic location. The hotel and restaurant staff are very friendly. The village is one of the most beautiful to see. Spring is an ideal time to see the waterfall.

name: CASUAL BOY
review_text: Lamentablemente Muy mala experiencia en esta casa rural. No recomiendo la habitacion abuhardillada salvo que midas 1,50 porque si los superas literalmente te das con el techo en el 70% de la estancia. La ducha no permite moverse, un nino de 8 anos se las ve para enjabonarse, un adulto literalmente debe de hacer la estatuta y enjabonarse encomendandose a los dioses. El fin de fiesta llega cuando decides apagar la luz para descansar y toda la habitacion queda iluminada con un panel de luz de emergencia muy bien pensado para que 2 luces intensas se te claven en los ojos cuando te preguntas que has echo tu para merecer eso. Por lo demas.. lo dejaremos en un;  Podrian mejorarse muchas cosas.
review_translated_text: Unfortunately, this was a very bad experience at this rural house. I don't recommend the attic room unless you're 1.50 meters tall, because if you're taller, you'll literally hit the ceiling for 70% of the room. The shower is too small to move; an 8-year-old struggles to soap up; an adult literally has to do the trick and soap up, praying to the gods. The end of the party comes when you decide to turn off the light to rest, and the entire room is illuminated by a very well-designed emergency light panel, so two intense lights shine in your eyes as you wonder what you did to deserve this. Otherwise, we'll just leave it at that; many things could be improved.

name: Inigo Riano
review_text: Ademas de la simpatia y amabilidad de tanto camareros, cocinera y responsable, una gran profesionalidad y una comida fantastica a un precio asequible a todos los bolsillos. La habitacion impoluta aunque no busques modernidad, es un hotel rural... Muy recomendable!!!!
response_from_owner_text: Muchas Gracias
review_translated_text: In addition to the friendliness and kindness of the waiters, cook and manager, great professionalism and fantastic food at a price affordable for all budgets. The room is spotless even if you are not looking for modernity, it is a rural hotel... Highly recommended!!!!
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much

name: Marce Olaziregi
review_text: Un pueblo que hay que ver , el hotel en un sitio espectacular , estuvimos alojados en la habitacion 6 , espaciosa con vistas al exterior , bano amplio y limpio , la cocina un 10 ,  personal y el propio dueno no se les puede superar , volvere y lo recomendare , MUCHAS GRACIAS
review_translated_text: A town that must be seen, the hotel is in a spectacular location, we stayed in room 6, spacious with views to the outside, large and clean bathroom, the kitchen a 10, staff and the owner himself cannot be surpassed, I will return and recommend it, THANK YOU VERY MUCH

name: Ruben Lastra
review_text: He estado en el servicio de cafeteria y buena atencion y servicio
review_translated_text: I have been in the cafeteria service and good attention and service

name: Xabier Iriondo
review_text:
Un dia muy caluroso, el pueblo precioso pero cuando llegamos a tomar un trago nos invitaron a sentarnos y cuando pedimos la bebida nos dijeron que ni habia raciones con la escusa de que el comedor estaba lleno, acto seguido vino una pareja y les ofrecieron raciones algo que me parecio una falta de respeto tremenda, no le pongo menos nota porque no se puede
Recalco, el pueblo precioso merece mucho la pena venir!!!
response_from_owner_text: Justo en ese momento tuvimos una cancelacion por telefono, y en ese momento decidimos aceptar a los siguientes que llegaran.
review_translated_text:
A very hot day, the town was beautiful, but when we arrived to get a drink, they invited us to sit down and when we ordered drinks, they told us there were no portions, with the excuse that the dining room was full. A couple came right after and offered them portions, which I found extremely disrespectful. I'm not giving it a lower rating because I can't.
I emphasize, the beautiful town is well worth a visit!!!
response_from_owner_translated_text: Just then we had a cancellation over the phone, and at that point we decided to accept the next arrivals.

name: Sergi Cantenys
review_text:
De entrada decir que esta opinion es sobre los administradores del hotel y no del establecimiento en si que no pude llegar a visitar.

En resumen, tenia una reserva en el establecimiento y dos dias antes de ir, por un tragico fallecimiento de un familiar me vi obligado a cancelar la. Sabiendo que no se podia reembolsar ni cancelar (segun las condiciones del hotel), me puse en contacto con el hotel con la esperanza de encontrar algo de humanidad, comprension y empatia por parte del hotel, y que pudiesen cambiarme las fechas para ir en otra ocasion. Y ahi llego la sorpresa: he tratado con contestadores automaticos mas humanos y empaticos que la persona que me atendio. Ni una sola palabra de empatia en sus mensajes. Cito textualmente su mensaje: "Lo sentimos, pero la reserva no es reembolsable de ninguna manera."
Tratando asi a sus clientes no creo que le importe mucho fidelizarlos. Pues por 70 piojosos euros que me ha cobrado, ha perdido a una familia de clientes y toda la posible gente que hubiese recomendado. Y se de lo que hablo, porque mi familia lleva mas de 40 anos trabajando en la hosteleria con 1 hotel y 4 restaurantes.
Espero que esto sirva de aviso por si vuelven a tratar algun nuevo cliente de la misma manera, que no se extrane a nadie.

Un saludo.
response_from_owner_text: Saludos, lamentamos mucho lo ocurrido. Simplemente queremos aclarar que nuestro personal de recepcion ha tratado el asunto de la forma mas asertiva posible debida la situacion, comprendemos tu frustracion pero nosotros no podemos aplicar excepciones a las cancelaciones fuera de plazo.
review_translated_text:
First of all, this review is about the hotel's management, not the establishment itself, which I was unable to visit.

In short, I had a reservation at the hotel, and two days before my arrival, due to the tragic death of a family member, I was forced to cancel it. Knowing that I couldn't refund or cancel (according to the hotel's policies), I contacted the hotel hoping to find some humanity, understanding, and empathy from the hotel, and that they might be able to reschedule my stay for another time. And then came the surprise: I dealt with answering machines that were more humane and empathetic than the person who helped me. Not a single word of empathy in their messages. I quote their message verbatim: "We're sorry, but the reservation is non-refundable under any circumstances."
By treating their customers like this, I don't think they care much about building loyalty. For the lousy 70 euros they charged me, they've lost a family of customers and all the potential people I would have recommended. And I know what I'm talking about, because my family has been in the hospitality industry for over 40 years, with one hotel and four restaurants.
I hope this serves as a warning in case they treat any new customers the same way again; no one should be surprised.

Best regards.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Greetings, we are deeply sorry for what happened. We simply want to clarify that our reception staff has handled the matter as assertively as possible given the situation. We understand your frustration, but we cannot make exceptions for late cancellations.

name: silvis sd
review_text: La habitacion es enorme!! Muy limpia. El personal son muy correctos y educados. Las vistas impresionantes, que mas....ven y disfrutalo tu mismo sin que nadie te lo cuente
review_translated_text: The room is huge!! Very clean. The staff are very correct and polite. The impressive views, what else...come and enjoy it yourself without anyone telling you about it

response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much

name: Miguel Ruiz
review_text: Precioso
review_translated_text: Precious

name: Maika Hernandez Perez
review_text:
Un lugar entranable, con un servicio de personal ...prudente, carinoso y eficaz.

Una maravilla, volveremos
review_translated_text:

Wonderful, we'll be back.

name: Manuel Alonso Villar
review_text: Ojo con este establecimiento, piden pago por adelantado en la reserva, establecen un checking hasta las 21:00h y aunque llame para avisar que llegaria mas tarde de esa hora, se negaron a facilitarte el poder entrar mas tarde, simplemente te.indican que lo sienten mucho pero has perdido los 65 euros y directamente aprovechan y te cancelan la reserva. Muy patetico teniendo en cuenta que tenia alojamiento de esa noche y el desayuno. que pasa?, mas tarde de las 21:00 no me das habitacion? pero tampoco puedo ir a tomar los desayunos que tambien he pagado? Se aprovechan de la gente porque finalmente he tenido que pagar un segundo hotel en Burgos, el Alda Cardena, que aunque tiene checking hasta las 00:00 ademas si llegas de noche como me paso a mi, te facilitan entrar por telefono y te dejan las llaves en un buzon, como tiene que ser.
response_from_owner_text: Estimado cliente, nuestros horarios son claros y estan expuestos en todos los lugares donde estamos anunciados como tambien lo estan en tu reserva. Queremos recordar que a la hora de formalizar reserva estas aceptando estas condiciones. Por otro lado, tiene que quedar claro que la reserva no fue cancelada hasta pasada la medianoche, lo que quiere decir que si hubieras llegado en hora tu reserva hubiera seguido siendo valida. Lo que no puedes pretender es que el mismo dia de tu llegada nos llames sobre las 19:00 de la tarde y quieras imponernos un horario diferente (llegada sobre las 2.00 de la madrugada) solo para satisfacer una necesidad puntual tuya, ni que dejemos una llave desprotegida vulnerando la seguridad del resto de nuestros huespedes.
review_translated_text: Be careful with this establishment, they ask for advance payment in the reservation, they establish a check-in until 9:00 p.m. and although I called to let them know that I would arrive later than that time, they refused to allow you to enter later, they simply tell you that they are very sorry but you have lost the 65 euros and they directly take advantage and cancel your reservation. Very pathetic considering I had that night's accommodation and breakfast. What's wrong? You won't give me a room after 9:00 p.m.? But I can't go to have the breakfasts that I have also paid for? They take advantage of people because I finally had to pay for a second hotel in Burgos, the Alda Cardena, which, although it has check-in until 00:00, also if you arrive at night like what happened to me, they make it easier for you to enter by phone and leave the keys in a mailbox, as it should be.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Dear guest, our opening hours are clearly stated in all our listed locations, as well as on your reservation. We want to remind you that by making a reservation, you agree to these terms and conditions. It must also be made clear that the reservation was not canceled until after midnight, which means that if you had arrived on time, your reservation would still have been valid. You cannot expect to call us around 7:00 p.m. on the day of your arrival and force us to change the time (arrival around 2:00 a.m.) just to accommodate a specific need, nor can we expect to leave a key unsecured, compromising the security of our other guests.

name: Diana Velasco
review_text: Es una casa rustica, de encanto, la habitacion muy limpia, la cena casera muy rica, tanto el rabo como las croquetas, el desayuno espectacular, muy atentos, muy recomendable , muchas gracias.
review_translated_text: It is a rustic, charming house, the room is very clean, the homemade dinner is very delicious, both the tail and the croquettes, the breakfast is spectacular, very attentive, highly recommended, thank you very much.

name: Emp 89
review_text: Sitio espectacular , con unas vistas preciosas, comimos chuletillas que eran plato del dia y estaban buenisimas ,el postre casero tambien , y el precio es mas que asequible. Por poner una pega , la cuesta hasta llegas jjj que de eso no tiene culpa el restaurante! Volvere

The homemade dessert was also delicious, and the price was more than reasonable. The only drawback is the steep slope to get there, which isn't the restaurant's fault! I'll be back.

name: Ronald Yague

The bed is comfortable, the bathroom is warm. Hearty breakfast, delicious coffee. We were very pleased. Highly recommend

review_text: Tres dias magnificos, expectacular lugar, para pasar unos dias en la naturaleza. El hotel "La Puebla" muy bonito, limpio, atendidos por gente muy amable y educada y la comida rica y abundante, los precios muy razonable, en definitiva  volveremos!!!.

name: Renatabeatriz EZQUERRA SANZ
review_text: Excepcional... Atencion estupenda.. Sitio maravilloso y personal magnifico

review_text: Sitio encantador, el chico super amable y atento. Un lugar muy tranquilo, con una cena estupenda. Hay que tener en cuenta que el acceso no es nada facil.
review_translated_text: Lovely place, the guy was super friendly and attentive. A very quiet place, with a great dinner. It must be taken into account that access is not easy at all.

name: R A
review_text: Todo genial tanto las habitaciones como las comidas y desayuno ,y el trato fabuloso

name: Alma Lopez
review_text: Atencion exquisito. No tiene aparcamiento. Comedor excepcional. Los platos abundantes y ricos. Desayuno fantastico

name: Daniel
review_text:
Pesima experiencia.

NO VOLVERE NI A PLANTEARME RESERVAR DE NUEVO CON ELLOS
review_translated_text:

name: Cristina Garcia
review_text: Precioso sitio, muy complicado meter el coche x calles super estrechas pero si lo consigues el pueblo es espectacular, la cueva del agua, la cascada de Orbaneja... name: FERNANDO SANCHEZ
review_text: El trato, la comida, todo excepcional.
