name: Jose Miguel Garcia Gutierrez
review_text: Hemos estado tres dias, entre semana, a finales de Octubre. Sitio agradable, bonito, limpio, tranquilo, buen trato. Desayuno abundante incluido en el precio. Cena variada y bien de precio. Entorno espectacular, paraiso para senderistas.
review_translated_text: We stayed three days, during the week, at the end of October. Nice place, beautiful, clean, quiet, good treatment. Hearty breakfast included in the price. Varied and well priced dinner. Spectacular environment, paradise for hikers.

name: Carmina Del Moral
review_text: Buenas vistas!!!
review_translated_text: Good views!!!

name: Nacho Verde
review_text: Un hotel perdido en la montana pero no pierde el encanto y la perfeccion a la hora de servir buenos platos o darte las llaves de una habitacion acogedora, la unica pega (y por ponerla) es que las almohadas son un poco duras.
review_translated_text: A hotel lost in the mountains, but it doesn't lose its charm and perfection when it comes to serving good dishes or giving you the keys to a cozy room. The only drawback (and I have to mention it) is that the pillows are a bit hard.

name: Karen Martinez
review_text: Fantastic place ( apart from the  hill!!!)Bed was really comfortable.Food in restaurant was very good.Staff polite and efficient.Best thing were the spectacular views.I would return
response_from_owner_text: Thanks

name: Dolors Vaghi Tutusaus
review_text: Hotel situado en un lugar precioso.Hemos estado 8 dias haciendo senderismo x la zona y nos han atendido super bien, personal muy amable, comida abundante y muy buena. Buen desayuno. Totalmente recomendable.
review_translated_text: Hotel located in a beautiful location. We spent eight days hiking in the area and received excellent service. The staff was very friendly, and the food was plentiful and delicious. A good breakfast. Highly recommended.

name: Juan Jose Ponce Pereira
review_text: Buen servicio y atencion. Muy amables. Y el sitio inmejorable.
review_translated_text: Good service and attention. Very friendly. And the unbeatable place.

name: marina gutierrez ruiz
review_text: Habitaciones muy limpias. Desayuno super completo y buen restaurante con raciones caseras a buen precio. Las vistas y el entorno son preciosas. Y el trato de los trabajadores muy cercano. Un gusto!
review_translated_text: Very clean rooms. Super complete breakfast and good restaurant with homemade portions at a good price. The views and surroundings are beautiful. And the treatment of the workers is very close. A pleasure!

name: Anji
review_text: El apartamento esta fenomenal. Tiene unas vistas que son una pasada. Muy limpio, bonito y totalmente equipado con lo que necesites. Ademas, la comida del restaurante es muy buena y son muy atentos.
response_from_owner_text: Gracias
review_translated_text: The apartment is phenomenal. It has views that are amazing. Very clean, beautiful and fully equipped with whatever you need. In addition, the restaurant's food is very good and they are very attentive.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you

name: Agustin Fernandez Marcos
review_text: Multiples apartamentos y casas rurales en un entorno natural espectacular, muy bien dotadas, acceso en coche un poco dificil pero solventable
response_from_owner_text: Gracias
review_translated_text: Multiple apartments and rural houses in a spectacular natural setting, very well equipped, access by car a little difficult but manageable
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you

name: Belen Morla Carrera
review_text: Hotel normalito , pero tiene unas vistas inmejorables , desayuno muy completo ,camarera muy servicial y simpatica , lastima que no tuve habitacion con vistas
response_from_owner_text: Gracias
review_translated_text: Average hotel, but it has unbeatable views, very complete breakfast, very helpful and friendly waitress, it's a shame I didn't have a room with a view
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you

name: Pilar Hermosa
review_text: Muy limpio, acogedor, con vistas preciosas, buena atencion y fantastico desayuno.
response_from_owner_text: Gracias
review_translated_text: Very clean, cozy, with beautiful views, good service and a fantastic breakfast.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you

name: J.R. B.R.
review_text: Amabilidad. Restaurante. Desayuno y un entorno espectacular. Orbaneja del Castillo.
review_translated_text: Kindness. Restaurant. Breakfast and a spectacular environment. Orbaneja del Castillo.

name: Alberto Lacasta
review_text: Hotel totalmente recomendable , muy limpio , Habitacion correcta , y amabilidad a raudales ,en la recepcion nos informaron tanto como en una oficina de turismo , ENCANTADORES
review_translated_text: Totally recommendable hotel, very clean, correct room, and abundant kindness, at the reception they informed us as much as in a tourist office, CHARMING

name: Esther De Miguel
review_text: Bonito hotel rustico, habitaciones comodas y limpias. El desayuno bueno y rapido. El trato amable. Tiene tb restaurante, cenamos a base de raciones muy bien. Tiene una terraza con vistas muy bonitas.
review_translated_text: A lovely rustic hotel with comfortable, clean rooms. Breakfast was good and quick. The service was friendly. It also has a restaurant; we had a very well-portioned dinner. It has a terrace with beautiful views.

name: Jose Exposito Vilela
review_text: Se encuentra en la parte superior de este bonito pueblo y ofrece unas vistas estupendas al entorno, el servicio muy amable y atento.
review_translated_text: It is located at the top of this beautiful town and offers great views of the surroundings, very friendly and attentive service.

name: Julian Ruiz
review_text: Un hotel con encanto. Las vistas desde sus ventanas a las hoces del Ebro son espectaculares, ademas de las vistas desde la terraza del bar-restaurante. El personal muy atento y amable en todo momento. La serenidad que te da observar desde su terraza mirador como anochece mientras disfrutas de una magnifica cena y con el sonido de los torrentes del Ebro por las hoces.
review_translated_text: A charming hotel. The views from its windows of the Ebro gorges are spectacular, as are the views from the bar-restaurant terrace. The staff is always attentive and friendly. The serenity of watching the sunset from the viewing terrace while you enjoy a magnificent dinner and the sound of the Ebro torrents rushing through the gorges.

name: jovino rodriguez
review_text: Tiene buenas vistas y buena carta en un pueblo con encanto
review_translated_text: It has good views and a good menu in a charming town

name: Cristina Sastre
review_text:
Estupendo alojamiento. Atencion muy buena. Todo ordenado, limpio, cuidado... Sencillo y natural como su enclave.
El desayuno es muy abundante y equilibrado al mismo tiempo, ademas de rico. Las cena tambien. Carta breve y acertada. Esto le aporta un plus de comodidad.
Para repetir
review_translated_text:
Great accommodation. Very good attention. Everything organized, clean, cared for... Simple and natural like its enclave.
The breakfast is very abundant and balanced at the same time, as well as delicious. Dinner too. Brief and accurate letter. This gives you extra comfort.
To repeat

name: Tamara QF
review_text: Tanto el sitio como el servicio, muy acogedores. La ubicacion tiene unas vistas estupendas. La habitacion muy limpia. A destacar el restaurante. La comida estaba buenisima.
review_translated_text: Both the site and the service, very welcoming. The location has great views. The room very clean. To highlight the restaurant. The food was very good.

name: Vanessa Rey
review_text: El hotel muy comodo, buena comida, tienen una atencion 10, muy cordiales, excelente atencion. Volveria a repetir!!
review_translated_text: The hotel is very comfortable, good food, they have 10 attention, very cordial, excellent service. I would repeat again!!

name: MARIA JOSE DOMINGO SORIA
review_text: No recomendado para personas con movilidad reducida debido a las cuestas de la zona y el acceso tanto al hotel, casa y apartamentos. Esta genial para descansar y con unas vistas espectaculares. Fuimos una noche 4 personas y nos alojamos en la vivienda de uso turistico que pertenece al hotel. Todo genial y limpio, muy comodo. La atencion del personal fue estupenda y todos muy amables. Recomendado.
review_translated_text: Not recommended for people with reduced mobility due to the hills in the area and the access to the hotel, house, and apartments. It's a great place to relax and enjoy spectacular views. Four of us stayed for one night in the hotel's tourist accommodation. Everything was great, clean, and very comfortable. The staff was wonderful, and everyone was very friendly. Recommended.

name: Alanus Ur
review_text: Un hotel rural con habitaciones muy bonitas, limpias, un gran desayuno y buena atencion. Tambien destacaria el bar y las generosas raciones para cenar. Esta en la parte mas alta del pueblo, por lo que hay subir una buena cuesta a pie, pero sus maravillosas vistas hacen que merezca la pena.
review_translated_text: A rural hotel with very nice, clean rooms, a great breakfast, and excellent service. I'd also highlight the bar and the generous portions for dinner. It's located in the highest part of the village, so there's a steep climb, but the wonderful views make it worth it.

name: Maria Moreno
review_text: Muy recomendable. Sin duda un lugar para guardar y volver. La casa esta genial, tiene de todo y muy limpia. Esta distribuida en 3 plantas pero las escaleras tienen barandilla, ibamos con una persona mayor y podia bajar bien. La casa esta en lo alto de todo del pueblo. Pero hace que las vistas sean espectaculares. El trato del personal fantastico muy agradable. La cena y desayuno alli recomendable.
review_translated_text: Highly recommended. Without a doubt a place to save and return. The house is great, it has everything and very clean. It is distributed over 3 floors but the stairs have a railing, we were with an elderly person and he could go down well. The house is at the top of everything in the town. But it makes the views spectacular. The fantastic staff treatment, very pleasant. Dinner and breakfast there recommended.

name: Bego A.G.
review_text: Precioso hotel con buenas vistas del entorno de orbaneja. Buena atencion y muy buen desayuno.
review_translated_text: Beautiful hotel with good views of the surroundings of Orbaneja. Good service and very good breakfast.

name: elena Espana smirnova
review_text:
Fuimos para una noche, el trato qie recibimos fue correcto. Al llegar tan cansadas, cenamos tambien en el restaurante que tienen ellos. La cena fue espectacular ademas con unas vistas impresionantes.
La verdad que en este sitio se duerme super bien, ya que es muy tranquilo y es para desconectar y descansar, ademas de que en el pueblo no teniamos ni cobertura.
Al dia siguiente nos dieron un desayuno super completo, y el check-out fue facilisimo.
review_translated_text:
We went for one night, and the service we received was excellent. Since we arrived so tired, we also had dinner at their restaurant. Dinner was spectacular, with breathtaking views.
The truth is that you sleep incredibly well here, as it's very quiet and perfect for relaxing and unwinding, and we didn't even have any cell phone service in town.
The next day we were given a super-full breakfast, and check-out was a breeze.

name: Avelino Martinez Gonzalez
review_text: Magnifica atencion y extraordinaria ubicacion. Parada obligada para quienes quieran disfrutar del enorme espectaculo que la naturaleza nos ofrece en este paraje del canon del rio Ebro. Las apetitosas viandas que ofrece este establecimiento hotelero Unido al trabajo y la amabilidad de cuantos lo atienden merece el reconocimiento a su profesionalidad. Las estancias ya sea de sus apartamentos o habitaciones estan muy pulcras y acogedoras.
review_translated_text: Magnificent service and extraordinary location. A must-visit for those who want to enjoy the magnificent spectacle that nature offers in this spot in the Ebro River canyon. The delicious food offered by this hotel, combined with the work and friendliness of all its staff, deserves recognition for their professionalism. The rooms and apartments are very clean and welcoming.

name: Emilio Tagui
review_text: Camareros muy amables y muy buen trato y comida excelente......y con unas vistas envidiables.
review_translated_text: Very friendly waiters and very good treatment and excellent food......and with enviable views.

name: Pablo Zabala
review_text: Los postres no son caseros, por lo demas todo muy bien.
review_translated_text: The desserts are not homemade, otherwise everything is very good.

name: PWR-_-ItzCaillou
review_text: Sitio acogedor y si lo que necesitas es tranquilidad, este es tu lugar.
review_translated_text: Cozy place and if what you need is tranquility, this is your place.

name: Jose Antonio
review_text: Merece la pena subir la cuesta hasta este hotel restaurante. Vistas impresionantes hacia el canon del Ebro. Espectacular el cachopo de cecina y queso y riquisimas las croquetas de morcilla de Burgos, la pinta de cerveza Alhambra bien fresquita entra sola. Habitacion en atico pero muy comoda al igual que la cama y el bano. Desayuno variado y completo. Trato amable y atento. Sin duda para repetir cuando volvamos por la zona, lo recomendamos.
review_translated_text: It is worth going up the hill to this hotel-restaurant. Impressive views towards the Ebro canyon. The cachopo of cured meat and cheese is spectacular and the Burgos blood sausage croquettes are delicious, the pint of very cold Alhambra beer goes alone. Attic room but very comfortable as well as the bed and bathroom. Varied and complete breakfast. Friendly and attentive treatment. Without a doubt to repeat when we return to the area, we recommend it.

name: Juan Merino
review_text:
Todo muy bueno.
El aparcamiento escaso
review_translated_text:
All very good.
Scarce parking

name: Veronica Sanchez Marcos
review_text: Nos ha encantado trato, la ubicacion, entorno, instalaciones y servicios. Totalmente recomendable. Volveremos
review_translated_text: We loved the treatment, the location, surroundings, facilities and services. Totally recommended. We will return

name: Maribel Bermejo Mudarra
review_text: Todo perfecto, alojamiento y comida y personas muy agradables.
review_translated_text: Everything perfect, accommodation and food and very nice people.

name: Fernando Cruz
review_text: Alojamiento perfecto para visitar el pueblo de Orbaneja. Estuvimos en el hotel, en julio. A destacar la limpieza de sus habitaciones y su terraza para comer o cenar, con unas vistas asombrosas. El personal muy atento. El restaurante con unos precios muy acomodados y raciones generosas ademas de que estaba todo muy bueno. Recomendable sin dudas.
review_translated_text: Perfect accommodation to visit the town of Orbaneja. We were at the hotel in July. To highlight the cleanliness of its rooms and its terrace for lunch or dinner, with amazing views. Very attentive staff. The restaurant had very reasonable prices and generous portions, plus everything was very good. Recommended without a doubt.

name: Belen Villarejo
review_text:
Tuvimos un problema con la reserva del hotel, el personal de la recepcion no comprobo la reserva tras nuestra llamada dos dias antes y aunque fue error nuestro, si el hubiera hecho bien su trabajo se podria haber solucionado.
En ningun momento nos ayudo.
response_from_owner_text: Saludos, como bien reconoceis despues de varios comentarios en diferentes webs el error es vuestro, la "ayuda" que solicitasteis es que el establecimiento asumiera los costes de vuestro error, cosa que no podemos hacer.
review_translated_text:
We had a problem with our hotel reservation. The front desk staff didn't check the reservation after we called two days before. Although it was our mistake, if they had done their job properly, it could have been resolved.
They didn't help us at any point.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Greetings, as you've clearly recognized after several comments on various websites, the error is yours. The "help" you requested is for the establishment to assume the costs of your error, which we cannot do.

name: Daniel Barrios
review_text:
Como otros clientes tuvimos un problema con la reserva y por la negligencia del personal de recepcion salimos perdiendo...TODO EL PROBLEMA SE PODIA HABER EVITADO si esta persona, cuando respondio a nuestra llamada 2 dias antes de la reserva, hubiese chequeado la reserva pero NO LE DEBIA APETECER MUCHO REVISAR LA RESERVA.
Lamentable.

Ademas la habitacion algo sucia, el cachopo muy muy grasiento y el bizcocho del desayuno ya tenia un par de dias...

Lastima porque el sitio tiene mucho potencial y bien gestionado seria una maravilla de lugar.

Se salvan las vistas y las 2 camareras.
response_from_owner_text: Saludos, simplemente aclarar que el problema con la reserva fue responsabilidad unicamente y exclusivamente de vuestra parte al no comprobar las fechas para vuestra estancia, el establecimiento cumplio con el contenido contratado por ustedes y por ello los costes generados por este error lo tuvieron que asumir ustedes.
review_translated_text:
Like other guests, we had a problem with the reservation, and due to the negligence of the reception staff, we lost out... THE WHOLE PROBLEM COULD HAVE BEEN AVOIDED if this person, when they answered our call two days before the reservation, had checked the reservation, but they probably didn't feel like checking it.
Regrettable.

Also, the room was a bit dirty, the cachopo was very, very greasy, and the breakfast cake was already a couple of days old...

It's a shame because the place has a lot of potential and if managed well, it would be a wonderful place.

The only positives are the views and the two waitresses.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Greetings, I would like to clarify that the problem with the reservation was solely and exclusively your responsibility for not checking the dates for your stay. The establishment fulfilled the content you contracted, and therefore you had to assume the costs generated by this error.

name: Jose Manuel Sanz Ibanez
review_text: Espectacular sitio para conocerlo,la gente sumamente maja,el sitio espectacular y se come fenomenal,muy buen desayuno,repetiremos
review_translated_text: Spectacular place to visit, the people are extremely nice, the place is spectacular and the food is phenomenal, very good breakfast, we will repeat

name: Luis Val Mar
review_text: Merece la pena subir hasta arriba del pueblo por las vistas.  Y la tranquilidad, buena comida
review_translated_text: It's worth climbing to the top of the village for the views. And the tranquility, good food.

name: Jose Antonio Lopez Marin
review_text: Maravilloso lugar y el personal fantastico, su comida fue toda una sorpresa, muy muy buena recomendable 100%
review_translated_text: Wonderful place and fantastic staff, their food was a surprise, very very good 100% recommended

name: jaime rodriguez mateo
review_text: Buen trato, buena comida, buen descanso y buenas vistas. Hemos quedado encantados
review_translated_text: Great service, good food, good rest, and great views. We were delighted.

name: Miren Lopez
review_text: Es literalmente subir a la montana, la parte mas alta y con vistas mas espectaculares, para comer, cenar en su terraza. Ahora subir con el coche, tiene su aquel, mejor estar en forma y tener seguridad al  conducir. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: It is literally going up the mountain, the highest part and with the most spectacular views, to eat and dine on the terrace. Now getting in the car has its own advantages, it is better to be in shape and have confidence when driving. Highly recommended.

name: Su La Torre
review_text: Un hotel con encanto , bien conservado, con muchos detalles y vistas espectaculares, aunque sea una odisea llegar alli, vale la pena ir, 100 x 100 recomendable, personal muy atento. Desayuno incluido en el precio. Es un sitio para repetir.
review_translated_text: A charming, well-maintained hotel with many details and spectacular views. Even though it's a bit of an ordeal to get there, it's worth it. 100% recommended. The staff is very attentive. Breakfast is included in the price. It's a place I'll definitely stay again.

name: Daniel Estrada
review_text: Precio alto para la calidad.
review_translated_text: High price for quality.

name: jose manuel
review_text: Buen sitio para pasar unos dias
review_translated_text: Good place to spend a few days

name: Eleonora Vanyova Radulova
review_text: Excelente relacion calidad/precio. Atencion muy cercana y amable. La comida casera, platos grandes, no caro. El desayuno variado y las vistas espectaculares! Se supone que estaba lleno, pero dormimos genial sin escuchar ruidos.  Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Excellent quality/price ratio. Very close and friendly attention. Homemade food, large dishes, not expensive. Varied breakfast and spectacular views! It was supposed to be full, but we slept great without hearing any noise.  Highly recommended.

name: Ignacio Pulido
review_text: Se trata de un lugar estupendo en el que desconectar. Esta enclavado en lo alto de Orbaneja del Castillo. Se llega en coche, aunque las calles del pueblo son muy estrechas y empinadas. Sus empleados son muy atentos y las instalaciones estan genial. En los espacios comunes se respetan con celo las medidas anticovid. Tambien ofrecen comidas y cenas. La relacion calidad - precio es la adecuada. Su desayuno es estupendo. Posee una bonita terraza.
review_translated_text: It is a great place to disconnect. It is located at the top of Orbaneja del Castillo. You can get there by car, although the streets of the town are very narrow and steep. Their employees are very attentive and the facilities are great. Anti-covid measures are carefully respected in common spaces. They also offer lunch and dinner. The quality-price ratio is adequate. Their breakfast is great. It has a nice terrace.

name: Isa Sanchez
review_text: Solo estuvimos  una noche,  pero super relajante, el entorno espectacular y las instalaciones muy limpias
review_translated_text: We only stayed one night, but it was super relaxing, the surroundings were spectacular and the facilities were very clean.

name: Milagros Cifre Andreu
review_text: Espectacular , trato muy bueno y estancias muy buenas , lo recomendamos
review_translated_text: Spectacular, very good treatment and very good stays, we recommend it

name: Veronica Gonzalez
review_text: Muy buena atencion por parte del personal. Desayunos espectaculares y muy completos. Las vistas desde el mismo muy bonitas. Un buen lugar para descansar, desconectar, y disfrutar de un entorno maravilloso
review_translated_text: Very good attention from the staff. Spectacular and very complete breakfasts. The views from it are very beautiful. A good place to rest, disconnect, and enjoy a wonderful environment

name: Antonio Garcia Valdeolivas
review_text: Muy atentos. Buena comida y abundante.
review_translated_text: Very attentive. Good food and plenty of it.

name: Fede Del Valle
review_text: Excelentes vistas. Bien cuidado y bien atendido. Muy amables
review_translated_text: Excellent views. Well maintained and well-staffed. Very friendly.

name: KL Dance
review_text: Muy aconsejable. Acogedor y muy limpio. Sin duda recomendable 100%
review_translated_text: Highly recommended. Cozy and very clean. Definitely 100% recommended.

name: Jorge
review_text: Llegamos con las bicis haciendo el GR del Ebro por etapas y nos atendieron de lujo. Nos guardaron las bicis y el lugar es impresionante. Muy amables.
review_translated_text: We arrived on bikes while completing the GR Ebro in stages, and they treated us wonderfully. They stored our bikes for us, and the location is impressive. Very friendly.

name: BEGONA JIMENEZ GARCIA
review_text: Perfecto para alojarse, desayunar y cenar. Vistas fantasticas. Buena comida, buena atencion. Muy recomendable
review_translated_text: Perfect to stay, have breakfast and dinner. Fantastic views. Good food, good service. Highly recommended

name: Julio Pascual
review_text: Lugar encantador, trato fenomenal, personal super amable y desayuno y cena de primera
review_translated_text: Charming place, phenomenal treatment, super friendly staff and first-class breakfast and dinner

name: Fco. Javier Mas Albert
review_text:
La ubicacion del Hotel es espectacular y muy limpio.
La comida buena y la atencion perfecta.
Tengo que resaltar el Servicio de comidas como los desayunos, Fanny se encarga del servicio y la verdad que muy rapida y atenta.
No dejeis de preguntar a Ivan para que os recomiende sitios para caminar y pasar un dia fabuloso.
Estuvimos dos noches y todo perfecto; volvere al mismo sitio para seguir descubriendo la zona.
review_translated_text:
The location of the Hotel is spectacular and very clean.
Good food and perfect service.
I have to highlight the food service such as breakfast, Fanny is in charge of the service and is really very fast and attentive.
Be sure to ask Ivan to recommend places to walk and spend a fabulous day.
We stayed two nights and everything was perfect; I will return to the same place to continue discovering the area.

name: Joaquin Perez Piera
review_text: Hotel rural en un entorno muy bonito. Instalaciones cuidadas. Amabilidad del personal. Platos bien elaborados y raciones generosas. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Rural hotel in a beautiful setting. Well-maintained facilities. Friendly staff. Well-prepared dishes and generous portions. Highly recommended.

name: JOSE FELIX ZAMANILLO
review_text: Buen trato y excelente comida
review_translated_text: Good treatment and excellent food

name: dolores serrano
review_text: Muy amables,se come fenomenal,platos muy generosos y ricos.Muy bien de precios y respetan super bien medidas covid.
review_translated_text: Very friendly, great food, very generous and delicious dishes. Very good prices and they respect covid measures very well.

name: Sergio Serrano Gomez
review_text: X un fallo suyo al reservar x telefono pagan el pato los clientes. Tened mucho cuidado al reservar telefonicamente.
response_from_owner_text:
Saludos, nuestro establecimiento garantiza a sus clientes las condiciones, precios, y fechas de la reservas a traves del procedimiento de confirmacion de reserva que es vinculante para todas las partes y que ademas realizamos por dos vias diferentes (correo electronico y WhatsApp). Por ello es imprescindible comprobar la confirmacion de reserva. En vuestro caso particular, ustedes cometieron el error de no comprobar la confirmacion de reserva generando un perjuicio para las dos partes pero el cual, y sintiendolo mucho, es responsabilidad exclusivamente vuestra.

Un saludo cordial.
review_translated_text: Because of a mistake on your part when booking by phone, the customers pay the price. Be very careful when booking by phone.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Greetings, our establishment guarantees its guests the conditions, prices, and dates of reservations through the reservation confirmation process, which is binding on all parties and is carried out via two different channels (email and WhatsApp). Therefore, it is essential to check the reservation confirmation. In your particular case, you made the mistake of not checking the reservation confirmation, causing harm to both parties, but which, I regret, is solely your responsibility.

Best regards.

name: ALICIA SAN ROMAN
review_text: El hotel esta muy bien situado, una terraza preciosa. La habitacion sencilla , el pueblo y los entornos don preciosos
review_translated_text: The hotel is very well located, a beautiful terrace. The simple room, the town and the beautiful surroundings

name: Azucena Antolin Alvarez
review_text: Maravilloso lugar,con mucho encanto,un trato estupendo y muy buena comida.Muy recomemdable
response_from_owner_text: Muchas Gracias
review_translated_text: Wonderful place, very charming, with great service and very good food. Highly recommended.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much

name: Raul Guardo
review_text: Consulto si hay sitio para comer 2 personas ya que habia 4 mesas libres (unas recogidas y otras limpias) y su respuesta es que no tienen sitio , si tienen reservas supongo que tendrian las mesas limpias y preparadas y las limpias con algun tipo de cartel de reservado...hora sobre las 15:20/25...supongo que ya hizo el dia...
response_from_owner_text: Saludos, en nuestro restaurante el sitio no lo marcan las mesas libres sino la capacidad de la cocina para producir platos. Si se les respondio que no habia sitio era porque la cocina no podia atender mas mesas. Sentimos mucho las molestias, para otra vez le recomendamos que reserven con antelacion y mas en una fecha de tan alta demanda.
review_translated_text: I ask if there is room for 2 people to eat since there were 4 free tables (some cleared and others clean) and their answer is that they don't have room , if they have reservations I suppose they would have the tables clean and prepared and the clean ones with some type of reserved sign...time around 3:20/25...I guess it's already made the day...
response_from_owner_translated_text: Greetings, at our restaurant, seating isn't determined by the number of available tables, but by the kitchen's capacity to produce dishes. If you were told there was no room, it was because the kitchen couldn't accommodate any more tables. We're very sorry for the inconvenience. Next time, we recommend booking in advance, especially during such a busy time.

name: feliciano jimenez
review_text: Un sitio para desconectar, los propietarios son super amables, no nos ha faltado de nada. Hemos estado muy a gusto . La comida casera muy rica. Un sitio muy recomendable. Gracias por hacernos felices.
review_translated_text: A place to disconnect, the owners are super friendly, we have not missed anything. We have been very comfortable. Very delicious homemade food. A highly recommended site. Thank you for making us happy.

name: Deborasdancers 74
review_text: Maravilloso rincon para disfrutar cuando NO este masificado !!!!
review_translated_text: Wonderful corner to enjoy when it is NOT crowded!!!!

name: Alejandro "Alex"
review_text: Increible lugar para hospedarse. Vistas increibles y personal super agradable.
review_translated_text: Amazing place to stay. Amazing views and super nice staff.

name: Daniel Prieto Carballo
review_text: Bonito hotel rural con un encanto increible gracias al pueblo en el que esta, estuvimos en el apartamento que tiene dos habitaciones en el cual se estaba de lujo, el trato por parte de los trabajadores fue muy correcto. De precio no es nada caro y las vistas que tienes y la tranquilidad que da no tiene precio. El apartamento contaba con cocina, TV, dos habitaciones con calefaccion, un bano con ducha y una pequena terraza que solo tenia salida para ella.
review_translated_text: Nice rural hotel with an incredible charm thanks to the town it is in, we stayed in the apartment that has two rooms in which it was luxurious, the treatment by the workers was very correct. The price is not expensive at all and the views you have and the tranquility it gives are priceless. The apartment had a kitchen, TV, two heated rooms, a bathroom with a shower and a small terrace that only had an exit for her.

name: Motoclub Acerela Manolete
review_text: Las croquetas excelentes, repetiremos.
review_translated_text: The croquettes are excellent, we will repeat.

name: Jose Luis Garcia Martinez
review_text: Solo probamos el restaurante.  La olla podrida estaba espectacular, la mezcla muy fresca y los postres muy buenos
review_translated_text: We only tried the restaurant.  The rotten pot was spectacular, the mixture was very fresh and the desserts were very good.

name: Sonia Antolin Gomez
review_text: Un lugar muy familiar, un trato genial y la comida muy bien
review_translated_text: A very familiar place, great service and very good food

name: Olga Villalon
review_text:
Fantastico sitio. Magnifica atencion.. y el entorno unico.
Tengo que volver a pasar un fin de semana entero
review_translated_text:
Fantastic site. Magnificent attention... and the unique environment.
I have to spend a whole weekend again

name: federico palacios monzon
review_text: Excelente
review_translated_text: Excellent

review_text: Bonito hotel rural y desayuno fantastico.
review_translated_text: Nice rural hotel and fantastic breakfast.

name: Miriam Berzosa
review_text: Maravilloso. Todo limpisimo y una atencion buenisima,el desayuno impresionante
review_translated_text: Wonderful. Everything was spotless, the service was excellent, and the breakfast was amazing.

name: emile diaz
review_text:
Etablissement renove avec un tres bon gout. Calme, stationnement difficile vu la complexite des lieux.
Petit dejeuner correct, repas du soir uniquement. Grande terrasse avec un point de vue magnifique.
Personnel accueillant, sympathique et tres professionnel.
review_translated_text:
Establishment renovated with very good taste. Quiet, parking difficult given the complexity of the place.
Decent breakfast, evening meal only. Large terrace with a magnificent view.
Welcoming, friendly and very professional staff.

name: David Albeniz
review_text: Hermoso hotel en un extremo de Orbaneja. Nos trataron estupendamente ofreciendonos una cena muy variada y rica (rabas, tabla de embutidos, entrecot, croquetas, rabo de toro, huevos con papas, morcilla, revuelto de morcilla...). El desayuno muy bueno con zumo, macedonia, croissant, pan tostado, embutidos y cafe. Las vistas desde la habitacion son preciosas. La ducha, la cama, la television, calefaccion funcionan a la perfeccion. El wifi en la habitacion va regular, pero pienso que a este sitio se viene a desconectar. Merece la pena al 100%.
review_translated_text: Beautiful hotel at one end of Orbaneja. They treated us wonderfully, offering us a very varied and delicious dinner (rabbits, charcuterie board, entrecote, croquettes, oxtail, eggs with potatoes, blood sausage, scrambled blood sausage...). Very good breakfast with juice, fruit salad, croissant, toast, cold cuts and coffee. The views from the room are beautiful. The shower, bed, television, heating work perfectly. The wifi in the room is regular, but I think that this place is about to disconnect. It's 100% worth it.

name: Aitor Arceredillo
review_text: Absolutamente idilico
response_from_owner_text: Gracias
review_translated_text: absolutely idyllic
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you

name: Celia Fernandez
review_text: Buen trato y economico. Desayuno de 10, muy completo. El pueblo es precioso.
review_translated_text: Good service and affordable. A 10-point breakfast, very complete. The town is beautiful.

name: Maria Ramona Rusu
review_text:
La habitaciones bonitas y limpias (nos toco la buhardilla) pena con la vistas que hay ...la ventana muy pequena....pero se descansa muy bien.El desayuno muy abundante y completo!! Hemos estado 1 dia...pero recomendable almenos 3 dias. El pueblo super bonito y las vistas ....espectaculares.
Se tiene que dejar el coche abajo del pueblo y el hotel esta cuesta arriba...subir con las maletas un poco complicado (nosotros hemos subido con el coche pq en este momento no hay mucho turismo...normalmente esta prohibido)
review_translated_text:
The rooms are nice and clean (we had the attic) it's a shame with the views...the window is very small...but you can rest very well. The breakfast is very abundant and complete!! We have been there for 1 day...but recommended at least 3 days. The town is super pretty and the views...spectacular.
You have to leave the car at the bottom of the town and the hotel is uphill... going up with suitcases is a bit complicated (we went up with the car because at this time there is not much tourism... it is normally prohibited)

name: K HH
review_text: Excelente ubicacion.
review_translated_text: Excellent location.

review_text: Un lugar  con encanto y maravilloso atencion   exquisita.
review_translated_text: A place with charm and wonderful exquisite attention.

Gracias
review_translated_text:
The breakfast was very good, but we booked two rooms, and in both, the bathroom wasn't very clean. The rest was fine.
Thank you.

name: ROSA MARIA AGUEDA MARTIN
review_text: Solo tomamos una cerveza, pero el sitio donde esta es perfecto y precioso
review_translated_text: We only had a beer, but the place where it is is perfect and beautiful

review_translated_text: Good service, powerful breakfast

name: Diana Ramos
review_text: El pueblo es un encanto y el hotel es un poco anticuado. Las camas dejan mucho que desear, para el precio que tiene no tiene unas instalaciones adecuadas. Volveremos pero a otro hotel.
review_translated_text: The town is charming, but the hotel is a bit dated. The beds leave a lot to be desired, and for the price, the facilities are inadequate. We'll return, but to another hotel.

name: Javier Giral
review_text: Estuve tomando algo en la magnifica terraza con vistas que tiene. No puedo valorar nada mas
review_translated_text: I had a drink on the magnificent terrace with views. I can't say enough good things about it.

name: Clara Fernandez
review_text:
La estancia ha sido maravillosa. Vistas desde la habitacion preciosas y la atencion por parte de los empleados ha sido buena.
Desayunos y cenas abundantes y de calidad.
review_translated_text:
The stay has been wonderful. Beautiful views from the room and the attention from the employees has been good.
Abundant, quality breakfasts and dinners.

name: Arantxa Manzaneque
review_text: Deja mucho que desear la atencion del personal, las habitaciones son de lo mas normales, la comida cara y escasa, no voy a volver.... una pena porque el pueblo es precioso.
review_translated_text: The staff's attention leaves a lot to be desired, the rooms are very normal, the food expensive and scarce, I will not return... a shame because the town is beautiful.

name: Andrea Orbiso Arroyo
review_text: Primero, destacar el exquisito trato del servicio, siempre atentos, agradables y profesionales. Desayunos y cenas excelentes, con unas vistas inmejorables. La habitacion muy comoda,moderna y limpia. No somos capaces de encontrar una queja hacia el lugar o los trabajadores. Teniamos una reserva de tres noches y al estar tan a gusto ampliamos nuestra estancia una noche mas. Volveremos seguro!!! Totalmente recomendable.
review_translated_text: First, highlight the exquisite treatment of the service, always attentive, pleasant and professional. Excellent breakfasts and dinners, with unbeatable views. The room was very comfortable, modern and clean. We are not able to find a complaint towards the place or the workers. We had a reservation for three nights and being so comfortable we extended our stay for one more night. We will return for sure!!! Totally recommended.

name: abebamagma m.
review_text: Esta muy bien, eso si arriba del pueblo del todo/, el personal atento, amable el hotel(restaurante) precioso bien habilitado, muy limpia las habitaciones. Repetiremos, vistas  inmejorables.
review_translated_text: It is very good, yes, above the town at all/, the staff is attentive, friendly, the hotel (restaurant) is beautiful, well equipped, the rooms are very clean. We will repeat, unbeatable views.

name: Carlos Eduardo Sanchez Estarita
review_text: Excelente experiencia
review_translated_text: Excellent experience

name: Marcos Vazquez Munoz
review_text: Hotel rural bonito y con una vistas maravillosas. Las habitaciones espaciosas (al menos la mia que era una triple) y limpias. Aunque no cene alli todos los platos que vi pasar tenian una pinta excelente. Desayuno correcto en la terraza, un gusto. Pedi pan sin gluten y leche vegetal y lo atendiera sin problema. El trato muy amable.
review_translated_text: Beautiful rural hotel with wonderful views. The rooms were spacious (at least mine was a triple) and clean. Although I didn't have dinner there, all the dishes I saw passing by looked excellent. Correct breakfast on the terrace, a pleasure. I asked for gluten-free bread and vegetable milk and they served it without a problem. Very friendly treatment.

name: Victoria Menchacatorre Ruiz
review_text: Una atencion exquisita, muy buena cocina. Si vais con una persona celiaca la cuidaran muchisimo.
review_translated_text: Exquisite service, excellent cuisine. If you go with someone with celiac disease, they'll take great care of them.

name: Diego Marquinez Pena
review_text: Lugar perfecto para dormir en un sitio espectacular como Orbaneja del Castillo. Buena comida y buena atencion. La terraza es super tranquila y tiene vistas inmejorables
review_translated_text: Perfect place to sleep in a spectacular place like Orbaneja del Castillo. Good food and good service. The terrace is super quiet and has unbeatable views.

name: CARLOS SAIZ CARRION
review_text: Excelente hotel rural en la zona alta del pueblo. No se puede llegar con coche, ellos te avisan con antelacion de este inconveniente, pero el recorrido por el pueblo hasta llegar merece la pena. Habitacion espaciosa, limpia y con todas las comodidades. El desayuno es espectacular, te vas con fuerza hasta mas del mediodia. Las vistas son de ensueno hacia la sierra frente al pueblo.
review_translated_text: Excellent rural hotel in the upper area of   the town. You cannot get there by car, they warn you in advance of this inconvenience, but the journey through the town to get there is worth it. Spacious, clean room with all the comforts. The breakfast is spectacular, you go strong until after noon. The views are dreamlike towards the mountains in front of the town.

name: J G
review_text: Perfecto, cuidado, buenas vistas, buen desayuno, bonito. Volveremos.
review_translated_text: Perfect, well-kept, good views, good breakfast, beautiful. We will return.

name: Augusto Rodriguez
review_text: Espectaculares vistas, desde lo mas alto del pueblo
review_translated_text: Spectacular views, from the top of the town

name: Carles Gonzalez
review_text: Todo perfecto...sitio, comida y servicio
review_translated_text: Everything perfect...place, food and service

name: Miguel "Muni"
review_text: Muy buen servicio instalaciones y magica ubicacion
review_translated_text: Very good service, facilities and magical location

name: Hortensia Hermida
review_text: Muy contentos un pueblo bonito ,en el hotel el trato cercano y amigable con todas las medidas contra el virus y una maravillosa cocina volveremos seguro
review_translated_text: Very happy, a beautiful town, in the hotel the close and friendly treatment with all the measures against the virus and a wonderful cuisine, we will return for sure

name: Julian M. Silverio Garcia
review_text: Excelente atencion, buenos desayunos y muy buena cocina..
review_translated_text: Excellent service, good breakfasts and very good cuisine..

name: Emi Lube
review_text: Hotel sensacional, situado en lo alto del pueblo, con unas vistas espectaculares a la Hoces del rio Ebro,  el trato muy muy amable, y en el restaurante  comida espectacular, tanto en el desayuno como en la comida a la carta.
review_translated_text: Sensational hotel, located at the top of the village, with spectacular views of the Ebro River Gorges. The service was very friendly, and the restaurant offered spectacular food, both at breakfast and a la carte.

name: J.Javier Hervas Carcel
review_text:
La atencion fue buena y correcta.
Las habitaciones, muy bien, con espacio suficiente, tv, bano con ducha, una vistas al canon preciosas y lo mas importante, limpias
La cena estaba estupenda, tienen buena cocina y el desayuno tambien miren, servido en mesa, en la terraza del hotel al sol de la manana y mirando el canon, perfecto.
Si hay un pero es, que no hay parking, y que ahora mismo estan adoquinando el pueblo y tienes que subir con todo desde la carretera porque no se puede pasar el coche, esto no es culpa de ellos claro, en circunstancias normales, paras en la puerta y vacias trastos, nosotros como ibamos en moto, pudimos subir la moto a una calle del pueblo y no andamos tanto, pero si es un tanto incomodo, ya que ademas es la casa mas alta del pueblo.
review_translated_text:
The service was good and correct.
The rooms were very nice, with enough space, a TV, a bathroom with a shower, beautiful views of the canyon, and most importantly, clean.
Dinner was great. They have good food, and breakfast was also excellent, served at the table on the hotel terrace in the morning sun overlooking the canyon.
The only downside is that there's no parking, and the village is currently being paved, and you have to carry everything up from the road because you can't get a car through. This isn't their fault, of course. Under normal circumstances, you'd stop at the gate and empty your belongings. Since we were on a motorcycle, we were able to get the motorcycle up a village street and didn't have to walk too far, but it was a bit inconvenient, as it's also the tallest house in the village.

name: M C J
review_text: Hotel muy limpio y atencion exquisita. Desayuno abundante. Precio normal. Como mejora anadiria un servicio de taxi que te subiera de Escalada a Orbaneja. El transporte publico solo llega a Quintanilla Escalada y desde alli  tienes dos formas de llegar: una senda bastante comoda de 5km o bien un taxi que busques por tu cuenta. Nosotras contactamos con Javier que bajo desde Crespos a por nosotras. Serio y muy puntual.
review_translated_text: Very clean hotel with excellent service. A hearty breakfast. Fair price. As an improvement, I would add a taxi service from Escalada to Orbaneja. Public transportation only goes to Quintanilla Escalada, and from there you have two ways to get there: a fairly comfortable 5km hike or a taxi you can find yourself. We contacted Javier, who came down from Crespos to pick us up. He was serious and very punctual.

name: javier
review_text: Hotel increible para descansar y disfrutar del pueblo, habitaciones grandes y las camas super comodas. Cenamos en el hotel ,muy rico todo y casero.
review_translated_text: Incredible hotel to rest and enjoy the town, large rooms and super comfortable beds. We had dinner at the hotel, everything was delicious and homemade.

name: Vanessa Silva Herranz
review_text: No le damos la quinta estrella porque las camas pequenas del apartamento eran un poco incomodas. Vistas increibles, los apartamentos estan fenomenal y tienen el mejor restaurante de Orbaneja. Muy buena relacion calidad/precio. El chico que nos atendio era majisimo, de 10. Volveremos seguro
review_translated_text: We didn't give it a fifth star because the apartment's small beds were a bit uncomfortable. Incredible views, the apartments are fantastic, and they have the best restaurant in Orbaneja. Great value. The guy who served us was incredibly nice, a 10/10. We'll definitely be back.

name: Juan Carlos Herrero
review_text: Genial, muy buena atencion para volver
review_translated_text: Great, very good service to come back

name: Jose Luis Quesada Blanca
review_text: Hotelito con mucho encanto, muy acogedor y confortable, aunque el acceso es un poco dificil pero compensan las maravillosas vistas que tiene. Magnifica atencion del chico que que esta a cargo. Se come de lujo y a buen precio. Lo recomiendo al 100x100.
review_translated_text: Charming little hotel, very cozy and comfortable, although access is a bit difficult, but the wonderful views make up for it. The service from the guy in charge is magnificent. The food is luxurious and reasonably priced. I highly recommend it.

name: Berto
review_text: Buena estancia y restaurante en un entorno de agreste naturaleza .
review_translated_text: Good stay and restaurant in an environment of rugged nature.

name: francisco alonso
review_text: Es un hotel rural con mucho encanto, muy bien atendidos y un desayuno espectacular
review_translated_text: It is a rural hotel with a lot of charm, very well attended and a spectacular breakfast.

name: Carlos
review_text: Hotel muy acogedor y limpio. Perfecto para una estancia corta o larga visitando orbaneja.
review_translated_text: Very cozy and clean hotel. Perfect for a short or long stay visiting Orbaneja.

name: carmen Diez
review_text:
Fatal, tuvimos un problema con la reserva y el encargado no nos ayudo para nada.
Fatal, no lo recomiendo para nada
response_from_owner_text:
Saludos, ustedes cometieron un error en su reserva del que el hotel se vio perjudicado. El encargado diligentemente escucho vuestro caso y os ofrecio una alternativa adecuada a la situacion que ustedes no quisieron aceptar. Por otro lado ustedes no disfrutaron de nuestros servicios por lo tanto no tienen capacidad para hacer juicios de valor sobre estos.

Lamentando lo ocurrido, un saludo.
review_translated_text:
Fatal, we had a problem with the reservation and the manager did not help us at all.
Terrible, I don't recommend it at all
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Greetings, you made a mistake in your reservation, which affected the hotel. The manager diligently listened to your case and offered you a suitable alternative to the situation, which you refused to accept. Furthermore, you did not enjoy our services, so you are unable to make value judgments about them.

We regret what happened. Best regards.

name: Nereida _
review_text: Lugar acogedor con vistas impresionantes. La comida del restaurante muy muy buena, el trato del encargado genial.
review_translated_text: Cozy place with stunning views. The restaurant food was very very good, the manager's treatment was great.

name: Luismi Fuente
review_text: Muy coqueto el hotel en un lugar precioso
review_translated_text: Very charming hotel in a beautiful place

name: Alfonso P
review_text:
Ubicacion, trato limpieza y precio.
Las cenas espectaculares, calidad/precio
review_translated_text:
Location, cleanliness and price.
Spectacular dinners, quality/price

name: Celeste g-b
review_text:
Buen lugar, agradable y limpio.
Nos gusto, volveremos
review_translated_text:
Good place, nice and clean.
We liked it, we will return

name: F7533MJmicheles
review_text: Superbe petite auberge.Excellent accueil.Tres bonne table et tres bonne carte de vins.|Les chambres etaient aussi tres bien,bien chauffees et bien propres...|En gros seule la meteo nous a trahis et pourtant il y avait plein de monde !!!|Village et adresse a retenir.
review_translated_text: Superb little inn. Excellent welcome. Very good food and very good wine list.|The rooms were also very nice, well heated and very clean...|Basically only the weather let us down and yet there were lots of people!!!|Village and address to remember.

name: Dafne Gonzalez
review_text: Muy satisfecha, habitacion calida limpia y confortable, el joven que nos atendio muy amable y educado, la carta con comida rica, de la zona y de temporada a  un precio muy razonable, y el desayuno super variado casi buffet! Un sitio sin pretensiones que supero mis expectativas.
review_translated_text: Very satisfied. The room was warm, clean, and comfortable. The young man who served us was very friendly and polite. The menu offered delicious, local, and seasonal food at a very reasonable price. The breakfast was super varied, almost buffet-style! An unpretentious place that exceeded my expectations.

name: Daniel J. C
review_text: Estancia estupenda. Nos han atendido fenomenal y hemos comido genial. En cuanto al alojamiento super tranquilo en lo mas alto de orbaneja y las camas muy comodas.
review_translated_text: A wonderful stay. We received fantastic service and a fantastic meal. The accommodations were super quiet at the top of Orbaneja, and the beds were very comfortable.

name: Carlos Carro Bravo
review_text: Magnifica atencion
review_translated_text: Magnificent attention

name: Tomas Del Pozo Martinez
review_text:
Buen servicio y esplendido desayuno.
Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text:
Good service and splendid breakfast.
Highly recommended.

name: Jose Maria
review_text: Buen establecimiento. Bonito. Confortable. La unica pega (sin importancia) es que en la habitacion permanece encendida toda la noche la luz de seguridad. Aunque molesta poco. Pero yo necesito oscuridad para dormir. Es una mania mia. El desayuno es excelente. Todo muy bien.
review_translated_text: Good establishment. Pretty. Comfortable. The only drawback (unimportant) is that the security light in the room stays on all night. Although it bothers a little. But I need darkness to sleep. It's a hobby of mine. Breakfast is excellent. Everything very good.

name: Hurtado
review_text: Pueblo precioso. Sin duda una visita genial para repetir. Muy tranquilo y tranquilo para pasear.
review_translated_text: A beautiful town. Definitely a great visit to repeat. Very peaceful and quiet for strolling.

name: Ana Dominguez
review_text: Un hotel sencillo, con unas vistas impresionantes, los desayunos espectaculares. El unico inconveniente, es la subida al hotel, hay una cuesta bastante considerable, por lo demas todo bien y muy amables.
review_translated_text: A simple hotel, with stunning views, spectacular breakfasts. The only drawback is the climb to the hotel, there is a quite considerable hill, otherwise everything is fine and very friendly.

name: Mari Trini Granados
review_text: No lo detesto,es un lugar con vistas espectaculares,aunque el acceso en coche es complicado.Buen servicio
review_translated_text: I don't hate it, it is a place with spectacular views, although access by car is complicated. Good service

name: Fernando
review_text: Lugar acogedor, desayuno formidable y la comida muy rica,  por supuesto una terraza con unas vistas preciosas,    la pena q no tenga parking
review_translated_text: Cozy place, great breakfast and very delicious food, of course a terrace with beautiful views, it's a shame that it doesn't have parking

name: 365 rutas en familia. bv
review_text: Acceso complicado en coche para dejar las maletas, el propietario fue muy antipatico, las habitaciones no estaban muy limpias, el pueblo nos encanto y la gente del pueblo muy atenta, volveremos pero a otro hotel.
review_translated_text: Difficult access by car to leave the suitcases, the owner was very unfriendly, the rooms were not very clean, we loved the town and the townspeople were very attentive, we will return but to another hotel.

name: Carlos Javier Dominguez Rodriguez
review_text: Bonitas vistas
review_translated_text: Beautiful views

name: Honorio Quintana
review_text: Bonito lugar, nos encanto la vista, su gente y unas habitaciones muy lindas, lo ideal es ir con mochila o maleta pequena, es hotel de montana por lo que no es necesario una gran maleta. Ah, se me olvidaba lo mas importante, la comida, su restaurante es fabuloso, recomendable 100x100, incluso si solo vas a visitar el pueblo.
review_translated_text: Nice place, we loved the view, its people and very nice rooms, the ideal is to go with a backpack or small suitcase, it is a mountain hotel so a large suitcase is not necessary. To keep in mind: it is located at the top of the town, and it is not easy to get there by vehicle since you have to go through the middle of the town and sometimes the path is blocked, there are also no places to park, so the car has to be left at the bottom, next to the river.

name: Carlos Munoz Alonso
review_text:
Comente que en Orbaneja del Castillo no me parecio encontrar una atractiva oferta gastronomica. Sin embargo, acerte en la eleccion tomada aquel dia, porque en este restaurante comimos de maravilla sin pagar mucho dinero. En cuanto calidad precio, me parecio excelente. Lo recomiendo.
Visualmente, es muy bonito y agradable, porque ademas, es relativamente pequeno y con buena atencion.
review_translated_text:
I mentioned that I didn't think I'd find a very attractive culinary offering in Orbaneja del Castillo. However, I made the right choice that day, because we had a wonderful meal at this restaurant without paying a lot of money. In terms of value for money, I thought it was excellent. I recommend it.
Visually, it's very pretty and pleasant, and it's also relatively small and offers good service.

name: Marcos Garcia
review_text:
Pros:
The views from the room are very beautiful.
The room was clean and the furniture brand new.
The breakfast, even if it was not a buffet was  good enough in quantity and quality.
Cons:
Regarding the food service, you can only be sure of the breakfast. You will need to ask the staff about lunch and dinner everyday because they don't serve quite often. No lunch and no dinner at random days without previous notice.
Most of the time there's no staff on the hotel. If you need something there is noone you can ask. Just in the morning you are sure that there will be someone.
Very expensive dishes for lunch and dinner (in case you are lucky and they are available).
Even if the furniture is brand new, the installations were very defective. The shower was leaking water out of the cabinet and we needed to dry it with towels.
There was mold in one of the walls of the room, hidden not-so-well with a closet.
response_from_owner_text:
First of all, we thank your review. As a rural establishment we try to do our best in order to improve our service. Here they are some points we would love to clear up.
1.- The restaurant's schedule has been published for more than a year in our website and establishment. Even though the staff notified you at the entrance, getting informed about it would have been better for your visit.
2.- On the one hand, we believe here's a really harsh critique to the staff when there's a worker on duty to attend the reception phone and the inner phone line with each room 24/7. On the other hand, the crew has always been diligent and helpful with you as much as possible. Even though customers can be icy and unfriendly, we do our best to make its visit as nice as it's expected.
3-  We feel sorry if the restaurant service was not as good as awaited. This is the best way of service that our circumstances allow us since the rural hotel remains in a medieval village with less than 50 inhabitants. We always make an effort in order to inform our clients about the services we offer but we cannot be responsible of the lack of knowledge if there is no willingness to self inform about our hotel. We remember that all the information can be checked out in our website (www.orbanejadelcastillo.es) or by a phone call. We will gladly clarify your doubts.
Finally, we are sorry that your visit was not as pleasant as you hoped. We truly thank your time and wish you a nice day.

name: Chus Lopez
review_text:
Hotel muy bonito y bien situado, en lo alto del pueblo, con espectaculares vistas sobre el pueblo y la montana. Se puede llegar con el coche hasta alli y aparcarlo sin problemas. Todo limpisimo (la mampara de la ducha sin un solo resto de gotas secas). Las camas son comodas, la habitacion grande.  Noe, el chico que nos atendio en recepcion y en el restaurante, es muy amable, cortes y profesional, pero sin ser pesado.
Cenamos en el restaurante, los siete que eramos pedimos platos combinados, y estaba todo buenisimo, bien presentado y con una cantidad generosa de comida. El desayuno muy rico, no demasiado abundante pero suficiente, pan tostado con mantequilla, mermelada o con aceite y tomate, madalenas, y un zumo de naranja natural. Me gusto especialmente el detalle de la brocheta con trocitos de fruta.  Muy recomendable para pasar un fin de semana en este bonito pueblo.
review_translated_text:
Very nice and well located hotel, at the top of the town, with spectacular views over the town and the mountains. You can drive your car there and park it without problems. Everything was very clean (the shower screen without a single trace of dried drops). The beds are comfortable, the room large.  Noe, the guy who served us at reception and in the restaurant, is very friendly, courteous and professional, but without being annoying.
We had dinner at the restaurant, the seven of us ordered mixed dishes, and everything was delicious, well presented and with a generous amount of food. The breakfast was very rich, not too abundant but sufficient, toasted bread with butter, jam or with oil and tomato, muffins, and fresh orange juice. I especially liked the detail of the skewer with pieces of fruit.  Highly recommended to spend a weekend in this beautiful town.

review_text: No podemos mas que agradecer el trato recibido en este pequeno hotel con mucho encanto. Llegamos tarde por la noche fuera del horario de cocina y a pesar de ello nos sirvieron de cenar. Y no un plato cualquiera. Cenamos una parrillada de verduras, pastel de puerros, revuelto de morcilla, todo con una presentacion y sabor excelente. El hotel esta un poco apartado de la espectacular cascada que tiene el pueblo, y lo agradecemos, porque la cascada es preciosa, pero con la cantidad de agua que llevaba el ruido era ensordecedor, y hemos descansado con total tranquilidad. Las vistas de los alrededores desde la habitacion super chulas. El personal, encantadores. La relacion calidad precio, excelente. Super recomendable .
review_translated_text: We can only thank you for the treatment received in this small, charming hotel. We arrived late at night outside of kitchen hours and despite this they served us dinner. And not just any dish. We had grilled vegetables for dinner, leek pie, scrambled blood sausage, all with excellent presentation and flavor. The hotel is a little away from the spectacular waterfall that the town has, and we appreciate it, because the waterfall is beautiful, but with the amount of water it carried, the noise was deafening, and we rested in total tranquility. The views of the surroundings from the room are super cool. The staff, charming. Excellent value for money. Super recommended.

name: Felix Arnaiz Quintana (Felix A.Q.)
review_text: Hotel bien acondicionado al entorno rural que le rodea. Situado en lo alto del pueblo, y por lo tanto con dificil acceso para los coches por las estrechas y empenidas rampas y escasez de aparcamiento, el hotel se puede considerar como nuevo, porque la profunda restauracion que han tenido que hacer asi se demuestra. Las habitaciones y los banos limpios, y con lo necesario. Sin ningun lujo pero con lo basico en perfecto estado. Habitaciones y mobiliario con un toque natural y rustico que le da un encanto. El hecho de estar en lo mas alto del pueblo permite que al asomarte por las ventanas no haya obstaculos de viviendas para admirar el paisaje. Las habitaciones con dos camas, alguna de matrimonio y una habitacion amplia con 5 camas y con sofa cama y dos"turcas" recogidas, lo que en un momento determinado se podrian meter hasta 9 personas en la habitacion (esto es cosa mia. No se si los duenos admiten esta posibilidad.) Un desayuno muy correcto. Aparte de lo mas o menos tipico en un desayuno: pan tostado, magdalenas..., el ponerte una brocheta de fruta ( no me acuerdo exactamente pero al menos tenia kiwi, fresa, platano, pera y un par de cosas mas) el zumo de naranja natural y salsa de tomate natural para ponerte en el pan o en las tostadas. Un par de companeros pidieron repetir cafes y sin problemas. Eramos 9 y a todos nos dejo muy buena impresion.
review_translated_text: A hotel well-suited to the surrounding rural environment. Located at the top of the village, and therefore difficult to access for cars due to the narrow, steep slopes and limited parking, the hotel can be considered as new, as evidenced by the extensive restoration they have undergone. The rooms and bathrooms are clean and equipped with everything you need. Nothing luxurious, but the basics are in perfect condition. Rooms and furnishings have a natural, rustic touch that gives it a certain charm. Being at the top of the village means that when you look out the windows, there are no obstacles from the houses and you can admire the landscape. The rooms have two beds, some are double, and one spacious room has five beds, a sofa bed, and two "Turkish" beds, which at any given time could accommodate up to nine people (this is my own opinion. I don't know if the owners allow this option). The breakfast was very decent. Aside from the more or less typical breakfast items: toast, muffins, etc., there was a fruit skewer (I don't remember exactly, but at least it had kiwi, strawberry, banana, pear, and a couple of other things), fresh orange juice, and natural tomato sauce to put on your bread or toast. A couple of our friends asked for second coffees, and they had no problem with that. There were nine of us, and we were all very impressed.

name: JAG
review_text:
En contra: el aparcamiento, ya que es la ultima edificacion de Orbaneja y al estar el pueblo en una ladera de calle unica y de una sola direccion aparcan al lado los cinco o seis primeros que lleguen.
A FAVOR: es un hotel "ESPECIAL" en el servicio, la limpieza, el trato y amabilidad del personal.
Desayuno: No creo que haya una persona que se acabe el desayuno que te sirven.
Comida o cena: suficientes platos en el menu diario para poder escoger entre seis o siete primeros, otros tantos segundos y cinco o seis postres. Algunos cambian todos los dias y estan mejor que el dia anterior.
ATENCION  un 10
CALIDAD PRECIO: un 9 porque no hay nada perfecto.
He estado 3 dias y me voy encantadisimo de Orbaneja pero mas del Hotel Rural La Puebla.

RCOMENDADO 100%.

JOSE A. GIMARE
review_translated_text:
Cons: The parking, as it's the last building in Orbaneja, and since the village is on a hillside with a single, one-way street, the first five or six people to arrive park next to it.
PROS: It's a "SPECIAL" hotel in terms of service, cleanliness, and the friendliness of the staff.
Breakfast: I don't think a single person will finish the breakfast they serve.
Lunch or dinner: Enough dishes on the daily menu to choose from six or seven starters, as many main courses, and five or six desserts. Some change daily and are better than the day before.
SERVICE: A 10.
VALUE FOR MONEY: A 9 because nothing is perfect.
I stayed for three days and I'm delighted with Orbaneja, but even more so with Hotel Rural La Puebla.

100% RECOMMENDED.

JOSE A. GIMARE

name: Juanjo Rodriguez
review_text:
Estuvimos en noviembre, sin tanta aglomeracion de turistas como en verano. El pueblo, precioso, y los entornos naturales (Mirador del Ebro, Pesquera, Rudron, Escalada, Covanera...), siempre espectaculares.
El restaurante esta a las afueras del pueblo, en una pequena cuesta, un paseito de tres minutos.
La comida, de menu (20 EU), pero de calidad, cantidad proporcionada y sobrada variedad donde poder elegir. El trato del camarero, muy agradable, cuidado, esmerado y atento a la mas minima necesidad.
Recomendado tanto para quedarse en la casa rural como para ir a comer en una escapada (a ser posible sin aglomeraciones).
review_translated_text:
We were there in November, with fewer tourists than in the summer. The town is beautiful, and the natural surroundings (Mirador del Ebro, Pesquera, Rudron, Escalada, Covanera, etc.) are always spectacular.
The restaurant is on the outskirts of town, on a small hill, a short three-minute walk away.
The food was a set menu (EU20), but high-quality, with ample amounts of food and plenty of choice. The waiter was very pleasant, attentive, and attentive to even the smallest needs.
Recommended both for staying at the rural house and for a meal on a getaway (preferably without crowds).

*          Una copa de zumo de naranja natural recien exprimido.

*          Una pequena racion de tomate natural rallado

review_translated_text:
Simple site. Ideal for not spending a lot of money.
The breakfast had nothing to do with what they put in their photos.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear guest, our breakfast (you can find it here: http://orbanejadelcastillo.es/restaurante-bar.html) consists of the following items:
* A glass of freshly squeezed orange juice.
* A skewer of natural fruits or a fruit salad.
* Butter, various jams, and olive oil.
* A portion of toast with country bread and whole-wheat bread.
* A portion of assorted cured meats and mozzarella.
* A portion of artisan pastries.
* A small portion of grated natural tomatoes.
* A coffee, hot chocolate, or herbal tea.

If you think it's a little small, we can understand. But for the quality of the food and the amount of money you haven't spent, it seems fair.

name: Lorena Prieto Fernandez
review_text:
Hola a todos los turistas que se acerquen hasta Orbaneja del Castillo. El sitio no tiene comparacion con la decepcion que nos hemos llevado este fin de semana en hotel la Puebla.
Lo primero que me gustaria decir es que deberian de actualizar su pagina web con los menus y cartas que ofrecen porque no tiene nada que ver con lo que nos muestran en la web a cuando se esta alli. Asi como especificar que se puede comer al medio dia y a la noche porque nos encontremos con que hay cosas que solo se pueden de noche y en ningun lado aparece reflejado.
Segundo, las habitaciones dejan mucho que decir...la limpieza escasea,el hotel se esta reformando,por ejemplo ,despues de pasar toda la tarde por el pueblo decidimos acercarnos hasta la habitacion y nos encontramos con que habian cambiado los numeros de las habitaciones y nadie dijo nada. Las tuberias deberian de revisarlas porque huelen. Asi, como tampoco nos gusto el interes que tenian en que dejaramos las llaves de la habitacion en la recepcion (nosotros bueno es que la haran),pero nuestra sorpresa fue que si la hicieron y nos dejaron unos cojines que no habia antes y pa colmo las fundas sucias.
Por ultimo dire que para que la gente vaya deberian acabar todo y limpiar en condiciones  y por nuestra parte sera un sitio en el que no repetiremos.
review_translated_text:
Hello to all the tourists who come to Orbaneja del Castillo. The place has no comparison with the disappointment we experienced this weekend at the La Puebla hotel.
The first thing I would like to say is that they should update their website with the menus and menus they offer because it has nothing to do with what they show us on the website when you are there. As well as specifying that you can eat at noon and at night because we find that there are things that can only be eaten at night and are nowhere reflected.
Second, the rooms leave a lot to say...cleanliness is poor, the hotel is being renovated, for example, after spending the entire afternoon in the town we decided to go to the room and found that the room numbers had changed and no one said anything. The pipes should be checked because they smell. So, just as we didn't like the interest they had in us leaving the room keys at the reception (it's a good thing they will do it), but our surprise was that they did and left us some cushions that weren't there before and to make matters worse the dirty covers.
Finally I will say that for people to go they should finish everything and clean it properly and for our part it will be a place where we will not repeat.

name: Laura Esteban Abajo
review_text:
Un hotel agradable y limpio donde hospedarse. Se sube a pie a las 2 plantas de habitaciones, 8 en total, y son sencillas, pero para un dia o dos de paso esta bien. El desayuno es muy completo, zumo recien exprimido, bizcocho casero, tostadas con mantequilla y mermelada y tambien con tomate y aceite, al gusto, y un poco de embutido para complementar, y cafe o similar. Todo ello incluido en el precio de la habitacion. El personal amable.
Y creo que por la malisima experiencia que tuvimos cenando en "El Arroyo" (uno de los bares-restaurntes del pueblo), puede ser una buena opcion para cenar... cuestion de preguntar un poco, por el desayuno cuidado, no creo que defraude.
Los colchones normales, un poco rigidos, de muelles, y al tener ruedas, si unes dos camas un poco incomodo para dormir en pareja. Les sugeriria que compraran fundas de esas dobles para dejar los colchones unidos, o que buscaran alguna sujecion para dejar las camas juntas cuando sea doble.
El bano limpio y la ducha calienta rapido.
El techo de la segunda planta, habit. 5-8, son un poco abuhardilladas, pero comodas igualmente, solo un poco de cuidado con la cabeza en la zona baja. Muchas ventanas pequenas en la 7, pues es muy larga, teniendo opcion hasta a 5 camas.
review_translated_text:
A nice and clean hotel to stay. You walk up to the 2 floors of rooms, 8 in total, and they are simple, but for a day or two of passing through it is fine. Breakfast is very complete, freshly squeezed juice, homemade cake, toast with butter and jam and also with tomato and oil, to taste, and a little sausage to complement, and coffee or similar. All included in the price of the room. Friendly staff.
And I think that due to the very bad experience we had dining at "El Arroyo" (one of the bars-restaurants in town), it may be a good option for dinner... a matter of asking a little, for the careful breakfast, I don't think it will disappoint.
Normal mattresses, a little rigid, with springs, and since they have wheels, if you join two beds together, they are a little uncomfortable for sleeping as a couple. I would suggest that you buy those double covers to leave the mattresses together, or that you look for some support to leave the beds together when it is a double.
The bathroom is clean and the shower heats up quickly.
The ceiling of the second floor, habitation. 5-8, they are a little attic, but comfortable anyway, just a little care with the head in the lower area. Many small windows in room 7, as it is very long, with the option of up to 5 beds.

name: PE-0987
review_text: I stayed here to visit the Burgos cathedral and the formerly walled city. The hotel is across the street from a bridge leading to city entrance through the Santa Maria arch, and less than a five minute walk to the cathedral. The hotel is in a former palace, with a beautiful exterior, very comfortable and spacious lobby and a spectacular space for special events. Hotel staff were exceptionally accommodating and friendly. Initially I reserved a large room with a promised "river view"; the room itself was exceptionally nice and well furnished and if you looked at an angle from the window you could see the cathedral but not the small river. Unfortunately this premium room faced a busy street and was too noisy for us so the hotel staff found a very quiet room facing the back of the hotel - no view but no noise either; it was not as luxurious as the first room but still quite spacious and well decorated and maintained. The hotel breakfast was excellent, and like all NH hotels featured several local foods. Around the corner from the hotel were several small grocery stores, a nice bar and a great ice cream shop - if you want to avoid the more crowded walled city shops and restaurants.

name: Silvia BS
review_text:
Hotel de 4* situado al otro lado del rio, a 5minutos de la Catedral. Situacion magnifica.
La habitacion que nos toco (222) era esquinera y tenia un tamano bastante mas grande que la de nuestros acompanantes (siendo de la misma categoria).
Cama comoda, armarios grandes, caja fuerte, neverita, agua de cortesia, cafetera y hervidor con cafes y tes...
PERO esta bastante anticuada, no le haria ningun mal una actualizacion. Los muebles estan gastados (esquinas golpeadas, aranazos...) y donde mas se nota es en los banos. Banera bastante alta, junta de la banera oscura y sin silicona y, sobre todo, algun azulejo del suelo roto, incluso con un agujero (peligrosisimo si vas con ninos pequenos o andas descalzo ya que te puedes cortar).
Desayuno muy completo con posibilidad de pedir platos calientes a cocina.
El servicio muy bueno en todo el hotel (recepcion, desayuno...) y tienen un codigo QR mediante el cual pedir elementos extra para la habitacion, que atienden en cuestion de minutos.
Una de las noches habia una boda en el claustro; no se que estarian cocinando pero olia todo el hotel a comida (incluido dentro de las habitaciones).
Habiamos leido que el parking es bastante estrecho e incomodo para coches grandes (cosa que nos confirmaron en recepcion), por lo que decidimos dejarlo en el del Museo de la Evolucion, que es nuevo y tiene muy buen precio.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Silvia,

Estamos encantados de saber que nuestra excelente ubicacion, amplias habitaciones y servicios cumplio con sus expectativas. Nos alegra tambien que haya disfrutado de nuestro completo desayuno y del eficiente servicio de nuestro personal.

Lamentamos, sin embargo, que ciertos aspectos de su estancia no hayan sido completamente satisfactorios. Apreciamos su observacion sobre la necesidad de actualizar algunos elementos en nuestras habitaciones, incluyendo la condicion de los muebles y los banos. Aseguramos que su seguridad y comodidad son de suma importancia para nosotros.

Sobre la incidencia del aroma de comida durante la boda, tomamos nota y veremos como podemos mejorar en este aspecto.

Finalmente, en cuanto al estacionamiento, su eleccion de utilizar el del Museo de la Evolucion suena como una alternativa conveniente. Apreciamos sus comentarios y esperamos tener la oportunidad de darle la bienvenida de nuevo en el futuro.

Atentamente.

Nuria
Gutierrez Berlana

review_translated_text:
4* hotel located on the other side of the river, 5 minutes from the Cathedral. Magnificent situation.
The room we had (222) was a corner room and was much larger than that of our companions (being of the same category).
Comfortable bed, large closets, safe, refrigerator, complimentary water, coffee maker and kettle with coffee and tea...
BUT it is quite outdated, an update wouldn't hurt. The furniture is worn (bumped corners, scratches...) and where it is most noticeable is in the bathrooms. Quite high bathtub, dark bathtub seal without silicone and, above all, some broken floor tiles, even with a hole (very dangerous if you go with small children or walk barefoot as you can cut yourself).
Very complete breakfast with the possibility of ordering hot dishes from the kitchen.
The service is very good throughout the hotel (reception, breakfast...) and they have a QR code with which to request extra items for the room, which they attend to in a matter of minutes.
One of the nights there was a wedding in the cloister; I don't know what they were cooking but the entire hotel smelled of food (including inside the rooms).
We had read that the parking lot is quite narrow and uncomfortable for large cars (which was confirmed to us at reception), so we decided to leave it in the one at the Museum of Evolution, which is new and has a very good price.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Silvia,

We are delighted to know that our excellent location, spacious rooms and services met your expectations. We are also glad that you enjoyed our complete breakfast and the efficient service of our staff.

We regret, however, that certain aspects of your stay were not completely satisfactory. We appreciate your comment about the need to update some elements in our rooms, including the condition of the furniture and bathrooms. We assure that your safety and comfort are of utmost importance to us.

Regarding the incidence of food aroma during the wedding, we take note and we will see how we can improve in this aspect.

Finally, as for parking, your choice to use the one at the Museum of Evolution sounds like a convenient alternative. We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Sincerely.
