I write this review with mixed feelings.
I'll start with the worst: The garage, they don't reserve a spot for you, it's on a first-come, first-served basis, not enough spaces, and a parking lot designed for Seat 600 or Minis from the 70s, putting in Porsches, Teslas, or Mercedes is a miracle if you find the right one, I should have taken a photo where there were three spaces together, the one in the middle either entered by breaking the front window, or impossible and one of the ones on the side with the column, going over the hood. The second night I had to go to the parking lot next door, much cheaper. If you have a big car, don't put it in. Second setback, the air conditioning does not go above 22 degrees, you call the reception: "I'll pass it on to the technician and he'll turn it up immediately", I'm already at home and I'm still waiting for him, I was cold in the room, but on the other hand, one thing I haven't seen, the bathroom mirror looks like a radiator at 90 degrees, when I came back I had a tan that I had never seen before. They would also think that my wife and I used the same toothbrush.
And now the positive, the great rooms, the detail of the coffee and water in them, super spacious and very clean. The breakfast was exaggerated and the facilities in general were very good, including the restaurant, which I recommend. Many people are afraid of hotel restaurants, but they are much better than many in any city and not at all expensive.

y 6.- (para no alargarme mas porque os garantizo que podria seguir) Esta a tan solo 3 minutos andando de la impresionante Catedral de Burgos. No te dejan ni empezar a pasear y ya estas delante de monumentos, bares, restautantes y mil cosas mas. Asi no hay quien haga el mas minimo ejercicio.

name: Segaristretto
review_text: Dieses Hotel hat die perfekte Lage fur eine Besichtigung von Burgos. Man ist zu Fuss (flach) in wenigen Minuten bei der Kathedrale, in der Innenstadt und bei Restaurants.|Das Fruhstucksbuffet ist gross und hat eine gute Auswahl, auch regionale Spezialitaten und guten Kase, keine industriellen Produkte. Sogar frische, reife Fruchte. Jeden Morgen noch einen frischen Smoothie-Shot (z.B. Rande-Karotte). |Die Zimmer sind gut ausgestattet, es funktioniert alles, die Frottetucher sind einmalig (dick, trocknen gut und Fuseln nicht).|Parkgarage im Haus (etwas eng, aber super).|Die Fenster sind leidet mit Einfach-Verglasung, sodass der Larm der Hauptstrasse vor der Tur auch bei geschlossenem Fenster zu horen ist.|Das Interieur in den Zimmern ist etwas ,old-style ,
review_translated_text: This hotel is in the perfect location for sightseeing in Burgos. The cathedral, the city center, and restaurants are just a few minutes' walk away (on flat ground). The breakfast buffet is extensive and has a good selection, including regional specialties and good cheese, no industrial products. There's even fresh, ripe fruit. Every morning, there's a fresh smoothie shot (e.g., beetroot and carrot). The rooms are well-equipped, everything works, and the terry towels are exceptional (thick, dry well, and don't pill). There's a parking garage on site (a bit cramped, but great). The windows are single-glazed, so the noise from the main street outside can be heard even with the windows closed. The room interiors are somewhat dated.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: OLEG
review_text:
Otel raspolozhen na protivopolozhnoy storone reki, naprotiv Arki - glavnoy dostoprimechatelnosti goroda. Bolshaya reception, bystroe zaselenie. Potrebovali kartu Visa dlya blokirovki sredstv za zavtrak i mini-yuar, chto vyglyadelo strannovato i neskolko oskorbitelno (v drugih otelya etoy seti ne trebuyut). Odnako otstali, kogda ya skazal, chto Visa vse ravno ne rabotaet.
Nomer bolshoy, chistyy, prostornyy, beloe bele. Est chaynik, kofe-mashina, mini-holodilnik. Bolshoy, udobnyy sanuzel, sovmeshchen s prihozhey i rakovinoy.
Net prikrovatnoy rozetki. Nomer vyhodil na ulicu s vezdom v gospital i na podzemnuyu parkovku zhilogo kompleksa. Do nochi gudeli i gazovali mashiny. A s utra poehali musorosborshchiki. Nu i kak vy dumaete, ya vyspalsya? Tak chto ves etot uyut nomera - na smarku.
review_translated_text:
The hotel is located on the opposite side of the river, opposite the Arch - the main attraction of the city. Large reception, quick check-in. They demanded a Visa card to block funds for breakfast and mini-SA, which looked strange and somewhat offensive (other hotels in this chain do not require it). However, they left me alone when I said that Visa did not work anyway. 
The room is large, clean, spacious, white linen. There is a kettle, coffee machine, mini-fridge. Large, comfortable bathroom, combined with a hallway and sink. 
No bedside socket. The room overlooked the street with an entrance to the hospital and the underground parking of a residential complex. Cars honked and revved until nightfall. And in the morning the garbage collectors arrived. Well, do you think I got enough sleep? So all this comfort of the room - down the drain.

name: Dori GC
review_text:
Ubicacion en pleno centro, esto hace que si te alojas con vista el ruido es tremendo, las ventanas no estan adecuadas y se escucha el ruido de fuera.
Te ponen de obsequio cafe y cuando fuimos hacerlo las tazas estaban sucias, una de las luces de la habitacion no habia como apagarla.
Le comentamos todo esto a la persona encargada ( no recuerdo el nombre, pero me dijeron que era "la jefa") a lo que se rie diciendo que si no sabemos apagar una luz que todas tienen interruptor. Manda al chico de mantenimiento ( muy majo) y nos dice que estaba mal enchufado.
Nos cambia de habitacion a una interior y cuando voy a sentarme a la cama se mueve y caigo al suelo, se lo cuento a la encarga ( de nuevo) y se vuelve a reir con prepotencia diciendo que todas las camas tienen ruedas ( vaya me trato en todo momento de tonta y en ningun momento se preocupo de si me habia o no hecho dano) envia a una chica de limpieza y nos dice que estaba mal la cama que no se habia bajado...
La habitacion muy bonita pero la cama y las almohadas horribles.
Prefiero tener peor ubicacion pero tener personal amable y comodidad a la hora de dormir, puesto que la finalidad de un hotel es descansar .

Ni loca me vuelvo alojar en este hotel.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Dori 
En primer lugar, nos gustaria aprovechar esta oportunidad para agradecerle la confianza que ha depositado en nuestra cadena, NH Hotel Group y por haber compartido su experiencia con nosotros. Su opinion es muy importante para nosotros ya que nos ayuda a situarnos en el mercado y nos motiva a seguir creciendo. 
Desearia expresar nuestra contrariedad por los aspectos desfavorables que nos relata, ocurridos durante su estancia y que en ningun caso contribuyeron a su completo bienestar. Lamento que su experiencia no haya sido memorable, espero que la proxima vez estemos a la altura de sus expectativas.
Reiteramos nuestro agradecimiento y espero poder saludarlo personalmente la proxima vez que decida hospedarse con nosotros. Cualquier duda o comentario adicional que tenga estamos a su entera disposicion. Gracias y saludos.
review_translated_text:
The location is right in the center, so if you stay with a view, the noise is tremendous. The windows aren't adequate, and you can hear the noise from outside.
They give you complimentary coffee, and when we went to get it, the cups were dirty. One of the lights in the room couldn't be turned off.
We mentioned all this to the person in charge (I don't remember her name, but they told me she was "the boss"), who laughed, saying that we don't know how to turn off a light, since all of them have a switch. He sent the maintenance guy (very nice) and told us it was plugged in incorrectly.
They moved us to an interior room, and when I went to sit on the bed, it moved and I fell to the floor. I told the manager (again), and she laughed arrogantly, saying that all the beds had wheels (she treated me like an idiot the whole time and never cared whether I was hurt). She sent a cleaning lady and told us that the bed was not in good condition and hadn't been lowered.
The room was very nice, but the bed and pillows were horrible.
I'd rather have a worse location but have friendly staff and a comfortable bed, since the purpose of a hotel is to rest.

I wouldn't stay at this hotel again.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Dori,
First of all, we would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the trust you have placed in our chain, NH Hotel Group, and for sharing your experience with us. Your opinion is very important to us as it helps us position ourselves in the market and motivates us to continue growing.
I would like to express our disappointment regarding the unfavorable aspects you described during your stay, which in no way contributed to your complete well-being. I regret that your experience was not memorable; I hope we can live up to your expectations next time.
We reiterate our gratitude and look forward to greeting you personally the next time you decide to stay with us. We are always at your disposal for any additional questions or comments you may have. Thank you and best regards.

review_text: Nestled in the heart of the historic city, NH Collection Palacio de Burgos is a testament to luxury, comfort, and impeccable service, making my stay truly unforgettable. This beautifully restored palace, with its blend of gothic charm and modern elegance, offers a unique gateway to the rich heritage and beauty of Burgos, Spain.From the moment I stepped into the grand lobby, I was struck by the hotel's attention to detail. The preservation of historical features, including stunning stained glass and intricate stone arches, alongside contemporary design, creates an ambiance that is both inviting and awe-inspiring. It's a place where history and modernity harmoniously coexist, offering guests a one-of-a-kind experience.The rooms at NH Collection Palacio de Burgos are a haven of comfort. With plush bedding, state-of-the-art amenities, and breathtaking views of the Burgos Cathedral or the Arlanzon River, every element is designed to provide the ultimate relaxation. The subtle elegance of the decor, combined with the latest technology, ensures a stay that is both comfortable and connected.Dining at the hotel is an experience in itself. The breakfast buffet is a gastronomic delight, offering a wide variety of local and international dishes. Fresh, high-quality ingredients and a charming setting make for the perfect start to the day. The hotel's restaurant further impresses with its innovative cuisine, drawing on traditional Spanish flavors to create dishes that are both familiar and surprising.Service at NH Collection Palacio de Burgos is unparalleled. The staff go above and beyond to ensure every guest feels welcomed and valued. Their recommendations for local attractions and dining options were invaluable, making my exploration of Burgos all the more enriching. It's clear that hospitality is not just a service here; it's a passion.Located within walking distance to many of Burgos' iconic landmarks, including the majestic Burgos Cathedral and the historic city center, the hotel serves as an ideal base for exploring the city's treasures. Yet, its tranquil ambiance also provides a serene retreat from the bustling streets outside.In summary, NH Collection Palacio de Burgos stands out as a jewel in the city's accommodation offerings. Its blend of historical elegance, modern luxury, and stellar service creates an environment where guests can truly immerse themselves in the splendor of Burgos. My stay was not just comfortable; it was a memorable experience that highlighted the best of Spanish hospitality and the rich cultural tapestry of Burgos. Whether you're visiting for business or pleasure, NH Collection Palacio de Burgos is a destination that promises to enchant and inspire.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Bruce Scott
review_text:
Centrally located. An easy 5 minute walk to Plaza Mayor and the city center. The Catedral de Burgos is an easy 10 minute walk. The castle is a 15 minute walk. Set just across from the river, you can stroll along the river banks and take in the natural beauty of the city.

The rooms are spacious and well appointed. Full-scale bathroom and lavatory area. Two closets, coffee bar area, refrigerator, room safe, two chairs, and a two person sofa. There is a desk (with one of the chairs) with USB plugs and an electrical outlet. When I said spacious, I do mean spacious for this not being one of their suites.

My only critique of the bath area is that the tub should have either more grab bars or the tub floor should have anti-slip strips.

The staff in the hotel is wonderful! Reception is very efficient both with check-in and check out. Questions were always answered with a smile and suggestions when requested.  The cocktail bar staff is friendly and attentive.

There is lemon water next to reception. After a day's walk about, a cold refreshing glass of water is most welcome.

Be sure to pay attention to their ecological conservation offers. You are rewarded with a beverage for delaying room service. This is a very creative idea to help conserve both water and energy.

I only have one small critical critique of one minor arrangement regarding the in-room coffee service. When we arrived, the in-room coffee bar only had 3 coffee pods - 1 intense, 1 normal and 1 decaffeinated.  Going down to reception to inquire of an extra coffee pod or two,  we were told that there would be a charge. However, if we waited until the next morning, housekeeping would provide any number of pods, no additional charge. This appears odd to me in that it delays the morning coffee "fix". For morning tea drinkers, this won't be an issue as there were numerous tea options and a kettle. Minor detail, but the reason for this process eludes me.

I highly recommend this hotel and look forward to staying here again during my winter holiday visit.
response_from_owner_text:
Dear Bruce,
First and foremost, we would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the trust you have placed in our chain, NH Hotel Group, and for having shared your experience with us. 
I am glad to know that your stay at NH Collection Palacio de Burgos hotel has been at the height of your expectations. We hope to continue providing a high-quality service so that your satisfaction is not diminished.

We really thank you for your comments. We feel positively overwhelmed by the level of detail in your review, it is certainly an appropriate summary to define the work we do daily so that customers can enjoy memorable experiences like yours.
Last but not least, I hope to see you again very soon, do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further question.
Sincere Regards

review_text: Ya he acudido muchas ocasiones para comer o cenar en la gran sala central por motivo de diferentes eventos, el menu siempre a sido adecuado y correcto, lo que sorprende es que tras tantos anos transcurridos aun no han sido capaces de mejorar a acustica de la sala comedor, el nivel de ruido es muy molesto debido seguramente a las reverberaciones provocadas por los materiales de construccion de la sala
response_from_owner_text: Muchisimas gracias por dejarnos su opinion, trabajaremos junto con el departamento de ingenieria en el tema que nos indica, gracias por ayudarnos a mejorar, reciba un cordial Jaime, hasta pronto,
review_translated_text: I have already gone on many occasions to have lunch or dinner in the large central room for different events, the menu has always been adequate and correct, what is surprising is that after so many years they have not yet been able to improve the acoustics of the dining room, the noise level is very annoying, probably due to the reverberations caused by the construction materials of the room.

name: Chris Perry

The staff was friendly and the breakfast was great.

We are also really proud of our historic building and we are glad to hear you enjoyed it to. 
Looking forward to welcome you again in the near future. 
Kind regards,
Ana Salcedo

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Dario Dell'Aversana
review_text:
Premetto che ho viaggiato molto con NH e scelgo questi hotel per posizione e cortesia.
Posizione ok, vicino al centro ma come tanto hotel della zona sicuramente meglio di questo.
Il personale dell'hotel fa la differenza in un soggiorno. Bene, qui hanno fatto un disastro. Staff inesperto ( stagista al check in da sola=1 ora per fare check in ), maleducazione totale. Zero sorrisi.
Noi avevamo un piccolo cagnolino e in altri NH ci hanno sempre messo la cuccia e i biscottini. Qui nonostante si paghi il supplemento, zero attenzioni.
Ma il peggio deve venire. Avevamo la colazione inclusa ma non potendo portare il cagnolino, l'abbiamo fatta togliere. Quando poi abbiamo deciso di farla, hanno deciso di farla pagare 10 euro in piu. La manager, una signora bionda che dovrebbe imparare l'educazione mi ha praticamente insultato dandomi dell' ignorante davanti alla fila di persone. Scusate ma io pago un servizio per questo genere di truffe? Mai piu!
response_from_owner_text:
Estimado Dario Dell'Aversana,
Muchas gracias por su comentario sobre su experiencia en nuestro hotel.
Para nosotros es vital conocer la opinion de nuestro huespedes y saber como resulto la estancia en nuestro establecimiento.
Tomo nota de sus observaciones sobre las mascotas y el desayuno.
Espero que en una proxima visita a nuestra ciudad vuelva a hospedarse con nosotros y mejoremos su percepcion del hotel.
Reciba un cordial saludo.
review_translated_text:
Let me start by saying that I have traveled a lot with NH and I choose these hotels for location and courtesy.
Location ok, close to the center but like many hotels in the area, certainly better than this one.
The hotel staff makes the difference in a stay. Well, they made a mess here. Inexperienced staff (intern checking in alone = 1 hour to check in), total rudeness. Zero smiles.
We had a small dog and in other NHs they always provided us with a kennel and biscuits. Here despite paying the supplement, zero attention.
But the worst is to come. We had breakfast included but as we couldn't bring the dog, we had it removed. Then when we decided to do it, they decided to charge 10 euros more. The manager, a blonde lady who should learn education, practically insulted me by calling me ignorant in front of the line of people. Excuse me but do I pay for a service for this type of scam? Never again!
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Dario Dell'Aversana,
Thank you very much for your comment about your experience at our hotel.
It's vital for us to hear our guests' opinions and how their stay was.
I've taken note of your comments about the pets and breakfast.
I hope you'll stay with us again on your next visit to our city and we can improve your perception of the hotel.
Kind regards.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: lidia soto
review_text:
Quizas no tendria que poner en Google comentarios negativos a "todos los hoteles NH" como dice usted, si tras mis quejas (presentadas tanto en recepcion como por via email), alguien del equipo de atencion al cliente de NH se hubiera dignado a ponerse en contacto conmigo y ofrecerme una disculpa. Creo que es lo minimo que puede hacer una empresa cuando un cliente queda insatisfecho: preguntar que ha pasado, solicitar sugerncias de mejora y ofrecer una disculpa (de 1o de marketing me atreveria a decir...).

NH pretende seguir viviendo de las rentas, de un lujo que un dia tuvo, y del que hoy tan solo quedan resquicios por la falta de renovacion y mantenimiento. Hoteles que en su dia fueron sinonimo de un turismo que rozaba la excelencia y del que hoy solo se desprende mediocridad a un precio muy caro. Desde luego, NH ya no cuenta con mi confianza como cliente, y debera hacer algo mas que un amago de mejora, si quiere sobrevivir en un sector servicios tan exigente como el actual.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Lidia Soto. 
Lamento su comentario como el que hace en Google a todos los hoteles NH. 
Reciba un cordial saludo.
review_translated_text:
Maybe I wouldn't have to put negative comments on Google for "all NH hotels" as you say, if after my complaints (presented both at reception and via email), someone from the NH customer service team had deigned to contact me and offer me an apology. I think it's the least a company can do when a customer is dissatisfied: ask what happened, ask for suggestions for improvement and offer an apology (from the 1st level of marketing, I would dare say...).

NH intends to continue living off the income, a luxury that it once had, and of which today only gaps remain due to the lack of renovation and maintenance. Hotels that were once synonymous with tourism that bordered on excellence and from which today only mediocrity emerges at a very expensive price. Of course, NH no longer has my trust as a client, and will have to do more than just a hint of improvement, if it wants to survive in a service sector as demanding as the current one.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Lidia Soto. 
I regret your comment, like the one you make on Google to all NH hotels. 
Receive a cordial greeting.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Im on the Beach
review_text:
Burgos is half way between Paris and the Costa del Sol, a great place to stop for the night on the road.  This hotel was a fantastic oasis of luxury and they accept dogs which is why we chose them.  The room was fully fitted with warm wood, cozy sofa, bathtub, and they gave us treats for the dog- a dog bed, biscuits and food and water bowls as well as a tag for the door so the cleaners don't enter if the dog is alone.  The location is good for walking to the beautiful historic center of Burgos where you will find huge pedestrian zone with literally hundreds or thousands of tapas bars each more typical than the next, outdoor living all year round.
Very large and cozy beds and silent room. We took a standard room on the quiet back street, as the premium rooms with views are over the main boulevard.  They looked sound proofed but we didn't need the view.
The hotel has a huge reception area in a historic courtyard and there was a very large reception this night but we didn't hear any of it from our room 228.  Would not have wanted to be closer to the party though so make sure you ask for a quiet room.
Will definitely come back on our way back and forth with our dog!

No, no volveremos y respecto a NH..pondremos en quarentena sus hoteles.

review_translated_text:
We stayed one night, thank goodness!!!
It is supposed to be a 5 X star hotel that should make us feel special... well NO.

1 Good large parking.
2. At reception... I would say that the "sympathy" shined... due to the absence... correct treatment but little interest, because an environment is not created in which the customer feels special...
3. The breakfast buffet...well, nothing special.
4. The room, they gave us 2 BEDS, I called them and they said they didn't have any more... (I doubt the hotel was full, not even joking!...want not to work).

The water constantly loses water (lack of maintenance, and inspection), there is no light and sockets....BUT THE STAR THE BATHROOM EXTRACTOR WAS NOT TURNED OFF AND THE HEATING OFF WAS NOISE....we called the reception and nothing could be put up with, not even a change of room, and not even in the slightest chance that someone would go up to the room to check it...just a dirty service, without empathy, or love for the job.

I think it is a good hotel, it has its charm but it shows that there is no one in charge to control the details and turn the stay into a good experience, lowering its category enough to write!!
There are many 5-star hotels, this hotel has the ingredients, location, historical building, to turn it into an experience... but they are making it bad because of the issues mentioned and others... to sleep I had to take a pill that I only take in very rare cases... but it was either that or we didn't sleep.
No, we will not return and regarding NH... we will quarantine their hotels.

We will return to Burgos...but in another hotel...regards

name: PattyMilano
review_text: L'hotel e in una ottima posizione per la visita di Burgos a poche centinaia di metri dal centro storico, dalla favolosa cattedrale e dalla bella passeggiata alberata lungo il fiume piena di bar e ristoranti. L'albergo e in parte collocato in un bel edificio storico a cui e stata aggiunta un ala piu moderna. ||Il personale della reception e molto disponibile e professionale, anche se c'era molta gente siamo riusciti a fare un check-in veloce. Molto gentile anche il personale addetto alla pulizia delle camere.||Noi avevamo prenotato una camera Premium: camera abbastanza accogliente, grande con ampia zona armadi e bagno spazioso. Abbiamo preferito una camera sull'interno, senza vista sul fiume, perche piu silenziosa. ||L'albergo all'interno ha un antico chiostro, ora coperto, da cui si accede alla sala per la colazione: discreta come qualita, un po' affollata.  ||L'albergo dispone di un parcheggio interno abbastanza stretto. A poche centinaia di metri vi e un parcheggio pubblico "Parking Catedral Plaza de la Vega" molto comodo: noi abbiamo preferito parcheggiare li.
review_translated_text: The hotel is in an excellent location for visiting Burgos, just a few hundred meters from the historic center, the fabulous cathedral and the beautiful tree-lined walk along the river full of bars and restaurants. The hotel is partly located in a beautiful historic building to which a more modern wing has been added. ||The reception staff is very helpful and professional, even though there were a lot of people we managed to check in quickly. The room cleaning staff were also very kind.||We had booked a Premium room: a fairly comfortable room, large with ample wardrobe space and spacious bathroom. We preferred a room on the inside, without a view of the river, because it was quieter. ||The hotel has an ancient cloister inside, now covered, which leads to the breakfast room: decent in quality, a little crowded. ||The hotel has a fairly narrow internal car park. A few hundred meters away there is a very convenient public car park "Parking Catedral Plaza de la Vega": we preferred to park there.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: bocause
review_text: Auf dem Weg nach Portugal bin ich in Burgos "gestrandet" und hatte mit dem Palacio eine gute Wahl getroffen. Ein Bisschen kompliziert war es, die Einflugschneise zur Tiefgarage zu finden, aber einmal drin, dauerte es nur noch 20', die Droschke einzuparken. Nicht die Schuld der jahrhundertealten Mauern, sondern eher des zu grossen Autos. Dass man aber wegen der dort befindlichen Tur  nicht ganz an die Wand fahren sollte ("Legen Sie den Leerlauf ein"), war, naja, schwierig. Empfang war nett, Zimmer sehr gut - alles prima. Und die Lage ist naturlich klasse, man ist mittendrin. Das Fruhstuck liess auch keine Wunsche offen und das Gebaude, der Palast, ist in der Tat beeindruckend.
review_translated_text: On my way to Portugal, I got stranded in Burgos and made a good choice by staying at the Palacio. It was a bit tricky finding the approach path to the underground parking garage, but once inside, it only took another 20 minutes to park the cab. Not the fault of the centuries-old walls, but rather of the car being too big. However, the fact that you shouldn't drive right up against the wall because of the door ("Put the car in neutral") was, well, difficult. The reception was friendly, the room very good--everything was perfect. And the location is, of course, fantastic; you're right in the middle of everything. The breakfast left nothing to be desired, and the building, the palace, is truly impressive.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: jofemafe
review_text:
Mala experiencia. Vamos por partes. No entiendo, aunque lo avisen, que la entrada a las habitaciones esten pospuestas a las 15:00, pero bueno es lo que hay. Lo que no me parece correcto es que cuando llegas a las 15:00 para poder dejar tus maletas y ocupar "tu" habitacion haya problemas. "La habitacion no esta limpia, estara en media hora". Esas fueron las palabras de la recepcionista. Ante nuestra insistencia se nos adjudica otra, pero que estara en 15 min. aceptamos. La sorpresa es cuando accedemos a la habitacion, esta huele a tabaco que echa para atras. Se lo comentamos a la persona que acaba de limpiar la habitacion y nos dice: "pues yo no lo huelo, si quieren les pongo un ambientador"... Evidentemente vamos a recepcion para que nos cambien la habitacion, nos ofrecen una pero mas pequena ??? Les decimos que hemos pagado por una habitacion y que no queremos una mas pequena. Nos adjudican una. Mi pregunta es, ? estaria esa nueva habitacion disponible hace una hora? ?No nos la podian haber adjudicado antes? Por fin tenemos una habitacion a las 15:45 horas aproximadamente.
Pero la mala experiencia no acaba aqui. Cuando hacemos el check in de la habitacion pregunto si hay que reservar para cenar en el restaurante del hotel. La recepcionista me dice que no, que no hay problema. Con eso nos quedamos. Por la noche bajamos a las 21:30 horas a cenar y nos encontramos con un cartel en la entrada del comedor que dice que estan llenos!!! Me asomo y veo dos  mesas vacias y otras dos que estan por recoger, sus comensales ya se habian ido. Le pregunto a la persona si es posible cenar, pero que no, que esta todo lleno???. Le comento en que por la tarde me dijeron que no habria problemas, tras explicarselo me dice que en 30 minutos bajemos a ver si hay mesa... (dos mesas vacias dispuestas y otras dos por arreglar que podrian usarse). Bajamos a la media hora y nada mas asomarnos me doy cuenta que las cuatro mesas que antes estaban, pienso, disponibles lo siguen estando, ?por que no nos las dieron al llegar hacia media hora? No entiendo nada. Que desastre. No suelo hacer resenas negativas de los lugares a donde voy, pero fue tantas cosas que he tenido que hacer esta. Que los responsables del hotel conozcan el trato que nos dieron. Saludos.
review_translated_text:
Bad experience. Let's go in parts. I don't understand, even though they warn you, that the entrance to the rooms is postponed to 3:00 p.m., but it is what it is. What doesn't seem right to me is that when you arrive at 3:00 p.m. to be able to leave your suitcases and occupy "your" room there are problems. "The room is not clean, it will be in half an hour." Those were the words of the receptionist. At our insistence we are awarded another one, but it will be in 15 minutes. we accept. The surprise is when we enter the room, it smells of tobacco that makes us turn back. We mention it to the person who has just cleaned the room and he tells us: "well, I don't smell it, if you want I'll put an air freshener on it"... Obviously we go to reception to change our room, they offer us a smaller one??? We tell them that we have paid for a room and that we do not want a smaller one. They give us one. My question is, would that new room be available an hour ago? Couldn't they have awarded it to us before? We finally have a room at approximately 3:45 p.m.
But the bad experience doesn't end here. When we check in to the room I ask if we need to make a reservation for dinner at the hotel restaurant. The receptionist tells me no, there is no problem. That's what we're left with. At night we went down at 9:30 p.m. to have dinner and we found a sign at the entrance to the dining room that says they are full!!! place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Honey
review_text:
Un hotel excelente en el centro de la ciudad. Tiene un facil acceso al garaje y bastante espacio para aparcar. La habitacion donde nos hospedamos era grande y con vistas al centro urbano; teniamos un hervidor de agua y una cafetera para preparar infusiones o cafe, (cortesia de la casa).
Todo estaba muy limpio y cuidado.
El personal tambien fue muy amable.
Hay un recibidor enorme con sofas y bar para esperar mientras te tomas algo.
Cuando sales del hotel y cruzas la carretera ya estas a lado de la catedral y de una de las calles principales; en tan solo dos minutos andando.
El tiempo que estuve en la habitacion no escuche ruido de otras habitaciones y durante la noche tampoco, perfecto para descansar.
Las camas y las almohadas tambien son muy comodas. Recomendado!
response_from_owner_text:
Estimado/a S,
Muchisimas gracias por publicar su comentario tan amable sobre su reciente estancia en nuestro hotel.
Creo que en su caso hemos conseguido lograr nuestro maximo objetivo, sorprender a nuestros clientes.
En NH Collection buscamos ofrecer algo mas que un buen servicio, eso es un aprobado y nosotros buscamos el sobresaliente.
Muchas gracias por su ayuda.
Saludos cordiales.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
An excellent hotel in the city center. It has easy access to the garage and plenty of parking space. The room where we stayed was large and with views of the city center; We had a kettle and a coffee maker to prepare infusions or coffee, (courtesy of the house).
Everything was very clean and cared for.
The staff was also very friendly.
There is a huge hall with sofas and a bar to wait while you have a drink.
When you leave the hotel and cross the road you are already next to the cathedral and one of the main streets; in just two minutes walk.
The time I was in the room I didn't hear noise from other rooms and neither did I during the night, perfect for resting.
The beds and pillows are also very comfortable. Recommended!
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear S,
Thank you very much for posting your kind comment about your recent stay at our hotel.
I believe that in your case we have achieved our ultimate goal: to impress our guests.
At NH Collection, we strive to offer more than just good service; that's a passing grade, and we strive for an A.
Thank you very much for your help.
Best regards.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Luis R
review_text:
Muy mala experiencia. Pagamos una habitacion normal y nos dan una buhardilla muy pequena y sin insonorizar (ademas habia un concierto, imposible dormir) en el ultimo piso.

Pido alguna compensacion, ya que no habia otras habitaciones disponibles por una boda y no me ofrecen nada, ni el desayuno, ni un misero cafe...

Ademas almohadas y colchon terriblemente incomodos, viejos y de mala calidad.

Como colofon final, me avisan de que el parking es de pago. En ningun momento nos lo dijeron en recepcion.

Evitar a toda costa. Burgos es precioso, pero una noche aqui te arruina la experiencia.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimado Luis R.
Lamento que su estancia haya supuesto una mala experiencia.
Me sorprende su sorpresa por el precio del parking. Esta publicado en nuestra web y antes de llegar a recepcion hay, al menos, dos carteles que indican la tarifa.
Se que le ofrecieron otras habitaciones por si deseaba cambiar pero que usted las rechazo.
Se que fuimos inflexibles a sus peticiones de descontar desayunos, parking, etc... a cambio de no publicar comentarios pero no es nuestra forma de actuar.
Gracias por ayudarnos a mejorar.
Reciba un cordial saludo.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
Very bad experience. We paid for a normal room and they gave us a very small and unsoundproof attic (there was also a concert, impossible to sleep) on the top floor.

I ask for some compensation, since there were no other rooms available for a wedding and they don't offer me anything, not breakfast, not even a measly coffee...

In addition, pillows and mattress were terribly uncomfortable, old and of poor quality.

As a final culmination, they tell me that parking is paid. At no time did they tell us at reception.

Avoid at all costs. Burgos is beautiful, but a night here ruins the experience.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Luis R.
I'm sorry your stay was a bad experience.
I'm surprised you were surprised by the parking price. It's posted on our website, and before you reach reception, there are at least two signs indicating the rate.
I know you were offered other rooms in case you wanted to change, but you declined.
I know we were inflexible in response to your requests for discounts on breakfast, parking, etc., in exchange for not posting comments, but that's not our way of doing business.
Thank you for helping us improve.
Best regards.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Marian Barbero
review_text:
Edito mi anterior resena, que dejo mas abajo. El sablazo de este ano ha superado toda perspectiva. El menu de fiesta,  esta vez de 50EU, se limito a 3 entrantes minusculos,  a compartir,   y un trozo de embutido que podeis ver en mis fotos. El servicio dejaba mucho que desear. Ha contratado a cuatro crios que rompieron media vajilla y a los que habia que recordar que faltaba vino en la mesa. Por mi parte, no repetiria, aunque es uno de los sitios preferidos para celebrar cenas de navidad,  etc. Lo bueno es que ponen discoteca abajo y no te tienes que desplazar. Le quito una estrella,  y dejo 3 unicamente porque el lugar es precioso.

......................................................

Muy bonito,  sin embargo,  la calidad/precio del restaurante muy mala. En una comida de empresa nos soplaron 40 EU por un platito de arroz y una porcion de bacalao rebozado,  con un triste trozo de tarta como postre.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Marian,
Muchas gracias por su valoracion y comentarios sobre su reciente experiencia en nuestro hotel.
Lamento que el menu le haya parecido escaso y el servicio poco profesional y a la vez me sorprende un poco ya que hemos recibido muchas felicitaciones por el servicio prestado ese dia.
En fin, comentare con mi equipo su opinion.
Gracias por su ayuda
Reciba un cordial saludo.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
I edit my previous review, which I leave below. This year's sabbath has surpassed all prospects. The party menu, this time for EU50, was limited to 3 tiny starters, to share, and a piece of sausage that you can see in my photos. The service left a lot to be desired. He has hired four kids who broke half a set of dishes and who had to be reminded that there was no wine on the table. For my part, I would not repeat it, although it is one of the favorite places to celebrate Christmas dinners, etc. The good thing is that they have a disco downstairs and you don't have to move. I take away one star, and leave 3 only because the place is beautiful.

....................................................

Very nice, however, the quality/price of the restaurant very bad. At a business lunch we were charged EU40 for a small plate of rice and a portion of battered cod, with a sad piece of cake for dessert.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Dear Marian,
Thank you very much for your review and comments about your recent experience at our hotel.
I'm sorry you found the menu sparse and the service unprofessional. I'm also a little surprised, as we received many compliments on the service provided that day.
Anyway, I'll share your feedback with my team.
Thank you for your help.
Best regards.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director

On the other hand, I think breakfast is exorbitantly priced, EU16 per guest per day... I don't really know what they will offer...but I guess it will be gold converted into food. Otherwise the hotel is beautiful, like all the NHs we have been to before, and the room is very cozy.

review_text:
Hice una reserva especificando que iria con mi perro, y hasta ahi todo bien. Mi sorpresa fue cuando llego al hotel y me quieren hacer firmar unas condiciones para el perro, una de ellas, la mas impactante, que el perro no se puede quedar en ningun momento solo en la habitacion. Ni para desayunar ni nada! En su pagina web del hotel ni en la de Booking tienen esta condicion. Obviamente y despues de "hablar" con las chicas de recepcion, que no pueden ser mas bordes, decidimos anular la reserva, quedandonos a las 3 de la tarde sin hotel despues de hacer un viaje de 3 horas. Yo soy consciente que me voy con mi perro, MI PERRO, al cual conozco y se que no va a dar ningun problema, por eso me lo llevo siempre que puedo, pero claro esta que cuando son las horas de desayuno, comida y cena, el perro ha de quedarse en la habitacion solo!
No es un hotel que admitan perros, asi no!! Lo hacen cara a la galeria para atraer clientes, pero en la realidad lo que consiguen es esto, rechazo absoluto a este hotel por su trato y sus empleadas. NO VOLVERE NI RECOMENDARE ESTE HOTEL!!
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Ana Rodrigo,
Lamento que no se haya podido alojar en el hotel por nuestras condiciones para mascotas.
Son las normas que aplicamos en todos los hoteles de la cadena. Las mascotas, por supuesto, son bienvenidas pero no pueden acceder a los restaurantes ni quedarse solas en la habitacion. No es la primera vez que algun cliente ha incumplido esta norma y los ladridos de la mascota ha impedido el descanso de las huespedes de las habitaciones contiguas.
Gracias por su ayuda.
Saludos cordiales.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
I made a reservation specifying that I would be traveling with my dog, and so far, everything was fine. My surprise came when I arrived at the hotel and they wanted me to sign some dog-friendly conditions. One of them, the most shocking, was that the dog cannot be left alone in the room at any time. Not even for breakfast or anything! This condition is not mentioned on the hotel's website or Booking.com. Obviously, after "talking" with the front desk staff, who couldn't be more rude, we decided to cancel the reservation, leaving us at 3 p.m. without a hotel after a three-hour trip. I'm aware that I'm traveling with my dog, MY DOG, whom I know won't cause any problems, so I take him whenever I can. But of course, during breakfast, lunch, and dinner, the dog must stay alone in the room!
This isn't a dog-friendly hotel, not like that! They do it for show to attract customers, but in reality, what they achieve is this: I absolutely reject this hotel for its service and its employees. I WILL NOT RETURN OR RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL!!
response_from_owner_translated_text:

I'm sorry you couldn't stay at the hotel due to our pet policies.
These are the rules we apply to all hotels in the chain. Pets, of course, are welcome, but they can't enter the restaurants or be left alone in the room. This isn't the first time a guest has violated this rule, and their pet's barking has prevented guests in adjacent rooms from sleeping.
Thank you for your help.
Best regards.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director

review_text:
El parking es complicadisimo y casi imposible como lleves un vehiculo que no sea mediano tirando a pequeno. No asignan plaza fija segun tamano con lo cual se hace todo mas dificil.
Lo peor de todo es lo rematadamente mal que tienen organizado el desayuno.
En la mayoria de hoteles lo han resuelto con Buffet pero que el cliente con unas pinzas se sirve el solito. Incluso en algunos te ponen unas pincitas individuales en cada asiento.
Los camareros se vuelven locos de un lado para otro sin darse cuenta que sirven a los que entran en lugar de los que ya estan dentro en la cola. Y tambien si vas en grupo o pareja que sirven a uno y se olvidan del otro. Solo hubo una camarera con algo mas de experiencia que lo tenia en  cuenta. Y asi tres dias la misma historia.  Un desastre. El organizador, se ha cubierto de gloria.  Asi al hotel le salen mejor las cuentas pues pides menos e intentas irte lo antes posible del comedor. Ademas el Buffet es un poco corto. Aunque puedes pedir que te hagan algo de cocina, con todo ese lio se te quitan las ganas. Y a todo esto los precios son de cuatro estrellas en la banda alta, no pienses que por ese descontrol hay alguna bonificacion
response_from_owner_text:
Estimado Antonio Guinda,
Muchas gracias por su valoracion y comentario sobre su reciente estancia en nuestro hotel.
En estos tiempos tan duros que estamos viviendo en el sector turistico, valoraciones como la suya nos ayudan de una manera importantisima.
Sobre el parking, nuestro sistema no nos permite la reserva de plaza y, sinceramente, no conozco ningun parking, al menos de hotel, que asignen plaza por tamanos de coche.
En cuanto al desayuno, lamentablemente la normativa autonomica en Castilla y Leon impide el servicio de buffet en las comidas por lo que nos vemos obligados a servir este buffet asistido que no satisface plenamente ni a los huespedes ni a nosotros.
Confio en que en su proxima estancia con nosotros hayamos superado esta situacion y podamos volver al buffet tradicional que tanto gustaba a nuestros clientes.

Saludos cordiales.

Director
review_translated_text:

The waiters go crazy from one place to another without realizing that they are serving those who enter instead of those who are already inside in line. And also if you go in a group or couple who serve one and forget the other. There was only one waitress with a little more experience who took it into account. And so for three days the same story.  A disaster. The organizer has covered himself in glory.  This way the hotel's bills work out better because you order less and try to leave the dining room as soon as possible. Also the Buffet is a bit short. Although you can ask them to do some cooking for you, with all that hassle you won't feel like it. And despite all this, the prices are four stars in the high range, do not think that because of this lack of control there is any bonus

review_text: We are in Burgos quite frequently and stay either here or at the AC Hotel across the river. In the past we have had great stays at the NH Collection here however this time was not as nice. Rooms are really starting to show their wear and while the building is architecturally historic and very beautiful everything needs a good renovation. They also are continuing a policy of minimal amenities (no coffee maker, hot water boiler) in the rooms which we were grumpily told was due to COVID policy by the night manager but which is really just cost savings (we have recently been at NH Collections in Leon, Berlin and Madrid that have no such policy and have fully stocked rooms). In fact - when we raised these issues with the night manager and asked him to pass them along to the main manager he replied, "you tell him - I've already done it." I would have loved the chance to raise these issues directly with the hotel upon checkout but I was not asked how my stay was (nor thanked for staying for that matter). We have already changed our next reservation and will be back at the much more welcoming AC next trip during the Christmas period.

name: Tra La Ra
review_text:
Decepcionante.
Estuvimos un fin de semana y la experiencia fue decepcionante.
Cogimos este hotel, pagando mas de lo que costaba cualquier hotel de Burgos ese mismo fin de semana, confiando en que era NH y que ademas era Collection. La estancia nos costo 100EU mas que si nos hubieramos alojado en cualquier otro hotel (bueno) de la ciudad.
Es un hotel que necesita reformar. Las habitaciones no se corresponden con las de las fotos. Hay bastantes desperfectos (suelo y muebles aranados; la mampara del bano tenia uno de los enganches de la pared casi suelto; papelera del bano con el pedal roto. Son desperfectos que no espero en un NH Collection).
Los amenities son escasisimos. Tuve que pedir un gorro de ducha y algodones desmaquillantes y parecia que les sonaba a ciencia ficcion que pidiera algo asi. Ademas, eran las 10 de la noche y no tenian a nadie que pudiera traerlos a la habitacion (?en un 4* NH Collection y no hay nadie para subir algo a la habitacion a un huesped?).
Las colas para el desayuno eran epicas. Por mucho que te hacian reservar la hora del desayuno, daba igual. Bajabas a tu hora y te toca esperar unos 15/20 minutos para desayunar.
En el salon de desayuno, los empleados no daban a abasto. Hacian todo lo que podian, pero faltaba personal. Habia mesas libres, y sin embargo, huespedes esperando en el pasillo para poder pasar a desayunar, y es porque los empleados no daban a abasto a atender a los huespedes que ya estaban dentro, limpiar las mesas y tomar el numero de habitacion y hacer pasar a los que estaban esperando.
"No me importo" esperar porque era un viaje de ocio, pero si vas por trabajo, esa espera para desayunar se puede llevar al traste tu desayuno y que tengas que ir con prisas o irte directamente sin desayunar.
El buffet no era tan variado como suele ser en los NH (y que es uno de los motivos por los que elijo esta cadena).
Ademas, el ambiente del salon de desayuno era super ruidoso y estresante. Parecia que estabas en un dia de trabajo en el bar de la esquina pidiendo el desayuno. Nada de ambiente relajado y tranquilo como suele ser en los hoteles de 4* y en particular en los NH (otro de los motivos por los que elijo esta cadena).
Reservamos con NH rewards y no tuvimos ningun privilegio ni ningun detalle ni trato especial. Me pregunto para que sirve ser rewards. En otros NH Collection si que han tenido algun detalle por ser rewards (por ejemplo, en el NH Collection Palacio de Oquendo -Caceres- nos pusieron un plato de fruta en la habitacion y una tarjeta de bienvenida y ademas en la habitacion habia un hervidor con cafe e infusiones).
Nos dieron una habitacion abuhardillada muy pequena para dos personas. Nos quejamos y nos cambiaron a otra habitacion de tamano normal.
Esas habitaciones abuhardilladas pequenas deberian ofrecerlas como habitaciones economicas.
Cuando nos quejamos, dijimos en recepcion que teniamos reservada una habitacion superior y nos contestaron que por ser NH Collection todas las habitaciones eran superiores. Pues ... La habitacion abuhardillada no tenia ni punto de comparacion con la que nos dieron despues.
Nos gusto tan poco la habitacion que preguntamos si era posible coger otra de categoria superior (pagando la diferencia). No fue posible porque el hotel estaba lleno. Lo curioso es que delante de nosotros, un senor extranjero pregunto lo mismo. O sea que no eramos los unicos decepcionados y a los que no nos gustaba la habitacion, ya que no se parecia a lo que se ve en la pagina.
Le sobra una estrella. Podria ser un hotel de 3*, pero no de 4*.
En fin, una pena. El edificio es bonito y esta bien situado, pero no volvere a alojarme ahi.

review_translated_text:
Disappointing.
We stayed for a weekend and the experience was disappointing.
We took this hotel, paying more than any hotel in Burgos cost that same weekend, trusting that it was NH and that it was also a Collection. The stay cost us EU100 more than if we had stayed in any other (good) hotel in the city.
It is a hotel that needs renovation. The rooms do not correspond to those in the photos. There are quite a few damages (scratched floor and furniture; the bathroom screen had one of the wall hooks almost loose; bathroom trash can with the pedal broken. These are damages that I do not expect in an NH Collection).
The amenities are very scarce. I had to ask for a shower cap and makeup remover pads and it seemed like it sounded like science fiction to ask for something like that. Also, it was 10 at night and they had no one to bring them to the room (in a 4* NH Collection and there is no one to bring something to a guest's room?).
The lines for breakfast were epic. No matter how much they made you reserve breakfast time, it didn't matter. You came down at your time and you have to wait about 15/20 minutes to have breakfast.
In the breakfast room, the employees could not cope. They did everything they could, but there was a lack of personnel. There were free tables, and yet guests were waiting in the hallway to be able to have breakfast, and it is because the employees were not able to attend to the guests who were already inside, clean the tables and take the room number and let in those who were waiting.
"I didn't mind" waiting because it was a leisure trip, but if you go for work, that wait for breakfast can ruin your breakfast and you may have to rush or leave without breakfast.
The buffet was not as varied as it usually is at NHs (which is one of the reasons I choose this chain).
Also, the atmosphere in the breakfast room was super loud and stressful. It seemed like you were on a work day at the corner bar ordering breakfast. Nothing of the relaxed and calm atmosphere as is usually the case in 4* hotels and particularly in NH hotels (another reason why I choose this chain).
We booked with NH rewards and we did not have any privileges or any details or special treatment. I wonder what the point of being rewards is. In other NH Collections they have had some details for being rewards (for example, in the NH Collection Palacio de Oquendo -Caceres- they gave us a plate of fruit in the room and a welcome card and also in the room there was a kettle with coffee and infusions).
They gave us a very small attic room for two people. We complained and they moved us to another normal size room.
Those small attic rooms should be offered as economy rooms.
When we complained, we told reception that we had reserved a superior room and they told us that because it was NH Collection, all the rooms were superior. Well... The attic room had no point of comparison with the one they gave us later.
We didn't like the room so much that we asked if it was possible to get another one with a higher category (paying the difference). It was not possible because the hotel was full. The curious thing is that in front of us, a foreign man asked the same thing. So we weren't the only ones who were disappointed and didn't like the room, since it didn't look like what you see on the page.
It has one star left. It could be a 3* hotel, but not a 4*.
In short, a shame. The building is nice and well located, but I won't stay there again.

review_text: Su calidad en el servicio a la aplicacion " To good to go" no puede ser mas nefasta y enganosa. Por 4 euros te ponen 4 trozos de pan 1 loncha de jamon York, 1 de jamon serrano, 3 " cunitas" (Porque no pueden ser mas pequenas y finas) de queso, un trocito de pina hecho laminas, 1 trocito de sandia hecho laminitas, 1 trocito de melon hecho laminitas, (cuando digo trocitos hablo del tamano de un pulgar), 1 palmerita, 1 mini napolitana y 1 mini croasant. Todo esto ultimo todo de bolleria industrial. Me parece un engano que te cobren 4 euros por algo que en el supermercado no cuesta mas de 2. Deberian quitarlo de la aplicacion y no seguir enganando y aprovechandose de la gente. Como hotel no discuto que sea de lo mejor de Burgos, pero en lo referente a "to good to go" se deberian borrar porque lo unico que conseguiran es que no vaya ni a tomar un cafe. Que pena y que recepcion.
review_translated_text: Their service quality on the "To good to go" app couldn't be more disastrous and misleading. For 4 euros they give you 4 pieces of bread, 1 slice of York ham, 1 slice of Serrano ham, 3 "wedges" (because they couldn't be any smaller and thinner) of cheese, a slice of pineapple, 1 slice of watermelon, 1 slice of melon (when I say pieces I mean the size of a thumb), 1 palmerita, 1 mini Neapolitan, and 1 mini croissant. All of the latter are industrial pastries. I think it's a scam that they charge you 4 euros for something that doesn't cost more than 2 in the supermarket. They should remove it from the app and stop deceiving and taking advantage of people. As a hotel, I don't dispute that it's one of the best in Burgos, but regarding "to good to go," they should remove it because the only thing they'll achieve is that I won't even go for a coffee. What a shame and what a reception.

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Carmen M
review_text:
El hotel esta muy bien situado, muy cerca de la Catedral, y la fachada es impresionante. La recepcion tambien es muy agradable. Sin embargo la habitacion que nos toco olia muy mal, como a rancio.
Reservamos cama de matrimonio y nos pusieron dos camas pequenas pegadas que se separaban con demasiada facilidad.
Ademas habia una cama plegable adicional que se ve que no habian quitado de los anteriores huespedes, lo que quitaba espacio a la habitacion.
El bano tambien olia bastante mal, a tuberias, y a rancio tambien, como si hubiera sido limpiado con una bayeta sucia.
El agua de la ducha salia sin apenas presion, y la puerta estaba hinchada y rota por la parte baja de la misma. La verdad en mi opinion el precio que hemos pagado no se corresponde para nada ni con la calidad ni el estado en el que se encontraba la habitacion. Desde luego, no me esperaba para nada algo asi de un NH, ni mucho menos de un "Collection". Creo que la limpieza, la ventilacion, el "buen olor" y el correcto mantenimiento de las habitaciones es fundamental en cualquier hotel. No volvere a este hotel.
response_from_owner_text:
Estimada Carmen M,
Muchas gracias por su valoracion y comentario sobre su reciente estancia en nuestro hotel.
Lamento muchisimo que no le haya satisfecho la habitacion que le asignamos durante su estancia.
Me sorprende el comentario sobre los olores. Me interesare por saber la habitacion que ha ocupado y veremos lo ocurrido.
Confio que en su proxima visita estemos mas acertados.
Muchas gracias por su ayuda.
Saludos cordiales.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
The hotel is very well located, very close to the Cathedral, and the facade is impressive. The reception is also very nice. However, the room we had had a very bad smell, like musty.
We booked a double bed and they gave us two small beds pushed together that were separated too easily.
There was also an additional folding bed that had not been removed from the previous guests, which took up space in the room.
The bathroom also smelled quite bad, like pipes, and rancid too, as if it had been cleaned with a dirty cloth.
The shower water came out with hardly any pressure, and the door was swollen and broken at the bottom. The truth is, in my opinion, the price we paid does not correspond at all to the quality or the condition in which the room was. Of course, I didn't expect something like that from an NH at all, much less from a "Collection". I believe that cleanliness, ventilation, "good smell" and proper maintenance of the rooms is essential in any hotel. I will not return to this hotel.

Thank you very much for your review and comment about your recent stay at our hotel.
I am very sorry that you were not satisfied with the room we assigned you during your stay.
I am surprised by the comment about the odors. I will be interested in finding out which room you occupied and we will see what happened.
I trust that we will be more accurate on your next visit.
Thank you very much for your help.
Best regards.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director

name: belen aguirre sanz de bremond
review_text:
Excelente ubicacion.
Muy buen trato.
Detalles para los peques. Neceser en la habitacion y platos,cuencos y cubiertos en el desayuno.
La lavanderia es externa y no tiene servicio el fin de semana, para mi fue un fallo xq el peque se puso malo y vomito mucho, si no es un punto de poca importancia.
Habitaciones muy grandes, nos cabia supletoria, cuna y sobraba mucho sitio para moverse!
Buena insonorizacion, hubo un evento el viernes y no nos hubiesemos enterado si no hubiese tenido que salir de noche a urgencias.
El desayuno buffet es caro, pero merece la pena. Tambien se puede tomar un desayuno normal que es mas economico.
El propio hotel es precioso, sobre todo el claustro.
Nos ha encantado. Si volvemos a Burgos repetiremos en este hotel.

Muchas gracias por su valoracion y detallado comentario sobre nuestro hotel en Google.
Nos produce una inmensa satisfaccion saber que ha disfrutado de nuestras edificio, ubicacion, desayuno y del confort de las habitaciones.
Espero que le prestemos un servicio aun mejor en su proxima visita.
Muchas gracias.
Saludos cordiales.

Alfonso Ruiz
Director
review_translated_text:
Excellent location.
Very good service.
Little details for the kids. Toiletry bag in the room and plates, bowls, and cutlery at breakfast.
The laundry room is off-site and doesn't have service on the weekends. In my opinion, this was a mistake because the little one got sick and vomited a lot. Otherwise, it's a minor point.
Very large rooms, we had room for an extra bed and crib, and plenty of room to move around!
Good soundproofing. There was an event on Friday, and we wouldn't have noticed if I hadn't had to go to the emergency room at night.
The breakfast buffet is expensive, but it's worth it. You can also have a regular breakfast, which is cheaper.
The hotel itself is beautiful, especially the cloister.
We loved it. If we return to Burgos, we will stay here again.

name: Juan Carlos Monteagudo
review_text:
Muy flojo para ser un 4 estrellas 'Premium'.
Espera de 10 minutos en la puerta del restaurante para poder desayunar porque no hay mesas cuando tienen el espacio en medio del claustro muerto de risa. Los empleados, que hacen lo que pueden, indican que el director ya conoce el problema.... 
Las zapatillas, que indican que estan incluidas en habitacion, hay que pedirlas en recepcion. Supongo que igual que el albornoz, que no pedi, que brillaba por su ausencia.
La habitacion 'Premium' que nos dieron para dos personas (no era barata...), muy pequena y oscura. Era un pasillo que no caben ni dos mesitas. Cualquier parecido con las de la web es pura coincidencia. Por cierto, ofrecen un checking online para elegir la habitacion antes de llegar que no funciona.
En cuanto a lo positivo, habitacion limpia, desayuno variado, bano grande pero mal distribuido, los empleados, amables.
Hay mejores hoteles incluso de 3 estrellas. NH era una buena cadena con multitud de detalles que ofrecian una oferta diferencial, que, temo, ya no es lo que era.
review_translated_text:
Very weak for a 4 star 'Premium'.
Wait 10 minutes at the door of the restaurant to have breakfast because there are no tables when they have the space in the middle of the cloister dying of laughter. The employees, who do what they can, indicate that the director already knows the problem.... 
Slippers, which indicate that they are included in the room, must be requested at reception. I suppose just like the bathrobe, which I didn't ask for, which was conspicuous by its absence.
The 'Premium' room they gave us for two people (it wasn't cheap...), very small and dark. It was a hallway that didn't even fit two tables. Any resemblance to those on the website is purely coincidental. By the way, they offer an online check-in to choose the room before arriving, which does not work.
As for the positive, clean room, varied breakfast, large but poorly distributed bathroom, friendly employees.
There are even better 3 star hotels. NH was a good chain with a multitude of details that offered a differential offer, which, I fear, is no longer what it was.

name: David Knapp
review_text:
Not much English spoken if at all in this area of Spain. Richly decorated building outside and delightfully minimal inside. The hotel is decorated with Spanish masterpieces reduced to a few lines or colors. There's a wonderful covered cloister area but that is unfortunately only used for functions. Instead, breakfast is served in an austere dining hall. Yogurt, fruit cheese and coffee is good. Somewhat lacking in the bread and sweets areas.
Comfy couches and light in the lobby/bar. Rooms and bathrooms are large.
Parking is easy. Pull up to the hotel, there are reserved spaces. Go in and get the pass and go to the garage. It is actually the opening just before the hotel and shared with Hertz, so you could back up 20 feet and go in but the safest way is to go around the block. Passages are comfortably wide and easy to maneuver.
Comfortable walk to old town and probably quieter.

name: Sheyla
review_text:
Maravilloso hotel en el centro de Burgos un palacio con un claustro precioso,como todo NH no defrauda, todo muy bonito y limpio con agua y fruta en recepcion por si quiere ser consumida, periodicos del dia para coger y leer, amabilidad de todo el personal!!
habitaciones grandes y limpias, una gran television,con hervidor de agua y cafetera nespreso, bano grande y limpio;puntuar que tuvimos un pequeno problema con las almohadas y hay que decir que el personal de recepcion tanto tomo las camareras de pisos hicieron todo lo posible para que nuestra estancia seria de lo mas agradable(mil gracias por todo)
El desayuno es espectacular no faltaba nada y las camareras dos chicas son un amor y dispuestas a todo!! Fue lo que mas me gusto el trato del hotel y la hora del desayuno!!
Pasamos unos dias muy buenos.

Wonderful hotel in the center of Burgos, a palace with a beautiful cloister, like all NH does not disappoint, everything very nice and clean with water and fruit at reception in case you want to consume it, daily newspapers to pick up and read, kindness of all the staff!!
Large and clean rooms, a large television, with a kettle and a Nespresso coffee maker, a large and clean bathroom; note that we had a small problem with the pillows and it must be said that the reception staff and the maids did everything possible to make our stay as pleasant as possible (thank you so much for everything)
The breakfast is spectacular, nothing was missing and the waitresses, two girls, are sweet and willing to do anything!! What I liked most was the hotel treatment and the breakfast time!!
We had some very good days.

The lobby was pleasant, but it appeared that 2 young men, not staying at the hotel were using it as an "office." ( Wifi was free and open to non-guests) They would be there for 3-4 hours every day.  Their perfume/cologne was so strong (and awful) that it was unpleasant to be in the lobby.  Additionally, I wanted to eat at the hotel on Sunday and Monday nights, but there were private events and this meant the restaurant was closed to guests.  Based on my experience I would look to other places to stay next time.

Chambre triste et bruyante donnant sur la rue mais propre. Heureusement, nous n'avions retenu qu'une nuit.
Pour le petit dejeuner les viennoiseries avaient un gout de decongele.
Mais surtout un accueil execrable a la reception par une demoiselle qui n'a fait aucun effort, plus attachee a son look qu'a son travail. Hautaine, pimbeche et bien sur incompetente. Elle saura se reconnaitre si elle est encore en poste a la reception. A virer.
Bravo par contre a la stagiaire francaise qui a tout fait pour nous etre agreable.
response_from_owner_text:
Cher/e daxone saxone,
Je vous remercie d'avoir pris le temps de nous donner votre commentaire sur Trip Advisor. Je suis sincerement navre de ce qu'il s'est produit lors de votre sejour et tres surpris d'entendre que notre recepcioniste n'a pas bien fait son travail. Sachez que je vais faire le necessaire aupres de mes equipes pour que cela ne se reproduise plus, car cela ne correspond pas du tout a la qualite de service que nous souhaitons fournir a nos clients.
Veuillez accepter a nouveau mes excuses et j'espere tout de meme avoir le plaisir de vous recevoir une nouvelle fois afin de vous montrer que ces evenements ne sont pas dans nos habitudes!
Tres cordialement,

Alfonso Ruiz
Directeur
review_translated_text:
Sad and noisy room overlooking the street but clean. Fortunately, we only had one night.
For breakfast the pastries had a defrosted taste.
But above all an execrable welcome at the reception by a young lady who made no effort, more attached to her look than to her work. Haughty, dull and of course incompetent. She will know who she is if she is still working at reception. To be fired.
Congratulations on the other hand to the French intern who did everything to be pleasant to us.

Director

place_name: Hotel NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
name: Simone_viagem
review_text: Localizado no centro, a poucos passos de um dos mais importantes cartoes postais da cidade, o Arco de Santa Maria, este hotel foi instalado em um antigo convento. Com lindas instalacoes que preservaram toda a parte historica do edificio. O melhor deste hotel e que se pode conhecer toda a cidade sem a necessidade do carro. Os quartos sao espacosos, com boa qualidade de roupa de cama e amenidades. O hotel tem garagem propria, porem cobram caro pela diaria. Existe um parking publico bem perto que tem precos mais baixos. O unico ponto negativo que salta aos olhos, e a falta de atencao para com o hospede. Ficamos hospedados durante seis noites e os atendentes da recepcao mal nos davam bom dia. Passei o dia de meu aniversario la e mesmo sendo membro da rede NH Rewards, nao recebi nem uma felicitacao! No quesito atendimento deixam muito a desejar. Por ser a categoria Collection da rede, o que quer dizer superior a um NH normal, precisam rever como acolhem seus hospedes, pois a nossa experiencia neste quesito foi decepcionante!
review_translated_text: Located in the city center, just a few steps from one of the city's most important landmarks, the Arco de Santa Maria, this hotel was set up in an old convent. Its beautiful facilities have preserved the entire historic part of the building. The best thing about this hotel is that you can explore the entire city without needing a car. The rooms are spacious, with good quality bedding and amenities. The hotel has its own garage, but they charge a high daily rate. There is a public parking lot nearby that has lower prices. The only negative point that stands out is the lack of attention to guests. We stayed there for six nights and the reception staff barely said good morning to us. I spent my birthday there and even though I am a member of the NH Rewards network, I didn't even receive a single congratulation! In terms of service, they leave a lot to be desired. Since it is part of the Collection category of the chain, which means it is superior to a regular NH, they need to review how they welcome their guests, because our experience in this area was disappointing!

review_text:
Buena atencion del personal, buenas instalaciones y mejor ubicacion.
Lugar de la visita: NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
Fecha de la visita: 9,10 y 11 de diciembre de 2017
No pudimos haber elegido mejor hotel para nuestra visita a la ciudad de Burgos.
Su situacion al lado del rio Arlanzon y a escasos metros del Puente de Santa Maria, le hacen ideal para visitar la ciudad y ademas tiene parking propio.
El hotel esta en un edificio de estilo gotico con un claustro cubierto por una espectacular vidriera, con unas escaleras amplias, propias de los palacios de la epoca, asi como pasillos anchos y decorados con muebles y cuadros de estilo palaciego.
Las habitaciones son muy amplias y funcionales, disponiendo de una maquina de cafe y un calentador de agua para infusiones, de libre disposicion.
Tengo que agradecer la amabilidad del personal de recepcion por su simpatia y amabilidad, y por extension a las camareras del desayuno que en todo momento te preguntan si necesitas algo y su rapidez en despejar la mesa de los platos sucios, para que puedas desayunar lo mas comodo posible.
La zona de desayuno ocupa un comedor muy grande, con techos altos y con un gran surtido de todo, absolutamente de todo, y ademas puedes pedir que te hagan al momento una tortilla francesa, unos huevos fritos, etc.
En cuanto a la habitacion, teniamos reservada una superior con vistas, y agradezco a la direccion del hotel el habernos mejorado a una habitacion Premiun y a la botella de cava que nos regalo por la celebracion de nuestro 36 aniversario de casados.
Si vas a Burgos, sin duda este es tu hotel.
review_translated_text:
Good staff service, good facilities and better location.
Place of visit: NH Collection Palacio de Burgos
Date of visit: December 9, 10 and 11, 2017
We could not have chosen a better hotel for our visit to the city of Burgos.
Its location next to the Arlanzon River and a few meters from the Santa Maria Bridge, make it ideal for visiting the city and it also has its own parking.
The hotel is in a Gothic-style building with a cloister covered by spectacular stained glass, with wide stairs, typical of palaces of the time, as well as wide hallways decorated with palace-style furniture and paintings.
The rooms are very spacious and functional, with a coffee machine and a water heater for infusions, freely available.
I have to thank the kindness of the reception staff for their friendliness and kindness, and by extension the breakfast waitresses who always ask you if you need anything and their speed in clearing the table of dirty dishes, so that you can have breakfast as comfortably as possible.
The breakfast area occupies a very large dining room, with high ceilings and a large assortment of everything, absolutely everything, and you can also ask for a French omelette, fried eggs, etc. to be made on the spot.
As for the room, we had reserved a superior one with a view, and I thank the hotel management for upgrading us to a Premium room and for the bottle of cava they gave us for the celebration of our 36th wedding anniversary.
If you go to Burgos, without a doubt this is your hotel.

We went to tell reception and they excused themselves (showing quite a lack of attitude, as with everything) saying that not all rooms can have a double bed... obviously, I'm not that stupid, but if I booked in advance it was to make sure I had one.
From what I have seen in many Tripadvisor comments, my case is not the only one at all. I'm starting to think that they don't have any rooms with a double bed.

Ciao amici viaggiatori,

seguendo TA abbiamo trovato questo bellissimo hotel e ne siamo rimasti entusiasti.
Prenotato qualche mese prima direttamente sul sito NH, due camera superior, al nostro arrivo abbiamo avuto la bella sorpresa di un upgrade gratuito alla suite. L'hotel e stupendo, in quanto e ricavato dentro un antico convento e infatti la sala colazione e vicino al chiostro antico. La struttura e ubicata vicino al centro storico e alla cattedrale ma leggermente fuori dal casino ed e dotato di un comodo parcheggio privato sotterraneo.
Le camera sono bellissime e dotate di ogni confort, con una bottiglia d'acqua offerta e ciabatte e accappatoio.
Degna di nota la colazione, con ogni bonta, sia dolce che salata.
Ottimo rapporto qualita/prezzo e personale disponibile.
DA CANCELLARE LA NOSTRA ESPERIENZA AL RISTORANTE (cui dedico recensione a parte)
review_translated_text:
Hello traveler friends,

following TA we found this beautiful hotel and were thrilled with it.
Booked a few months before directly on the NH website, two superior rooms, upon our arrival we had the nice surprise of a free upgrade to the suite. The hotel is wonderful, as it is housed inside an ancient convent and in fact the breakfast room is near the ancient cloister. The structure is located near the historic center and the cathedral but slightly outside the casino and has a convenient private underground car park.
The rooms are beautiful and equipped with every comfort, with a free bottle of water and slippers and bathrobe.
Breakfast is worthy of note, with every goodness, both sweet and savory.
Excellent value for money and helpful staff.

review_text:
Depuis 50 ans, nous voyageons beaucoup mon epouse et moi et des hotels quatre ou cinq etoiles,  nous en avons testes pas mal lors de nos peregrinations.
Mais l'experience que nous retiendrons de celui-ci est veritablement enthousiasmante.
Un contraste etonnant, soit dit en passant, avec l'hotellerie francaise, tant la note nous a parue modeste au point de vue qualite-prix (du simple au double a qualite egale).
Une belle grande chambre aussi agreable que confortable, une literie de grande qualite, une proprete irreprochable, une vraie salle de bain ou rien ne manque et ou tout y est vu dans les moindres details avec pour couronner le tout un personnel aux petits soins, attentif et souriant.
Il y a meme a une cinquantaine de metres de la, oh surprise, un restaurant etoile Michelin vallant vraiment le detour, dont l'addition etait etonnamment modeste elle aussi.
Le pied quoi !

Jacques de Bruxelles
review_translated_text:
For 50 years, my wife and I have been traveling a lot and we have tried quite a few four or five star hotels during our travels.
But the experience we will remember from it is truly exciting.
An astonishing contrast, by the way, with the French hotel industry, as the bill seemed modest to us from a quality-price point of view (from single to double for equal quality).
A beautiful large room as pleasant as it is comfortable, high quality bedding, impeccable cleanliness, a real bathroom where nothing is missing and where everything is seen down to the smallest detail with, to top it all off, caring, attentive and smiling staff.
There is even about fifty meters away, oh surprise, a Michelin-starred restaurant really worth the detour, whose bill was also surprisingly modest.
What a foot!

James of Brussels
