review_text: Aunque el hotel tiene muchas virtudes, la mas destacada, sin duda, es la ubicacion, a 5 escasos minutos andando de la catedral y sin embargo, al estar al otro lado del rio, sin el ajetreo y limitaciones de acceso de los hoteles ubicados dentro del casco historico (el hotel tiene parking propio de pago, pero en nuestro caso aparcamos sin problema a 100 o 150m del hotel). Habitaciones comodas y bien equipadas. En nuestro caso la habitacion era superior (Premium segun la denominacion del hotel) y nos sorprendio que, sin ser pequena, las dimensiones eran contenidas. El equipamiento, TV, climatizacion, hervidor, cafetera de capsulas, dotacion del bano, etc contribuyen a hacer una estancia comoda y agradable. Solo en algun detalle se echa en falta renovacion y un mantenimiento mas cuidadoso, pero solo detalles. Desayuno muy bueno, con productos de calidad, variado y completo. Personal eficiente a amable (especialmente la chica que nos hizo el check-in, que se molesto en avisarnos por telefono cuando la habitacion estaba disponible). El edificio es un antiguo convento y dispone de un precioso claustro cubierto que inexplicablemente esta desaprovechado. Posiblemente lo reservan para bodas, pero es una pena que los clientes no puedan disfrutarlo. En resumen un hotel muy recomendable para procurar una vista comoda a Burgos. El precio dependera de la habitacion y promocion, pero pagas el nivel de un NH Collention aunque quizas este en algun detalle un poco por debajo de lujo de estos hoteles. Pero es, sin duda, un gran hotel totalmente recomendable.
review_translated_text: Although the hotel has many virtues, the most notable, without a doubt, is the location, just 5 minutes walk from the cathedral and yet, being on the other side of the river, without the hustle and access limitations of the hotels located within the historic center (the hotel has its own paid parking, but in our case we parked without problem 100 or 150m from the hotel). Comfortable and well-equipped rooms. In our case the room was superior (Premium according to the hotel's name) and we were surprised that, without being small, the dimensions were contained. The equipment, TV, air conditioning, kettle, capsule coffee maker, bathroom equipment, etc. contribute to making your stay comfortable and pleasant. Only in some details is renovation and more careful maintenance missing, but only details. Very good breakfast, with quality products, varied and complete. Efficient to friendly staff (especially the girl who checked us in, who bothered to let us know by phone when the room was available). The building is an old convent and has a beautiful covered cloister that is inexplicably wasted. Possibly reserved for weddings, but it's a shame that clients can't enjoy it. In short, a highly recommended hotel to provide a comfortable view of Burgos. The price will depend on the room and promotion, but you pay the level of an NH Collention although it may be in some details a little below the luxury of these hotels. But it is, without a doubt, a great hotel that is totally recommended.

review_text: El hotel muy bien en general. Habitacion amplia, limpia, acogedora, moderna y elegante a la vez, cama muy comoda, desayuno bueno y abundante. Pero quiero resaltar un detalle, en el bar no habia ni Cacaolat, ni Okey ni ningun otro batido de chocolate y tampoco lima Rives. El camarero del bar se esforzo en buscar la lima, fue hasta al almacen a ver si tenia, pero no encontro y pedimos otra cosa y nos dijo que por hacernos esperar tanto y no tener ninguna de las dos cosas que le habiamos pedido nos invitaba a la consumicion. Fue muy amable y ese tipo de detalles son los que marcan la diferencia.
review_translated_text: The hotel is very good in general. Spacious, clean, cozy, modern and elegant room at the same time, very comfortable bed, good and abundant breakfast. But I want to highlight one detail, in the bar there was no Cacaolat, no Okey or any other chocolate shake and no Rives lime either. The bar waiter tried hard to look for the lime, he went to the store to see if he had it, but he couldn't find it and we ordered something else and he told us that for making us wait so long and not having either of the two things we had asked for, he was inviting us to the drink. He was very kind and those kinds of details are what make the difference.

name: Teunie Geerlof-Lub
review_text:
Onderweg terug naar Nederland hier overnacht. Hotel ligt vlakbij snelweg en is gemakkelijk bereikbaar. Er zijn een aantal parkeerplaatsen vlak voor de ingang.
Hotelkamer is qua grootte ruim zat, echter een erg hard matras en douchen moet in een gladde badkuip. Daarnaast zijn de kamers erg gehorig, bijna de gehele nacht is een brom te horen geweest, als iemand over de gang loopt of een deur dichtdoet is dit goed te horen.
Het restaurant van het hotel was gesloten (was bekend) maar in de nabije omgeving is ook geen restaurant te vinden dat open is op maandag. Ontbijt is van prima kwaliteit, echterhet aanbod en keuze is beperkt.
Al met al voor ons de 4 sterren echt niet waard.
review_translated_text:
Spend the night here on the way back to the Netherlands. Hotel is located near the highway and is easily accessible. There are a number of parking spaces just in front of the entrance.
The hotel room is spacious in size, but a very hard mattress and you have to shower in a slippery bathtub. In addition, the rooms are very noisy, a hum could be heard almost the entire night, and when someone walks across the hallway or closes a door, this can be heard clearly.
The hotel restaurant was closed (as was known) but there is no restaurant in the vicinity that is open on Mondays. Breakfast is of excellent quality, but the range and choice is limited.
All in all, really not worth the 4 stars for us.

name: JEAN PARENT
review_text:
Si vous devez faire une halte sur votre route, cet hotel est une bonne option. Il y a 1 batiment plus recent et de style moderne, plus hautement etoile que l'ancien batiment de style traditionnel. Ce dernier restant toutefois tres honorable.
Le restaurant nous a propose une cuisine assez fine. Enfin l'ensemble recoit des evenements. Mariage et sortie d'associations de danse de salon durant notre sejour arrives par bus et voyage organise.
Le complexe comporte un jardin avec jeuc pour enfants et des terrasses arborees. C'est calme bien que non eloigne de l'autoroute.
Je remercie la personne qui nous a recommande cet hotel. Gracias Eduardo.
review_translated_text:
If you need to make a stop on your route, this hotel is a good option. There is 1 newer, modern style building, more highly starred than the old traditional style building. The latter, however, remains very honorable.
The restaurant offered us quite fine cuisine. Finally the whole receives events. Wedding and exit from ballroom dance associations during our stay arrived by bus and organized trip.
The complex has a garden with children's play area and tree-lined terraces. It's quiet although not far from the highway.
I thank the person who recommended this hotel to us. Gracias Eduardo.

review_text: Contrate un paquete de Escapada Romantica para el mes de Agosto y no pude realizarlo por motivos personales, podia haber cancelado y no quise hacerlo porque me apetecia mucho vivir la experiencia, lo cambie de fecha para este fin de semana y en en lugar de cama matrimonial dos camas juntas y colchones malisimos, almohadas super bajas, el detalle romantico de la habitacion ni aparecio, bajamos a quejarnos cuando vimos todo eso y se des entendieron, nos dijeron que eso seria el dia de la cena romantica...se limitaron a ponernos una vela en la mesa, en fin... nos dijeron al dia siguiente que nos tenian que haber invitado a una copa o algo,no llego ni un detalle, le comente que consumimos del minibar una lata de kas de naranja y despues de todo lo que no mos habian dado de nuestro paquete romantico tuvieron la osadia de cobrar 2'50EU por el kas... En fin... una experiencia poco agradable, no pongo ni estrellas,bueno una porque si no ni puedo poner mi opinion
review_translated_text: I hired a Romantic Getaway package for the month of August and I couldn't do it for personal reasons, I could have canceled and I didn't want to because I really wanted to live the experience, I changed the date for this weekend and instead of a double bed, two beds together and terrible mattresses, super low pillows, the romantic detail of the room didn't even appear, we went down to complain when we saw all that and they didn't understand, they told us that it would be the day of the dinner romantic...they limited themselves to putting a candle on the table, anyway... they told us the next day that they should have invited us to a drink or something, not a single detail arrived, I told them that we consumed a can of orange kas from the minibar and after everything that they had not given us from our romantic package they had the audacity to charge EU2.50 for the kas... Anyway... a not very pleasant experience, I don't even give stars, well one because if not I can't even give my opinion

review_translated_text: Quiet and pleasant staff.

name: Alejandro Gomez Robles
review_text: Muy buenas instalaciones y comida
review_translated_text: Very good facilities and food

name: Dejan Janjic
review_text: Our stay was very pleasant. The hotel had a cozy atmosphere and was perfect for travelers with pets. The room service was top-notch and the restaurant had a delicious menu. The only criticism was that the breakfast selection was somewhat limited. We had to pay extra for our animal companions, but it was worth it.

name: corinne beaufreton
review_text: Hotel qui nous permet de faire des etapes lors de nos vacances au Portugal a l'aller et au retour, qui accepte les animaux. Hotel propre, chambres spacieuses avec le necessaire, bar et restaurant. L'accueil est agreable. Le seul bemol soit que la douche ne possede qu'un ciel de pluie et pas de douchette donc pour ceux qui n'aiment pas recevoir l'eau directement sur le visage c'est un probleme. A part ceci, nous en sommes tres contents.
review_translated_text: Hotel which allows us to make stops during our holidays in Portugal on the way there and back, which accepts animals. Clean hotel, spacious rooms with the necessary amenities, bar and restaurant. The welcome is pleasant. The only downside is that the shower only has a rain shower head and no hand shower, so for those who don't like having water directly on their face it's a problem. Other than that, we are very happy with it.

name: Rubla Cedo
review_text:
Estupendo hotel para descansar, silencioso y limpio.
El personal lo mejor del hotel, simpaticos y super amables, cosa que se agradece mucho.
El restaurante esta genial y la comida esta buenisima.
review_translated_text:
Great hotel to rest, quiet and clean.
The staff is the best in the hotel, friendly and super friendly, which is very much appreciated.
The restaurant is great and the food is delicious.

name: Lorena C.S.
review_text: Menu de 46EU, pero el lechazo estaba recalentado, el servicio fue deficiente y el aire acondicionado no daba a basto en un dia normal de agosto en Burgos. No repetiremos.
review_translated_text: EU46 menu, but the lamb was overheated, the service was poor and the air conditioning was not enough on a normal August day in Burgos. We will not repeat.

name: athena brieu
review_text:
Hotel vraiment bien tenu,chic et propre, les halls, leurs chambre et restaurant(tout prix)sont si jolies, un gros plus pour l'espace petit dejeuner tres bon avec pleins de choix, et l'espace jeux d'enfant top ! Mon fils de 4ans s'est bien occupe :)
Arrive en catastrophe suite a une panne vehicule, un taxi nous a depose dans cet hotel et on ne regrette pas, car grace a Suzana et Juan Carlos, ils ont su nous mettre a l'aise et a l'abris sans avoir pu reserver moi et ma famille, de plus, nous avions une grosse glaciere avec beaucoup de nourriture il nous on meme propose d'utiliser leurs frigos pour ne rien perdre et enfin ils se sont occupe d'appeler le garage en Espagne a notre place, pour en savoir plus quand a la panne de notre vehicule, ils n'etaient en rien oblige de faire tout cela mais ils l'on fait c'est vraiment de l'hotellerie dans toute sa grace  cet hotel restera a jamais dans mon coeur . Meme si nous n'avions pas le coeur a la fete a cause de notre voiture, leurs gentillesse et service nous ont touches
Gracias el valles
Cordialement
review_translated_text:
Really well-kept hotel, chic and clean, the halls, their rooms and restaurants (all prices) are so pretty, a big plus for the very good breakfast area with lots of choice, and the top children's play area! My 4 year old son was well taken care of :)
Arrived in disaster following a vehicle breakdown, a taxi dropped us off at this hotel and we have no regrets, because thanks to Suzana and Juan Carlos, they were able to put us at ease and sheltered without being able to book me and my family, what's more, we had a large cooler with lots of food, they even offered to use their fridges so as not to lose anything and finally they took care of calling the garage in Spain for us, to find out more about the breakdown of our vehicle, they were in no way obliged to do all this but they did it, it is truly hospitality in all its grace  this hotel will forever remain in my heart. Even if we weren't in the mood to celebrate because of our car, their kindness and service touched us.
Gracias el vales
Kind regards

name: Lara P. Albuixech
review_text:
Agradecer a todos su atencion ya que por una urgencia he tenido que irme antes de tiempo, sin ningun cargo.
Las habitaciones son muy amplias y confortables, la cena es muy buena y sus trabajadoras encantadoras. Ademas es un hotel que permite animales y me encanto el buen trato que se le da, aunque yo haya viajado sin animales.
Por poner alguna pega sustituiria la banera por una ducha amplia, ya que el bano es super amplio.
Desayuno correcto un poco justo para un 4 estrellas.
review_translated_text:
I would like to thank everyone for their attention, as due to an emergency, I had to leave early, free of charge.
The rooms are very spacious and comfortable, the dinner was excellent, and the staff were charming. It's also a pet-friendly hotel, and I loved the friendly service, even though I traveled without pets.
If I had any complaints, I would replace the bathtub with a spacious shower, as the bathroom is extremely spacious.
The breakfast was adequate, a bit limited for a 4-star hotel.

name: Montse Sole Lopez
review_text:
Bien ubicado, parking perfecto dentro del hotel.
Buen trato , calidad precio excelente.
Desayuno 10EU completo.
Camas comodas
review_translated_text:
Well located, perfect parking inside the hotel.
Good treatment, excellent price quality.
Full breakfast EU10.
comfortable beds

name: Cedric Martins
review_text:
Accueil top ! Le personnel est tres sympathique.
Rapport qualite-prix excellent. Difficile de faire mieux.
Un bel hotel pour un passage.
Situe un peu au milieu de nul part.
Je recommande sans souci.
review_translated_text:
Great welcome! The staff is very friendly.
Excellent value for money. Difficult to do better.
A nice hotel for a visit.
Located a bit in the middle of nowhere.
I recommend without worry.

name: Isabel Garcia
review_text: Las duchas que sean fijas no me gustan. Lo demas bastante bien
review_translated_text: I don't like fixed showers. Everything else is pretty good.

name: Natalia Fernandez Vidal
review_text:
Las habitaciones antiguas pero con un lavado de cara suficiente para no dar mala impresion. Limpias. La cama un poco blanda para mi gusto y casi ningun amenity (Para un cuatro estrellas normalmente ponen cepillos de dientes, pasta, gorro de ducha...) Tienen cunas y puedes alojarte con tu mascota.
Parking en el recinto y zona tranquila pero alejada del centro, esta en un lateral de la nacional.
El restaurante es una maravilla, no muy economico pero tampoco caro. Calidad y una atencion muy agradable.
El gran pero llega con la "insonorizacion". Oyes de la habitacion de al lado desde como enchufan el cargador del movil, toser y hasta la conversacion mas normal.
Son las 7 de la manana y estan las de la limpieza, barriendo, moviendo muebles (imagino que para limpiar) y se oye todo. No por que griten o no tengan cuidado, sino por las paredes.
Nos dieron alojamiento en la planta baja, pasa una carretera secundaria justo por detras y tambien se oye cada coche o camion.
review_translated_text:
The rooms are old but with a facelift enough to not give a bad impression. Clean. The bed was a little soft for my taste and almost no amenities (For a four-star hotel they usually provide toothbrushes, toothpaste, a shower cap...) They have cribs and you can stay with your pet.
Parking on the premises and a quiet area but far from the center, it is on one side of the national highway.
The restaurant is wonderful, not very economical but not expensive either. Quality and very pleasant attention.
The big but comes with the "soundproofing". You hear from the next room everything from how they plug in the cell phone charger, coughing and even the most normal conversation.
It's 7 in the morning and the cleaning people are there, sweeping, moving furniture (I imagine to clean) and you can hear everything. Not because they scream or are not careful, but because of the walls.
They gave us accommodation on the ground floor, a secondary road passes right behind and you can also hear every car or truck.

name: JoseManuel1956
review_text: En la ruta de la CAM por Burgos y las Merindades hemos estado 4d/3n.|La habitacion con una cama comoda, mini frigorifico y bano con lo esencial para el aseo.|Todo muy limpio, el personal muy amable. Si se quiere tomar algo se puede hacer en la cafeteria que hay en la recepcion con buenos precios.|El buffet del desayuno normal pero suficiente, ademas, cuando llegavamos nos tenian preparadas tostadas recien hechas y asi no teniamos que esperar, todo un detalle.|Para ir a Briviesca se puede hacer andando, en recepcion te indican como hacerlo.|Sitio agradable
review_translated_text: We stayed 4 days for 3 nights on the CAM route through Burgos and the Merindades. The room had a comfortable bed, a mini-fridge, and a bathroom with toiletries. Everything was very clean, and the staff was very friendly. If you want a drink, you can do so at the cafeteria at reception, which has good prices. The breakfast buffet was average but sufficient. Plus, when we arrived, they had fresh toast ready for us so we didn't have to wait--a nice touch. Briviesca can be reached on foot; reception will tell you how to do it. Pleasant location.

name: Juan Ramon Vicuna Garrues
review_text: El hotel en si, muy bien , la pena que esta un poco apartado de Briviesca.
review_translated_text: The hotel itself is very good, just a shame that it is a little far from Briviesca.

name: Albina Pereira
review_text: Es la segunda vez que quedamos en el hotel y mi opinion ha variado considerablemente. Le sobra por lo menos una estrella. Por poner algun ejemplo : la banera deber ser ya una ducha, la recepcion y hall de entrada es bastante cutre a nivel de sofas, se ven bastante sucios, etc. desayuno normal tirando a mediocre. Hemos tenido que coger una habitacion de dos camas porque no quedaban de matrimonio y no he descansado a gusto porque no son buenas. Podria enumerar mas cosas pero bueno ahi queda la opinion por si puede ayudar en algo.
review_translated_text: It is the second time we have stayed at the hotel and my opinion has changed considerably. It has at least one star left. To give an example: the bathtub should already be a shower, the reception and entrance hall are quite shabby in terms of sofas, they look quite dirty, etc. Normal breakfast bordering on mediocre. We had to take a room with two beds because there were no double beds and I have not rested comfortably because they are not good. I could list more things but here's the opinion in case it can help in any way.

name: jorge joaquin revuelta de la vara
JN Pan
review_text: Wo Men Tuan Dui Yi Xing 42Ren Zai Zhe Li Zhu Su Yi Wan,Fang Jian Da Er Qie Gan Jing,Wan Can Fu Wu Yuan Fei Chang Re Qing Hao Ke,Wo Men Gan Shou Dao Liao Bin Zhi Ru Gui De Fu Wu,Sui Ran Jiu Dian Chi Bu Er Ge Si Wu Shi Gong Li Yuan,Dan Shi Zhe Ye Xu Shi Ni Geng Hao De Xuan Ze!
review_translated_text: Our group of 42 people stayed here for one night. The room was large and clean. The dinner waiters were very hospitable. We felt like we were at home. Although the hotel is fifty kilometers away from Burgos, this may be a better choice for you!

name: jesus72Cadiz
review_text: Hemos estado un grupo por motivos deportivos y nos han tratado genial, el personal encantador, las habitaciones estupendas y la comida q nos pusieron muy buena. El hotel esta alejado de la ciudad pero merece la pena por la tranquilidad y calidad
review_translated_text: We were a group here for sports and were treated brilliantly. The staff was lovely, the rooms were great, and the food was excellent. The hotel is far from the city, but it's worth it for the tranquility and quality.

name: Alvaro Marrero
review_text:
Lamentable,es mi segunda vez que visito este restaurante y deja mucho que desear regular  ....otra situacion..el dia de hoy nos invitaron a comer mis suegros ,al pagar todo correcto pero la sorpresa !!!salimos  del sitio y nos llaman a los gritos la senora de recepcion o encargada me imagino acusandonos de ladrones por unos vasos de coca cola .. increible, como su mala educacion,sus maneras de abordar unos clientes,acusando sin razon ...
Por favor esta clase de personas deben llamar la atencion,.el responsable.
Tened mas tacto con los clientes antes de ir atropellando con acusaciones muy serias..
Decepcionado .. No recomiendo .
Atte.Alvaro Quintero
review_translated_text:
It's unfortunate, it's my second time visiting this restaurant and it leaves a lot to be desired...another situation...today my in-laws invited us to eat, when we paid everything was correct but the surprise!!! we left the place and they shouted at the lady at the reception or manager, I imagine accusing us of being thieves for a few glasses of coke...incredible, like their bad manners, their ways of approaching customers, accusing us for no reason...
Please, these kinds of people must draw attention to the person responsible.
Be more tactful with your clients before making very serious accusations.
Disappointed.. I do not recommend.
Atte.Alvaro Quintero

name: Jose Da Costa Ferreira
review_text: Excellente accueil et service
review_translated_text: Excellent welcome and service

name: Jorge Montero (montero)
review_text: El hotel no esta mal , la habitacion es relativamente actual ahora bien a nosotros nos toco justo la que esta detras pared con pared de direccion y la verdad que una de las mananas molestaron temprano con un taladro , suele tener aparcamiento de sobra , el desayuno es el mejor que he visto en relacion calidad-precio.
review_translated_text: The hotel is not bad, the room is relatively modern, but we had the one behind wall to wall and the truth is that one of the mornings they bothered them early with a drill, they usually have plenty of parking, the breakfast is the best I have seen in relation to quality and price.

name: ofeedbackalgarve Steenwinkel
review_text: Wat een rust.
review_translated_text: What peace.

name: Okasam
review_text: No lo recomiendo, en el restaurante la metre muy borde y sin ninguna educacion ni saber estar en su puesto. La acera que rodea el hotel tenia las tapas de registro rotas y estaban marcadas con un cono de obra, los asientos de la cafeteria y de recepcion estaban mugrientos y bastante desvencijados. Lo unico bueno es el desayuno tipo bufet
review_translated_text: I don't recommend it. The waitress in the restaurant was very rude and lacked any manners or proper manners. The sidewalk surrounding the hotel had broken manhole covers marked with a construction cone. The cafeteria and reception chairs were filthy and quite shabby. The only good thing was the buffet breakfast.

review_text:
Just stayed here one night.
It was OK..
Bed was small for 2 people and mattress was awful.
Shower was fab.
Breakfast ok, not alot of choice, nothing warm..
Parking right outside.
Receptionist when we arrived in the evening was friendly,
Didn't try the restaurant as it seemed quite expensive and we just wanted snacks.
I would say more like a 3 star accommodation.

name: Mayte Alberti
review_text: Es un hotel que admite perros, pero no pudimos ir al comedor con ellos y nos subieron la cena. La persona que lleva el desayuno de 10.
review_translated_text: It's a dog-friendly hotel, but we couldn't bring them into the dining room, so they brought dinner up to us. The breakfast chef was a 10/10.

name: Jose Sdr
review_text: Viaje con la comunidad de Madrid, agradable, la comida no tanto, lo mejor, el servicio del comedor.
review_translated_text: Travel with the community of Madrid, pleasant, the food not so much, the best, the dining room service.

name: Chencho

review_translated_text: Expensive Mother's Day menu, quality price, and without drinks,

name: joop de vries
review_text: Top hotel, with excellent service and good food. We  certainly come back. Thanks Carlos for all yr help

name: Viejera Sin parar
review_text: Limpio! Y el restaurante muy bonito y comida rica! Desayuno muy bien tambien!
review_translated_text: Clean! And the restaurant is very nice and the food is delicious! Breakfast is very good too!

name: Carles Collado Puig
review_text: He pasado toda la noche con un olor fortisimo a cloaca en el bano. Ademas hotel anticuado y mal mantenido. Personal aceptable. Pongo 1 estrella porque no puedo poner menos.
review_translated_text: I spent the entire night with a very strong sewage smell in the bathroom. Also outdated and poorly maintained hotel. Acceptable staff. I give 1 star because I can't give less.

name: Jose Castillo Soriano
review_text: Nuestra experiencia en el Hotel Restaurante El Valles fue fantastica. La habitacion era muy limpia, acogedora y silenciosa, lo que garantizo una estancia confortable. Durante nuestra visita en Semana Santa, tuvimos la opcion de elegir entre el menu especial de 40EU o la carta, optando por esta ultima. Los platos que seleccionamos estaban deliciosos y nos dejaron completamente satisfechos. Definitivamente, si volvemos a la zona, no dudaremos en alojarnos de nuevo en este encantador hotel. !Muy recomendado!
review_translated_text: Our experience at the Hotel Restaurant El Valles was fantastic. The room was very clean, cozy, and quiet, ensuring a comfortable stay. During our Easter visit, we had the option of choosing between the EU40 special menu or the a la carte menu, which we opted for. The dishes we selected were delicious and left us completely satisfied. If we return to the area, we will definitely stay at this charming hotel again. Highly recommended!

name: Esmeralda Cebollero
review_text:
El personal de 10, atentos en todo momento.
Volveria sin dudarlo
review_translated_text:
The staff of 10, attentive at all times.
I would return without hesitation

name: sharon Frazao
review_text: Hotel is exec style near motorway. Staff not very friendly and although restaurant has good reviews I didn't eat there as opened late and I was too travel weary! Breakfast uninspiring and not worth the money.

name: Julian Martin
review_text: Estuvimos un fin de semana. La habitacion es bastante amplia, pero el aire acondicionado no funcionaba, ademas de ser bastante antiguo su panel de funcionamiento. El desayuno "buffet" muy pobre, para nada corresponde con hotel de cuatro estrellas. Como unico plato caliente tortilla del Mercadona . Un poco de fiambre, queso y bolleria variada escasa. En cuanto al personal, bastante correcto. A este hotel le sobran dos o tres estrellas.
review_translated_text: We stayed for a weekend. The room was quite spacious, but the air conditioning didn't work, and its control panel was quite old. The breakfast buffet was very poor, hardly worthy of a four-star hotel. The only hot dish was an omelet from Mercadona . A few cold cuts, cheese, and a variety of pastries were scarce. As for the staff, they were quite decent. This hotel deserves two or three stars.

name: Cristina Vasilut
review_text: Todo fantastico
review_translated_text: Everything fantastic

name: Wendy De la Rosa
review_text:
Personal maravilloso, amables y empaticos, alargaron su jornada laboral (restaurante)por atendernos (grupo de 34 PAX) tras llegar dos horas tarde por retencion de trafico.
Instalaciones y servicio de calidad.
Altamente recomendable sin lugar a dudas.
review_translated_text:
Wonderful, friendly, and empathetic staff. They extended their restaurant workday to serve us (a group of 34) after arriving two hours late due to traffic.
Quality facilities and service.
Highly recommended without a doubt.

name: Rosa Latienda
review_text:
Prevista nuestra cena en este lugar, despues de un viaje mas largo de lo deseado por las muchas retenciones, llegamos muy tarde, cuando ya era mas que hora de cierre.
Vaya por delante un 10 como valoracion a la cena que degustamos. Pero quiero destacar la amabilidad con la que se nos ha tratado a todo el grupo por parte de recepcion y personal de cocina y comedor.
En todo momento habeis estado pendientes de nuestro viaje, haciendo un esfuerzo enorme despues de todo un dia de trabajo para atendernos. Nos habeis esperado y acogido a deshoras con un trato que es para aplaudir y que, sin duda va mas alla de lo puramente profesional.
Un inmenso gracias por todo.
La cena, exquisita. Vosotros/as, inmejorables.
review_translated_text:
Having planned our dinner at this place, after a longer-than-expected trip due to the many traffic jams, we arrived very late, just as it was already closing time.
I'd like to give the dinner we enjoyed a 10/10. But I want to highlight the kindness with which the entire group was treated by the reception and kitchen and dining room staff.
You were attentive to our trip at all times, making a tremendous effort after a full day's work to serve us. You waited for us and welcomed us after hours with a treatment that is commendable and that, without a doubt, goes beyond the purely professional.
A huge thank you for everything.
The dinner was exquisite. You were unbeatable.

name: Jose Pedro Almagro
review_text:
Quiero agradecer la atencion en el restaurante. Soy conductor de autobus, tuvimos un problema en la carretera y la atencion a los viajeros durante la cena fue excelente.
El menu que nos prepararon fue muy bueno,
Gracias por todo.
review_translated_text:
I want to thank you for the attention in the restaurant. I am a bus driver, we had a problem on the road and the attention to travelers during dinner was excellent.
The menu they prepared for us was very good,
Thanks for everything.

name: Chisco Ahechu Zunzarren
review_text: Una atencion y servicio mas alla de lo contratado. El personal muy profesional y amable. La comida exquisita. No se puede pedir mas.
review_translated_text: Attention and service beyond what was contracted. Very professional and friendly staff. The exquisite food. You can't ask for more.

name: Segrie
review_text: Restaurant|Brilliant convenient stop off, lunch was a bonus.|Amazingly high quality and quantity, wine included.|For the first time in twenty years I tasted tender pork which tasted like pork|20EU a head, result|Hotel |was comfortable and clean, staff friendly

name: Nuria GRI
review_text: He venido a conocer el pueblo y nos habian hablado del Restaurante Valles que suele parar a comer entre semana y muy bien, hemos parado a comer, pero no se si es porque estamos en Semana Santa o que,  la calidad muy buena pero la cantidad y precio  ademas la carne, habiamos pedido entrecot, te lo sacan ya cortado, si es que es Entrecot porque como se ve en la foto parecen trozos de Chuleta, y si encima te pasa como a nosotros, que estaba fria y tienen que recalentar entonces ya,  no sacas el gusto y tenia algun trozo de que se estaba poniendo malo pero bueno ya,  el sitio muy comodo limpio  y el personal amable agradable.  Una pena pero. La foto del solomillo es de un Restaurante De Cantabria que fuimos el Jueves Santo a comer alli. Todavia hay restaurantes que saben como comportarse con sus clientes para que vuelvan.
review_translated_text: I have come to see the town and they had told us about the Valles Restaurant that usually stops to eat during the week and very good, we have stopped to eat, but I don't know if it is because it is Easter or what, the quality is very good but the quantity and price  also the meat, we had ordered entrecote, they bring it out already cut, if it is Entrecote because as you can see in the photo they look like pieces of Chop, and if it happens to you like us, it was cold and They have to reheat it then, you don't get the taste and there were some pieces that were going bad but hey, the place is very comfortable, clean and the friendly staff is pleasant.  A shame but. The photo of the sirloin is from a Cantabria Restaurant that we went to eat there on Holy Thursday. There are still restaurants that know how to behave with their customers to keep them coming back.

name: Olaf-Christian Lepthien
review_text: Gutes Hotel mit klasse Restaurant in einer fur Reisende sehr praktischen Lage. Sicher auch einen Ort, um die interessante Umgebung zu erkunden. Das Personal ist immer super freundlich und versucht einem bei kleinen Problemen sofort zu helfen.
review_translated_text: A good hotel with a great restaurant in a very convenient location for travelers. It's also a great place to explore the interesting surrounding area. The staff is always super friendly and tries to help immediately with any minor problems.

name: F040
review_text: El Valles ligt direct aan de snelweg wat op zich niet verkeerd is als je op doorreis bent. De kamer was oke en voldeed, maar de grote verrassing kwam toen we er gingen eten. Het restaurant opende pas om 20.30 uur haar deuren, de menukaart was weinig uitdagend en de bediening evenzo! De hamburger die we besteld was niet smaakvol en niet vers , geperst vlees! De bediening was onpersoonlijk, het servies werd nog net niet uit je handen getrokken! Dachten we alles gehad te hebben kregen we nog de volgende dag het ontbijt, om te janken zo slecht en niet vers! Dus neem maar lekker een ander hotel als je op doorreis bent en in Burgos een tussenstop nodig hebt.
review_translated_text: El Valles is located right on the highway which is not bad if you are traveling through. The room was okay and adequate, but the big surprise came when we went to eat there. The restaurant only opened at 20:30, the menu was not very challenging and the service was just as good! The hamburger we ordered was not tasty and not fresh, pressed meat! The service was impersonal, the dishes were almost taken out of your hands! We thought we had had everything, but the next day we still got breakfast, to cry so bad and not fresh! So just choose another hotel if you are traveling through and need a stopover in Burgos.

name: Luisa Insua
review_text:
Hotel muy confortable, con encanto.
Personal muy agradable, diligente y servicial.
La habitacion: silenciosa, muy amplia, cama muy comoda.
Todo muy limpio.
Estancia muy satisfactoria.
review_translated_text:
Very comfortable, charming hotel.
Very nice, diligent and helpful staff.
The room: quiet, very spacious, very comfortable bed.
Everything very clean.
Very satisfactory stay.

name: Ainhoa Martin
review_text: Trato excelente por parte del recepcionista Juan Carlos y de la hostelera Raquel, el hotel muy bien. Tanto instalaciones como amplitud y limpieza.
review_translated_text: Excellent treatment from the receptionist Juan Carlos and the hotelier Raquel, the hotel was very good. Both facilities, spaciousness and cleanliness.

name: Eva Varela

name: Ismael Morante
review_text:
Un hotel ideal para pasar una noche en mitad de un viaje.
Las habitaciones son amplias y muy bien equipadas, excepto por la TV, que era enana, tamano pantalla de ordenador.
Tiene aparcamiento gratuito, restaurante de carta, el desayuno buffet es muy recomendable y ademas esta cerca del pueblo.
Nos cambiaron la habitacion sin problema porque con el fuerte aire que hacia y el ruido de la carretera era imposible estar en la habitacion del fondo del pasillo, ya que daba al esquinazo del hotel y temblaban las paredes.
Por lo demas todo perfecto.
review_translated_text:
An ideal hotel for a one-night stay in the middle of a trip.
The rooms are spacious and very well-equipped, except for the TV, which was tiny, the size of a computer screen.
It has free parking, an a la carte restaurant, a highly recommended breakfast buffet, and it's also close to the town.
They changed our room without any problem because with the strong wind and the noise from the road, it was impossible to stay in the room at the end of the corridor, as it faced the corner of the hotel and the walls shook.
Otherwise, everything was perfect.

name: Irene Diaz Roncero
review_text:
Estabamos de viaje y llamamos para preguntar explicitamente si se podia comer y podiamos llevar a nuestro perro. Confirmaron que si. Una vez llegamos, nos dijeron que nuestro perro era demasiado grande para el comedor y que no podiamos pasar.

No nos avisaron en ningun momento de que hubiera limite de tamano para perros. Si solo admiten de tamano pequeno nos lo deben especificar.

Muy mala experiencia. Nada recomendado si tu perro supera el tamano de un bolso.
review_translated_text:
We were traveling and called to explicitly ask if it was okay to eat and we could bring our dog. They confirmed yes. Once we arrived, they told us that our dog was too big for the dining room and that we couldn't come in.

We were never notified that there was a size limit for dogs. If they only allow small sizes, they must specify it to us.

Very bad experience. Not recommended if your dog exceeds the size of a purse.

name: Ana Canal
review_text: El personal correcto pero poco amable excepto una camarera. Eramos grupo de 25 y teniamos menu. No le gusto a nadie . Fideua que no parecia, albondigas duras, pescado con salsa pero cocido, todo poco gustoso. En fin, no nos gusto nada
review_translated_text: The staff was decent but unfriendly, except for one waitress. We were a group of 25 and had a set menu. No one liked it. The fideua didn't look right, the meatballs were tough, the fish was sauced but cooked, all tasteless. In short, we didn't like it at all.

name: mabel lopez martin
review_text: El hotel mas especial que he conocido, y con el personal mas agradable que he conocido. No os lo perdais!
review_translated_text: The most special hotel I've ever experienced, with the friendliest staff I've ever met. Don't miss it!

name: Araceli de Bunes del Valle
review_text: Hotel muy agradable, personal muy amable y simpatico, la cocina buena y los desayunos buenos, lo unico que tiene banera en vez de plato de ducha, para volver
review_translated_text: Very nice hotel, very kind and friendly staff, good cuisine and good breakfasts, the only thing that has a bathtub instead of a shower tray, to return

name: Rosa Maria Delgado
review_text: Nos hemos hospedado un grupo de 55 personas y no eramos del IMSERSO. Mi queja es para el desayuno. Muy escaso, se estropeo la maquina del cafe y trajeron 3 termitos acabandose rapidamente en la tercera persona, se estropeo la tostadora. Habia que tostar el pan desplazandose a otra sala, saltaban los plomos y nos quedabamos a oscuras, los croisanes escasos, no habia ni uno para cada uno. La camarera corriendo de un lado a otro, la chica hacia lo que podia, quejandose. Falta de prevision y organizacion. Porque habia otras salas mas cerca de la entrada y nos llevaron a la mas recondita que para volver nos perdimos. Menos mal que es un sitio de pasada y no volvere
response_from_owner_text:
Buenos dias:
Todo el personal ha hecho mas de lo que podia para atenderles. La mayor parte del grupo ha comprendido la situacion que era ajena al personal. Las personas muchas veces debemos de tener un poco de empatia y ponernos en el lugar del personal. El salon es el habilitado para los grupos ya que es donde caben, en el pequeno ni hay espacio ni se va a atender a una parte del grupo en un salon y a la otra mitad en otro. Espero que la proxima vez si vienen no exista un inconveniente como el acontecido. Disculpen la situacion pero el personal ha trabajado para atenderles.
review_translated_text: We have stayed as a group of 55 people and we were not from IMSERSO. My complaint is for breakfast. Very scarce, the coffee machine broke down and they brought 3 termites, quickly ending up in the third person, the toaster broke down. We had to toast the bread by moving to another room, the lights went off and we were left in the dark, the croissants were scarce, there was not one for each of us. The waitress running from one side to the other, the girl doing what she could, complaining. Lack of foresight and organization. Because there were other rooms closer to the entrance and they took us to the most remote one that we got lost on the way back. Thank goodness it's a passing place and I won't be back.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Good morning:
The entire staff has gone above and beyond to assist you. Most of the group understood the situation, which was beyond the staff's control. People often need to show a little empathy and put themselves in the staff's shoes. The room is designated for groups because that's where they fit. There isn't enough space in the small room, and they won't be serving part of the group in one room and the other half in another. I hope that next time you come, there won't be an inconvenience like the one that happened. We apologize for the situation, but the staff has worked hard to assist you.

name: jen harrison
review_text: Great value- especially lovely meal in their fab restaurant! Will definitely visit again

name: NAI
review_text: La habitacion que nos asignaron estaba genial! con un bano enorme. El personal es muy amable.
review_translated_text: The room they assigned us was great! with a huge bathroom. The staff is very friendly.

name: Gato Ashera
review_text: A classic hotel restaurant with great food. We eaten here few times and everything is just perfect. They maintain the quality which is rare for a hotel on the road. The staff was always nice. We will definitely return.

name: Philippe Valet
review_text:
Bien situe sue la route de l'Andalousie ou du Portugal.
Hotel au prix interessant, par contre restauration chere
review_translated_text:
Well located on the road to Andalusia or Portugal.
Attractively priced hotel, but expensive food

name: Kelly Mairena
review_text: Nos quedamos el dia de ayer, fuimos con nuestro perrito debo decir que el trato a sido de lo mejor y el chico de la recepcion es muy amable, cenamos en el restaurante y la comida es espectacular.
review_translated_text: We stayed yesterday, we went with our dog, I must say that the treatment was the best and the guy at the reception is very friendly, we had dinner at the restaurant and the food is spectacular.

name: ANDRES CORPU
review_text: Buen sitio para dormir si te pilla de paso, gran hotel.
review_translated_text: Good place to sleep if you are passing through, great hotel.

name: Francisco Clavijo
review_text: El servicio del comedor deja mucho que desear y es muy antipatico. Habiendo una mesa de 6 personas libre y sin reserva previa, me dicen que "no hay mesas libres" y me sugieren espere en la recepcion "a ver si alguna se libera....". Y que por si acaso bajaban 6 personas a cenar... yo no podia ocuparla. O sea que habiendo mesa libre y siendo yo uno solo, y con un monton de mesas de 4 personas ocupadas por un solo individuo, ... yo no tengo derecho! Como es obvio le dije que no me parecia correcto y que no estaba de acuerdo, y a partir de aqui ya me pusieron en una mesa que resulta, estaba libre en otra sala adiacente. Aun dando una solucion, el trato ha sido muy antipatico, incluso descortes, y he pasado un rato bastante desagradable. No lo recomiendo en absoluto.
review_translated_text: The dining room service leaves a lot to be desired and is very unfriendly. Having a table of 6 people free and without prior reservation, they tell me that "there are no free tables" and they suggest I wait at the reception "to see if any become free....". And just in case 6 people came down to dinner... I couldn't occupy it. In other words, with a free table and there being only one of me, and with a lot of tables of 4 people occupied by a single individual,... I have no right! Obviously I told him that it didn't seem right to me and that I didn't agree, and from then on they put me at a table that happened to be free in another adjacent room. Even with a solution, the treatment has been very unfriendly, even rude, and I had a rather unpleasant time. I don't recommend it at all.

name: JOSE LUIS ,MUNOZ GOMEZ
review_text: Moderno.Bue jin servicio
review_translated_text: Modern. Good service.

name: Nano del Hoyo
review_text: Restaurante muy acogedor y bien atendido. Comida muy buena. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Very cozy and well attended restaurant. Very good food. Highly recommended.

name: antonio hernandez fuentes
review_text: Nos ha encantado. Llevamos a nuestro perro "Curro" y necesitabamos un hotel que acogiera mascotas. Podias llevarlo hasta al restaurante a cenar. Habia muchas personas alojadas con sus mascotas. La habitacion muy bien. La cena espectacular. Tienen una carta muy completa. Sin ruidos por la noche. Merece la pena si vais a visitar la zona.
review_translated_text: We loved it. We brought our dog "Curro" and needed a hotel that welcomed pets. You could even take him to the restaurant for dinner. There were many people staying with their pets. The room very good. The spectacular dinner. They have a very complete menu. No noise at night. It is worth it if you are going to visit the area.

name: Pedro Garcia
review_text: Un muy buen hotel es El Valles en la comarca burgalesa de La Bureba, concretamente en la localidad de Briviesca. Enclavado en un edificio moderno, pero muy elegantemente decorado, tiene una organizacion excelente. Las habitaciones son comodas y amplias, con unas camas muy confortables. Muy bien aislado, aun estando al lado de una carretera. La limpieza es muy buena, tanto en las habitaciones, como en el resto del hotel. La atencion por parte del personal es excelente, tanto en recepcion, como en el restaurante, son amables y muy profesionales, siempre atentos a resolver las necesidades de los clientes, a los que tratan mas como amigos. Los precios son muy atractivos, para ser un cuatro estrellas. Tiene terraza. Tambien un muy amplio aparcamiento. Hotel muy, pero que muy, recomendable, del que se sale muy satisfecho.
review_translated_text: A very good hotel is El Valles in the Burgos region of La Bureba, specifically in the town of Briviesca. Located in a modern, but very elegantly decorated building, it has excellent organization. The rooms are comfortable and spacious, with very comfortable beds. Very well isolated, even being next to a road. Cleaning is very good, both in the rooms and in the rest of the hotel. The attention from the staff is excellent, both at reception and in the restaurant, they are friendly and very professional, always attentive to solving the needs of clients, whom they treat more like friends. The prices are very attractive, for a four-star hotel. It has a terrace. Also a very large parking lot. Very, very recommendable hotel, from which you leave very satisfied.

name: Monik Amoedo
review_text: No estuvo mal pero, la experiencia goblal no va acorde con las 4 estrellas que dicen tener, la habitacion tenia el aire acondicionado estropeado  y no resolvieron el problema, la solucion que nos dieron fue que abriesemos la ventana, lo hicimos y se lleno de moscas  el cuarto. Lo bueno es que aceptan mascotas y es una ventaja para quien viaja  con animales ya que no hay muchas opciones por la zona. Por lo demas es un sitio tranquilo y el coche queda bien resguardado.
review_translated_text: It wasn't bad, but the overall experience didn't live up to the 4-star rating they claim. The room had a broken air conditioner, and they didn't fix the problem. The solution they gave us was to open the window, which we did, and the room filled with flies. The good thing is that they allow pets, which is a plus for those traveling with animals, as there aren't many options in the area. Otherwise, it's a quiet place, and the car is well protected.

name: Pepelu S
review_text: Desayuno de lujo
review_translated_text: Luxury breakfast

name: Miguel Sobrino
review_text: aire acondicionado no funcionaba,  la solucion ofrecida:  abrir ventana.  TV cable inexistente
review_translated_text: Air conditioning was not working, the solution offered: open window.  Non-existent cable TV

name: Beatriz
review_text:
No me parece que se corresponda con la calidad que se espera en Espana de un 4*. El desayuno escaso, unos panes con jamon de york y queso de barra, unos cruasan de ayer y un poco de manzana cortada.
El servicio que atiende el salon del desayuno deja bastante que desear.
Las habitaciones son amplias, el bano tambien. Limpieza buena.
Recibe excursiones grandes que a veces saturan mucho los espacios
review_translated_text:
I don't think it meets the quality expected of a 4-star hotel in Spain. The breakfast is sparse: some bread with ham and cheese, some old croissants, and a slice of apple.
The service in the breakfast room leaves a lot to be desired.
The rooms are spacious, as is the bathroom. Cleanliness is good.
The hotel welcomes large excursions, which can sometimes overcrowd the space.

name: fransvanhoorn
review_text: We booked a suite which we always do and encountered a very very bad smell , it was so bad that we found it hard too sleep |It's a pity , hotel is ok and staff is great and hotel has a good menu . It is nicely situated so all in all the smell spoiled our stay

review_text: El acceso es complicado

review_text:
Goed hotel voor een tussenstop.
Het eten in het restaurant is zeer goed.
Het ontbijt is ok, de ontbijtruimte is ongezellig en er hangt een onfrisse geur.
review_translated_text:
Good hotel for a stopover.
The food in the restaurant is very good.
The breakfast is ok, the breakfast room is uninviting and there is an unpleasant smell.

name: paty cardoso
review_text:
Adoramos.. Excelente quarto e o grande jardim cheio de arvores e mesas ideal p relaxar antes ou depois do jantar
Recomendo.. Ano que vem ja tenho o meu hotel p pausa antes de seguir viagem!
review_translated_text:
We loved it.. Excellent room and the large garden full of trees and tables, ideal for relaxing before or after dinner.
I recommend it.. Next year I'll already have my hotel for a break before continuing my journey!

name: Alpha Corps
review_text: Bastante buena relacion calidad-precio. Economico, dan un muy buen servicio tanto en hotel como restaurante. La comida del Restaurante espectacular. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Pretty good value for money. Economical, they provide very good service both in the hotel and restaurant. The restaurant's food is spectacular. Highly recommended.

name: M. Victoria VU
review_text:
El hotel es de 4 estrellas pero , en mi opinion le sobran 2 de ellas. El desayuno es escaso y mal servido . Se acaba el pan y no hay mas y lo mismo ocurre con las galletas e incluso el cafe , lo tienes que tomar frio porque como aun queda en el termo es lo que hay . De fruta solo hay naranja y manzanas .
En cuanto a las habitaciones son amplias pero la almohada muy mala y en el bano solo nos pudieron 2 jabones pequeno en tres dias.
Muy austero . No lo recomiendo .
review_translated_text:
The hotel is 4 stars but, in my opinion, it has 2 of them left over. Breakfast is scarce and poorly served. The bread runs out and there is no more and the same thing happens with the cookies and even the coffee, you have to drink it cold because since it is still in the thermos it is what there is. For fruit there are only oranges and apples.
As for the rooms, they are spacious but the pillow was very bad and in the bathroom they only gave us 2 small soaps in three days.
Very austere. I don't recommend it.

name: Danilo De Fulviis
review_text: Tres beau hotel et rapport qualite prix super
review_translated_text: Very nice hotel and great value for money

name: Jose Maria Garcia Del Castillo
review_text: Estuvimos comiendo por lo que no puedo puntuar las habitantes. El trato y la comida excelentes.
review_translated_text: We had lunch here, so I can't rate the residents. The service and food were excellent.

name: Marcel van Raamsdonk
review_text: Het restaurant is zeer goed en lekker eten. Het hotel is maar middelmatig gaten in de lakens slecht ontbijt slecht need met een kuil erin. De airco is wel goed ruime kamer en badkamer zit er echt schoon uit, Hoewel ik overal vliegen zie maar dat kan een andere oorzaak hebben. De locatie is lastig te vinden heel smalle afslag op de rotonde. Voor mij niet voor herhaling vatbaar
review_translated_text: The restaurant has very good and tasty food. The hotel is just mediocre holes in the sheets bad breakfast bad need with a hole in it. The air conditioning is good, the room is spacious and the bathroom looks really clean, although I see flies everywhere, but that may have another cause. The location is difficult to find, very narrow exit on the roundabout. Not worth repeating for me

name: Frans van Hoorn
review_text: Gebruiken dit hotel als stopover hotels en dan is het uiterst geschikt ... de grootste kamer stinkt naar riool en hebben dat gemeld kamer weer geboekt na 7 weken en lucht was net zo slecht .... Staf reuze aardig maar kunnen er niets aan doen zal dus aan management liggen .... Eten is top en plek is leuk
review_translated_text: We use this hotel as a stopover hotel and then it is extremely suitable ... the largest room stinks of sewer and we reported that room booked again after 7 weeks and the air was just as bad .... Staff is very nice but they can't do anything about it so it must be down to management... Food is top and place is nice

name: Thierry Albert
review_text:
Bel hotel,  personnels professionnels et a l'ecoute.
Parfait pour visiter la region.
review_translated_text:
Beautiful hotel, professional and attentive staff.
Perfect for visiting the region.

name: Almudena Arjona Felipe
review_text:
Me he alojado durante 1 semana junto con mi pareja, mi bebe y mi perra. Un trato de 10. Todo muy limpio y acogedor, aunque en la web ponia q no daban cunas, nos facilitaron una nada mas llegar. El trato con la perra increible, puede estar en todos lados junto con nosotros, todos los dias entramos al restaurante con ella y la ponian agua. La cocina es muy buena, relacion calidad precio inmejorable, creo que probamos casi todas carta y no sacamos nada negativo.
Por poner un contra, pillo tormenta y estuvimos 4 dias sin agua caliente, tardan mucho en solucionar los problemas.
No me gusto que no se pueda ir andando a Briviesca con facilidad ( con carro de bebe y perro casi imposible)
Sin duda repetiremos.
review_translated_text:
I stayed for 1 week with my partner, my baby and my dog. A treatment of 10. Everything very clean and cozy, although on the website it said that they did not provide cribs, they provided us with one as soon as we arrived. The treatment with the incredible dog, she can be everywhere with us, every day we entered the restaurant with her and they gave her water. The cuisine is very good, unbeatable value for money, I think we tried almost all of the menu and didn't get anything negative.
To put it another way, there was a storm and we were without hot water for 4 days, it takes them a long time to solve the problems.
I didn't like that you can't walk to Briviesca easily (with a baby stroller and dog almost impossible)
Without a doubt we will repeat.

name: Carlos HB
review_text:
Tras pasar una noche con las ventanas abiertas y el bano con la luz encendida y abierto para intentar sacar el hedor que inundaba la habitacion, asi como el resto del hotel (pasillos, recepcion) espere 40 minutos a ser atendido en recepcion (no habia nadie) para solicitar la devolucion del importe o una parte de este.

Siguen sin ponerse en contacto conmigo, creo que han pasado cuatro meses del incidente.
review_translated_text:
After spending a night with the windows open and the bathroom with the light on and open to try to get rid of the stench that filled the room, as well as the rest of the hotel (hallways, reception) I waited 40 minutes to be attended to at reception (there was no one) to request a refund of the amount or part of it.

They still haven't contacted me, I think it's been four months since the incident.

name: avh69
review_text: Voor een 4 sterren hotel had ik er meer van verwacht. Personeel is super vriendelijk kamer is schoon maar dit hotel mist net iets wat het 4 sterren maakt. We hadden oude handdoeken zelfs een met een gat er in, douche werd niet lekker warm de verlichting word overal op sensoren geschakeld wat de gangen en ruimtes uiteraard donker maakt waardoor het niet uitnodigt om in te lopen.
review_translated_text: For a 4 star hotel I expected more. Staff is super friendly room is clean but this hotel lacks something that makes it 4 stars. We had old towels even one with a hole in it, shower was not nice and warm the lighting is switched on sensors everywhere which of course makes the corridors and rooms dark so it is not inviting to walk in.

name: Jose Delgado Maria
review_text:
Nous somme tombes en panne en Espagne et avons ete achemines a cet hotel via l'assurance !

Quel professionnalisme ! Nous sommes tombes sur des etres humains dote d'un sens du travail et d'une empathie remarquable !

Dans notre malheur toute l'equipe de l'hotel etait a notre ecoute , nous a aide beaucoup plus que notre propre assurance !

Des petites attentions , des mots reconfortants , nous avons trouve chez toute l'equipe de l'hotel une sincerite profonde et une gentillesse rarement vue  jusqu'alors dans un etablissement ...

Merci a eux a toute l'equipe , reception , restaurant , bar etc

Je recommande vivement cet etablissement pour tout le confort qu'il propose la proprete mais aussi pour l'humanite dont font preuve toute l'equipe au service des clients ! Une qualite que je pensais disparue mais que j'ai redecouvert grace a cet hotel !
review_translated_text:
We broke down in Spain and were taken to this hotel via our insurance!

What professionalism! We encountered human beings with a dedication to work and remarkable empathy!

In our misfortune, the entire hotel team listened to us and helped us much more than our own insurance!

With little touches and comforting words, we found in the entire hotel team a deep sincerity and kindness rarely seen before in an establishment...

Thank you to the entire team: reception, restaurant, bar, etc.

I highly recommend this establishment for all the comfort it offers, the cleanliness, but also for the humanity demonstrated by the entire team in their customer service! A quality I thought had disappeared but which I rediscovered thanks to this hotel!

name: VBA
review_text: Parcours clients optimise avec bar, terrasse, jeux d enfant exterieur et a l'abris, restaurant. Le tout dans un coin calme.
review_translated_text: Optimized customer journey with bar, terrace, outdoor and sheltered children's games, restaurant. All in a quiet area.

name: gon blanco. uvieu
review_text: muy buen hotel. limpieza y amabilidad

name: Patrick Schu
review_text:
Rooms are quite big and clean.
Beds are short, if you're over 1,80 your feet will hang over the matrass.
The toilet is very close to the wall with the toilet paper holder mounted just next to it, so you need to sit at an angle.
The breakfast buffet is quite rudimentary.

name: Danil Zinovyev
review_text: We stayed at this hotel due to its convenience as it was on our way to France from Portugal. It is nicely located to the highway without any issues with noise from the road. The rooms were very well maintained and cleaned and updated. The only thing is that the breakfast was VERY lacking for a 4 star hotel. They provided much less than any other hotel I've stayed at with such a rating. That was disappointing for a 10EU per person price tag. Otherwise the hotel was very nice.

name: JOSE IGNACIO TEJADA EDESO
review_text: Excelente, muy buen menu !!!
review_translated_text: Excellent, very good menu!!!

name: Sergio Mera
review_text:
Lugar acogedor con buen clima pero el menu escaso y muy rapido en el servicio.
Pedido cerrado. Perdimos gaseosa y se primgan en darnos la botella ya abierta y supongo que esta rellenada.
Asi que me imagino el resto de la comida.
No volvere a no ser que no quede mas remedio.
review_translated_text:
A cozy place with a nice atmosphere, but a limited menu and very fast service.
Order closed. We lost our soda, and they rushed us to give us an already opened bottle, which I assume was refilled.
So I'm just imagining the rest of the meal.
I won't be back unless I absolutely have to.

name: Mar Diaz Korama
review_text: Paramos a la ida de vacaciones para descansar. La ducha una gozada para el cuerpo tras un viaje en coche,  agua con mucha presion y muy caliente. Cuenta con todos los accesorios de bano. Bajamos a cenar, y una calidad excelente y variada de precios. Por la noche muy tranquilo, cama confortable,  climatizado y Pet friendly.  El bufet de desayuno de acuerdo a las necesidades. Me ha sorprendido gratamente la calidad. Mi mascota feliz yo mas! . A la vuelta hemos vuelto a repetir experiencia para continuar el viaje. Calidad muy buena recomiendo
review_translated_text: We stopped on the way from vacation to rest. The shower was a pleasure for the body after a car trip, water with a lot of pressure and very hot. It has all the bathroom accessories. We went down for dinner, and excellent quality and varied prices. Very quiet at night, comfortable bed, air-conditioned and Pet friendly.  The breakfast buffet according to needs. I was pleasantly surprised by the quality. My pet happy me more! . On our return we repeated the experience to continue the trip. Very good quality I recommend

name: Carmen Alonso Lopez
review_text:
Viaje CAM: 16/07-19/07
Resenas positivas: instalaciones, personal de recepcion y un sitio muy tranquilo y confortable.
Resenas negativas: Mal servicio de comedor. Muy desagradables las dos camareras que lo atienden, haciendo distinciones y cambios del menu cerrado/concertado entre el personal del grupo. Contestando de muy malas maneras y protestando por todo!!! La direccion del centro deberia tomar medidas al respecto.
review_translated_text:
CAM Trip: July 16-July 19
Positive reviews: Facilities, reception staff, and a very quiet and comfortable location.
Negative reviews: Poor dining room service. The two waitresses who serve the restaurant are very unpleasant, making distinctions and changing the pre-set menu among the group staff. They respond rudely and complain about everything! The center's management should take action in this regard.

review_text: Calidad a buen precio, las habitaciones muy cuidadas. Un clasico en la zona, cerca de la autovia y con buen restaurante.
review_translated_text: Quality at a good price, very well maintained rooms. A classic in the area, close to the highway and with a good restaurant.

name: Antonio Bovio
review_text: Un cuatro estrellas que no defrauda. Cuidado, tranquilo, limpio y amplio. Precios bajos. En recepcion amabilisimos. Los televisores de la habitacion debieran ser un poco mayores.  Recomendable.
review_translated_text: A four-star hotel that never disappoints. Well-maintained, quiet, clean, and spacious. Low prices. Very friendly reception. The TVs in the room could be a bit larger. Recommended.

name: NAN DO
review_text: Hemos vuelto a comer y fenomenal. Servicio y calidad extraordinario.
review_translated_text: We have eaten again and it was phenomenal. Extraordinary service and quality.

name: Alicia
review_text: Habitacion grande pero austera en decoracion. Ruidos bien temprano ya q estaba en zona de paso constante de gente a la hora del desayuno. Demasiado calor en la habitacion. Desayuno correcto y muy tranquilo ya q estaba divido zona de huespedes y zona de autobuses de excursion ......gracias a dios
review_translated_text: Large but austerely decorated room. Noises from early on, as it was in an area where people were constantly passing by at breakfast time. The room was too hot. Breakfast was decent and very quiet, as the area was divided between the guest area and the tour bus area... thank goodness.

name: Colette Tesson
review_text: tres bon hotel pour une etape tres bon rapport qualite prix  bon petit dejeuner propre ,personel sympa contrairement a ce que nous avions lu sur certains avis  il y a des places de parking en nombre oui avec une grosse voiture certaines places sont un peu justes  mais  il est toujours possible de trouver une place si on marche 10m de plus!!! hotel non bruyant malgre  la proximite de la route.
review_translated_text: very good hotel for a stopover very good value for money good clean breakfast, friendly staff contrary to what we had read in some reviews there are plenty of parking spaces yes with a large car some spaces are a little tight but it is always possible to find a space if you walk 10m more!!! non-noisy hotel despite the proximity to the road.

name: Ciprian Nicolae Cucianu
review_text:
He venido a trabajar por la zona y mis clientes me hicieron la reserva, 3 noches con posibilidad de ampliar! Las primeras 3 noches de lujo, no me esperaba que sea asi de bien, el desayuno bastante bien, atencion inmejorable!
Al ampliar 2 noches mas me cambio de habitacion: al entrar olia a desague y pense que por no dejar la ventana abierta olia asi! Deje toda la noche la luz del bano encendida ( por el extractor) y puse toallas en todos los sanitarios para evitar disgustos! Al despertarme fui al bano y no vomite de milagro! Pedi un cambio y al chico ...se le olvido al parecer. Lo consegui a la tarde pero me cambio a la zona vieja! La verdad que me decepciono si no tendrias las 5 estrellas
review_translated_text:
I came to work in the area and my clients made a reservation for me, 3 nights with the possibility of extending! The first 3 nights were luxurious, I didn't expect it to be this good, the breakfast was quite good, unbeatable service!
When I extended 2 more nights I changed rooms: when I entered it smelled like a drain and I thought that because I didn't leave the window open it smelled like that! I left the bathroom light on all night (due to the exhaust fan) and put towels in all the toilets to avoid any unpleasantness! When I woke up I went to the bathroom and miraculously I didn't vomit! I asked for a change and the guy apparently forgot. I got it in the afternoon but I'm moving to the old area! The truth is that I was disappointed if you didn't have 5 stars

name: fernandasb8
review_text: Hotel con muy buena relacion calidad-precio a escasos 10 minutos andando del centro, aunque hay que ir con cuidado ya que tienes que atravesar una carretera e ir por un tunel no iluminado por la noche. El personal fue encantador, e incluso pudimos entrar con nuestros perros en el restaurante. El desayuno muy basico. No hay limitacion de peso en perros para el hotel, aunque hay un suplemento de 10EU por perro y por noche.
review_translated_text: A very good value hotel just a 10-minute walk from the center, although you do need to be careful as you have to cross a road and go through an unlit tunnel at night. The staff was lovely, and we were even able to bring our dogs into the restaurant. The breakfast was very basic. There is no weight limit for dogs at the hotel, although there is a EU10 supplement per dog per night.

name: Jose Ramon Marzana Fernandez
review_text: Llegue muy tarde y me atendio muy bien,limpio pero antiguo.

review_translated_text: Tastefully furnished rooms, good service, and a very good restaurant. Don't let the highway deter you; the rooms are absolutely quiet. We'd be happy to come back.

review_text: Hotel con muy buena relacion calidad-precio a escasos 10 minutos andando del centro, aunque hay que ir con cuidado ya que tienes que atravesar una carretera e ir por un tunel no iluminado por la noche. name: Milvussan Milvussan (Milvussan)
review_text: Hotel especializado en grupos (tenlo en cuenta de cara a desayunar por ejemplo). No puedo decir nada malo porque cumple con todo pero da la sensacion de que vivio tiempos mejores y ahora subsiste por el nombre: las habitaciones muy bien (limpias), la ducha en el techo (no tiene manguera), el grifo un poco corto pero te apanas, bien de agua caliente, calefaccion y aire funcionan correctamente (eso es importante), buenos ascensores y silenciosas. Pegas? La comida (si no es en restaurante) muy en lo limite, si quieres tomar algo por la noche sera en la entrada y para llegar a Briviesca andando a echar a andar por un tunel (que por la noche no se ilumina) que pasa por debajo de la carretera y atravesarla un poco
review_translated_text: A hotel specializing in groups (keep this in mind when having breakfast, for example). I can't say anything negative about it because it meets all the requirements, but it feels like it's seen better days and now survives because of its name: the rooms are very good (clean), the shower is on the ceiling (no hose), the tap is a bit short but you can manage, there's plenty of hot water, the heating and air conditioning work properly (that's important), and the elevators are good and quiet. The drawbacks? The food (if not in the restaurant) is very limited. If you want to have a drink at night, you'll have to go at the entrance, and to get to Briviesca, you'll have to walk through a tunnel (which isn't lit at night) that runs under the road and cross it for a bit.

name: gourmandsenballade
review_text: Premier bon point, cet hotel accepte les chiens. C'est deja un critere important. En effet, en Espagne, lorsque vous selectionnez un hotel et que vous cochez la case "animaux acceptes", vous perdez 80 % de votre selection. Cela progresse un peu, mais cela reste difficile. Comme si les chiens etaient sales. On paie un supplement de 10 euros (oui quand meme). Apres ca, on s'etonnera que des chiens sont abandonnes chaque annee...|Bref, l'hotel est tres moderne et tres propre et affiche 3 etoiles. Le personnel accueillant, seul le receptionniste parle Anglais. La chambre est tres bien, le lit est de qualite et la salle de bain est complete. Il y a une jolie terrasse pour prendre un verre a l'ombre ou au soleil. On decide de se faire plaisir au restaurant ou on accepte egalement notre chien, en dessous de la table.|En entrees, on se partage une salade mixte, une poignee de cepes au foie gras (un delice), ensuite une queue de boeuf sauce Riberira (facon carbonnade au vin rouge), cuite a la perfection. Le repas accompagne de bouteille de Ribeira del Duero Joven. Le dessert, un super riz au lait maison partage accompagne de 2 magnifiques, Pedro Jimenez XO. prix du restaurant : 79.40 EU, service impeccable.|Le petit dejeuner est tres bien egalement.|Malgre que l'Hotel ne soit pas tres eloigne de la Nationale, nous n'avons rien entendu. Nous le recommandons donc pour une etape.||
review_translated_text: First good point, this hotel accepts dogs. This is already an important criterion. Indeed, in Spain, when you select a hotel and check the "pets allowed" box, you lose 80% of your selection. This is improving a little, but it's still difficult. As if dogs were dirty. We pay a supplement of 10 euros (yes, really). After that, we'll be surprised that dogs are abandoned every year...|In short, the hotel is very modern and very clean and has a 3-star rating. The staff is welcoming; only the receptionist speaks English. The room is very nice, the bed is good quality, and the bathroom is complete. There is a lovely terrace for a drink in the shade or in the sun. We decide to treat ourselves to the restaurant, where our dog is also accepted, under the table.|For starters, we share a mixed salad, a handful of porcini mushrooms with foie gras (a delight), then an oxtail with Riberira sauce (a red wine carbonnade), cooked to perfection. The meal was accompanied by a bottle of Ribeira del Duero Joven. Dessert was a delicious homemade rice pudding shared with two magnificent Pedro Jimenez XOs. Restaurant price: EU79.40, impeccable service. |The breakfast is also very good. |Despite the fact that the hotel is not very far from the main road, we didn't hear anything. We therefore recommend it for a stopover.

review_text: Muy lindo hotel muy comodo y de buen acceso en la ruta a Vitoria Gasteiz...muy amables ..cuarto comodisimo y bano moderno ..el restaurante excelente y muy bien servido y la comida deliciosa...una joya en el camino ...buena relacion precio calidad

name: People Truelove Tellers
review_text:
Recientemente, tuve la oportunidad de trabajar como fotografo de bodas en el Hotel Restaurante El Valles, y me gustaria compartir mi experiencia en este excepcional lugar que brinda un ambiente unico para capturar imagenes memorables de parejas.

Lo que hace que El Valles se destaque es su elegante entorno, con cuidados jardines que ofrecen un telon de fondo perfecto para fotos al aire libre. El hotel tambien cuenta con un encantador salon acristalado que permite aprovechar la luz natural en un ambiente mas intimo y sofisticado. Ademas, la combinacion de estilos rusticos y modernos crea un ambiente acogedor y elegante para cualquier celebracion.

Uno de los detalles especificos de El Valles que no puedo dejar de mencionar es su exquisita gastronomia. El restaurante ofrece deliciosos platos que deleitan a los invitados, lo cual suma puntos al disfrute de la boda y a la satisfaccion de todos los asistentes.

En resumen, mi experiencia trabajando en el Hotel Restaurante El Valles ha sido verdaderamente gratificante. Este lugar ofrece un entorno versatil para tomar fotografias unicas y capturar la esencia del amor en un dia tan especial. Lo recomiendo a las parejas que buscan un espacio distinguido y acogedor para celebrar su boda y conservar recuerdos inolvidables.
review_translated_text:
Recently, I had the opportunity to work as a wedding photographer at Hotel Restaurant El Valles, and I'd like to share my experience at this exceptional venue, which offers a unique setting for capturing memorable images of couples.

What makes El Valles stand out is its elegant setting, with manicured gardens that provide a perfect backdrop for outdoor photos. The hotel also has a charming conservatory that allows you to take advantage of natural light for a more intimate and sophisticated atmosphere. Furthermore, the combination of rustic and modern styles creates a cozy and elegant atmosphere for any celebration.

One of the unique details of El Valles that I can't help but mention is its exquisite cuisine. The restaurant offers delicious dishes that delight guests, adding points to the enjoyment of the wedding and the satisfaction of all attendees.

In short, my experience working at Hotel Restaurant El Valles has been truly rewarding. This venue offers a versatile setting for taking unique photographs and capturing the essence of love on such a special day. I recommend it to couples looking for a distinguished and welcoming space to celebrate their wedding and preserve unforgettable memories.

name: Moises Martinez
review_text:
Solo hemos ido a comer.
El restaurante siempre ha tenido prestigio y decir que la cocina sigue siendo muy buena. Muy buena calidad de los ingredientes.
Hemos tomado 2 menus degustacion del dia de la madre y un menu infantil.
El menu infantil muy correcto con cantidades generosas.
El menu degustacion muy bueno.
Entrantes del langostinos y setas en tempura con salsas bien hechos. Los esparragos gratinados se nota que los compran frescos y los preparan alli.
Los ibericos correctos, sin mas.
La merluza rellena espectacular, fresca, al punto y se parte en lascas muy jugosa.
La carne, aunque de los platos que hemos tomado sea el que menos nos ha gustado, buenisima, bien hecha, en cantidad y se nota que es de calidad.
Como postres la tarta mil hojas ha sido toda una experiencia la crema deliciosa y la nata nada empalagosa.
La tarta de trufa muy buena, pero junto a la mil hojas no ha destacado.
La relacion calidad precio es excelente. Un lugar para repetir experiencia.
review_translated_text:
We only went to eat.
The restaurant has always had prestige and to say that the cuisine is still very good. Very good quality of the ingredients.
We have had 2 Mother's Day tasting menus and a children's menu.
The children's menu is very correct with generous quantities.
The tasting menu is very good.
Starters of prawns and mushrooms tempura with well-made sauces. The gratin asparagus is clearly bought fresh and prepared there.
The correct Iberians, without further ado.
The stuffed hake is spectacular, fresh, to the point and is cut into very juicy flakes.
The meat, although of the dishes we have had it is the one we liked the least, was delicious, well done, in quantity and it is evident that it is of quality.
As for desserts, the thousand-leaf cake has been quite an experience, the cream is delicious and the cream is not at all cloying.
The truffle cake was very good, but next to the thousand leaves it did not stand out.
The price-quality ratio is excellent. A place to repeat experience.

Die Portionen sind mehr als grosszugig gewesen. Alle Speisen (wir waren zu 5.) waren zumindest gut oder sehr gut. Zum Beispiel Linseneintopf, Fischsuppen, Salate, (ganze) Doraden, Rindfleisch, etc.

Am  Wochenende sind die Menus etwas teurer, um die 22-23EU.

Werde bei Gelegenheit wieder hinfahren.

Highly recommended restaurant on the Spanish federal highway 1 near Briviesca.

Surprisingly good food for a menu around EU15 per person (during the week!) with 5 first courses and 5 second courses including dessert, wine, water and bread.

review_text:
La atencion en cafeteria,recepcion perfecta.

Nos iban retirando los platos sin aun terminar ni los primeros y los segundos.
Tuve que trasladar a mi segundo plato con mis manos lo que aun me quedaba del primero.
Pesimo.
En fin.

Appalling.
In the end.

Poor breakfast.
Only night for work reasons.

review_text: Buscaba un bar para tomar algo, y bueno, como bar justito. La camarera super amable, pero poco genero, por lo visto a partir de julio se esmeran mas, y se puede picotear cuando abre cocina. The waitress was super friendly, but there weren't many items available; apparently, they've been putting more effort into it since July, and you can grab a bite to eat when the kitchen is open. Once you manage to open the heavy sliding door to the left of the La Carola sign, you enter a very comfortable space. A place worth exploring; I'll be back.
