review_text: Muy bonito, muy grande, como preparado para albergar gente, el entorno bonito, merece la pena visitar los pueblos de alrededor y hacer marchas, pero una noche con eso suficiente. Ahora en comidas, muy pobre y escaso y para las personas que tengan problemas de comidas, no te solucionan la situacion y te quedas sin comer, luego el Bufet que nos pusieron para 45 personas, muy escaso, nada de fruta fresca ( hoy en dia, que se compra tantisima por k, eso no supone ningun problema ) y llenar un hotel con 45 personas, no se llena todos los dias.
review_translated_text: Very nice, very large, as if prepared to accommodate people, the surroundings are beautiful, it is worth visiting the surrounding towns and going out, but one night with that is enough. Now in terms of meals, very poor and scarce and for people who have food problems, they do not solve the situation and you are left without eating, then the Buffet that they gave us for 45 people, very scarce, no fresh fruit (nowadays, when you buy so much for a kilo, that is not a problem) and filling a hotel with 45 people, it does not fill up every day.

name: Skrabal Anna
review_text:
Das Hotel hat viele Parkplatze auch fur auch fur Transporter mit grossen Anhanger. Das Personal ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Die Zimmer sind gross  geraumig und sehr sauber. Hunde darf man gegen geringen Aufpreis mitbringen, was in Spanien nicht ganz einfach ist. Das Fruhstuck ist als kleines Bufett
aufgebaut und alles ist frisch und lecker, Kaffee ist super lecker. Sehr empfehlendswert, waren schon siebenmal dort.
review_translated_text: The hotel has plenty of parking, even for vans with large trailers. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The rooms are large, spacious, and very clean. Dogs are allowed for a small surcharge, which isn't easy in Spain. Breakfast is a small buffet, and everything is fresh and delicious. The coffee is delicious. Highly recommended; we've been there seven times already.

name: Marta "Marsabru"
review_text:
Una verdadera decepcion. El acceso mal indicado.
Pedi una sepia (dura como ella sola), acompanada de una ensalada verde (y le pregunto a la persona que me atiende si dicha ensalada era de lechuga o de brotes, ya que no me gustan las ensaladas de brotes, a lo que me responde que es de lechuga). Y, cual es mi sorpresa, cuando me llega la sepia con ensalada de brotes de soja. Un desastre!  Ante tal situacion,  no toque el plato,  pero tampoco se molestaron en preguntarme si me habia gustado o no. El postre,  ni lo pedi.
No creo que vuelva por alli.
review_translated_text:
A real disappointment. Poorly indicated access.
I ordered a cuttlefish (hard as it is), accompanied by a green salad (and I asked the person serving me if said salad was lettuce or sprout salads, since I don't like sprout salads, to which he replied that it was lettuce). And, what is my surprise, when I get the cuttlefish with bean sprout salad. A disaster!  In such a situation, I didn't touch the plate, but they didn't bother to ask me if I liked it or not. I didn't even ask for dessert.
I don't think I'll go back there.

name: NURIA GASULLA
review_text:
Hemos estado hospedados en este hotel
Queda un poco aislado del pueblo entre carreteras y vias del tren. Hotel muy espacioso, con mucha luz. Habitaciones amplias y con camas muy comodas. El bano completo con una enorme banera, bidet, gran lavabo con mucho espacio, secador de pelo, grande espejo y otro espejo de aumento para maquillaje. Television, aire acondicionado, escritorio, nevera, una silla y una butaca. Todo con muy buena iluminacion.
El desayuno es un buffet muy completo:diferentes tipos de panes, leche cafe, variedad de infusiones, queso, jamon York, jamon serrano,. Bolleria. Fruta fresca, fruta ya preparada limpia y cortada. Todo muy bien presentado.
Todo el personal, desde recepcion pasando por las camareras hasta las de limpieza muy eficientes y profesionales. Siempre atentos a cualquier necesidad.
El restaurante precioso con sillas enfundadas con telas elegantes. Lamparas de arana y decoracion de cuadros de planos antiguos de medios de transporte.
La comida deliciosa y bien presentada.
Para aparcar perfecto y sin problemas.
review_translated_text:
We have been staying at this hotel
It is a little isolated from the town between roads and train tracks. Very spacious hotel, with lots of light. Spacious rooms with very comfortable beds. The bathroom is complete with a huge bathtub, bidet, large sink with plenty of space, hair dryer, large mirror and another magnifying mirror for makeup. Television, air conditioning, desk, refrigerator, a chair and an armchair. All with very good lighting.
Breakfast is a very complete buffet: different types of bread, milk, coffee, a variety of infusions, cheese, York ham, Serrano ham. Pastries. Fresh fruit, already prepared fruit, cleaned and cut. Everything very well presented.
All the staff, from reception to the waitresses to the cleaning staff, were very efficient and professional. Always attentive to any need.
The beautiful restaurant with chairs covered in elegant fabrics. Chandeliers and decoration of paintings of old plans of means of transportation.
Delicious and well presented food.
For perfect and problem-free parking.

name: Maria De Los Angeles Martinez
review_text: En general muy bien.

Mientras que el sandwich venia acompanado de patatas y era bastante aceptable (4EU), las tostadas eran dos tostas de pan tipo supermercado, de untar, extremadamente pequenas. Y lo mejor de todo es que cada tostada costaba lo mismo que el sandwich, basicamente, cada mitad dos euros. Vista la situacion, nos quejamos en recepcion, donde nos ofrecieron otro plato de las mismas caracteristicas. Aunque en conclusion, el trato fue bueno, las tostadas son las peores que he probado en relacion calidad precio. No las pidais.
review_translated_text: We stopped for a snack at this hotel on the way north, and to begin with there was no staff in the cafeteria, but rather the receptionist had to assist us. Although their attention was close, our surprise came when we had to pay EU17.80 for 2 soft drinks, a tea, two pieces of toast and a mixed sandwich. While the sandwich came with potatoes and was quite acceptable (EU4), the toasts were two pieces of supermarket-type bread, spreadable, extremely small. And the best of all is that each toast cost the same as the sandwich, basically, two euros each half. Given the situation, we complained at reception, where they offered us another dish with the same characteristics. Although in conclusion, the treatment was good, the toasts are the worst I have ever tried in relation to quality and price. Don't ask for them.

name: aywilson
review_text: On our way home from the Algarve to Calais, we stayed for one night.  The room was, clean, large and airy and the bathroom was also very large.  Excellent view from the room and peaceful.  Staff were very friendly and helpful and also spoke several languages.  The car park was a bit tight but there is plenty of parking.  Only had a snack in the restaurant, the food was ok and the continental breakfast was very good.  Would definitely  stay there again  passing through.

name: Jose Maria Hernamperez Buron
review_text: La comida es excelente, sin embargo no tienen zumo de naranja natural en el desayuno.
review_translated_text: The food is excellent, however they do not have fresh orange juice for breakfast.

review_text: Porque esta muy limpio, los empleados amables y eficientes, un encanto estar alli y deseando volver

name: Angela Nyayko

review_text: Nous avons cherche un endroit ou faire une pause au dernier moment , nous avons essaye cet Hotel donne pour un 4 etoiles. Plutot 3 au vu du petit dejeuner. Salle de restaurant improbable (decoration) 80 euros pour deux un peu cher . Sinon bon compromis pour une halte d une nuit. Chambre a l arriere calme.

Improbable restaurant room (decor) 80 euros for two a bit expensive. Otherwise good compromise for a one night stop. Quiet room at the back.

review_text: Hotel luxueux, nous y avons passe une tres bonne nuit

review_text: Hemos estado muy a gusto. La decoracion interior de los salones quizas este un poco anticuada, pero el resto de las instalaciones estan muy bien y se come bastante bien.

name: JazzBoro
review_text: Good place to stay for one or two nights , nice clean room and good tapas served also good Rioja available. Although service a bit slow it was ok for one night. Would certainly stay here again but not long term.|

review_text: Hotel au calme, propre et personnel tres serviable. Petit dejeuner garni comme d'habitude. Ce n'est pas la premiere fois que nous sejournons la et surement pas la derniere

name: Mandy Connelly
review_text: Good value overnight stay.  Food was excellent although not the cheapest. Quality en-route meal and pet friendly too.

review_text: La habitacion aceptable sin ser nada del otro mundo. Lo impresionante es el paisaje que lo rodea. Te levantas oliendo a campo y rodeado de verde. La cena en el restaurante del hotel estuvo bien.
review_translated_text: The room was acceptable, but nothing special. What's impressive is the surrounding landscape. You wake up smelling of the countryside and surrounded by greenery. Dinner at the hotel restaurant was good.

name: Autodesk World
review_text: Very good !

name: Supermark12
review_text: Mi sono fermato in questo hotel durante un viaggio di lavoro in Spagna.la posizione non e certo delle migliori,praticamente si affaccia sull'autostrada, ma la camera era moderna e pulita e sinceramente non desideravo altro. Il personale molto cordiale e gentile,in caso di viaggio lavoro,li trovo assolutamente adatto.
review_translated_text: I stopped at this hotel during a business trip to Spain. The location is certainly not the best, practically overlooking the highway, but the room was modern and clean and honestly I did not want anything else. The staff was very friendly and kind, in case of a business trip, I find them absolutely suitable.

name: Antonio Casjun
review_text: Tuvo mejores tiempos
review_translated_text: He had better times

name: Clementine LEFEVRE
review_text: Reception et chambre tres agreable. Le restaurant n'est pas mal, on y mange bien, le seul bemol est la vitesse du service qui est bien trop rapide. Prix abordables, meme pour petit budget. Je recommande.
review_translated_text: Very pleasant reception and room. The restaurant isn't bad; the food is good. The only downside is the speed of service, which is far too fast. Affordable prices, even for those on a budget. I recommend it.

name: Jose Luis

name: Rein Lansen
review_text:
Op onze terugreis uit de Algarve zijn we gestopt in Briviesca voor een overnachting in Hotel Isabel.
Bij aankomst waren we blij verrast. De ontvangst was hartelijk en de kamer was prima met een heerlijk bed. Alles was schoon en heel wat wij ook wel eens anders meemaken bij veel duurdere locaties.
We konden de auto veilig kwijt achter het hotel op een kleine afgesloten parkeerplaats.
Het centrum van het plaatsje is autovrij zo ook rond het hotel. Het gezellige plein met spelende kinderen en terrasjes was een welkom rustmoment na een lange autorit.
Een absolute aanrader wat ons betreft.
Anja en Rein Lansen
review_translated_text:
On our return trip from the Algarve we stopped in Briviesca for an overnight stay at Hotel Isabel.
Upon arrival we were pleasantly surprised. The welcome was warm and the room was fine with a lovely bed. Everything was clean and quite something we sometimes experience differently at much more expensive locations.
We were able to safely park the car behind the hotel in a small enclosed parking lot.
The center of the town is car-free, as is the area around the hotel. The cozy square with playing children and terraces was a welcome moment of rest after a long drive.
An absolute must as far as we are concerned.
Anja and Rein Lansen

name: Angel Lopez
review_text:
Un hotel con una calidad/precio impresionante.
Limpisimo, camas comodas y la duena encantadora. Ibamos 8 amigos con la moto y teniamos que salir pronto a la manana siguiente y ella adelanto el horario de desayuno para que no marchasemos sin desayunar.
Recomendable 100%.
review_translated_text:
A hotel with impressive quality/price.
Very clean, comfortable beds and the charming owner. We were 8 friends on the motorcycle and we had to leave early the next morning and she brought forward the breakfast time so that we wouldn't leave without breakfast.
100% recommended.

name: jacques de Chaunac
review_text: Hotel tres confortable, literie remarquable, emplacement central et service sympathique et efficace! Merci Beatriz!
review_translated_text: Very comfortable hotel, remarkable bedding, central location and friendly and efficient service! Thanks Beatriz!

name: Santiago Florez Santiago
review_text:
Genial todo, hemos ido en un grupo de 8 motos y todo perfecto. Muy centrico y con aparcamiento.
Beatriz nos alga tratado fenomenal y muy profesional.
Las camas y almohada muy comodas. Muy limpio todo.
Volveremos seguro.
review_translated_text:
Everything was great. We went in a group of 8 motorcycles and everything was perfect. Very central and with parking.
Beatriz treated us wonderfully and was very professional.
The beds and pillows were very comfortable. Everything was very clean.
We will definitely return.

name: raul martin
review_text: Un hotel de los que te hacen sentir en confianza y agusto, Beatriz se nota que pone carino en su negocio nos adapto el horario del desayuno a nuestra salida en moto. Confortable, muy bien localizado y completo. Muchas gracias Bea.
review_translated_text: A hotel that makes you feel confident and comfortable, Beatriz shows that she puts care into her business and adapted the breakfast schedule to our motorcycle outing. Comfortable, very well located and complete. Thank you very much Bea.

name: VmaxPat
review_text:
Accueil sympathique
Chambre confortable et tres calme
Bon petit dejeuner
Excellent rapport qualite/prix
Bien situee en pleine ville
Un gros plus pour ma moto : le parking de l'hotel

Friendly welcome

Good breakfast
Excellent value for money

name: Sandra F F
review_text: Mi primera experiencia en el Hotel ha sido maravillosa. La atencion de Isa, la recepcionista excelente estuvimos solo una noche fuimos atendida yo y mi hija de maravilla. Recomendado al 100 x 100
review_translated_text: My first experience at the Hotel has been wonderful. The attention of Isa, the excellent receptionist, we were only there one night, me and my daughter were treated wonderfully. Recommended at 100 x 100

name: YOLANDA
review_text:
No se oyede decir nada negativo de este hotel.
Ubicacion en pleno centro.
Personal encantador y muy buen trato.
Habitaciones amplias muy limpias con colchones mas que buenos , cuarto de bano grande  y cuenta con banera y bide.
Tambien tiene television ,  calefaccion y aire acondicionado.
Tiene cafeteria, parcking privado y ascensor.
Esta en pleno centro de Briviesca y por supuesto que si volvemos repetiremos con el hotel.
TOTALMENTE RECOMENDABLE.
review_translated_text:
You don't hear anything negative said about this hotel.
Location in the center.
Lovely staff and very good treatment.
Large, very clean rooms with more than good mattresses, large bathroom with bathtub and bidet.
It also has television, heating and air conditioning.
It has a cafeteria, private parking and elevator.
It is in the heart of Briviesca and of course if we return we will repeat the hotel.
TOTALLY RECOMMENDED.

name: btt_jimmy hanfri
review_text: Muy buena experiencia. En recepcion muy dispuestos a ayudar. Las habitaciones renovadas y desayuno recien hecho.
review_translated_text: Very good experience. At reception very willing to help. Renovated rooms and freshly made breakfast.

name: GERARD PELLEJA

review_translated_text: Everything perfect! The girl at the reception was very nice and very attentive. 100% recommended

name: Andrea Navarro
review_text: Estuvimos anoche. Un sitio delicioso para no perderselo. Limpisimo y un trato exquisito por parte de Beatriz. Muchas gracias. Mercedes.
review_translated_text: We were there last night. A delicious place not to be missed. Very clean and exquisite treatment from Beatriz. Thank you so much. Mercedes.

name: francisco garcia pavon
review_text: El mejor sitio para quedarse en Briviesca y alrededores. La situacion perfecta y ademas con parking.Lo mejor el trato cercano de la duena del hotel( la senora Beatriz ) y lo calentito que se esta en el hotel .
review_translated_text: The best place to stay in Briviesca and surroundings. The perfect location and also with parking. The best thing is the close treatment of the hotel owner (Mrs. Beatriz) and how warm it is in the hotel.

name: Conchi Garcia Lopez
review_text: Despues de una mala experiencia en otro alojamiento, fuimos a parar al Hotel Isabel, para mi un diez. La ubicacion, las instalaciones, la limpieza y sobre todo Bea, super atenta, amable, simpatica. Lo recomiendo
review_translated_text: After a bad experience at another hotel, we ended up at Hotel Isabel, a ten for me. The location, the facilities, the cleanliness, and especially Bea--super attentive, kind, and friendly. I recommend it.

name: MARIA OLIVA GONZALEZ
review_text: Acogedor y muy bien situado, hemos pasado unos dias maravillosos, parking justo al lado, la zona tiene mucha restauracion donde poder disfrutar de su gastronomia. Muy recomendable. Nosotros volveremos.
review_translated_text: Cozy and very well located, we had a wonderful time. Parking right next door, and the area has plenty of restaurants where you can enjoy the local cuisine. Highly recommended. We'll be back.

name: JOSEP FRANCH PICO
review_text:
El Hotel Isabel en Briviesca se encuentra el mismo centro de la ciudad. A 2 minutos a pie de la plaza Mayor, rodeado de tiendas, bares y espacios de ocio. Dispone de parking propio a 50 metros.
Gran atencion personalizada, muy amables y cordiales.
Gran calidad en el desayuno, habitaciones perfectas y muy limpias. En todo el hotel se respira una gran calma y tranquilidad.
No dudaria ni un momento, en repetir el alojamiento.
review_translated_text:
The Hotel Isabel in Briviesca is located right in the city center. It's a 2-minute walk from the Plaza Mayor, surrounded by shops, bars, and entertainment venues. It has its own parking lot 50 meters away.
Excellent personalized service, very friendly and welcoming.
Excellent breakfast, perfect and very clean rooms. The entire hotel exudes a sense of calm and tranquility.
I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

name: Raul
review_text:
En cualquier viaje la decision de elegir la estancia es lo que marca la diferencia entre un viaje exitoso o lo contrario... Sin duda TODO UN ACIERTO EL HOTEL ISABEL.
Situado en  Briviesca en pleno centro de la capital  de la Bureba, encontramos un lugar increible para desconectar. Limpio, con una atencion excepcional por parte de los anfitriones Armando y Bea los cuales estan en todo momento dispuestos a brindar una atencion extraordinaria para dar una estancia a los clientes agradable.
Habitaciones limpias ordenadas y transmisoras de descanso. Lugar silencioso para desconectar y sobre todo a mano de todo por estar en pleno centro.
Trato personalizado que marca la diferencia, te preparan el desayuno al momento marcando una gran diferencia con otros hoteles de puntuacion superior. Sin duda totalmente recomendable si quereis descansar y sentiros como en casa.
Gracias pareja por estos dias....
Fueron todo facilidades y sonrisas. VOLVEREMOS!!
review_translated_text:
On any trip, the choice of accommodation is what makes the difference between a successful trip or the opposite... Without a doubt, the Hotel Isabel was a great choice.
Located in Briviesca, right in the center of the capital of the Bureba region, we found an incredible place to unwind. Clean, with exceptional service from the hosts Armando and Bea, who are always ready to provide extraordinary attention to ensure a pleasant stay for their guests.
Clean, tidy, and restful rooms. A quiet place to unwind, and above all, close to everything thanks to its central location.
Personalized service makes the difference. They prepare breakfast on the spot, which sets them apart from other hotels with higher ratings. Definitely highly recommended if you want to relax and feel at home.
Thank you, couple, for these days....
It was all facilities and smiles. WE WILL RETURN!!

review_text: Acudo por trabajo, hotel pequeno confortable, acogedor y limpio, el personal es excepcional y agradable, ademas de centrico, lo recomiendo,volvere, muchas gracias por todo.
review_translated_text: I come for work, a small, comfortable, cozy and clean hotel, the staff is exceptional and pleasant, as well as being centrally located, I recommend it, I will return, thank you very much for everything.

review_text: Atencion de diez en recepcion, desayuno muy bien .limpieza recomendado 100% volveremos

name: Esperanza Martin
review_text: Ubicacion en el centro con bares y todo cerca. Encima con parking gratuito con puerta de seguridad que esta en la parte trasera/lateral del hotel. Las habitaciones y servicio todo de 10. Limpieza al detalle, cama comodisima, se nota que estan nuevos los colchones, almohada viscoelastica magnifica. El bano con todo lo necesario, incluso el gel de bano me dejo la piel bien suave despues de una agradable ducha con agua calentita que salia rapido. La chica de la recepcion muy detallista y agradable. Sin duda volvere a alojarme aqui.
review_translated_text: Central location with bars and everything nearby. Plus, free parking with a security gate at the back/side of the hotel. The rooms and service were all top-notch. Cleanliness was top-notch, the bed was incredibly comfortable (you can tell the mattresses are new), and the memory foam pillow was magnificent. The bathroom had everything you needed, even the body wash left my skin feeling soft after a pleasant shower with warm water that ran quickly. The lady at reception was very attentive and pleasant. I will definitely stay here again.

name: Manuel Ros Fernandez
review_text: Un hotel con habitaciones limpias, comodas y con buen precio, sin lujos.
review_translated_text: A hotel with clean, comfortable and well-priced rooms, without luxuries.

name: Laura Robles Manzanaro
review_text: Un hotel de 2 estrellas centrico y sencillo, MUY limpio, con camas comodas, buen trato y precio muy razonable. Nos ayudaron en todo lo que pudieron ya que viajabamos con un bebe recien nacido. Aparcar es facil.
review_translated_text: A centrally located, simple, two-star hotel, VERY clean, with comfortable beds, friendly service, and a very reasonable price. They helped us in every way they could since we were traveling with a newborn baby. Parking is easy.

name: josema carretas
review_text: Hemos estado siete amigos con nuestras bicis y todo han sido facilidades. La recepcionista, una maquina, y muy maja y atenta. Hemos estado muy agusto
review_translated_text: Seven of us were there with our bikes, and everything was easy. The receptionist was a genius, very nice and attentive. We had a great time.

name: Explorer140629
review_text: Hotel con todo lo necesario tanto en la habitacion como en el bano, bien cuidado, muy limpio, muy buen colchon y almohada. La persona que atiende la recepcion de diez. Ubicacion en pleno centro de Briviesca, con garaje pero se puede aparcar cerca.Sin duda un hotel para recomendar y volver.
review_translated_text: The hotel has everything you need in both the room and the bathroom. It's well-maintained, very clean, and has a great mattress and pillow. The front desk staff was excellent. Located in the heart of Briviesca, with a garage, but parking is possible nearby. Definitely a hotel we'd recommend and return to.

name: jorge joaquin revuelta de la vara
review_text:

name: 270luisjavierm
review_text: El trato fue fenomenal, la habitacion super limpia. Nos indicaron todo lo que necesitabamos saber sobre la ciudad.|Si tengo que volver al Briviesca, no tengo ninguna duda de que volvere a este hotel.|La ubicacion es muy buena en el centro de la ciudad y muy buena entrada.
review_translated_text: The service was phenomenal, the room super clean. They told us everything we needed to know about the city. If I have to return to Briviesca, I have no doubt I'll return to this hotel. The location is very good in the city center and has a very good entrance.

review_text:

El director / propietario esta muy amable !
La camara estaba limpia, el colchon comodo, servicio perfecto.
Muchas gracias para la estancia.
review_translated_text:
Perfect place, in the center of Briviesca.
The director/owner is very friendly!
The chamber was clean, the mattress comfortable, service perfect.
Thank you very much for the stay.

name: Mari Carmen Caler Guerrero
review_text: Excelente personal y trato al cliente.
review_translated_text: Excellent staff and customer service.

name: 179joaquing
review_text: Esta ubicado en el centro de la bonita ciudad de Briviesca. En una zona peatonal por lo que recomiendo utilizar el parking. Las habitaciones estan perfectamente equipadas, son comodas, muy limpias y cumplen ampliamente con todas las necesidades que puedas tener. En mi opinion la categoria de 2 estrellas se le queda pequena a este hotel.|Es opcional el desayuno que preparan de una manera muy personal a los clientes. Porque esto es lo que distingue a este hotel, la amabilidad y atenciones que dispensan a sus clientes, tanto en sugerencias de excursiones como de cualquier necesidad que pueda surgirte.|En definitiva fue un acierto alojarnos en este hotel para descubrir las bellas localidades de Las Merindades de Burgos.
review_translated_text: It's located in the center of the beautiful town of Briviesca. It's in a pedestrian zone, so I recommend using the parking lot. The rooms are perfectly equipped, comfortable, very clean, and fully meet all your needs. In my opinion, the two-star rating is too small for this hotel. Breakfast is optional, and they prepare a very personalized service for guests. This is what distinguishes this hotel: the kindness and attention they provide to their guests, both in terms of excursion suggestions and any needs you may have. Ultimately, it was a good choice to stay at this hotel to discover the beautiful towns of Las Merindades de Burgos.

name: pegatauro Sanchez
review_text: Hotel centrico en Briviesca. Habitantes limpias y servicio muy atento. Precio mas que razonable. Recomendable para visitar un pueblo bonito y tranquilo.
review_translated_text: Central hotel in Briviesca. Clean inhabitants and very attentive service. More than reasonable price. Recommended to visit a beautiful and quiet town.

name: Puri
review_text:
Super limpias las habitaciones,con detalles para resolver el alojamiento,secador pelo,espejo aumento y doble almohada para un buen descanso,
Hotel silencioso y muy centrico para todo tipo de servicios,el personal profesional y muy amables.

The hotel is quiet and centrally located for all types of services. The staff is professional and very friendly.

review_text:
Hotel muy limpio, buena atencion.. habitaciones acogedoras.
Si pasas por Briviesca y quieres pasar la noche te lo recomiendo.
review_translated_text:
Very clean hotel, good service... cozy rooms.
If you pass through Briviesca and want to spend the night, I recommend it.

name: Angeles de la Gala Bueno
review_text: Me sorprendio mucho su cocina. Muy bien elaborada y muy bien presentada. Buena calidad a buen precio. El servicio muy amable. Para recomendar
review_translated_text: I was very surprised by their cuisine. It was very well prepared and beautifully presented. Good quality at a good price. The service was very friendly. Highly recommended.

name: Maria Pilar Cortes
review_text:
Muy atentos Beatriz y Armando, ademas encantados de haber visitado el Santuario de Sta Casilda gracias a su consejo.
Hotel luminoso, limpio y cuidado en los detalles, excelente cafe con leche!
review_translated_text:
Beatriz and Armando were very attentive. We were also delighted to have visited the Sanctuary of St. Casilda thanks to their advice.
The hotel was bright, clean, and attentive to detail. Excellent cafe con leche!

name: Alfred bou
review_text: Mui agradable una atencion muy familiar
review_translated_text: Very pleasant, very familiar attention

name: Jan Willem Burggraaff
review_text:
Super hotel!! Zeker gezien de prijs is dit hotel een aanrader! Midden in een gezellig stadje. Ontzettend aardige vrouw die ons hielp. Heel schoon, lekker bed!! Overal behaaglijk warm want wij waren er begin februari. Wij gaan hier zeker terug en dan wat langer want het stadje is zo gezellig met veel pleinen en veel te bekijken 
Er staan 2 sterren voor dit hotel maar verdient minstens 3 sterren!
review_translated_text:
Great hotel!! Especially considering the price, this hotel is highly recommended! In the middle of a pleasant town. Very nice woman who helped us. Very clean, nice bed!! Pleasantly warm everywhere because we were there at the beginning of February. We will definitely go back here and stay a little longer because the town is so cozy with many squares and lots to see 
There are 2 stars for this hotel but it deserves at least 3 stars!

name: Alicia Sanchez Soberon
review_text: Personal muy agradable, habitaciones muy limpias y la ubicacion inmejorable
review_translated_text: Very friendly staff, very clean rooms and unbeatable location

name: Daniel Armengol
review_text: PEQUENO HOTEL IDEAL PARA HACER UNA PARADA !! ARMANDO EL GERENTE OS DARA UN TRATO COMO EN CASA! MUY RECOMENDABLE.
review_translated_text: SMALL HOTEL, IDEAL FOR A STOPOVER! ARMANDO, THE MANAGER, WILL TREAT YOU LIKE YOU'RE AT HOME! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

name: Jorge David Lahera Garcia
review_text:
Hotel pequenito, muy limpio, con habitaciones corrientes pero limpias.
El trato fue inexistente puesto que no habia nadie en recepcion.
El sitio muy silencioso, muy tranquilo y muy bien ubicado, su que las vistas de la habitacion daban a un solar y eran un poco desoladoras.
Es un sitio al que podrian sacar mas partido si se lo montaran bien.
El pueblo no acompana puesto que no hay casi nadie...
review_translated_text:
Small hotel, very clean, with ordinary but clean rooms.
The treatment was non-existent since there was no one at the reception.
The place was very quiet, very calm and very well located, the views from the room overlooked a lot and were a bit desolate.
It is a place that they could get more out of if they set it up well.
The people do not accompany since there is almost no one...

name: lc brgrd
review_text: J'ai beaucoup, beaucoup aime. Tres propre, gerant tres aimable et petit dejeuner copieux, delicieux avec deux grands savoureux croissants frais du matin. Cafe, jus d'orange, lait... Le tout pour 47,40 EU. A recommander. Seul bemol, la connexion Internet. Le gerant paraissait surpris aussi, me disant qu'il avait contacte le fournisseur. Je ne suis reste qune seule nuit et je ne peux donc pas juger du Net.
review_translated_text: I liked it very, very much. Very clean, very friendly manager and plentiful, delicious breakfast with two large, tasty fresh croissants in the morning. Coffee, orange juice, milk... All for EU47.40. To recommend. The only downside is the Internet connection. The manager seemed surprised too, telling me that he had contacted the supplier. I only stayed one night so I can't judge the Internet.

name: Inigo Medrano
review_text: Hotel en el centro del pueblo con Parking privado.Muy bien en cuanto instalaciones.El desayuno esta bien.
review_translated_text: Hotel in the town center with private parking. Very good facilities. Breakfast was fine.

name: endeckung
review_text: Hotel en plein coeur de la petite ville avec parking prive, ferme a proximite. |A proximite de l'autoroute. |La jeune femme a la reception est absolument charmante et devouee pour sa clientele. |La chambre est propre et confortable. |Le petit dejeuner est parfait.
review_translated_text: Hotel in the heart of the small town with private, gated parking nearby. |Close to the highway. |The young woman at the reception desk is absolutely charming and dedicated to her customers. |The room is clean and comfortable. |The breakfast is perfect.

name: Victor De La Torre Cerdeno
review_text:
Ha sido una experiencia fantastica.
Nos alojamos un grupo de 17 personas por una reunion familiar.
El trato del personal ha sido excelente desde el primer momento.
Las habitaciones limpias y confortables.
Repetiremos sin dudarlo.
review_translated_text:
It has been a fantastic experience.
We stayed as a group of 17 people for a family reunion.
The treatment of the staff has been excellent from the first moment.
The rooms clean and comfortable.
We will repeat without hesitation.

name: Aranzazu
review_text: Es agradable, las habitaciones muy limpias. La ubicacion, mejor imposible.
review_translated_text: It's nice, the rooms are very clean. The location couldn't be better.

name: Clara
review_text:
Es un hotel sencillo, familiar, sin pretensiones.  Las habitaciones son muy sencillas, pero esta limpio y la relacion calidad-precio es buena.
Los propietarios son muy amables y simpaticos.
review_translated_text:
It is a simple, familiar, unpretentious hotel.  The rooms are very simple, but it is clean and the value for money is good.
The owners are very kind and friendly.

name: Albert Martin Ballesta
review_text: En ple centre de Briviesca. Atencio molt amable i empatica. Habitacions i banys amplis i molt nets. Llits individuals grans i comodes. Decorat amb gust. Detallistes. Es pot esmorzar a l'hotel, normal (no de bufet). Disposen d'aparcament pero n'hi ha de molt facil als carrers del voltant (si mes no en el mes d'octubre).
review_translated_text: In the heart of Briviesca. Very friendly and empathetic service. Spacious and very clean rooms and bathrooms. Large and comfortable single beds. Tastefully decorated. Attention to detail. You can have breakfast at the hotel, normal (not buffet). They have parking but there is very easy parking in the surrounding streets (at least in October).

name: Unionista
review_text:
No puedo mas que decir que fue todo un acierto. Ubicacion, habitacion, trato y gran desayuno.
Gracias Armando por tu simpatia y ese gran desayuno, me vino genial para darle a la bicicleta con ganas en mi viaje,
Por destacar una cosa, la limpieza de la habitacion. Estuve super como, nuevamente gracias. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text:
I can only say that it was a success. Location, room, treatment and great breakfast.
Thank you Armando for your sympathy and that great breakfast, it was great for me to hit the bike hard on my trip,
To highlight one thing, the cleanliness of the room. It was great, thank you again. Highly recommended.

name: Teyo
review_text: Hotel perfecto para pasar unos dias tranquilos. Buen trato y muy limpio.
review_translated_text: Perfect hotel for a relaxing few days. Friendly service and very clean.

name: Pedro Garcia De La Cal
review_text: Mi hotel de referencia en La Bureba....
review_translated_text: My reference hotel in La Bureba....

name: Antje Pank
review_text: Mitten in der Stadt. Alles problemlos( zb.parken). Sauber. Top. Rezeption und rundum Service und Empfehlungen sehr sehr gut . Ein ganz fantastisches Hotel mit perfektem Service in allen Bereichen bei allen Fragen. Wir bedanken uns .
review_translated_text: Right in the heart of the city. Everything was problem-free (e.g., parking). Clean. Excellent. Reception and all-around service and recommendations were very, very good. A truly fantastic hotel with perfect service in all areas, answering all questions. Thank you.

name: Roberto Hermosilla
review_text: Muy buena relacion calidad-precio, trato amable y familiar
review_translated_text: Very good value for money, friendly and familiar treatment

name: jesus bernal sanchez
review_text: Armando te as portado como un campeon,trato magnifico y para otra vez ya sabemos k nos lavas la ropa de la bici,muchas gracias por todo
review_translated_text: Armando, you have behaved like a champion, magnificent treatment and for another time we already know that you wash our bike clothes, thank you very much for everything

name: Milagros Calleja
review_text: Hotel muy recomendable, tranquilo, bien situado, con un practico parking a 50 metros. Habitacion amplia, limpia y cama muy comoda. El personal muy amable, agradable y profesional.
review_translated_text: Highly recommended hotel, quiet, well located, with a practical parking 50 meters away. Large, clean room and very comfortable bed. The staff very friendly, pleasant and professional.

name: Carmen Alvarez
review_text: Muy bien muy limpio muy nuevo muy amable. No hay peros. :)
review_translated_text: Very good, very clean, very new, very friendly. There are no buts. :)

name: Pedro Garcia
review_text: Muy buen Hotel en Briviesca, con servicios muy superiores a los de su categoria. Habitaciones muy amplias. Las camas son comodisimas. La limpieza es insuperable. Muy buena cafeteria. Muy practico el parking cercano al hotel. La atencion por parte del personal es excelente, amables y atentos. Muy buen lugar para recorrer la zona de la Bureba burgalesa, asi como Las Merindades.
response_from_owner_text:
Muchas gracias Pedro
Hotel Isabel
review_translated_text: Very good Hotel in Briviesca, with services far superior to those of its category. Very spacious rooms. The beds are very comfortable. The cleanliness is second to none. Very good cafeteria. The parking near the hotel is very practical. The attention from the staff is excellent, friendly and attentive. Very good place to explore the Bureba area of   Burgos, as well as Las Merindades.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Thank you very much, Pedro
Hotel Isabel

name: Sara Fernandez Maroto
review_text: Hotel muy limpio y personal muy amable, Volveria sin dudarlo.
review_translated_text: Very clean hotel and very friendly staff, I would return without hesitation.

name: jpl201725
review_text: Hotel aise a trouver, dans la ville de Briviesca qui, d'ailleurs, merite une visite.|La literie est parfaite, l'hotel avec parking prive est tres calme bien qu'a quelques dizaines de metres du centre-ville, a proximite de restos,  et l'accueil est absolument top.|Excellent rapport qualite/prix.|Une excellent adresse pour une etape... j'y ai sejourne a deux reprises a une semaine d'intervalle...
review_translated_text: Easy to find hotel in the town of Briviesca, which is definitely worth a visit.|The bedding is perfect, the hotel with private parking is very quiet despite being a few dozen meters from the town center, close to restaurants, and the welcome is absolutely top.|Excellent value for money.|An excellent place for a stopover... I stayed there twice within a week of each other...

name: Reiner Leichtlein
review_text: Kleines, aber feines Hotel mitten in der Fussgangerzone. Fur unsere Reise genau der richtige Ort, um fur 3 Tage auszuspannen. Das Zimmer ist gross und sauber. Bad mit Dusche/Badewanne, Bidet, WC. Heizung und Klimaanlage funktionieren. Fruhstuck um hauseigenen Bistro war gut und ausreichend. Sehr freundlicher Empfang, alle Fragen wurden geklart. Parkplatz um die Ecke, wenn man ihn gefunden hat, ist sicher. Kurze Wege in alle Bars der kleinen Stadt. Meine Empfehlung mitten in Briviesca
review_translated_text: Small but nice hotel in the middle of the pedestrian zone. Just the right place for our trip to relax for 3 days. The room is large and clean. Bathroom with shower/bathtub, bidet, toilet. Heating and air conditioning work. Breakfast in the in-house bistro was good and sufficient. Very friendly welcome, all questions were answered. Parking around the corner, once you find it, is safe. Short distances to all the bars in the small town. My recommendation in the middle of Briviesca

name: NRRIK
review_text: Trato excelente, muy limpio y personal muy profesional y honrado
review_translated_text: Excellent treatment, very clean and very professional and honest staff

name: Daniel
review_text: Genial !!!! Profesionalidad, calidad y atencion cercana y familiar.
review_translated_text: Brilliant !!!! Professionalism, quality and close and familiar attention.

name: Ana Sastre
review_text: Personal muy amable, instalaciones perfectas, estancia agradable.
review_translated_text: Very friendly staff, perfect facilities, pleasant stay.

name: jose
review_text: De los mejores hoteles que he estado la atencion del dueno inmejorable mis dieces a todo
review_translated_text: One of the best hotels I've been to, the owner's attention was unbeatable, my ten for everything

name: Raul Martin
review_text: Totalmente recomendable!!!
review_translated_text: Totally recommended!!!

name: loiola adri
review_text: Muito bom e aconchegante concerteza um otimo lugar !!!
review_translated_text: Very good and cozy, definitely a great place!!!

name: Jesus Cornejo Paez
review_text: ARMANDO gracias a ty y tu equipo teneis un hotel muy funcional u versatil. Gracias por todo...eres un gran motero
review_translated_text: ARMANDO, thanks to you and your team, you have a very functional and versatile hotel. Thanks for everything...you are a great biker

name: RICARDO VIEIRA
review_text: Excelentes instalaciones y servicios, trato ameno y cordial.  COMO EN CASA
review_translated_text: Excellent facilities and services, friendly and cordial service. JUST LIKE HOME

name: Maria Pilar Fernandez
review_text: El hotel esta limpio, bien situado y la atencion de 10 sobre tofo por Beatriz,  la recepcionista del hotel.
review_translated_text: The hotel is clean, well located, and the service was top-notch from Beatriz, the hotel receptionist.

name: Ilka Jahn
review_text:
Super freundlich, familiengefuhrtes Hotel. Mitten im Ort mit der Moglichkeit das Auto sicher zu parken. Dennoch leise! Tolle Tapasbar nur wenige Meter vom Hotel entfernt (siehe mein Foto).
Gerne hatten wir aber ein ausgiebigeres Fruhstuck gehabt. Spanien halt.
review_translated_text:
Super friendly, family-run hotel. In the middle of town with the option to park the car safely. Still quiet! Great tapas bar just a few meters from the hotel (see my photo).
But we would have liked to have had a more extensive breakfast. Spain.

name: Marco Agosta
review_text: Una perla in mezzo al niente. Tutto perfetto. Prima colazione non continentale ma del tipo cappuccio e brioche. Personale risicato ma perfettamente all'altezza. Consiglio vivamente.
review_translated_text: A pearl in the middle of nowhere. Everything perfect. Breakfast not continental but cappuccino and brioche type. Staff limited but perfectly up to the task. I highly recommend.

name: federico monroy
review_text: Muy centrico y muy buena atencion.
review_translated_text: Very central and very good service.

name: Venlim
review_text: El hostal muy bien. Totalmente recomendable. La habitacion limpia, comoda y agradable Desayuno rico,con su zumito de naranja.||Ellos geniales. Pregunte por una habitacion de matrimonio y no tenian, les dije que no importaba,valia de dos camas. Pues ellos sacaron la mesilla y nos juntaron las dos camas para hacer una. Gracias chicos!!! Esos detalles son muy bonitos.||Lo malo?...No tener dias para quedarnos un poquito mas. ||Si andais por la zona y quereis dormir: En Briviesca. Hostal Isabel. Sin dudarlo!!!!
review_translated_text: The hostel was great. Highly recommended. The room was clean, comfortable, and pleasant. The breakfast was delicious, with orange juice. They were great. I asked about a double room, but they didn't have one. I told them it didn't matter; two beds were fine. So, they brought out the nightstand and pushed the two beds together to make one. Thanks, guys! Those are really nice touches. The downside? Not having a few days to stay a little longer. If you're in the area and want to sleep: In Briviesca, Hostal Isabel. Without a doubt!

name: Sissi
review_text: Petit hotel familial que nous utilisons systematiquement comme etape en route pour le Sud de l'Espagne. Nous sommes toujours surs d'y trouver des chambres scrupuleusement propres et tres confortables pour un prix tout a fait modique. Une adresse que nous gardons bien jalousement.
review_translated_text: A small, family-run hotel that we always use as a stopover en route to southern Spain. We're always sure to find scrupulously clean and very comfortable rooms at a very reasonable price. A place we'll cherish with pride.

name: Carmen Cembranos
review_text: Hotel muy recomendable, por su situacion (incluye parking), limpieza y el trato de sus gerentes q es excelente. Teniendo en cuenta que es un hotel de dos estrellas perfecto.
review_translated_text: A highly recommended hotel for its location (including parking), cleanliness, and the excellent service of its managers. Considering it's a two-star hotel, it's perfect.

name: Natividad Araujo Sanchez
review_text: En fantastico.  Las habitaciones tienen un tamano mas que aceptable  modernas y el bano esta bastante bien.  La gerente nos ha facilitado todo muchisimo,  a pesar de que estrene de vacaciones.  El sitio inmejorable.  Super centrico y silencioso.  Volvemos seguro
review_translated_text: In fantastic.  The rooms are a more than acceptable modern size and the bathroom is quite good.  The manager has made everything very easy for us, even though it's just a holiday break.  The unbeatable place.  Super central and quiet.  We will return for sure

name: na774
review_text: Een zeer nette schone hotel!||Goede service, de eigenaren zijn zeer behulpzaam!||Kamers zijn stofvrij en heel schoon en netjes.||Zeker voor herhaling vatbaar!||Ligging precies in het midden van het dorp.||Gast jamel uit Nederland.
review_translated_text: A very neat and clean hotel!||Good service, the owners are very helpful!||Rooms are dust-free and very clean and tidy.||Definitely worth repeating!||Location right in the middle of the village.||Guest Jamel from the Netherlands.

name: ana maria ortega
review_text: Un hotel acogedor. Te solucionan cualquier problema. La sra de recepcion es muy atenta y servicial. Nosotros solemos hacer una noche de camino a Galicia desde hace unos pocos anos.
review_translated_text: A cozy hotel. They solve any problem for you. The lady at the reception is very attentive and helpful. We have usually spent the night on the way to Galicia for a few years.

name: Patricia Puente Marquez
review_text: Estuvimos este verano en Agosto en las fiestas. Es un hotel familiar, muy centrico y sencillo. Muy limpio. Las habitaciones muy agradables. Pero sobre todo destaco el trato de Armando y Bea que son los gerentes y estan pendientes de que no te falte nada, y ademas te hacen sentir como si estuvieras en casa. Gracias por todo repetiremos.
review_translated_text: We were there this summer in August at the parties. It is a family hotel, very central and simple. Very clean. Very nice rooms. But above all, the treatment of Armando and Bea stood out, they are the managers and they make sure that you don't miss anything, and they also make you feel as if you were at home. Thank you for everything we will repeat.

name: edernedc
review_text: El hotel ya no es lo que era. Por lo menos en el trato. Para empezar el bar lo tienen cerrado hace meses. Solo dan desayunos a los huespedes. ||Los recepcionistas son bastante bordes y desagradables: ej" tengo que marcar el pin? Respuesta: "hombre! Pues si te lo pide"||No se puede dormir en los dias de fiesta. No aconsejo alojarse en este hotel si no vas a salir pues la verbena termina a las 4:30 AM. ||Reserve dos noches  pero tras no dormir la primera dije en recepcion que nos ibamos. Respuesta: un ya lo siento? No. Pues me haces una putada me contesta . ||La dije que aceptaba una penalizacion. Al final no me cobro el segundo dia supongo que xk sabe de sobra k ocupa la hab seguro pero no x ser afable o cordial .||Ha cambiado de manos y no tienen sutileza ni educacion
review_translated_text: The hotel is no longer what it used to be. At least in the way we treat people. For starters, the bar has been closed for months. They only serve breakfast to guests. ||The receptionists are quite rude and unpleasant: e.g., "Do I have to enter my PIN?" Answer: "Well! Well, if he asks you." ||You can't sleep on holidays. I don't recommend staying at this hotel if you're not going out because the festival ends at 4:30 AM. ||I booked two nights, but after not sleeping the first night, I told reception we were leaving. Response: "Sorry?" No. "Well, you're messing with me," she replies. ||I told her I'd accept a penalty. In the end, she didn't charge me for the second day, I suppose because she knows full well I'm definitely occupying the room, but not because she's being affable or cordial. ||It's changed hands and they have no subtlety or education.

name: Nagore Gonzalez
review_text: Hotel familiar, bien cuidado y limpio. La atencion del personal es inmejorable, son super amables.  Esta ubicado en pleno centro de Briviesca. Dan desayunos en lo que era antes una cafeteria abierta a publico (ya no). Un lugar muy agradable.
review_translated_text: Family hotel, well maintained and clean. The staff's attention is unbeatable, they are super friendly.  It is located in the heart of Briviesca. They serve breakfast in what was previously a cafeteria open to the public (not anymore). A very nice place.

name: Christian Kuhnke
review_text: Zimmer war wie beschrieben, alles sauber mit einem Bad in vernunftiger Grosse. Das Hotel liegt sehr Zentral und viele Restaurants Cafes und Bars sind zu Fuss problemlos zu erreichen. Das Personal war sehr nett und hoflich. Wir hatten auch einen Parkplatz direkt am Hotel der fur kleines Geld zu mieten ist. Einzig negativer Punkt ist der Duschkopf, dieser war komplett defekt, so das ich ihn abschrauben und mich mit den Schlauch abduschen. Der Defekt war auch nicht neu und ein Duschkopf kostet auch nicht die Welt. Der Ausblick des Zimmers auf den Hinterhof ist auch eher abschreckend aber den bewerte ich ausdrucklich nicht. Ich hatte das Zimmer zum schlafen fur die Durchreise gebucht und war wie beschrieben bis auf den Duschkopf rundum zufrieden
review_translated_text: Room was as described, everything was clean with a reasonable size bathroom. The hotel is very centrally located and many restaurants, cafes and bars can be easily reached on foot. The staff was very nice and polite. We also had a parking space directly at the hotel that can be rented for little money. The only negative point is the shower head, which was completely defective, so I had to unscrew it and shower myself with the hose. The defect wasn't new either and a shower head doesn't cost the earth either. The room's view of the backyard is also rather off-putting, but I definitely don't rate it. I had booked the room to sleep in while in transit and was completely satisfied, as described, except for the shower head

name: Lazaro Mendez
review_text: Hotel familiar,  trato exquisito. Ubicacion perfecta. Habitaciones muy confortables, especialmente las que miran al jardin de los gatos., por  su tranquilidad. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Family hotel, exquisite service. Perfect location. Very comfortable rooms, especially those overlooking the cat garden, for their tranquility. Highly recommended.

name: Hope Joy
review_text: Hotel muy comodo, la atencion muy buena, los duenos son muy amables y se preocupan de que estes agusto
review_translated_text: Very comfortable hotel, very good service, the owners are very friendly and make sure you are comfortable

name: Vicky Barcos
review_text:
Hotel en el centro de Briviesca. Habitacion funcional  con ventana a un patio renovado, asi que el descanso ha sido tranquilo y silencioso. Desayuno sencillo, con la excelente atencion de Beatriz. Parking privado cercano al hotel que merece mucho la pena porque el centro es todo peatonal.
La llegada y la salida  son un poco complejas porque los accesos de Google cuentan con que se puede pasar por zonas peatonales que tienen postes que impiden el paso.
review_translated_text:
Hotel in the center of Briviesca. Functional room with a window to a renovated patio, so the rest has been calm and quiet. Simple breakfast, with excellent attention from Beatriz. Private parking near the hotel that is very worth it because the center is all pedestrian.
Arrival and departure are a bit complex because Google accesses allow you to pass through pedestrian areas that have posts that prevent passage.

name: Juncal E.B.
review_text: Ha estado un amigo y menos mal q yo no he podido ir. La habitacion apestaba a ambientador  , soy afectada de sensibilidad quimica multiple y si hubiera pedido una habitacion con cierto protocolo( como lo he hecho en otros) no hubiera podido ser porque todas eran iguales, segun los comentarios. Porque lo limpio tiene que oler???tomen medidas por favor.
review_translated_text: A friend was there and thank goodness I couldn't go. The room reeked of air freshener, I am affected by multiple chemical sensitivity and if I had requested a room with a certain protocol (as I have done in others) it would not have been possible because they were all the same, according to the comments. Why does clean have to smell??? please take action.

name: Joaquin De Antonio Ventura
review_text: Todo muy bien, ninguna pega,todo perfecto.Si tuviera que volver no lo dudaria.
review_translated_text: Everything was great, no complaints, everything was perfect. If I had to come back, I wouldn't hesitate.

name: Sylvie Delaine
review_text: Tres bien
review_translated_text: Alright

name: Marta Rives Salinas
review_text:
Excelente servicio, personal inmejorable y limpieza absoluta en general. Desayuno riquisimo.Gracias por la hospitalidad chic@s.
Volveremos
review_translated_text:
Excellent service, unbeatable staff and absolute cleanliness in general. Delicious breakfast. Thank you guys for the hospitality.
We will return

name: emilio
review_text: Hotel muy agradable, muy bien ubicado y con parquin privado y vigilado con camaras, el personal muy amable y el trato inmejorable, sin duda recomendado, la habitacion muy acogedora y limpia.
review_translated_text: Very nice hotel, very well located and with private parking and monitored with cameras, very friendly staff and unbeatable treatment, definitely recommended, the room very cozy and clean.

name: Iciar Rodriguez
review_text: Es superlimpio y agradable pienso volver
review_translated_text: It is super clean and pleasant I plan to return

name: Kiko Garcia

Las habitaciones amplias, igual que el bano y sobretodo destaca por su extrema limpieza. Por la noche se descansa muy bien por la tranquilidad de la zona y por la comodidad de las camas. El parking esta justo en la calle de al lado y es bastante seguro.
Una pena que no pudimos probar el desayuno porque aun no estaba la cafeteria abierta, pero sin duda es una opcion a tener en cuenta por la zona.
review_translated_text:
Upon entering you find a modern hotel, small but cozy and in a central area. The receptionist and staff in general were very friendly. The rooms are spacious, as is the bathroom, and above all it stands out for its extreme cleanliness. At night you rest very well due to the tranquility of the area and the comfort of the beds. The parking lot is right on the next street and is quite secure.
It's a shame that we couldn't try breakfast because the cafeteria wasn't open yet, but it's certainly an option to consider in the area.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: Serchoice
review_text: Lugar tranquilo donde poder alojarte, cercano a varias zonas interesantes de la provincia de Burgos. La duena fue amable con nosotros, ya que tuvimos un problema con la reserva (muy mal por booking, porque hicimos la reserva con dos adultos y dos ninos y, por olvidar poner las edades de los ninos, nos encontramos con un precio distinto. Y gracias a que la duena pudo apanar que pudieramos dormir los 4, pero seria de agradecer que booking, en su resumen al hacer la reserva y DESPUES, indique las condiciones que has reservado, y no solo ponga dos adultos y dos ninos). Como decia, gracias a la duena pudimos, finalmente, alojarnos (aunque el sofa cama era horriblemente duro). Bueno, de mas hizo ella.|El desayuno carecia de algunas cosas, como zumo natural o jamon serrano (cosas que, en hoteles de 4 estrellas, siempre he encontrado), pero no esta mal.|Por lo demas, todo correcto. Quiza hacia demasiado calor dentro de la casa, en comparacion a afuera, aunque nos dejaron un ventilador en la habitacion...|El pueblo no tiene mucho, pero es muy tranquilo para descansar. Existe un mirador muy chulo, y el bar es tranquilito, barato, y un remanso de paz.
review_translated_text: A quiet place to stay, close to several interesting areas in the province of Burgos. The owner was kind to us, as we had a problem with the reservation (very bad on Booking.com, because we made the reservation with two adults and two children, and forgot to specify the children's ages, and we ended up with a different price). Thanks to the owner, she was able to arrange for all four of us to sleep, but it would be appreciated if Booking.com, in their summary when making the reservation and AFTERWARDS, indicated the conditions of your reservation, and not just listed two adults and two children). As I said, thanks to the owner, we were finally able to stay (although the sofa bed was horribly hard). Well, she did more than enough. Breakfast lacked some things, like natural juice or Serrano ham (things I've always found in 4-star hotels), but it wasn't bad. Otherwise, everything was fine. Perhaps it was too hot inside the house compared to outside, although they left us a fan in the room... The town doesn't have much, but it's a very quiet place to rest. There's a really cool viewpoint, and the bar is quiet, cheap, and a haven of peace.

review_text: Es triste pero debo hablar sobre todos los aspectos, para que nadie mas pase por unas noches decepcionantes, donde nos hospedamos 4 noches. ||Es un hotel para pasar una unica noche, si no tienes otro lugar donde pasar la noche. ||Os comento aspectos negativos: |- El hombre que ayuda a la duena del palacete, no tiene ni un apice de generosidad ni amabilidad, llegando a ser un poco indecente e impertinente. |- Tras volver de visitar de ver Haro a las 23:30h, nos controla la llegada y encima me dice que horas son esas de llegar a dormir, cuando no debe ni controlarnos ni opinar, puesto que es un hotel y no un hospedaje de la casa de Pepito. Despreciable hacia el cliente. |Ademas de tener la sauna llena de trastos y rota, y lo que esta cercano al jacuzzi oxidado, debido al alto volumen de cloro que utilizan, que es incluso denunciable por las concentraciones tan elevadas. ||- El desayuno es pobre, pero lo justo para desayunar aunque si que, nada es casero, todo es industrial, incluso el zumo que son polvos Tang y los huevos revueltos agua con polvos. ||- Las temperaturas mas elevadas  suelen subir y estan en lo alto, pues no tienen aire acondicionado porque por la noche refresca, pero esta lleno de mosquitos y en ola de calor no refrescan las noches, por lo que deberia tener pinguinos por si los necesitara. ||Lo unico bueno que puedo decir, es que el entorno es tranquilo y para aparcar es facil. ||Consejos a la duena:||- Don de gentes al maximo por mejorar.|- Reparar y limpiar todo exhaustivamente. |Y la ultima pero mas importante, las personas viajamos para dormir mejor que en nuestras casa y por eso pagamos precios, en esa pension, que no se puede llamar hotel, se deberia de bajar el precio, porque no los vale, y encima empieza por cambiar los colchones, que aunque la habitacion no este arreglada o limpia, si tu duermes bien en la cama, a todo lo demas no le das tanta importancia. ||Por favor, espero que mejoreis, porque no volveremos jamas.
review_translated_text: It's sad, but I must talk about all the aspects, so that no one else has to go through a disappointing time, where we stayed for four nights. ||It's a hotel for a single night, if you don't have anywhere else to spend the night. ||I'll tell you about the negative aspects: |- The man who helps the owner of the mansion lacks an ounce of generosity or kindness, becoming somewhat indecent and impertinent. |- After returning from visiting Haro at 11:30 p.m., he checks our arrival and then tells me what time it is to go to sleep, when he shouldn't be checking on us or giving his opinion, since it's a hotel and not a guesthouse at Pepito's house. But it's more like an Airbnb than a hotel, because you walk through his living room, and everything is dark. ||- It's recommended to change the mattresses every 10 years, and these were literally over 25 years old, so you can't spend a night sleeping because the springs are stuck in you and you wake up feeling sunken. They only make the bed. ||- The house is poorly maintained, with light fixtures hanging off the wall, broken bed frames, swollen floors, bent baseboards, and a musty stench that will make you die. In the attic room, which is the highest, imagine the lowest room. ||- They turn the jacuzzi on a little while beforehand so it can warm up and save electricity, but it doesn't have the power to heat that and they don't understand that it uses less by keeping the water hot like a heater. And on top of that, they cover the buttons, to raise the temperature if you want, with white hard plastic held together with masking tape. Disdainful towards the customer. |In addition to having the sauna full of junk and broken, and what's near the jacuzzi is rusty, due to the high volume of chlorine they use, which is even reprehensible due to the high concentrations. ||- The breakfast is poor, but just enough for breakfast, although yes, nothing is homemade, everything is industrial, even the juice, which is Tang powder, and the scrambled eggs, water with powder. ||- The highest temperatures tend to rise and are high, since they don't have air conditioning because it gets cool at night, but it's full of mosquitoes and in heat waves they don't cool down the nights, so they should have penguins in case they need them. ||The only good thing I can say is that the surroundings are quiet and parking is easy. ||Advice to the owner:||- Their people skills need to be improved.|- Everything needs to be repaired and cleaned thoroughly. |And last but not least, we travel to sleep better than at home, and that's why we pay the prices. review_text: We stayed at El Palacete del Obispo 2 weeks ago and simply loved the place. name: Ruben Caballero
review_text: El edificio es del S. XVII restaurado y decorado con mucho gusto. Todo muy acogedor y agradable. Los duenos, que atienden el hotel son muy amables y agradables y siempre estan dispuestos a ayudarte en cuanto a visitas por alrededores u otra contingencia que este en su mano. Todo muy limpio y cuidado. El desayuno, incluido en el precio, es adecuado y hay un cafe-bar con terraza en la parte de arriba de lo mas agradable, sobre todo por la noche, muy bien decorado como todo el edificio. El parking es bastante justo pero se puede aparcar en las calles de los alrededores sin ningun problema. Tiene 2 puntos de carga para coches electricos. Se cena bastante bien a un precio razonable. El pueblo es de lo mas tranquilo y acogedor y sin embargo esta a 11 Kms. de Briviesca, una poblacion grande, y la autopista Burgos-Vitoria. Nos fuimos muy satisfechos de la experiencia. Puntos a mejorar, tener champu para el pelo, ya que solo hay gel de ducha, almohadas mas consistentes (hay una suplementaria) y el colchon es un poquito duro pero por otro lado la cama de matrimonio era muy amplia. Nos parecio que tenia una relacion calidad-precio bastante buena. Si volvemos por la zona probablemente repitamos.
response_from_owner_text: muchas gracias
review_translated_text: The building is from the 17th century, restored and decorated with great taste. All very cozy and pleasant. The owners, who run the hotel, are very friendly and pleasant and are always willing to help you with visits to the surrounding area or any other contingency that is in their power. Everything very clean and cared for. The breakfast, included in the price, is adequate and there is a cafe-bar with a terrace at the top that is very pleasant, especially at night, very well decorated like the entire building. Parking is quite tight but you can park on the surrounding streets without any problem. It has 2 charging points for electric cars. You have a pretty good dinner at a reasonable price. The town is very quiet and cozy and yet it is 11 km from Briviesca, a large town, and the Burgos-Vitoria highway. We left very satisfied with the experience. Points to improve, having hair shampoo, since there is only shower gel, more consistent pillows (there is an additional one) and the mattress is a little hard but on the other hand the double bed was very spacious. We thought it was pretty good value for money. If we return to the area we will probably repeat.

review_text:
Pasamos una noche en este hotel de vuelta de las vacaciones. Reservamos la suite porque ibamos con nuestros hijos y asi poder estar mas comodos. La habitacion no esta mal pero Ia vi muy basica. Eche en falta una pequena nevera. El colchon de muelles no muy comodo. Las almohadas poco mullidas. El sofa cama con un colchon muy fino, no muy confortable. De amenities en el bano, solo botecitos de gel. No champu. Un gorro de ducha un un jaboncito pequeno. La alcachofa de la ducha no se podia regular en altura. Por la noche cenamos en el patio, muy agradable, con lamparas de velas. La carta a priori apetitosa y a precio razonable pero las raciones algo escasas y sin una presentacion trabajada, muy simple. La oreja y la morcilla estaban muy ricas. Precio algo elevado para lo ofrecido. El desayuno: un buffet justito. Eso si, nos prepararon al momento unos huevos revueltos. Pero echamos en falta bacon y algun fiambre de mas calidad. El pan bueno. Poca fruta. El bizcocho algo seco.
En definitiva, el edificio es bonito y la decoracion de las zonas comunes es elegante pero en conjunto me parece caro para lo que se ofrece (170EU una noche, desayuno incluido)
response_from_owner_text: 170EU cuatro personas  es caro  y en lo referente a la habitacion  cuando ustedes la reservaron pone toda la descripcion  de la misma  no enganamos a nadie  saludos
review_translated_text:
We spent one night at this hotel on our way back from vacation. We booked the suite because we were going with our children so we could be more comfortable. The room is not bad but I found it very basic. I missed a small refrigerator. The spring mattress not very comfortable. The pillows are not very fluffy. The sofa bed with a very thin mattress, not very comfortable. Of amenities in the bathroom, only small bottles of gel. Not shampoo. A shower cap and a small soap. The shower head could not be adjusted in height. At night we had dinner on the patio, very pleasant, with candle lamps. The menu a priori appetizing and at a reasonable price but the portions are somewhat scarce and without a well thought out presentation, very simple. The ear and the blood sausage were very delicious. Price somewhat high for what is offered. Breakfast: a fair buffet. Of course, they prepared scrambled eggs for us on the spot. But we miss bacon and some higher quality cold cuts. The good bread. Little fruit. The cake is somewhat dry.
In short, the building is beautiful and the decoration of the common areas is elegant but overall it seems expensive for what is offered (EU170 a night, breakfast included)
response_from_owner_translated_text: 170EU for four people is expensive and when you booked the room, it includes the full description of it. We are not deceiving anyone. Regards.

review_translated_text:
You could say it's located in a ghost town, because there's no life at all, not even a bar open for dinner. We first arrived at the cottage and the lights were off. When we rang the bell, the owner greeted us with the TV on, as if we were at her home. The quality and price of the dinner items are not worth it at all; low-quality products are priced at the price per plate. Breakfast was very poor for a buffet. The first day we were alone, and they served us less than the second day's breakfast, when a buffet is supposed to always have the same amount of food.
They made the jacuzzi completely freezing, so you couldn't even put a foot in it. The heating in the room where it was located was off... a real disaster. We were very respectful in not saying anything... but that's the reality.
It seems like you're invading her home more than anything else.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
It's not a ghost town at the time they arrived in winter. Any town is like this. Regarding the television, it was on.
But I don't see the problem. Regarding the jacuzzi, they arrived on Friday and I had it prepared at the right temperature, but they decided to go in on Saturday. On Saturday, I had it on again all day, at the expense that entails. They told me they would use it at 8:00 a.m. and at 7:30 a.m. they called me to tell me they would use it on Sunday morning. I told his partner, who was the person who called, very clearly that the jacuzzi is turned off at night, first because of the noise it makes and secondly because of the expense. Logically, it lowers a few degrees, so that it would probably be cold in the morning. He told me that nothing would happen after breakfast.
They went to the jacuzzi and his partner came down in his swimsuit to ask me if I couldn't make it hotter. I told him that I had already told him the night before.
Raising the temperature by one degree in more than 3,000 liters of water takes at least an hour.
The heating was on, but the water, instead of 35 degrees, which is what I had, was at 25. It wasn't my problem, but yours. Regarding breakfast, the quality-price ratio was superior. Both days I served the same things. The only thing was that instead of getting a whole thermos of coffee, I served it myself.
Let me recommend that next time you travel, find out where you're going. If you want a lot of people and bars, choose something bigger.
Best regards and thank you very much.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo

review_text: Hotel rural con escaso lugar para aparcar, la puerta de acceso preciosa, antigua pero dificil entrar y salir. Decoracion cuidada en zonas comunes pero no es acorde con la zona. Desayuno incluido de bajo nivel embutido y zumo industrial, fruta escasa la calidad no de mesa. Limpieza ok Sesion de banera hidromasaje! Con las mismas toallas de la noche anterior. |"El termostato esta donde tiene que estar ", la pareja que esta gestionando podra entender que el cliente repite si se le recibe con una sonrisa.
review_translated_text: A rural hotel with limited parking, a beautiful entrance, old but difficult to get in and out of. Decor is neat in common areas, but not in keeping with the area. The included breakfast is subpar, with processed cold cuts and juice, and scarce fruit, not table quality. Cleanliness is OK. The hot tub session is still the same as the previous night. "The thermostat is where it should be," the couple managing the hotel will understand that the guest is returning if they are greeted with a smile.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo

review_text:
Tranquilo y maravilloso Palacete regentado por Ana y Julio, que te sorprende.

Nos recomendaron la escursion a Frias y fue un exito.

La situacion esta muy bien en un pueblerino cuidado y entre varios puntos muy atractivos ( La Bureba, Haro, Briviesca, Pancorbo ). Un sitio ideal para una escapada

Comfortable and spacious rooms and cozy in all its spaces (dining room, living room, bar-terrace...). The situation is very good in a well-kept village and between several very attractive points (La Bureba, Haro, Briviesca, Pancorbo). An ideal place for a getaway

For dinner, we ordered two entrees, and everything was homemade, which is appreciated. The breakfast buffet was also a delight. We didn't use the jacuzzi/spa. Recommended.

Menu variado y una sesion de jacuzzi pone la guinda a una experiencia muy relajante, totalmente recomendable.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: Sandra Escandon
review_text:
El palacete en si  una monada, muy buen gusto en la decoracion de las zonas comunes y sencilla en las habitaciones. Se entiende q es un sitio para descansar, la tv q tenia nuestra habitacion  muy pequena, en general  no es problema, salvo q te falle la vista!
Los anfitriones muy correctos, Ana muy amable y servicial, ademas de cocinar muy bien!
Hemos estado muy a gusto, si os sirve se echa de menos algunos detalles que, a mi modo de ver estarian acordes a un sitio de esta categoria, como por ejemplo, poner verduras de la huerta, no de bolsa, bolleria y zumos naturales y no industrial.
Las personas q utilizamos estos servicios con frecuencia  lo agradecemos mucho.
Por otra parte debo decir q la comida estaba muy rica, unas croquetas caseras increibles!
Una terraza y cafeteria muy txula.
Para aparcar sin problemas.
El WiFi muy bien.
Gracias por la atencion !
El pueblo super tranquilo
review_translated_text:
The palace itself is cute, very good taste in the decoration of the common areas and simple in the rooms. It is understood that it is a place to rest, the TV that our room had was very small, in general it is not a problem, unless your eyesight fails you!
Very correct hosts, Ana very friendly and helpful, in addition to cooking very well!
We have been very comfortable, if it helps you, we miss some details that, in my opinion, would be in line with a place of this category, such as, for example, putting vegetables from the garden, not from the bag, pastries and natural juices and not industrial ones.
Those of us who use these services frequently appreciate it very much.
On the other hand, I must say that the food was very delicious, some incredible homemade croquettes!
A very txula terrace and cafeteria.
To park without problems.
The WiFi very good.
Thanks for your attention!
The super quiet town

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo

review_text: Hotel rural confortable. Buena ubicacion cercana a la Rioja. Ana nos cuido durante toda nuestra estancia como si estuvieramos en su casa. Si bien es cierto que la calidad de la habitacion esperabamos algo mas, quedo compensado con el trato atento y amable de quienes lo regentan. Muy buenos desayunos y cenas. Recomendable para parejas.

Although it is true that we expected something more from the quality of the room, it was compensated by the attentive and friendly treatment of those who run it. Very good breakfasts and dinners. Recommended for couples.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo

review_text: El trato fue muy seco y en ciertas ocasiones desagradable por parte del senor. En cambio Ana, intentaba ser mas agradable. La limpieza en general un poco escasa en la zonas comunes. El jacuzzi bien, pero mucho cloro. El menu para lo que es, esta bien, pero le falta variedad. En general la sensacion es de que estas invadiendo su casa, no te sientes acogido como en cualquier otro hotel.

Hola solo comentarte que en tu caso. no tenias menu y que  disponias
de una carta  de tres hojas un folio entero con platos combinados , tostar y Sandwich  y si decirte que  quites los pies de la mesa es ser borde entonces si es borde  un saludo

The jacuzzi is good, but a lot of chlorine. The menu is good for what it is, but it lacks variety. In general the feeling is that you are invading their home, you do not feel welcome like in any other hotel.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Hi, I just wanted to let you know that in your case, you didn't have a menu, but you had a three-page menu, a whole page with mixed dishes, toast, and a sandwich. If telling you to take your feet off the table is rude, then it is rude. Best regards.
