place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: Sgb gestion, s.l. gestion
review_text: Llegamos el dia 08/10, se complico un poco por la carretera ,en el camino avisamos llegariamos un poco tarde, FENOMENAL la primera impresion del Propietario (Julio) a la llegada, y como no la maravillosa ANA nos dio de cenar cerca de las diez de la noche, ah y que  cena, buenissssima, digo todas las comidas un 10, prepararon con mucha delicadeza a una de nosotros comida especial, en fin, como en casa, ah y tertulias en el bar por la noche con el Sr. Julio, se hacen querer los duenos, te hacen sentir con trato familiar, nosotros lo recomendamos y por supuesto volveremos.
review_translated_text: We arrived on 08/10, it got a bit complicated on the road, on the way we warned that we would be a bit late, PHENOMENAL the first impression of the Owner (Julio) upon arrival, and of course the wonderful ANA gave us dinner around ten at night, oh and what a dinner, delicious, I say all the meals were a 10, they prepared a special meal for one of us with great care, in short, like at home, oh and chats at the bar at night with Mr. Julio, the owners make themselves loved, they make you feel like you are being treated by family, we recommend it and of course we will return.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: mel milan
review_text: Un pueblo muy tranquilo. Nos ha encantado el palacete esta decorado muy chulo y tiene bar con terracita. Todo te llama la atencion. Los anfitriones son encantadores y super atentos aunque el desayuno es muy completo me faltaba jamon serrano pero Ana me trajo y al dia siguiente se acordo tambien .Nos hemos sentido como en casa. Muy contentos y muchas gracias a los anfitriones por tratarnos tan bien. Volveremos pronto.
review_translated_text: A very quiet town. We loved the palace, it is very coolly decorated and has a bar with a terrace. Everything catches your attention. The hosts are charming and super attentive although the breakfast is very complete, I was missing Serrano ham but Ana brought me and the next day she remembered too. We felt at home. Very happy and many thanks to the hosts for treating us so well. We will be back soon.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: ana ortiz
review_text: Sabado 9 de octubre llego al hotel dos habitaciones reservadas y para nuestra sorpresa tenian todas las habitaciones ocupadas. Mas de una hora esperando para no darnos ninguna solucion y nos encontramos en pleno puente sin alojamiento y a dos horas de nuestra casa... un error lo tiene cualquiera pero la actitud fue lo peor. Ella solo salio de su escondite una vez, apenas un minuto, el entraba y salia diciendo buscar buscar...Me siento orgullosa de la educacion y el respeto con el que tratamos este asunto no por ello menos molesta. Lo que mas me dolio es no recibir por su parte ni una llamada interesandose por nosotras, si habiamos conseguido alojamiento o habiamos tenido que volver a nuestra casa. Realmente yo me pensaria mucho reservar en este alojamiento, ir a disfrutar y encontrarte sin donde dormir y lo que es peor sin facilitar ninguna opcion no es buena manera de gestionar un negocio. Una pena la actitud y el poco remordimiento de sus duenos.
review_translated_text: Saturday, October 9, two reserved rooms arrived at the hotel and to our surprise they had all the rooms occupied. Waiting for more than an hour without giving us any solution and we found ourselves on the bridge without accommodation and two hours from our house... anyone can make a mistake but the attitude was the worst. She only came out of her hiding place once, just for a minute, he came in and out saying search, search... I feel proud of the politeness and respect with which we treated this matter, which does not make it any less annoying. What hurt me the most is not receiving a single call from him inquiring about us, whether we had found accommodation or had had to return to our house. I would really think about booking this accommodation, going to enjoy it and finding yourself without a place to sleep and what's worse, without providing any options, it is not a good way to run a business. A shame about the attitude and lack of remorse of its owners.

place_name: Hotel Rural El Palacete del Obispo
name: Amaia Merchan Martin
review_text: No puedo catalogarlo dado que  un tras hacer una reserva el 20 de septiembre, al llegar el dia 9 de octubre , nos indican que ha habido un error y que no tienen habitaciones libres. Nos DEJAN EN LA CALLE, sin lugar para dormir porque aunque parece que se molestan en buscarnos algo en las cercanias siendo puente esta   todo ocupado en las inmediaciones. En conclusion, sin sitio para dormir nos ofrecen comer, cenar.... pero a dormir esa noche...BUSCATE LA VIDA. Hay errores que no se pueden cometer, no estabamos a 10 minutos para volvernos a casa.
review_translated_text: I cannot classify it since after making a reservation on September 20, upon arriving on October 9, they told us that there had been an error and that they had no free rooms. THEY LEAVE US ON THE STREET, without a place to sleep because although it seems that they bother to look for something for us nearby, being a bridge, everything is busy nearby. In conclusion, without a place to sleep, they offer us lunch and dinner.... but to sleep that night...LOOK FOR LIFE. There are mistakes that cannot be made, we were not 10 minutes away from returning home.

review_text: Nos hemos alojado la pasada noche del sabado. Nuestra calificacion es baja por varios motivos: es un lugar poco confortable por la falta de luz y la calefaccion algo baja. En la habitacion teniamos una tv con un tamano ridiculo que no apetecia mirar.|Decidimos tomar la cena por la falta de oferta de la localidad y me resulto incomprensiblemente malo el vino que me sirvieron, una copa de negro crianza a 2,30 euros la copa, reclame por malo que era y me la cambiaron por otra que era muy similar. Estando en una zona de vinos, Rioja y Ribera de Dueto, me parece una falta total de criterio servir un vino de esa categoria, al menos que el objetivo sea rentabilizar al maximo el coste de la botella. Sin duda esto hace que no piense en volver si estoy de turismo por la zona, ni que tampoco lo recomiende a nadie.
review_translated_text: We stayed last Saturday night. Our rating is low for several reasons: it's an uncomfortable place due to the lack of light and the heating being somewhat low. In the room, we had a ridiculously small TV that wasn't worth watching. We decided to have dinner due to the lack of local options, and I found the wine they served me to be incomprehensibly bad: a glass of Crianza red wine at EU2.30 a glass. I complained about how bad it was, and they replaced it with a very similar one. Being in a wine-producing region, Rioja and Ribera del Dueto, it seems to me a complete lack of judgment to serve a wine of that caliber, unless the goal is to maximize the cost of the bottle. This certainly means I won't consider returning if I'm sightseeing in the area, nor will I recommend it to anyone.

name: Manuel Caraballo Callero
review_text:
Llegue a Belorado desde Najera en bici el 26 de Abril de 2025, despues de recorrer 44 kilometros, despues de atravesar campos enormes de vides, embarrarse la bici, de la que estuve a punto de caer en un par de ocasiones por el barro del camino. Frio y lluvia fria fina. Pase por Santo Domingo de la Calzada donde pare a tomar un ColaCao caliente.

Al llegar a Belorado, deje las cosas en el Hostel y fui a una gasolinera a limpiarla con agua a presion (luego secado y lubricante en las partes mecanicas). La verdad es que la bici que me facilito Santiago Ways a traves de LeonBike estaba completamente dotada de utiles de emergencia o averia, como aceite para la cadena).
La poblacion tiene un casco interesante y el encargado me facilito toda la informacion que necesitaba.
Se celebrada ese dia una actividad relativa a las II Guerra Mundial, con canonazos y todo.
La iglesia de la plaza es de estilo neoclasico y participe en una misa reconfortante para alguien que ha sufrido bastante en El Camino.

Desayuno completo y energetico para la siguiente jornada con destino a Burgos.

Gracias al encargado (del que no recuerdo su nombre), que por cierto cocina muy bien :-)

Pondre este mismo comentario en el resto de establecimientos: "En mi modesta opinion, el Camino De Santiago hay que hacerlo en solitario, al menos la primera vez.
Para los que busquen vistas, les recomiendo ir en coche, que asi evitan el frio y la lluvia, y el calor extremo de estos dias de Julio.
Para los que busquen turismo deportivo, les recomiendo pillar una bici donde vivan y recorrer los alrededores de su poblacion las veces que quieran.
Para los que buscan un viaje introspectivo, muy personal, espiritual o religioso, es la experiencia de nuestras vidas".
response_from_owner_text: Muchas Gracias
review_translated_text:
I arrived in Belorado from Najera by bike on April 26, 2025, after traveling 44 kilometers, crossing vast fields of vines, getting my bike muddy, and almost falling off a couple of times due to the mud on the road. It was cold and the rain was fine. I passed through Santo Domingo de la Calzada, where I stopped for a hot Cola-Cao.

Upon arriving in Belorado, I left my things at the hostel and went to a gas station to clean it with a pressure washer (then dried it and lubricated the mechanical parts). The truth is, the bike Santiago Ways provided me through LeonBike was fully equipped with emergency or breakdown tools, such as chain oil.
The town has an interesting helmet, and the attendant gave me all the information I needed.
That day, a World War II-related activity was held, complete with cannon shots.
The church in the square is neoclassical, and I attended a heartwarming mass for someone who had suffered greatly on the Camino.

A full and energizing breakfast for the next day, heading to Burgos.

Thanks to the manager (whose name I forget), who, by the way, cooks very well :-)

I'll share this same comment with the other establishments: "In my humble opinion, the Camino de Santiago should be done alone, at least the first time.
For those looking for views, I recommend going by car, which will avoid the cold and rain, and the extreme heat of these July days.
For those looking for a sporty trip, I recommend getting a bike where you live and exploring the surrounding areas of your town as often as you like.
For those looking for an introspective, very personal, spiritual, or religious journey, it's the experience of a lifetime."
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much

name: Juan Fernandez
review_text:
Aqui os encontrareis con Joaquin una maquina en todo: desde ganadero, albanil, cocinero... y lo que se tercie este hombre puede con todo. El lugar era la antigua casa de sus padres y poco a poco lo fue transformando en lo que es hoy una verdadera obra de artesania: las bigas de chopo es lo que
mas llaman la atencion estan talladas a mano y las fue tallando el con la ayuda de sus hijos y los revestimientos de mortero tambien,sin haber trabajado en el oficio.  El aspecto final es puramente rustico y no hay mas que verlo para darse de cuenta del trabajo que se empleo para hacerlo.
Estuvimos muy comodos el dia que pasamos alli, todo esta limpio y curioso. La comida cena casera y preparada por el propio Joaquin,acompanada de historias de su vida nos permitieron pasar un rato realmente agradable; y ademas nos detallo al dedillo,con croquis incluido,como llegar a Burgos en bici.
En fin una estancia en un ambiente cordial y totalmente recomendable.
Gracias Joaquin.
response_from_owner_text: Muchas Gracias
review_translated_text:
Here you'll find Joaquin, a jack-of-all-trades: from rancher to bricklayer to cook... and whatever else, this man can handle it all. The place was his parents' old house, and little by little, he transformed it into what it is today, a true work of craftsmanship: the poplar beams are what most attract attention; they are hand-carved, which he carved with the help of his children, and the mortar cladding as well, without having worked in the trade. The final appearance is purely rustic, and you only have to see it to realize the work that went into it.
We were very comfortable the day we spent there; everything is clean and quaint. The home-cooked dinner prepared by Joaquin himself, accompanied by stories from his life, allowed us to have a truly enjoyable time; and he also gave us detailed instructions, including sketches, on how to get to Burgos by bike.
In short, a stay in a friendly atmosphere and highly recommended.
Thank you, Joaquin.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much

name: Elechan86
review_text:
Saro sincera, sono finita in questo ostello per caso perche quello che avevo scelto inizialmene a Belorado non mi ha ne risposto al telefono, ne ho trovato nessuno alla reception quando mi ci sono presentata di persona; sono quindi entrata qui, nonostante sia un po' piu caro della media degli ostelli che si trovano lungo il Cammino. Almeno sono stati soldi ben spesi :)
L'unica cosa che non ho apprezzato e che la stanza fosse addirittura al terzo piano (solo scale, niente ascensore), ma la camera era molto bella: non ci sono i letti a castello e la stanza ha dei comodi separatori per avere un po' di privacy, la sensazione e quella di essere in una doppia.
Bagni ampi, pulizia ovunque e comfort. I soldi in piu li vale davvero.
C'e anche la possiibilita di cenare e fare la colazione in struttura ad un prezzo aggiuntivo, cosa che io adoro perche ti offre l'opportunita di non mangiare da sola e conoscere altri pellegrini, cosi da allargare il giro di amicizie. Oltre che, se sei stanca, non hai il pensiero di doverti procurare e preparare il cibo.
La cena era davvero gustosa e molto abbondante.
Della colazione non ho usufruito, ma mi hanno permesso di utilizzare lo spazio comune per consumare la mia colazione.
Se vi volete coccolare un po' lungo il cammino e provare qualcosa di diverso rispetto ai soliti dormitori, lo consiglio sicuramente :)
response_from_owner_text: Muchas gracias! Buen camino!
review_translated_text:
I'll be honest, I ended up in this hostel by chance because the one I had initially chosen in Belorado didn't answer my phone, nor did I find anyone at the reception when I showed up in person; so I went in here, even though it's a bit more expensive than the average hostel along the Camino. At least it was money well spent :)
The only thing I didn't appreciate was that the room was on the third floor (only stairs, no elevator), but the room was very nice: there are no bunk beds and the room has comfortable dividers to have a bit of privacy, the feeling is that of being in a double room.
Large bathrooms, cleanliness everywhere and comfort. The extra money is really worth it.
There is also the possibility of having dinner and breakfast in the structure for an additional price, which I love because it gives you the opportunity to not eat alone and meet other pilgrims, thus widening your circle of friends. Also, if you are tired, you don't have to worry about getting and preparing food.
The dinner was really tasty and very abundant.
I didn't use the breakfast, but they allowed me to use the common area to eat my breakfast.
If you want to pamper yourself a little along the way and try something different from the usual dormitories, I definitely recommend it :)
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you very much! Good journey!

review_text: Pesimo trato. Nuestra queja se origino porq unos peregrinos ocuparon la totalidad del tendedero q teniamos en nuestra zona para secar los calcetines q teniamos puestos que mojamos al ir a comer del chaparron que cayo. Bajamos a preguntar y nos dijo el encargado, cuando subio llamo la atencion a quien habia ocupado nuestro tendedero. Cuando nos dio la ropa que habiamos bajado para lavar y secar, por la cual nos cobraron 7 euros!!!!!!, te dan la ropa mojada y buscate la vida para ponerte al dia siguiente para seguir el camino una ropa humeda. Nos dice q es q ellos no secan, q solo lavan, que tb tienen secadora pero que no la ponen (Hablamos de 7 eurazos solo por lavar!!!!) Cuando despues de 8 caminos y mas de 3000 km pateados, es el sitio donde me he sentido estafado por ese precio cuando en los demas albergues te secan y lavan por menos dinero, sin ir mas lejos en el hostel agora de estella. Despues de venir para cenar, nos encontramos que no tenemos sitio para cenar un poco de embutido que llevamos porque estan todas las mesas ocupadas dando cenas. Encontramos una mesa redonda donde poder tomar algo y al entrar veo que unas mallas q hablamos entregado para lavar, estan encima de una radiador en la zona comun. Y entonces aparece un empleado, con su chuleria y prepotencia diciendome que las mallas las habia puesto yo alli. Me dice que a que hora voy a dormir, a lo que le contesto q a el que le importa..... Contestando, no... Es q ahora estoy ocupado con las cenas y quiero hablar contigo seriamente. Todo ello en un tono desafiante y chulesco.... Puesa hi te estuve esperando a q acabaras, pero lo unico que hiciste fue venir como un corderito pidiendo disculpas. En conclusion.... Si eres un peregrino y no turigrino, si no usas mas transporte de mochila que tu espalda, sino quieres cenar a las 7 de la tarde ( por cierto, no dan menu a mediodia) y si no quieres pagar 7 euros x un desayuno, mejor vete a otro albergue, en este solo quieren turigrinos extranjeros a los que sablearle el dinero. Por cierto.... La zona de las camas compartidas no meten literas porque no caben  de altura!!! Si mides mas de 1,60 te juegas un buen golpe como el que se dio mi pareja.... Da gracias que no te denuncie x ello.
review_translated_text: Terrible treatment. Our complaint arose because some pilgrims occupied the entire clothesline that we had in our area to dry the socks that we had on that we got wet when we went to eat from the downpour that fell. We went down to ask and the manager told us, when he came up he called the attention of whoever had occupied our clothesline. When they gave us the clothes that we had brought down to wash and dry, for which they charged us 7 euros!!!!!!, they give you the wet clothes and you have to put on wet clothes the next day to continue on the path. He tells us that they don't dry, that they only wash, that they also have a dryer but they don't put it in (We're talking about 7 euros just to wash!!!!) When after 8 roads and more than 3000 km traveled, it is the place where I have felt cheated by that price when in the other hostels they dry and wash you for less money, without going any further in the hostel agora de estella. After coming for dinner, we find that we don't have room to dine on some of the sausage we brought because all the tables are busy giving dinners. We found a round table where we could have something to eat and upon entering I see that some tights that we had given to wash are on top of a radiator in the common area. And then an employee appears, with his cockiness and arrogance, telling me that I had put the tights there. He tells me what time I'm going to sleep, to which I answer that who cares..... Answering, no... It's just that I'm busy with dinners now and I want to talk to you seriously. All of this in a defiant and cocky tone... Well, I was waiting for you to finish, but all you did was come like a little lamb asking for an apology. In conclusion.... If you are a pilgrim and not a turigrino, if you don't use more backpack transportation than your back, but you want to have dinner at 7 in the afternoon (by the way, they don't give a menu at noon) and if you don't want to pay 7 euros for a breakfast, better go to another hostel, in this one they only want foreign turigrinos to whom they can shake money. By the way.... The shared bed area does not have bunk beds because they do not fit in height!!! If you are taller than 1.60 you are in for a big blow like the one my partner took.... Be thankful that I don't sue you for it.

name: El Mago 2.0
review_text: En este albergue germino uno de los grandes e inolvidables momentos de mi Camino de Santiago. Una tarde estaba cenando solo en el comedor, Joaquin (el propietario) me vio y empezamos a hablar. Primero me dio muy buenos consejos pero despues la conversacion se torno mas espiritual y sensitiva. Confirmo mi idea del camino y me descubrio otro camino "magico", hablamos de muchas cosas y acabamos con lagrimas en los ojos. Joaquin, me dijiste que cuando llegase a Santiago y estuviese mirando la fachada de la Catedral tendria un recuerdo para ti. Asi fue. Tal vez un dia te llame y te cuente lo que me ocurrio la manana que sali del albergue dispuesto a atravesar los Montes de la Oca. Te dire que no lo suelo contar porque la gente pensaria que estoy loco. Un abrazo Joaquin!! Hospitalero con mayusculas.
response_from_owner_text:
Me hubiera encantado el caminar junto a ti por los montes de Oca, y mucho mas el estar juntos en la Plaza del Obradoiro.
Algun dia me contaras, mas pronto que tarde y compartiremos la experiencia, me gustaria que fuese presencial con un poco de jamon y un vaso de tinto rioja de mi vecina tierra.
Me alegro que todo fuese bien y saludaras  a "Santi".
Suerte en este tu "verdadero camino" el del dia a dia
Gracias por tu generosidad.
Saludos, Joaquin
review_translated_text: In this hostel one of the great and unforgettable moments of my Camino de Santiago germinated. One afternoon I was having dinner alone in the dining room, Joaquin (the owner) saw me and we started talking. At first he gave me very good advice but then the conversation became more spiritual and sensitive. He confirmed my idea of   the path and discovered another "magical" path for me. We talked about many things and ended up with tears in our eyes. Joaquin, you told me that when I arrived in Santiago and was looking at the facade of the Cathedral I would have a memory for you. That's how it was. Maybe one day I will call you and tell you what happened to me the morning I left the hostel ready to cross the Montes de la Oca. I'll tell you that I don't usually tell it because people would think I'm crazy. A hug Joaquin!! Hospitaller with capital letters.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
I would have loved to walk with you through the Oca mountains, and much more to be together in the Plaza del Obradoiro.
Someday you will tell me, sooner rather than later and we will share the experience, I would like it to be in person with some ham and a glass of red rioja from my neighboring land.
I'm glad everything went well and you said hello to "Santi".
Good luck in this your "true path" of everyday life.
Thank you for your generosity.
Regards, Joaquin

review_text:
Un sitio que esta bien, aunque el precio del gas les obliga a racionar la calefaccion (no es culpa de ellos, es el.gobier o comunista que no da soluciones y les suben mos impuestos, y eso lo pagamos todos al final).

Como punto negativo: El edificio esta hecho con vigas de maderas y es muy antiguo, el suelo se mueve al andar y la gente hacia ruido.

En la habitacion compartida faltan biombos para no ver l de la cama de enfrente.
No hay enchufes accesibles desde las camas, pero si los hay en las paredes.

En general la esperiencia es buena y lo recomiendo pero con un biombo y un enchufe  en cada cama les hubiera puesto 4 estrellas.

Por lo menos esta resena servira como critica constructiva y les hare ganar mucho dinero si siguen mis recomendaciones.
response_from_owner_text: Muchisimas Gracias
review_translated_text:
A good place, although the price of gas forces them to ration the heating (it's not their fault, it's the communist government that offers no solutions and raises taxes, and we all end up paying for it).

On the downside: The building is made of wooden beams and is very old, the floor moves when walking, and people make noise.

The shared room lacks screens so you can't see the bed opposite you.
There are no accessible electrical outlets from the beds, but there are some on the walls.

Overall, the experience is good and I recommend it, but with a screen and an electrical outlet for each bed, I would have given it 4 stars.

At least this review will serve as constructive criticism, and I'll make you a lot of money if you follow my recommendations.

review_text: Nos alojamos en este Hostel en una habitacion cuadruple. Las sabanas no estaban demasiado limpias, no habia espacio para poder conectar los mobiles de los cuatro, no habia mesilla de noche.||El desayuno fue un abuso por parte del senor que regenta el hostel. La noche anterior le pedimos si podiamos desanunar y nos dijo que, si que tenia de todo. No fue verdad, solo tenia pan bimbo y cafe de filtro, no tenia embutido para los cuatro. Tubimos que dar a nuestra hija adolescente el embutido que teniamos nosotros para el camino. Tardamos una hora en desanunar porque el senor se lo hace todo el solo y no da abasto. ||Y los mas grave: por tostadas pan bimbo y nada de embutido nos queria cobrar 28 euros. La cena de la noche anterior, 2 platos con dos huevos fritos, 2  de lomo, un poco de janon pan agua y dos copas de vino 50EU. ||Por el camino nos encontramos a dos ciclistas que se habian alojado y habian escuchado mi conversacion con el dueno a la hora de pagar y me felicitaron por haberle dicho que no estaba bien que se aprovechara de los peregrinos. Nos contaron que a ellos por dos tostadas bimbo y un cafe de filtro les cobro 5 euros a cada uno. Suerte tubieron de que me queje, sino les cobra 7EU por cabeza. ||||Joaquin, hay que saber aceptar las criticas. Si no tienes lo que se pide, no hace falta enganar a la gente, no tengo pan y no tengo embutidos para desanunar no es grave, la gente podemos entender que si no pasa gente no se tenga de todo. Pero no puedes vender que tienes un gran bufe, porque es mentira.||||Salud!
review_translated_text: We stayed at this hostel in a quadruple room. The sheets weren't very clean, there wasn't enough space to plug in the four of our phones, and there was no nightstand. Breakfast was outrageous on the part of the man who runs the hostel. The night before, we asked if we could have breakfast, and he said he had everything. This wasn't true; he only had Bimbo bread and filter coffee, and no cold cuts for the four of us. We had to give our teenage daughter the cold cuts we had packed for the road. It took us an hour to get to breakfast because the man does everything himself and can't keep up. And the worst part: he wanted to charge us EU28 for toast and no cold cuts. Dinner the night before, two plates with two fried eggs, two pork loin, some Janon bread, water, and two glasses of wine, was EU50. ||Along the way, we met two cyclists who had been staying there and had overheard my conversation with the owner at checkout. They congratulated me for telling him it wasn't right for him to take advantage of pilgrims. They told us that he charged them 5 euros each for two Bimbo toasts and a filter coffee. They were lucky I complained, otherwise he'd charge them 7 euros each. ||||Joaquin, you have to know how to accept criticism. If you don't have what they're asking for, there's no need to deceive people. I don't have bread and I don't have cold cuts for breakfast, it's not a big deal. We people can understand that if there aren't many people passing by, you don't have everything. But you can't sell yourself as having a great buffet, because that's a lie. ||||Cheers!

review_text: Llegamos a Belorado en parada del camino de Santiago y nos hospedamos en este Hostel. review_translated_text: We arrived in Belorado as a stopover on the Camino de Santiago and stayed at this hostel. From the moment we arrived, everything was easy, and both Joaquin and the receptionist (whose name I can't remember) were charming. This establishment also offers restaurant service, so everything felt very homey. In our case, we weren't in the mood for a full menu for dinner, and they made us a custom-made dinner, almost like home. Everything was homemade, freshly prepared in front of us, and delicious. It's a pleasure to meet such nice people; they make the Camino de Santiago an even more enjoyable experience.

Respecto a la comida, tiene opciones muy variadas y muy ricas. Comi pescadito (verdel) con ensalada, torreznos con picadillo, y una pera al vino, a cual mas rico.
Pero lo mas destacable es la amabilidad, simpatia y carino de Joaquin y de su familia. Se sentaron a comer conmigo como si fueras uno mas de los suyos, y me senti como si estuviera en mi casa.  ;')

review_translated_text:

The truth is that I travel a lot for work, and it shows when a hotel/hostel takes the trouble to put the things that are needed at all times; B. gets an A on this point.
Regarding food, it has very varied and very delicious options. I ate little fish (greenfish) with salad, torreznos with minced meat, and a pear in wine, which was more delicious.
But the most notable thing is the kindness, sympathy and affection of Joaquin and his family. They sat down to eat with me as if you were one of their own, and I felt like I was at home.  ;')
If I return to Belorado, I am very clear that I will stay here again. Thank you very much for everything!!!

name: Antonio Parras
review_text: Llegamos al hotel por la tarde y nos informaron que el aire acondicionado estaba averiado, por lo que nos reubicarian en otro hotel a 10 minutos en coche. Mi primera sorpresa fue que, a pesar de esto, nos cobraron la habitacion en ese momento. Al dirigirnos al nuevo hotel, descubrimos que se encontraba a 20 minutos segun Google Maps, mucho mas lejos del centro de Burgos que el alojamiento original. Para colmo, el nuevo hotel resulto ser de una categoria inferior, con solo 2 estrellas, a diferencia de lo que habiamos reservado. Ademas, no nos proporcionaron ningun tipo de recibo o factura. En resumen, la experiencia fue decepcionante, y la proxima vez buscare otra opcion de alojamiento en Burgos. No lo recomiendo!!
review_translated_text: We arrived at the hotel in the afternoon and were informed that the air conditioning was broken, so we would be relocated to another hotel a 10-minute drive away. My first surprise was that, despite this, we were charged for the room at that time. Upon heading to the new hotel, we discovered it was 20 minutes away according to Google Maps, much further from the center of Burgos than the original accommodation. To top it all off, the new hotel turned out to be of a lower category, with only 2 stars, unlike the one we had booked. Furthermore, we were not provided with any kind of receipt or invoice. In short, the experience was disappointing, and next time I will look for another accommodation option in Burgos. I do not recommend it!

name: farasat ali
review_text: Muy boin servicio y gentes amigables
review_translated_text: Very good service and friendly people

name: Servando botella diaz
review_text:
Mas de lo mismo, estafa? No, intento de engano, Total.
Hicimos la reserva hace mas de una semana, el dia de la reserva, nos llama a las 14h para saber la hora de nuestra llegada, "pensamiento positivo". Le decimos que sobre las 19 y nos dicen que perfecto que alli nos esperaban, cuando llegamos estaba todo cerrado, llamo al telefono que me habia llamado y me dicen:
- 'ahora te abro',
nos abre y me dice esperate no descargues todavia, pasa que te explico, entro y me explica que no les funciona el aire y que me envian a un hotel superior en el que nos daban 2 duplex, uno por cada habitacion reservada, que nos cobraba alli, le pregunte para cenar y me dice que alrededor del nuevo hotel tenemos mucha oferta, llegamos al nuevo hotel 2* y ademas que no les quedaba nada mas que una habitacion con 4 camas no les funcionaba el ascensor y mi suegra, recien operada de rodilla, no podia subir escaleras, habia un bar en el pueblo que cerraba en 20 minutos, todo eran despropositos, al final despues de discutir, me hicieron la devolucion de lo pagado y buscamos un nuevo alojamiento a 30 minutos.
review_translated_text:
More of the same, scam? No, attempted deception.
We made the reservation over a week ago. On the day of the reservation, he called us at 2:00 PM to find out our arrival time. "Positive thinking." We told him it was around 7 p.m. and he told us it was fine, saying they were waiting for us there. When we arrived, everything was closed. I called the number he'd called and they said, "I'll let you in now." He opened the door and said, "Wait, don't unload yet." He came in and I'll explain. I went in and he explained that their air conditioning wasn't working and they were sending me to a superior hotel where they were giving us two duplexes, one for each reserved room, and that he was charging us there. I asked him about dinner and he told me there were plenty of options around the new hotel. We arrived at the new 2-star hotel and on top of that, they had nothing left but a room with four beds, the elevator wasn't working, and my mother-in-law, who had recently had knee surgery, couldn't climb stairs. There was a bar in town that closed in 20 minutes. It was all nonsense. In the end, after arguing, they refunded me and we looked for new accommodation 30 minutes away.

name: Monica Ochoa
review_text: Buenas tardes quiero dejar constancia mi malestar con el hotel asador versus 3* En el dia de hoy teniamos reserva con ellos y al llegar me han comunicado que hasta las 12.30 a 13.00 no se hacia el checking, les he dicho que perfecto que nos ibamos a tomar algo. Sobre las 12.45 hemos vuelto descargando todo de los vehiculos y a la hora de hacer el checking nos dicen que el aire acondicionado esta estropeado pero que nos derivan a otro hotel de 4 estrellas a 10 min de alli, que ellos nos cobran en este hotel (asador verdus3*) y que alli nos daran habitacion. Es un hotel (camino de rabe 2*) mejor que el asador versus (3*) y que ademas tiene restaurante y parking para las motos. Nos cobran con datafono y nos dan la direccion del nuevo hotel (camino rabe 2*) nuestro asombro ha sido que en el GPS ponia 20 min para llegar. Al llegar el hotel (camino de rabe) es de 2 estrellas, no tiene parking ni restaurante. Nos hemos sentido enganados y no podiamos irnos ya que nos habian cobrado la habitacion en el otro hotel (asador versus 3*), la chica de este hotel (camino rabe 2*)nos va ha comentado que ya llevan asi mas de una semana y que todos los clientes vienen muy enfadados. Al final me siento que es una estafa y una mentira ya que es una categoria inferior carece de todo lo que te explican y para finalizar nos hemos tenido que adaptar en una habitacion con camas individuales.
review_translated_text: Good afternoon, I want to record my discomfort with the hotel asador versus 3*. Today we had a reservation with them and upon arriving they told me that the check-in was not done until 12:30 to 1:00 p.m., I told them that it was perfect that we were going to have something to drink. At around 12:45 we returned unloading everything from the vehicles and when checking in they told us that the air conditioning is broken but that they refer us to another 4 star hotel 10 minutes away, that they charge us at this hotel (asador verdus3*) and that they will give us a room there. It is a better hotel (Camino de Rabe 2*) than the Asador Versus (3*) and it also has a restaurant and parking for motorcycles. They charge us with a dataphone and give us the address of the new hotel (Camino Rabe 2*). Our surprise was that the GPS said 20 minutes to get there. When you arrive, the hotel (Camino de Rabe) is 2 stars, it does not have parking or a restaurant. We felt cheated and we couldn't leave since they had charged us for the room at the other hotel (steakhouse versus 3*), the girl from this hotel (camino rabe 2*) told us that they have been like this for more than a week and that all the clients are very angry. In the end I feel that it is a scam and a lie since it is a lower category and lacks everything they explain to you and in the end we had to adapt to a room with single beds.

name: Ionut Birca
review_text: El aire acondicionado no funciona y el parking no existe.
review_translated_text: The air conditioning does not work and the parking does not exist.

name: Jose Martinez
review_text: Horrible

name: Ali
review_text:
Mi experiencia fue NEFASTA.
Primero de todo llegamos al lugar y nos comentan que el aire acondicionado no funcionaba desde ayer (porque no nos habian avisado?) nos dan la alternativa de unos apartamentos que estaban cerca del Hotel que por las fotos PARECIAN una buena opcion. Pues os hago spoiler: NO ERA UNA BUENA OPCION!!
Estaban a 20 min del hotel, a las afueras de burgos.. casi en Leon . Los "apartamentos" no tenian ni cocina, ni nevera ni nada!! Una mesa una tele y un sofa super sucio que ni lo tocamos por miedo a que tenga pulgas de lo sucio que estaba. Estoy super molesto. Las chicas de recepcion no tenian la culpa pero la duena desentendiendose de todo. LA PEOR ESTANCIA QUE ESTUVE.
review_translated_text:
My experience was HORRIBLE.
First of all, we arrived at the place and they told us that the air conditioning had not worked since yesterday (why hadn't they notified us?) They gave us the alternative of some apartments that were close to the Hotel, which from the photos SEEMED to be a good option. Well, I'll give you a spoiler: IT WAS NOT A GOOD OPTION!!
They were 20 minutes from the hotel, on the outskirts of Burgos... almost in Leon . The "apartments" did not have a kitchen, refrigerator or anything!! A table, a TV and a super dirty sofa that we didn't even touch for fear that it would have fleas because of how dirty it was. I'm super upset. The girls at the reception were not to blame but the owner ignored everything. THE WORST STAY I HAVE BEEN ON.

name: corinnesZ1732IX
review_text: Sur le chemin de nos vacances, nous nous sommes arretes dans cet etablissement pour la nuit.|Et malgre les commentaires negatifs que nous avons lus,  je tiens a preciser que cet hotel est tres propre, le personnel accueillant et souriant,|Seul petit bemol, la clim est a revoir car elle ne n'a pas du tout rafraichi notre chambre, aux belles proportions pour un court sejour et agrementee d'une belle salle de bain.|A vous d'en juger lors d'un futur voyage,|Merci a la sympathique et serviable receptionniste,

review_text: Falta de limpieza, hotel sin personal, parece un hotel fantasma, nos hemos sentido solos. Lastima restaurante cerrado.

name: Alniel geodesic house
review_text: El servicio del hotel deja mucho que desear, llegue el dia 29-07-2024, les di mis datos y les pedi una factura de mi estancia... Ayer cuando llegue al hotel, la puerta no se abria, no habia nadie para solucionar el problema me canse a llamar al timbre y llamar por telefono, hasta que al final me contestaron. Por un error de ellos, cambiaron mi estancia por la de otra persona ahi lo dejo la de problemas que me crearon y yo sin entrar en mi habitacion. Llevo pidiendo a factura de mi estancia desde mi llegada, primero que me la darian impresa pero segun ellos se termino la tinta de la impresora (Como si me importaran sus problemas internos) y la dejarian en mi habitacion, despues que me la mandarian por correo electronico, y esta manana, como no, nunca hay nadie en recepcion, ni al telefono ni para nada, ningun tipo de servicio ni de desayuno ni de restaurante ni para comprar una botella de agua aun sin mi factura. Me he cansado a llamar por telefono para reclamar mi factura hasta que al final me han contestado y aun asi no la tengo... Le verdad es que el servicio deja mucho que desear, gracias a el pongo esta resena. Tema habitaciones. Bueno cabe decir que el colchon esta lleno de bultos, que hay alargadores colgando para conectar la tele y demas, que el termostato del aire no esta, si te viene bien la temperatura que hay vale y si no te aguantas. No esta a la altura de sus 3 estrellas vamos que hay pensiones mejor que este hotel. Me paso casi todo el ano viajando por trabajo pero si tengo muy claro que este es uno de esos hoteles a los que ni harto de vino volvere por su mal servicio y mala atencion.
review_translated_text: The hotel service leaves a lot to be desired, I arrived on 07-29-2024, I gave them my information and asked them for an invoice for my stay... Yesterday when I arrived at the hotel, the door did not open, there was no one to solve the problem, I got tired of ringing the bell and calling on the phone, until they finally answered me. Due to their mistake, they changed my stay for someone else's, so I leave it with the problems they created for me and me without entering my room. I have been asking for an invoice for my stay since my arrival, first that they would give me a printed one but according to them the printer's ink ran out (as if I cared about their internal problems) and they would leave it in my room, after they would send it to me by email, and this morning, of course, there is never anyone at reception, not on the phone or for anything, any type of service, neither breakfast nor restaurant nor to buy a bottle of water even without my invoice. I got tired of calling on the phone to claim my bill until they finally answered me and I still don't have it... The truth is that the service leaves a lot to be desired, thanks to him I am posting this review. Theme rooms. Well, it should be said that the mattress is full of lumps, that there are extension cords hanging to connect the TV and so on, that the air thermostat is not there, if the temperature suits you, it's fine and if you can't stand it. It is not up to its 3 stars, there are better pensions than this hotel. I spend almost the entire year traveling for work but I am very clear that this is one of those hotels that I will not return to even if I get sick of wine due to its poor service and poor attention.

review_text: La habitacion era bastante pequena, con cama doble de colchon muy incomodo. Las sabanas tenian bolas...Ademas la TV no tenia mando y la calefaccion en el bano tenia fuga. name: Adam Davey
review_text: We stayed one night whilst travelling north and visiting Burgos. Decent hotel, decent value. We took the bus into the city rather than take two cars, as there's a bus stop just outside. There were a couple of problems with some room maintenance that negate a higher score (loose skirting board and a falling curtain rail that may have hit a head whilst in bed) but in general it's a decent choice. Friendly service, free (nearby) parking and good value.

review_text: I was here in the summer of 2011, stopped by on the way to Logrono not expecting anything special. I was pleasantly surprised to discover such delicious lamb dish. I will return soon, this is on my list.

review_text: Habitaciones grandes y limpias. Hotel moderno con restaurante a buen precio. Muchos platos donde elegir.
review_translated_text: Large, clean rooms. Modern hotel with a reasonably priced restaurant. Plenty of dishes to choose from.

review_text: Comida genial, menu diario muy variado y todo exquisito. La atencion muy buena y la relacion calidad/precio fenomenal. Zona para aparcar y rapido acceso.
review_translated_text: Great food, a varied daily menu, and everything is exquisite. The service is excellent, and the price/quality ratio is phenomenal. Parking is available and easy access.

name: Sara Sajaniemi-Afonso
review_text:
Very welcoming and kind staff, a spacious room.

Few minus points due to lack of secure car park on-site, limited menu at the downstairs restaurant and for bedding being slightly old-fashioned (a throw instead of a duvet).
Also, we struggled to find the hotel first and drove past it first. It could be good to put some signs to guide guests.

But a budget-friendly option for those driving past Burgos.

review_translated_text: Due to an unforeseen event on the road with the car we were forced to look for a place to spend the night, searching for it was the one that caught our attention the most, reasonable price, we entered the hotel at 10:50 and between checking in and chatting they gave us 11 or something, we still asked for dinner and the girl at the reception told us that they closed the kitchen at 11 but without thinking twice she did us the favor of giving us dinner, a charming girl, delicious food and kindness Great, if the possibility of returning is offered I will return.

The next day we decided not to look any further and ate suckling lamb. Delicious and very good. The prices are more than acceptable and by the way, they have a very nice terrace to have coffee. The rooms are perfect, comfortable beds and best of all, the bathroom. Everything is spotless.

que destacable.
Lo culminamos con un  buen asado en su comedor muy buena calidad y bodega a precios que hoy por hoy son muy asequibles.  Seguiremos repitiendo. Gracias.

We returned after these difficult times.  The attention and treatment of its employees was very friendly, close and professional.
The rooms are clean, comfortable and with a better quality-price ratio.
How remarkable.
We finished it off with a good barbecue in their very good quality dining room and wine cellar at prices that today are very affordable.  We will continue repeating. Thank you.

review_text:
Hotel con encanto pero dormir se hace casi imposible. Mucho calor y ruido en la habitacion y si enciendes el aire acondicionado aunque pongas a 15 grados echa calor.

Si lo dice usted sera que es verdad. He encendido el aire para que usted me diga que lo ponga en off. Yo me paso mas de la mitad del ano durmiendo en hoteles, se perfectamente como manejar un aire acondicionado, gracias por su aporte.  Igual quien se ha confundido de planeta es usted, no hace falta que insulte tan sutilmente.
Y ahora redacto lo que no he escrito en su dia para intentar no hacer dano pero ahora me siento obligado: En la habitacion que me han dado (25 creo recordar) es imposible dormir comodamente aunque usted no se lo crea. Ademas, fuera en el tejado al lado de la ventana de dicho cuarto tienen chimeneas y refrigeradores que estan toda la noche haciendo bastante ruido de forma ciclica, de tal forma que cuando se esta cerca de conciliar el sueno te vuelves a despertar.
review_translated_text:
Charming hotel but sleeping is almost impossible. A lot of heat and noise in the room and if you turn on the air conditioning even if you set it to 15 degrees it gets hot.

If you say it, it will be true. I turned on the air so you could tell me to turn it off. I spend more than half the year sleeping in hotels, I know perfectly how to operate an air conditioner, thank you for your contribution.  Maybe you are the one who has the wrong planet, you don't need to insult so subtly.
And now I write what I have not written in the past to try not to cause harm but now I feel obliged: In the room they have given me (25 I think I remember) it is impossible to sleep comfortably, even if you don't believe it. Furthermore, outside on the roof next to the window of said room they have fireplaces and refrigerators that are cyclically making a lot of noise all night, so that when you are close to falling asleep you wake up again.

review_text: Medio medio, nada simpatica la chica de la manana, me llamo la atencion por todo, cuando hicimos un despliegue logistico para bajar las maletas por la noche pues el ascensor no  lo ponian en marcha y nosotros teniamos que salir temprano.. En fin, parece que ya ahora lo de ser cordial no se usa... El hotel muy bien, uno va por una cama y una buena ducha, eso esta muy bien, no me voy a casar con ella, pero jamas amarga un dulce...

Anyway, it seems that now being cordial is not used... The hotel is very good, you go for a bed and a good shower, that's very good, I'm not going to marry her, but she never sours a sweet...

Facil aparcamiento para coches y camiones.
El hotel hare resena otro dia cuando volvamos que sera visita segura.
Muy recomendable
review_translated_text:
Homemade cuisine with a touch of exquisiteness.
The red beans at Ibeas were a discovery for me.
The lady who served us was very friendly and prompt in serving us the menus because we were in a hurry.
Very good value. We paid EU15 with dessert and coffee.
Very thoughtful details on the dishes and a good wine list.
Easy parking for cars and trucks.
I'll write a review of the hotel another day when we return, as it will definitely be a visit.
Highly recommended

I got the impression that they randomly charged us this extra fee, not adhering to the established prices, which I find very shameful.
The room left a lot to be desired, as the hydromassage shower didn't work, and the reception service was terrible.
I don't think we'll be back.

name: Antonio L
review_text: Como agente comercial por espana puedo decir que Burgos siempre ha sido complicado encontrar algo de buena calidad a buen precio. Este quizas no sea el hotel fuera de Burgos mas barato pero la calidad precio es buena. Las habitaciones estan limpias, los trabajadores son cordiales y tiene un restaurante que sirve buena comida. Quizas los precios del restaurante no encajen con el precio del hotel ya que tienden a ser bastante altos comparados con el precio de habitacion. Desayuno a partir de las 8am pero disponibilidad a tomarlo mas temprano avisando en recepcion. Como es de esperar wifi en las habitaciones y sin parking ero con varios sitios disponibles para aparcar alrededor. Como dicho en el titulo bueno si bus as un sitio para quedarte una noche.
review_translated_text: As a commercial agent in Spain I can say that Burgos has always been difficult to find something of good quality at a good price. This may not be the cheapest hotel outside of Burgos but the quality-price ratio is good. The rooms are clean, the workers are friendly and it has a restaurant that serves good food. Perhaps the restaurant prices do not match the hotel price as they tend to be quite high compared to the room price. Breakfast starts at 8am but availability to have it earlier by notifying reception. As expected, wifi in the rooms and no parking but with several places available to park around. As said in the title, well if you're looking for a place to stay one night.

name: Joshua Merino
review_text:
Mal en todos los aspectos muy caro pesimo servicio,  y si eres alergico te cambian el menu pero el cambio te sale carisimo porque no es que te lo cambien sino que te lo cobran aparte.
Hablando del menu para empezar morcilla envuelta en masa de hojaldre que bueno se puede comer, el pate de cabracho sacado directamente de una lata, de casero no tiene nada, seguido de unos chipirones que bueno ahi estaban y el segundo plato de traca un entrecot que la suela de una bota militar es mas tierna,  las chuletillas les falta tecnica para hacerlas y el Cordero he comido oveja asada mas tierna. Y los postres o comes tarta o te meten 8 euros por un sorbete de Limon que basicamente era solo hielo.  A todo esto una descoordinacion total en la entrega de platos unos habiamos acabado y otros aun no tenian el segundo plato.  Vamos que mal no peor aun y el menu de precio 46EU  solo faltaba haber salido diciendo manos arriba esto es un atraco.  Si estais pensando en como malgastar el dinero este es sin duda un buen sitio.
review_translated_text:
Bad in all aspects, very expensive, terrible service, and if you are allergic they change the menu but the change is very expensive because it is not that they change it but that they charge you separately.
Speaking of the menu, to start with black pudding wrapped in puff pastry that you can eat well, the scorpionfish pate taken directly from a can, there is nothing homemade about it, followed by some squid that were good there and the second plate of traca a entrecote that the sole of a military boot is more tender, the chops lack the technique to make them and the Lamb I have eaten more tender roast sheep. And for desserts, either you eat cake or they charge you 8 euros for a lemon sorbet that was basically just ice.  In addition to all this, there was a total lack of coordination in the delivery of dishes, some of us had finished and others still did not have the second dish.  Come on, it's bad, not even worse, and the EU46 menu only needed to come out saying hands up, this is a robbery.  If you are thinking about how to waste money this is undoubtedly a good place.

Al bajar habia una camarera que te servia en la mesa, eramos seis personas, cuatro y dos, dos mesas separadas. Estuvimos casi una hora hasta que pudimos empezar a desayunar, la chica no avanzaba. Sin saber muy bien por que, claro esta.
No entiendo para que me.hacen bajar a una hora en concreto si luego con seis personas no damos para mas
review_translated_text:
At first, it didn't seem like a bad place, but when we got to the room, when we turned down the bed, there were hairs, not ours. The shower screen was broken. Breakfast was included in the price of our stay, and we were "forced" to give an approximate time to come down for breakfast.
Upon coming down, there was a waitress serving us at the table; there were six of us, four and two, two separate tables. We waited almost an hour until we could start breakfast, but the waitress didn't make any progress. Without really knowing why, of course.
I don't understand why they make me come down at a specific time if, with six people, we can't make enough time.

review_text: La peor experiencia q he tenido con mi mujer en cualquier sitio. Todo lo desagradable vino x no decirle q no ibamos a cenar alli, y no se lo dijimos pq quedamos en q si cenabamos le avisabamos con antelacion. Pues resumiendo un poco, nos regano x llegar a las 21.45, q era muy tarde, q por etica teniamos q haber cenado alli pq su habitacion es muy barata,q preferiamos darle el dinero a otras personas q no eran espanoles de enfrente q a ell,y q x eso no nos iba a dar el desayuno pq el desayuno lo regala pq la habitacion era muy barata ,otra vez. review_translated_text: The worst experience I've ever had with my wife anywhere. The whole unpleasant experience came from not telling her we weren't going to have dinner there. We didn't tell her because we agreed that if we did have dinner, we would let her know in advance. To sum it up, she told us off for arriving at 9:45 pm, which was too late, saying that for ethical reasons we had to have dinner there because her room was very cheap, that we preferred to give the money to other people across the street who weren't Spanish, and that because of that, she wasn't going to give us breakfast because she gave us breakfast for free because the room was very cheap. Again, she wanted to give us our money back and tell us to go somewhere else. She told us she was going to call the Civil Guard, which was very rude. And we were freaking out, because it was surreal, and answering her politely, on top of that. Obviously we slept there because we didn't want to go anywhere else because there was nothing on at that time and of course we weren't going to have breakfast no way and on top of that he tells us that you're sure to criticize me on social media now, what a great old man and the worst experience I could have had. Never stay there.

review_text: Des personnes agreables qui souhaitent mettre a l'aise et qui font tout pour. Je recommande.
review_translated_text: Pleasant people who want to make you feel comfortable and who do everything to do so. I recommend.

name: Niels Putter

name: Bauke Putter
review_text: Een goed hotel. De man was heel vriendelijk en gastvrij. Het ontbijt was lekker en de kamer was netjes. Boomerang cottage is een goed verblijf
review_translated_text: A good hotel. The man was very friendly and hospitable. The breakfast was tasty and the room was tidy. Boomerang cottage is a good stay

name: Nathalie Zahour
review_text: Un couple charmant, qui vous accueillera au mieux.
review_translated_text: A charming couple, who will welcome you in the best possible way.

name: KeldorM
review_text: Si quieres descansar, ducharte, dormir sin ruidos... esta casa rural no esta mal para una noche a un precio moderado. Es como ir a casa de tus abuelos, los cuales estan contigo en las zonas comunes todo el tiempo. |No hay TV en las habitaciones (dicen que las tocaban y desprogramaban y luego el tecnico son 60EU)|No hay secador de pelo (dicen que el ultimo se quemo y no tienen tiempo de comprar otro)|Horarios muy limitados, el desayuno es de 8h a 9h|Desayuno "mini"malista|No hay fruta, ni embutidos, ni yogures...|Aceite de NO oliva (relleno)|Zumo NO natural|(Mejor no saber como se rellenan las jarras)
review_translated_text: If you want to rest, shower, and sleep without noise... this rural house isn't bad for a night at a reasonable price. It's like going to your grandparents' house, who are with you in the common areas all the time. | There is no TV in the rooms (they say they used to touch them and deprogram them, and then the repairman costs EU60) | There is no hairdryer (they say the last one burned out and they don't have time to buy another) | Very limited hours; breakfast is from 8 to 9 a.m. | A "mini" breakfast | No fruit, no cold cuts, no yogurt... | No olive oil (refilled) | No natural juice | (It's better not to know how to refill the jugs)

name: P G
review_text: Kind hosts who will pick you up and bring you/drop you back to the Camino (for a small charge). House is charming, rooms clean and comfortable, and breakfast included. Dinner was ok but expensive (EU20) for what it was and they didn't tell us the price till the next morning.

name: Jose Diaz
review_text:
Es correcto, las habitaciones som grandes y esta limpio. Pero hay un cartel que pone que solo aceptan metalico. Si no vas por Booking. Aunque insistiendo un poco pude pagar una parte por transferencia.
La ubicacion esta un poco lejos del Camino de Santiago si vas caminando
review_translated_text:
It's fine. The rooms are large and clean. But there's a sign that says they only accept cash. If not, go through Booking. Although with a little persistence, I was able to pay part of the amount by bank transfer.
The location is a bit far from the Camino de Santiago if you're walking.

name: Cristina Gallego Hernandez
review_text: Casa antigua aprovechada para alquilar sus habitaciones. Zona comedor con dos mesas en las que te sientas con otros huespedes. Cena compuesta de una ensalada central, un segundo plato y postre. Desayuno sin embutido.
review_translated_text: Old house used to rent its rooms. Dining area with two tables where you sit with other guests. Dinner consisting of a main salad, a second course and dessert. Breakfast without sausage.

name: Reinona Chofia
review_text: Un lugar genuino y autentico
review_translated_text: A genuine and authentic place

name: Yaiza Lancina Rodriguez
review_text: Roberto y su mujer nos han tratado genial. Nos hemos sentido como en casa. Nos encantan las experiencias asi. Es una casa super antigua que han sabido adaptar para dar servicio de hospedaje. Les deseo lo mejor para que puedan estar pronto con su familia en Australia
review_translated_text: Roberto and his wife have treated us great. We have felt at home. We love experiences like this. It is a super old house that they have been able to adapt to provide lodging service. I wish you the best so that you can soon be with your family in Australia

name: Marga Majem Tarruella
review_text: El mejor Albergue de todo el camino. Trato exquisito, comida buenisima y precio super economico
review_translated_text: The best hostel on the entire Camino. Exquisite service, delicious food, and super affordable prices.

name: Maria jose martin
review_text:
Buenisimo trato con el dueno, muy amable y servicial.
Los desayunos son buenos. Tienen leche sin lactosa.
Las habitaciones grandes, espaciosas y las camas y almohadas muy comodas.
Todo muy limpio.
La ubicacion aunque la carretera ahora estaba en obras es muy buena, a 10 minutos de burgos. Pueblo muy tranquilo.
Repetire seguro.
review_translated_text:
Great deal with the owner, very friendly and helpful.
The breakfasts are good. They have lactose-free milk.
The rooms are large, spacious and the beds and pillows are very comfortable.
Everything very clean.
The location, although the road was now under construction, is very good, 10 minutes from Burgos. Very quiet town.
I will repeat for sure.

name: Monika Rudow
review_text: Es war ein sehr schones Zimmer, der Hausherr war sehr freundlich und hat uns am Abend lecker bekocht. Es war ruhig dort, obwohl es in der Nahe einer grosseren Strasse liegt.
review_translated_text: It was a very nice room, the landlord was very friendly and cooked delicious food for us in the evening. It was quiet there, even though it is close to a major road.
