name: Eduard X
review_text: Encantadora estancia, muy recomendable y super amables. Edificio bien restaurado. Hemos estado muy a gusto y hablado mucho con Rodrigo, muy viajado
review_translated_text: Lovely stay, highly recommended and super friendly. Well restored building. We have been very comfortable and talked a lot with Rodrigo, who is well traveled.

name: O4535
review_text: Un accueil chaleureux et convivial vraiment nous recommandons de plus possibilite pour motards d'un garage privat et securise |Apres une belle route ensoleille...|FREE CHAPTER ROCHEFORT Didier &Carole
review_translated_text: A warm and friendly welcome, we really recommend it, plus the possibility for bikers of a private and secure garage | After a beautiful sunny road... | FREE CHAPTER ROCHEFORT Didier & Carole

name: Sera Elepe
review_text: Moscas muuuchas moscas
review_translated_text: Flies many flies

name: MariaJorge Montez
review_text:
E um local de alojamento, explorado por um casal simpatico, numa casa antiga.
O quarto nao estava muito limpo no chao e tinha uma almofada no armario com cabelos e uma mancha amarela. Nao senti seguranca para a usar.
O pequeno almoco e como se fosse em casa, mas nada abastado.
Dou 4 estrelas pela simpatia do Sr.
review_translated_text:
It is a place to stay, run by a friendly couple, in an old house.
The room was not very clean on the floor and there was a pillow in the closet with hair and a yellow stain. I didn't feel safe using it.
The breakfast is like at home, but not very rich.
I give it 4 stars because of the friendliness of the gentleman.

name: XavierJardi
review_text: Excelente trato, totalmente familiar y en un enclave de ruta bueno.|Es una casa grande con 4 habitaciones y un servicio mas parecido a alojarte en casa de un pariente lejano que de hotel.|Su ubicacion cerca de la autopista (pero no pegado) hacen que si vas en ruta, sea buena eleccion.
review_translated_text: Excellent service, completely family-friendly, and in a good location on the route. It's a large house with four rooms and service that's more like staying at a distant relative's house than a hotel. Its location near the highway (but not right next to it) makes it a good choice if you're traveling on the route.

name: Jordi Diaz Mata
review_text: Com a lloc de pas esta molt be i el Rodrigo (amfitrio) es molt amable i agradable, no podem dir el mateix de l'amfitriona pero. Esta lluny de Burgos, pero per anar-hi de pas no esta malament del tot.
review_translated_text: As a stopover it is very good and Rodrigo (host) is very kind and pleasant, we can't say the same about the hostess though. It is far from Burgos, but for a stopover it is not bad at all.

name: ANIBAL SANCHEZ TERUEL
review_text:
Para pasar una o dos noches, de paso, esta bastante bien. Los propietarios son super simpaticos y te aconsejan, estan a tu disposicion a todo momento y ademas, repasas ingles con la propietaria australiana.
Las camas son muy comodas, el bano tambien esta bien y el desayuno tambien, aunque deberia haber mas cosas saladas.

!Fantastico!
review_translated_text:
To spend one or two nights, in passing, it is quite good. The owners are super friendly and advise you, they are at your disposal at all times and you also review English with the Australian owner.
The beds are very comfortable, the bathroom is also good and the breakfast is also good, although there should be more salty things.

Fantastic!

name: Jeroen van Heck
review_text: Muy limpio, muy comodo y buen trato. Aparcar sin problema ninguna. Desayuno cafe con tostada y zumo.
review_translated_text: Very clean, very comfortable and good treatment. Parking without any problem. Breakfast coffee with toast and juice.

name: Marie-Christine Chartier
review_text: Merci pour cet accueil chaleureux, comme a la maison avec le service en prime. Literie tres agreable, dinner et petit dejeuner simple et parfait. Adresse a retenir et partager.
review_translated_text: Thank you for this warm welcome, like at home with the added service. Very pleasant bedding, simple and perfect dinner and breakfast. Address to remember and share.

name: Abdellah CHAKER
review_text: Service chaleureux et contact agreable hotes tres accueillant
review_translated_text: Warm service and pleasant contact, very welcoming hosts

name: Paz R. Villanueva
review_text: Autentico y a la vez singular B&B ubicado en el pueblecito de Quintanapalla-alfoz de Burgos y muy  proximo a esta ciudad-que es el lugar del  real matrimonio  real de Carlos I y Ma Luisa-precisamente en la casona donde se ubica este alojamiento-hoy regentado  por un matrimonio que ha apostado por volver al lugar de las  raices de el para darle vida.Muy recomendable para conocer Atapuerca.
review_translated_text: Authentic and at the same time unique B&B located in the small town of Quintanapalla-alfoz de Burgos and very close to this city-which is the place of the royal marriage of Carlos I and Ma Luisa-precisely in the mansion where this accommodation is located-today run by a couple who have opted to return to the place of their roots to give it life.Highly recommended to get to know Atapuerca.
experience_details: [{"name":"Trip type","value":"Business"},{"name":"Travel group","value":"Solo"},{"name":"Hotel highlights","value":"Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value"}]

name: Silvia Dublinia
review_text: De los mas economicos en la zona e incluyen desayuno!! Llegamos tarde y nos ofrecieron posibilidad de cena, muy de agradecer. Es una casona con encanto ideal para Camino de Santiago o visitar Atapuerca. Habitaciones muy grandes familiares con bano en suite. Muy tranquilo y comodo. Chimenea en el gran  salon y habitaciones calentitas con amenities y extra de mantas y almohadas. Los duenos nos hicieron sentir como en casa. Hay servicio de recoleccion de maletas o transporte. Si hace buen tiempo tienen jardin frontal muy bonito. El pueblo solo tiene 1 bar pero esta cerca de otros pueblos bonitos
review_translated_text: One of the most affordable in the area and includes breakfast! We arrived late and were offered dinner, which was very welcome. It's a charming mansion, ideal for the Camino de Santiago or visiting Atapuerca. Very large family rooms with en suite bathrooms. Very quiet and comfortable. There's a fireplace in the large living room and warm rooms with amenities and extra blankets and pillows. The owners made us feel right at home. They offer luggage collection or transportation services. If the weather is nice, they have a lovely front garden. The town only has one bar, but it's close to other pretty towns.

name: Angela Sopelana
review_text: La habitacion muy amplia y limpia. El dueno, un hombre encantador y muy hablador, nos estuvo contando cosas de su vida y la historia de la casa. El desayuno tambien muy bien. Volveremos
review_translated_text: The room was very spacious and clean. The owner, a charming and very talkative man, was telling us things about his life and the history of the house. Breakfast also very good. We will return

name: Benoit Martine
review_text: tres bon lieu et accueil tres agreable les chambres sont parfaites le dinee un peu cher mais le proprietaire et au petit soin de madame qui en profite un peut
review_translated_text: very good place and very pleasant welcome the rooms are perfect the dinner a little expensive but the owner and the little care of the lady who benefits a little

name: Feli90
review_text: Todo Perfecto. Los Duenos son maravillosos, la limpieza perfecta, el lugar es preciosos. No tengo ninguna pega, la comida generosa y buena. Habitacion amplia. En fin, no tengo nada malo que objetar.todo ok
review_translated_text: Everything was perfect. The owners are wonderful, the cleanliness was perfect, and the place is beautiful. I have no complaints at all. The food was generous and good. The room was spacious. In short, I have nothing negative to say. Everything was fine.

name: Alicia Gonzalez
review_text: Espectacular. La habitacion es super grande, te hacen la cena ellos, esta super limpio, hay wifi, el desayuno esta incluido y es buffet libre... Lo recomiendo 100%.
review_translated_text: Spectacular. The room is super big, they make dinner for you, it is super clean, there is Wi-Fi, breakfast is included and it is an open buffet... I recommend it 100%.

name: Lamo Litin
review_text: Nous avons reserve mi-octobre 2 chambres pour fin decembre via Booking, la reservation a ete validee.  Nous avons envoye un message la veille pour donner notre heure d'arrivee, aucune reponse ... Nous avons envoye un SMS le jour J, aucune reponse. Par contre la carte de credit a bien ete debitee ! Durant notre trajet, nous avons appele car nous etions en chemin et notre hote nous apprend que l'etablissement est ferme ! Ce n'est vraiment pas correct de ne pas nous avoir prevenu avant notre depart, encore moins de ne pas avoir repondu a notre demande de la veille. Nous nous sommes retrouves sans reservation le jour J. Aucune communication....
review_translated_text: We booked 2 rooms in mid-October for the end of December via Booking.com, and the reservation was confirmed. We sent a message the day before to give our arrival time, but no response... We sent a text message on the day, but no response. However, the credit card was debited! During our trip, we called because we were on the way, and our host told us that the establishment was closed! It was really not right not to have warned us before our departure, let alone not to have responded to our request the day before. We found ourselves without a reservation on the day. No communication...

name: piti mazagatos
review_text:
Casa vieja reformada para salir del paso....pero acogedor.
Rodrigo ... muy hablador y preocupado por tu estancia. Limpio.
review_translated_text:
Renovated old house, just out of the way... but cozy.
Rodrigo... very talkative and concerned about your stay. Clean.

name: Juan Carlos Alcaide Ibanez
review_text:
Un oasis de paz. Una atencion excelente. Un precio sin igual. Un desayuno suculento.
Estar a las afueras de Burgos no le quita valor.
Super recomendable.
review_translated_text:
An oasis of peace. Excellent attention. A price without equal. A succulent breakfast.
Being on the outskirts of Burgos does not detract from its value.
Super recommended.

name: Alberto Sanchez Vicente
review_text: Genial
review_translated_text: Brilliant

name: Jose Baldovi
review_text: Trato bueno
review_translated_text: Good treatment

name: Florence Bourgeois
review_text:
Lieu atypique ,avec emplacement pour garager voiture.lit peu confortable la chambre est penchee et le lit de meme.
Madame est  australienne et Mr Portugais ,Mr fais Madame est servie au ordre de Mme.Nous sommes Francais et ne parlons pas ou peu anglais et Portugais pas les bienvenus et surtout pas d effort .petit dejeuner convenable mais nous avons accepte le repas du soir etant a quelques minutes de la ville de Burgos ,35 euros pour deux ,bon mais trop chere pour la quantite ,un piege a touriste .bon pour une halte .
review_translated_text:
Atypical place, with space to park the car. Bed not very comfortable, the room is slanted and the bed is the same.
Madam is Australian and Mr. Portuguese, Mr. does Madam is served to the order of Mrs. We are French and speak little or no English and Portuguese not welcome and especially no effort. Breakfast adequate but we accepted the evening meal being a few minutes from the city of Burgos, 35 euros for two, good but too expensive for the quantity, a tourist trap. Good for a stopover.

name: Silvio
review_text: Pueblo Quintanapalla, a un paso de Atapuerca, Burgos.  Casa rural que te transporta al pasado. Muy tranquilo y limieza, trato cercano, y comida casera.
review_translated_text: Quintanapalla Village, just a stone's throw from Atapuerca, Burgos. A rural house that transports you back in time. Very quiet and clean, with friendly service and homemade food.

name: Peter Sjostedt
review_text: Prisvart boende. Har personligen lite svart for den spanska frukosten, hade garna sett lite skinka, korv och ost ocksa.
review_translated_text: Affordable accommodation. Personally, I have a bit of a problem with the Spanish breakfast, would have liked to see some ham, sausage and cheese too.

name: Walter Guerrero
review_text: Le top un petit village tipique
review_translated_text: The best, a typical little village

name: Jorge Morales
review_text:
Nos encontramos alojados en esta maravilloso caserio.
A nuestra llegada nos recibio Rodrigo y su esposa Hazel, de quienes hemos podido conocer de primera mano los misterios de este encantador lugar y sus alrededores.
La limpieza y el sitio de diez, la pena que estamos de paso y nos perderemos muchas cosas por ver.
Amenazamos con volver a visitar a esta fantastica familia y poder terminar nuestra aventura por Quintanapalla.
review_translated_text:
We are staying in this wonderful farmhouse.
Upon our arrival we were welcomed by Rodrigo and his wife Hazel, from whom we were able to learn first-hand about the mysteries of this charming place and its surroundings.
The cleanliness and the place are ten, it's a shame that we are passing through and we will miss many things to see.
We threaten to visit this fantastic family again and be able to finish our adventure through Quintanapalla.

name: Val Brl
review_text:
Bien situee , bonne literie, le Mr tres disponible et tres gentil par contre la dame pas tres gracieuse.
Detour recommande pour une nuit
review_translated_text:
Well located, good bedding, the Mr very available and very kind on the other hand the lady not very gracious.
Recommended detour for one night

name: khadija
review_text: Tres belle chambre d'hotes bien decoree et avec tout le necessaire. Le petit dejeuner est correct. On est tres bien accueilli par le proprietaire un vrai personnage. Parfaitement situe pour visiter Burgos.
review_translated_text: Very nice guest room, well decorated and with everything you need. Breakfast is ok. We are very well received by the owner, a real character. Perfectly located for visiting Burgos.

name: Marc Fuller
review_text: Une maison de famille tres ancienne (600 ans !) perdue au milieu de nulle part. Tres bon accueil des proprietaires, parking assure. Les chambres sont spacieuses et equipees correctement. Diner sur place simple et bon, mais un poil cher. Ideal pour une halte vers l'Andalousie depuis la France. Parlent l'espagnol et anglais.
review_translated_text: A very old family home (600 years old!) lost in the middle of nowhere. The owners gave us a very warm welcome, and parking was guaranteed. The rooms are spacious and well-equipped. Dinner on site was simple and good, but a bit pricey. Ideal for a stopover on the way to Andalusia from France. They speak Spanish and English.

name: Emmanuelle de brito
review_text: Hotes tres sympathiques, chambre propre et spacieuse. Bons repas (soir et matin)
review_translated_text: Very friendly hosts, clean and spacious room. Good meals (evening and morning)

name: GUY DEBEAUVAIS
review_text:
Belle maison ancienne
Petit village de pierre. Tres bonne literie neuve. Hotes tres accueillants.
review_translated_text:
Beautiful old house
Small stone village. Very good new bedding. Very welcoming hosts.

name: Maria Luisa Fernandez Perez
review_text: Es de los pocos sitios que he viajado y me he alojado que no volveria en otra ocasion! Ya he puesto mi resenas en otro sitio y no quiero volver a repetirlo!
review_translated_text: It is one of the few places I have traveled and stayed that I would not return to again! I've already put my reviews on another site and I don't want to repeat it again!

name: Nahi Ab
review_text:
Una casa rural con mucho encanto.

La habitacion muy limpia, sin television, con bano de ducha y secador de pelo.

La estancia muy agradable sobre todo por el trato tan familiar recibido por el matrimonio que lo regenta.

El residente de Quintanapalla y ella australiana, que nos acompanaron tanto en la cena como en el desayuno.

La cena muy buena y el desayuno tambien.

En nuestro caso estabamos haciendo el camino de santiago y por la manana recibimos una llamada del hotel por si nos encontrabamos lejos del hotel para venir a recogernos y al dia siguiente dejarnos en el mismo punto de nuestro camino.

Fue un placer hablar con ellos, bueno sobre todo con el, ya que la mujer hablaba poco espanol y nuestro ingles no es muy bueno, a lo que iba, que siempre es un placer esos ratos de charlas en los que te cuentan cosas del pueblo, de la casa,...
review_translated_text:
A rural house with a lot of charm.

The room was very clean, without television, with a shower and hairdryer.

The stay was very pleasant, especially because of the familiar treatment received by the couple that runs it.

The Quintanapalla resident and the Australian, who joined us for both dinner and breakfast.

Very good dinner and breakfast too.

In our case we were doing the Camino de Santiago and in the morning we received a call from the hotel in case we were far from the hotel to come pick us up and the next day drop us off at the same point on our route.

It was a pleasure to talk to them, especially with him, since the woman spoke little Spanish and our English is not very good, as I was saying, it is always a pleasure to have those moments of conversation in which they tell you things about the town, the house,...

name: Linda Bannister
review_text: Wonderful overnight stop, the owner's we're really lovely

name: Neil Blackett
review_text:
Old and quirky building in a very quiet village.
Comfy bed, good shower, goid breakfast and attentive hosts.
Ideal for an overnight stop if north of Madrid.

name: rocio chimeno
review_text:
Lugar muy agradable, tanto la casa como los duenos. Hemos estado una noche y nos ha parecido estupendo.. El desayuno genial, como la conversacion que tienes con ellos. Son un encanto.
Gracias!!!!
review_translated_text:
Very nice place, both the house and the owners. We stayed one night and thought it was great. The breakfast was great, as was the conversation you have with them. They are charming.
Thank you!!!!

name: marina de mingo
review_text: Repetire seguro
review_translated_text: I will repeat for sure

name: Silvia Ferrera
review_text: Como en casa, la atencion y carino de los propietarios. Junto a Burgos, un pueblo pequeno y tranquilo. La casa muy antigua, sin tele en la habitacion que nos parecio genial. Una casa con mucha historia. Nos gusto y si nos pilla cerca en otro viaje, volveremos seguro. Estupendo desayuno.
review_translated_text: Just like home, the owners' attention and warmth. Near Burgos, a small, quiet town. The house is very old, with no TV in the room, which we thought was great. A house steeped in history. We liked it, and if we're close by on another trip, we'll definitely return. Great breakfast.

name: Maria Fernandez
review_text: El lugar es precioso y el dormitorio, la cena de penay al dia siguiente nos tuvimos que ir porque nos hicieron un overbooking, asi que a 400 km de casa y sin alojamiento.
review_translated_text: The place is beautiful and the bedroom, the Pena dinner the next day we had to leave because they overbooked us, so 400 km from home and without accommodation.

name: isabel segovia vargas
review_text: El fin de semana pasado fue especial, correr de nuevo en el mejor Cross del mundo es increible, y ademas pasar la noche en Boomerang cottage ha hecho la experiencia inolvidable, gracias a Rodrigo y a Hazel por estar en todo momento pendientes de nuestro bienestar, nos volveremos a ver
review_translated_text: Last weekend was special, racing again in the best Cross Country in the world is incredible, and also spending the night at Boomerang cottage has made the experience unforgettable, thanks to Rodrigo and Hazel for always being attentive to our well-being, we will see each other again.

name: Daniel Gonzalez Laguna
review_text: Un lugar muy acogedor y tranquilo, comida casera. Nos hemos sentido como en casa gracias a la hospitalidad de Hazel y Rodrigo.
review_translated_text: A very cozy and quiet place, homemade food. We have felt at home thanks to the hospitality of Hazel and Rodrigo.

name: PILAR LOPEZ
review_text: Encantadora pareja ambos anfitriones, bonito lugar, muy carismatico y te hacen sentir en un ambiente muy familiar y entranable
review_translated_text: Lovely couple, both hosts, nice place, very charismatic and they make you feel in a very familiar and endearing atmosphere

name: Marian Vos
review_text:
De gast heer verdiend een dikke tien
Wat was dat een lieve man die erg zijn best deed het ons naar de zin te maken samen met zijn vrouw
Bij aankomst meteen een heerlijk koud pilsje
We  waren  laat maar de eigenaar maakte voor ons een heerlijk diner
En dat voor een schappelijke prijs
De kamers waren prachtig met mooi uitzicht

We komen hier zeker teug
review_translated_text:
The host deserves a big ten
What a sweet man he was who did his very best to make us feel at home together with his wife
A lovely cold beer immediately upon arrival
We were late but the owner made us a delicious dinner
And that for a reasonable price
The rooms were beautiful with a beautiful view

We will definitely come back here

name: Yugen Yachting & Maritime
review_text: This was a nice stop on our road trip and good value for money. We stayed one night in a large and comfortable room, everything was clean and the shower was also good. The chickpeas and the pig's trotters were terrible, nothing special.
We broke out in hives around lunchtime (we have no allergies) and we spent the whole afternoon with an upset stomach.
The cachopo had a very strange smell and wasn't even cooked properly.
The watermelon was spoiled, very soft and gelatinous.
And the cheesecake was served with a piece of paper and a hair on it. Thank goodness I noticed and put it aside.
Flies eat food.

Efectivamente el problema es que no veis las moscas y por eso no haceis nada para poner solucion.
No se si normalmente atendeis la terraza, pero seguro que lo haceis con malos comentarios como los que escuche el otro dia.
Os recomiendo usar esa energia en mejorar y no en contestar cuando recibis una mala resena. Un besito
response_from_owner_text:
Hola!! Hemos tardado en responder ya que hemos estado buscando las moscas que nos comentabas... aun no hemos visto ninguna!! 

Atendemos sin problema y con mucho carino a todos nuestros clientes en terraza, asi que si no ha sido asi os pedimos disculpas.

Saludos!

Typical restaurant full of flies where the waitresses exude joy, and complain in public about people ordering food on the terrace. Absolute lack of staff and professionalism. Also, high prices.
EDIT: As you can see, instead of trying to calm people down, they respond to reviews in a cocky tone.
Indeed the problem is that you do not see the flies and that is why you do nothing to solve them.
I don't know if you normally attend the terrace, but I'm sure you do with bad comments like the ones I heard the other day.
I recommend that you use that energy to improve and not to respond when you receive a bad review. a little kiss

Comimos menu y la verdad estuvo bueno en calidad-precio, raciones grandes, entrante, principal, bebida, cafe y postre por EU14.

De entrantes pedimos alubias y ensalada rusa, de principal churrasco y potro. Todo muy rico.
review_translated_text:
We were passing through the town and stumbled upon the Hostal Monica restaurant. We didn't know where to eat on the way to Orbaneja, and it was already late to find open restaurants. Seeing workers leaving, we took advantage and said, "This is it."

We had a set menu, and it was really good value for money: large portions, a starter, main course, a drink, coffee, and dessert for EU14.

For starters, we ordered beans and Russian salad, and for main courses, steak and pork belly. Everything was delicious.

Desde ese dia siempre que vamos a santander hacemos la parada para visitar a nuestro angel de la guarda, monica. Ojala vivir alli para poder verla todos los dias, gracias por todo.
review_translated_text:
It was a cold December day when we were heading to the beautiful town of Somo, with her great kindness Monica attended to three bikers, frozen like one of those ice cubes that are placed in tanks, and she saved us from significant hypothermia and from having died climbing the shield.
Since that day, whenever we go to Santander we make a stop to visit our guardian angel, Monica. I hope I live there so I can see her every day, thank you for everything.

Shortly after, my brother went to the bathroom and got locked in it, mystery solved, the screwdriver was to unblock the bathroom door :/. Not to mention the liquid soap in the bathroom that smelled bad, as if it had been open for a long time. How do you make soap smell bad? I still don't know, we arrived there and didn't spend a single night, we left as soon as we could, and I won't even tell you about the deal, the rest of the comments already tell you.

name: Fran Cerezo
review_text:
Nunca me habian mostrado tal grado de desconfianza en nungun hotel de los que he visitado, y la verdad es que son muchos.
Cuando llego al hotel me registro junto con un companero de trabajo, nos dan las habitaciones y bajo a ver si busco un sitio para aparcar, me doy unas vueltas por la zona y veo que es complicado, cuando vuelvo al hotel, le digo a la chica de recepcion que por favor me diga donde esta el parking para meter el coche, ella me contesta que tengo que abonarlo en ese momento y le digo qque cuando aparque me paso para abonarle los 15 EU que cuesta ya que me habia dejado la cartera en la habitacion, ella me contesta que si no lo abono al momento no me deja meteer el coche.
Es tal el grado de indignacion que me produjo en ese momento, que me fui y aparque finalmente fuera.

En conclusion, nunca mas volvere a ese hotel ni a los de la cadena, y por supuesto nungun companero de mi empresa.
review_translated_text:
I've never been shown such a level of distrust in any hotel I've ever visited, and the truth is, there are many.
When I arrive at the hotel, I check in with a coworker. They give us our rooms, and I go downstairs to see if I can find a parking space. I walk around the area a bit and find it's complicated. When I return to the hotel, I ask the receptionist to please tell me where the parking lot is so I can park my car. She tells me I have to pay for it right away. I tell her that when I park, I'll stop by to pay the EU15 fee since I left my wallet in the room. She replies that if I don't pay it right away, she won't let me park my car.
I was so outraged at that moment that I left and eventually parked outside.

In conclusion, I will never return to that hotel or any of the other hotels in the chain, and certainly not any of my colleagues at my company.

name: Patricia Ordonez Rodriguez
review_text:
Muy cerca del centro. A 10 minutos andando.
Cama muy comoda. Almohadas quizas un poco blandas y bajas para mi gusto pero es algo muy subjetivo.
Vistas desde la habitacion preciosas a la catedral.
Personal muy agradable.
Desayuno bufet completo.
No le he puesto las 5 estrellas porque todas las opciones de desayuno eran industriales, hasta los zumos, el bizcocho, las mermeladas, la miel, etc.
Reconozco que soy un poro tiquismiquis con el tema de la comida casera, ecologica, etc y es una pena que en un sitio con tan buena gastronomia como Burgos no tuvieran algo mas casero...
Por lo demas todo estupendo. Repetiria en este hotel.
review_translated_text:
Very close to the center. A 10-minute walk.
Very comfortable bed. Pillows perhaps a little soft and low for my taste, but that's subjective.
Beautiful views of the cathedral from the room.
Very pleasant staff.
Full buffet breakfast.
I didn't give it 5 stars because all the breakfast options were industrial, even the juices, cake, jams, honey, etc.
I admit I'm a bit picky about homemade, organic food, etc., and it's a shame that in a place with such good cuisine like Burgos, they didn't have something more home-style.
Otherwise, everything was great. I would stay at this hotel again.

name: Viajo 2
review_text:
El hall del hotel esta correcto pero los pasillos estan viejisimos, huele mal, las habitaciones no estan insonorizadas, no hay nevera, y las habitaciones necesitan una renovacion.
El desayuno es muy Justo, incluso comida en estado dudoso... no volveremos a alojarnos alli. Es mejor que cobren un poco mas y aumenten la calidad de la comida y arreglen las instalaciones.
review_translated_text:
The hotel lobby is fine, but the hallways are very old, smelly, the rooms are not soundproofed, there's no refrigerator, and the rooms need renovation.
The breakfast is very fair, even the food is in questionable condition... we won't stay there again. They'd better charge a little more, improve the quality of the food, and fix the facilities.

name: M. Gorri
review_text:
Nuestra estancia en este hotel fue un autentico desastre. A pesar de que la fachada del lugar por fuera parece bonita, al entrar en las habitaciones la decepcion fue total. Las paredes viejas y rotas, las cortinas caidas, marcas por todas partes... y un bano con una ducha y sanitarios completamente anticuados. Lo peor de todo fue el estado del bano, donde el unico "regalo" era un triste y escaso trocito de jabon de manos.

Sin lugar a dudas, lo mas impactante fue el desayuno. La comida estaba en un estado pesimo: productos en mal estado y algunos incluso con sabor avinagrado. La variedad era minima, y lo poco que habia estaba malisimo. El revuelto de huevo era incomible, lo mismo que el queso, el yogur y la fruta, todo seco y con signos de haber estado alli durante dias o incluso semanas.

Lo unico positivo que encontramos fue la limpieza. Las sabanas estaban en perfectas condiciones y las limpiadoras fueron muy amables. Sin embargo, a pesar de la limpieza, no volveriamos a este hotel ni aunque nos lo regalaran. Una experiencia horrible.
review_translated_text:
Our stay at this hotel was a real disaster. Although the facade of the place looks pretty from the outside, upon entering the rooms the disappointment was total. Old and broken walls, fallen curtains, marks everywhere... and a bathroom with a completely outdated shower and toilets. The worst of all was the state of the bathroom, where the only "gift" was a sad and scarce piece of hand soap.

Without a doubt, the most impressive thing was the breakfast. The food was in a terrible state: products in poor condition and some even tasted vinegary. The variety was minimal, and what little there was was terrible. The scrambled egg was inedible, as was the cheese, yogurt and fruit, all dry and showing signs of having been there for days or even weeks.

The only positive thing we found was the cleanliness. The sheets were in perfect condition and the cleaners were very friendly. However, despite the cleanliness, we would not return to this hotel even if it were given to us as a gift. A horrible experience.

name: David
review_text:
Reservamos una habitacion con terraza supuestamente, tal y como se puede ver en las fotos de la habitacion (pagina web oficial del hotel). Llamamos a recepcion y nos dijeron que la habitacion con terraza era otra, les ensenamos las fotos de su propia web y como no habia disponibilidad nos tuvimos que quedar con una habitacion que no correspondia con la descripcion, encima habia habitaciones iguales por 30EU menos (no cogemos la habitacion por tener vistas a la catedral, la cogemos para tener terraza y poder fumar, por tanto, resulto muy incomodo esto, ya que habia que bajar a fumar. Nos sentimos completamente estafados, en otro momento hubiese puesto una hoja de reclamaciones, pero sinceramente no teniamos ni ganas ni tiempo para hacerlo. A cambio nos incluyeron el desayuno gratis, pero un desayuno de 9EU no compensa esto, ademas por motivos de trabajo, estuvimos trabajando toda la noche y no disfrutamos del desayuno, tambien hay que decir que nos prepararon unos sandwiches para nuestra salida, detalle que agradecimos, la chica de recepcion en todo momento nos atendio muy bien.
Habitacion en terminos generales normalita, desde mi punto de vista el precio no corresponde con las calidades, por motivos de trabajo viajamos mucho y hemos estado en habitaciones muchisimo mejores por un precio similar, pensamos que el precio es alto solo por poder ver el tejado de la catedral.
Para acceder y salir del parking, sistema completamente incomodo.
Sinceramente, veo dificil que repitamos la estancia si volvemos a Burgos, a ningun cliente le gusta sentirse enganado y la solucion no fue satisfactoria para nosotros.
Igualmente agradecemos nuevamente la implicacion por parte de la chica de recepcion, no es una situacion sencilla para un empleado tener que solventar una situacion asi.
review_translated_text:
We booked a room with a terrace supposedly, as can be seen in the photos of the room (official hotel website). We called the reception and they told us that the room with a terrace was another one, we showed them the photos from their own website and since there was no availability we had to stay with a room that did not correspond to the description, on top of that there were identical rooms for EU30 less (we did not take the room for having views of the cathedral, we took it to have a terrace and to be able to smoke, therefore, this was very uncomfortable, since we had to go downstairs to smoke. We felt completely scammed, at another time I would have put in a complaint form, but honestly we had neither the desire nor the time to do it. In exchange they included us with free breakfast, but a EU9 breakfast does not compensate for this, also for work reasons, we were working all night and we did not enjoy breakfast, it must also be said that they prepared some sandwiches for us for our departure, a detail that we appreciated, the girl at the reception took great care of us at all times.
Room in general terms normal, from my point of view the price does not correspond to the qualities, for work reasons we travel a lot and we have been in much better rooms for a similar price, we think that the price is high just to be able to see the roof of the cathedral.
To enter and exit the parking lot, a completely uncomfortable system.
Honestly, I find it difficult for us to repeat our stay if we return to Burgos, no client likes to feel cheated and the solution was not satisfactory for us.
We also appreciate again the involvement of the girl at the reception, it is not a simple situation for an employee to have to solve a situation like this.

Es una zona muy buena y pudimos aparcar en la misma calle sin necesidad de utilizar el parking. En llegar al centro, se tarda, literalmente, 5 minutos.
Estuvimos en la novena planta. Habitacion amplia, reformada, con parque. Muy limpia y acogedora.
El desayuno con chacinas, algo de bolleria, fruta, cereales y los tipicos huevos con bacon y salchichas. Le pongo pegas al pan. Estamos en Espana y hay una variedad extensa y rica... Y solo tenian unas mini pulguitas y pan de molde. Si siempre sobra el pan de molde, es por algo...
Al checkout, comente un problema que tuvimos en la habitacion con el colchon y la recepcionista sobre la marcha, lo pido en conocimiento para darle solucion. Muy eficaz. Me ha gustado mucho. No le doy las 5* a la habitacion por el problema del colchon que tuve.
review_translated_text:
We were in Burgos during the Cidiana week weekend and chose this hotel for its location. We were right. From the highway, it takes two minutes to reach the hotel. It's a very good area, and we were able to park on the same street without having to use the parking lot. Getting to the center takes literally five minutes.
We were on the ninth floor. Our room was spacious, renovated, with parquet flooring. Very clean and cozy.
Breakfast included cured meats, some pastries, fruit, cereal, and the typical eggs with bacon and sausages. I have a minor complaint about the bread. We're in Spain, and there's a wide and delicious variety... And they only had mini sandwiches and sliced   bread. If there's always leftover sliced   bread, there's a reason...
At checkout, I mentioned a problem we had in the room with the mattress, and the receptionist was quick to respond. I'll let her know so she can resolve it. Very efficient. I really liked it. I'm not giving the room a 5* because of the mattress problem I had.

name: JAIME HUMBERTO TORRES LEON
review_text:
Buena atencion y muy buen servicio.
Las habitaciones muy bien aseadas y cuidadas
review_translated_text:
Good attention and very good service.
The rooms are very well cleaned and maintained.

name: Conde Aranda
review_text: Amables, limpio, comodo en la ubicacion. Me resulto caro 100  euros la hab. individual y el ascensor un ruido terrorifico.
review_translated_text: Friendly, clean, convenient location. I found it expensive at 100 euros for a single room, and the elevator was terribly noisy.

name: Nina Strolz
review_text:
Bad in Ordnung. Zimmer super laut auf Hauptstrasse, man denkt das Fenster ware offen, obwohl es geschlossen ist. Bekam ein Zimmer mit Verbindungsture - man hort leider jedes einzelne Wort, als ware diese Tur gar nicht vorhanden. Leider keine Bar vorhanden.
Personal sehr nett.
Lage des Hotels sehr gut. 5-10 Gehminuten in der Altstadt.
review_translated_text:
Bathroom OK. Room super noisy on the main street, you think the window is open even though it is closed. I was given a room with a connecting door - unfortunately you can hear every single word as if the door didn't even exist. Unfortunately there is no bar.
Staff very nice.
Location of the hotel very good. 5-10 minutes walk to the old town.

name: Marina Romero hernandez
review_text: El hotel esta bien, tiene todo lo necesario. El desayuno esta rico. El suelo de mi habitacion no estaba demasiado limpio. El hotel tiene 11 pisos y 2 ascensores, los cuales si hay mucha afluencia de gente utilizandolos tienes que esperar muchisimo para poder cogerlo. Estuve literalmente 10 minutos para que viniera el ascensor y poder bajar. Mal
review_translated_text: The hotel is good, it has everything you need. Breakfast is delicious. The floor in my room was not very clean. The hotel has 11 floors and 2 elevators, which if there is a lot of people using them you have to wait a long time to take them. It took me literally 10 minutes for the elevator to come so I could go down. Evil

name: Bartolome Romero Carretero
review_text: La habitacion muy, muy chica. Mal insonorizada con el exterior, se oye el aire muchisimo. La mesa, es una tabla suelta, que habia que tener cuidado de no caerse. Muy caro para el estado que se encuentra el hotel
review_translated_text: The room is very, very small. Poorly soundproofed from the outside, you can hear the air a lot. The table is a loose board, you had to be careful not to fall. Very expensive for the condition of the hotel

name: Cristobal Marco Rubert
review_text: Buen hotel, para ver Burgos y su provincia.
review_translated_text: Good hotel for seeing Burgos and its province.

name: C8845VQbarryd
review_text: Not the best at all.... A hotel with no bar, no restaurant and no tea/coffee making facilities..The coffee shop they advertise is actually a small room with coffee and food vending machine. The underground car park is grand in size, but trying to get in is another matter. Very tight squeeze down a ramp. Be careful if you have a hire car. The decor and room furniture is very dated. In bad need of a renovation. Outside my room stains on the wall. On the plus side, staff very friendly and helpful. Breakfast wasn't too bad. Location is near to town so handy. All in all, I wouldn't stay there again.. More of a hostel that a hotel.

name: Luis Angosto
review_text: No siendo un hotel de lujo, esta bastante bien. Habitacion muy limpias y confortables. El personal amabilisimo y eficiente.
review_translated_text: Not being a luxury hotel, it is quite good. Very clean and comfortable room. Very friendly and efficient staff.

name: jci eisa
review_text: Buena ubicacion, a 10 minutos andando de la catedral, zona tranquila y parking opcional, habitacion limpia y buena atencion en recepcion, repetiria sin dudarlo.
review_translated_text: Good location, 10 minutes walk from the cathedral, quiet area and optional parking, clean room and good service at reception, I would repeat without hesitation.

name: Dolores Fernandez
review_text: Hotel en Burgos  a 10 minutos andando del casco antiguo y la catedral. Limpio, buen desayuno y zona blanca para aparcar. Muy bien en general.
review_translated_text: Hotel in Burgos, 10 minutes walk from the old town and the cathedral. Clean, good breakfast and white parking area. Very good overall.

name: Maria Jose
review_text:
Quisimos hacer una reserva en diferentes ocasiones a traves de Wonderbox.
La primera vez nos rechazaron por ser temporada alta (mes de julio), el segundo intento nos pusieron pegas por las fechas que no estaban disponibles los dias que ofrecia la caja (4 noches) y el ultimo intento ya no trabajan con el servicio de Wonderbox.
review_translated_text:
We wanted to make a reservation on different occasions through Wonderbox.
The first time they rejected us because it was high season (July), the second attempt they gave us problems because the dates were not available on the days that the box offered (4 nights) and the last attempt they no longer work with the Wonderbox service.

name: Holacarola
review_text: Hotel perfecto  y con lo necesario para pasar un fin de semana, personal muy amable y desayuno correcto, bien situado ya que esta cerca del centro pero en una zona tranquila
review_translated_text: Perfect hotel with everything you need to spend a weekend, very friendly staff and correct breakfast, well located since it is close to the center but in a quiet area

name: enrique garcia
review_text: Relativamente centrico y accesible. Bastante comodo y habitaciones luminosas
review_translated_text: Relatively central and accessible. Quite comfortable and with bright rooms.

name: Rafael Exposito Cordero
review_text: Todo correcto
review_translated_text: Everything is correct

name: Pikkolomondano
review_text: partito con ottime aspettative. L'albergo si presenta bene, ha un buon parcheggio (a pagamento) e la colazione e dignitosa per un 3 stelle. Il problema che ho riscontrato e la piccolezza della camera che ci e stata assegnata. Appoggiare una valigia per aprirla .. non c'era spazio. Per una notte ci puo stare, ma se dovete starci anche solo 2.... c'e di meglio.
review_translated_text: left with great expectations. The hotel looks good, has good parking (for a fee) and the breakfast is decent for a 3 star. The problem I found is the smallness of the room we were assigned. Leaving a suitcase to open it .. there was no room. For one night it can be okay, but if you have to stay even just 2 .... there are better.

name: Dario Naranjo Jimenez
review_text: Hotel muy cerca de la Catedral de Burgos con habitaciones suficientemente amplias y bano reformado, se echa en falta una nevera. En las inmediaciones (5 minutos caminando) hay parking publico gratis y se aparca sin problemas. Lo mejor es la ubicacion, lo peor, quizas su personal tan serio y seco.
review_translated_text: A hotel very close to Burgos Cathedral with fairly spacious rooms and a renovated bathroom. The only drawback is a refrigerator. There's free public parking nearby (a five-minute walk), and parking is easy. The best thing is the location; the worst thing, perhaps, is the unprofessional and abrupt staff.

name: Indira Aniorte
review_text: El hotel esta muy bien situado, a 10 minutos andando de la catedral de Burgos. Las habitaciones estan bien y el bano esta reformado, se echa en falta una mininevera en la habitacion. Hay parking de pago pero se puede aparcar facil en las inmediaciones del hotel. Muy bien de precio para dormir un par de noches.
review_translated_text: The hotel is very well located, a 10-minute walk from Burgos Cathedral. The rooms are fine and the bathroom is renovated. The only thing missing is a mini-fridge in the room. There is paid parking, but parking is easy near the hotel. A very good value for a couple of nights' sleep.

name: Giuseppe Fabrizio
review_text: Hotel para salir del paso en un lugar bien situado. A las habitaciones les hace falta un profundo repaso.
review_translated_text: Hotel to get by in a well-located place. The rooms need a thorough review.

name: MARIA CARRERA
review_text: Excellent location and extremely friendly and helpful staff, however, it's crying out for a renovation!

name: Emmanuel Gasnier
review_text:
L'etablissement, grand, a bonne allure. L'accueil est courtois. La chambre n'est pas specialement spacieuse, la literie est relativement confortable.
La ou le bat blesse, c'est du cote de la climatisation : certes elle fonctionne, mais elle engendre de la condensation. Resultat : un bruit de goutte a goutte toute la nuit et une flaque d'eau sur le sol au matin !
Le petit-dejeuner, dans une salle au sous-sol, est simplement deficient : ne sont servis que des ingredients bas de gamme (mention speciale au jambon blanc, particulierement peu attirant, et aux viennoiseries, insipides).
En conclusion, ne vous laissez pas berner par les trois etoiles de cet hotel : le compte n'y est pas.
review_translated_text:
The establishment, large, looks good. The welcome is courteous. The room is not particularly spacious, the bedding is relatively comfortable.
Where the problem lies is with the air conditioning: it certainly works, but it causes condensation. Result: a dripping noise all night and a puddle of water on the floor in the morning!
The breakfast, in a room in the basement, is simply deficient: only low-end ingredients are served (special mention to the white ham, particularly unattractive, and the pastries, which are tasteless).
In conclusion, don't be fooled by the three stars of this hotel: it's not there.

name: Maria del Carmen Lalanza Lazaro
review_text: A diez minutos del centro caminando, muy amables
review_translated_text: Ten minutes from the center on foot, very friendly

name: MC
review_text:
el hotel me ha gustado, es funcional y limpio, el personal de recepcion y desayuno muy amable. Tan solo decir que se echa de menos que no tenga una cafeteria donde tomar algo, tan solo una maquina de vending.
la ubicacion esta a 5 minutos andando del casco historico pero en una calle en la qu eno hay nada, y por la noche muy sola.
review_translated_text:
I liked the hotel, it is functional and clean, the reception and breakfast staff are very friendly. Just to say that it is missed that it does not have a cafeteria where you can have a drink, only a vending machine.
The location is 5 minutes walk from the historic center but on a street where there is nothing, and at night it is very lonely.

name: Luis Montes Gonzalez
review_text:
Fue el hotel mas barato que encontre para una habitacion triple reservando el dia antes.

En positivo:
La ubicacion. Cerca del centro (1km) pero zona blanca para aparcar.
0 Ruidos de habitaciones vecinas. Aunque se escuchaban los del pasillo.
Bano y ducha todo correcto. (Aunque la mampara era de estas que se mueven y soltaba agua fuera)
La limpieza no era perfecta pero aceptable
Las camas comodas.
Barrio tranquilo.

En negativo: (a mejorar)
Los muebles tipo IKEA, se notaba que tendrian como mucho 4-5 anos y ya estaban machacados.
La TV no funcionaba bien. Los botones todos machacados solo podias cambiar de canal. El mando tpoco funcionaba.
No tenia nevera ni caja fuerte.
Los ascensores son solo 2 para 11 plantas.. vale mas usar las escaleras, solo consegui usarlos el primer dia cuando hice el check in.
No tiene cafeteria solo maquinas de vending.
review_translated_text:
It was the cheapest hotel I found for a triple room, booking the day before.

Positives:
The location. Close to the center (1 km) but with a white parking area.
No noise from neighboring rooms. Although you could hear noise from the hallway.
The bathroom and shower were fine. (Although the shower screen was one of those that moves and leaks water.)
The cleanliness wasn't perfect, but acceptable.
The beds were comfortable.
Quiet neighborhood.

Negatives: (to improve)
The IKEA-style furniture was obviously 4-5 years old at most and was already battered.
The TV didn't work well. The buttons were all battered, so you could only change channels. The remote didn't work either.
There was no refrigerator or safe.
There are only two elevators for 11 floors. It's better to use the stairs. I only managed to use them on the first day when I checked in.
There's no cafeteria, just vending machines.

name: patricia Gil Pereda
review_text: Todo fenomenal y la recepcionista Lorena super maja y atenta... volveremos
review_translated_text: Everything was great and the receptionist Lorena was super nice and attentive... we will return

name: Maps47750901110
review_text: Sejour d'une nuit avec petit dejeuner. Hotel bien situe, a 10 minutes a pied du centre historique. Quelques places de parking pour stationner gratuitement dans la rue face a l'entree de l'etablissement. Chambre suffisamment grande pour 2 personnes, tres propre, bien insonorisee, avec climatisation et vue sur la cathedrale. Excellent petit dejeuner avec du choix et de bons produits. Le personnel d'accueil et du petit dejeuner est tres agreable, souriant. La receptionniste parlait francais et nous a donne des conseils pour visiter le centre et de bonnes adresses de restos et tapas.|Hotel parfait pour une halte a Burgos.
review_translated_text: One-night stay with breakfast. Well-located hotel, a 10-minute walk from the historic center. A few free parking spaces are available on the street opposite the hotel entrance. The room is large enough for two people, very clean, well-soundproofed, with air conditioning and a view of the cathedral. Excellent breakfast with a wide selection and good products. The reception and breakfast staff are very pleasant and friendly. The receptionist spoke French and gave us tips for visiting the center and good restaurants and tapas. |Perfect hotel for a stopover in Burgos.

name: Yanina Lopez Perez
review_text: Muy recomendable. El personal tanto de recepcion como del bar en el desayuno, muy bien! Volveremos.
review_translated_text: Highly recommended. The staff at both the reception and the bar at breakfast, very good! We will return.

review_text: Hotel a unos cinco minutos del centro de burgos. Camas comodas y habitaciones amplias
review_translated_text: Hotel about five minutes from the center of Burgos. Comfortable beds and spacious rooms

name: Tony Laguna
review_text: El desayuno...., no puedo opinar, xq no hemos tenido el placer de probarlo....
review_translated_text: The breakfast..., I can't comment, because we haven't had the pleasure of trying it....

name: K4515AVmarcoc
review_text: Ottima sistemazione. Camere pulite e silenziose anche se danno sul bulevar. Colazione abbondante e varia a buffet. Parcheggio gratuito in strada. La zona non e il massimo ma in meno di 10 minuti a piedi si raggiunge la cattedrale e il centro. Per la sua fascia di prezzo il massimo
review_translated_text: Excellent accommodation. Clean and quiet rooms even if they overlook the bulevar. Rich and varied buffet breakfast. Free parking on the street. The area is not the best but in less than 10 minutes on foot you can reach the cathedral and the center. For its price range the best

name: Ana Gallego
review_text:
Nuestra habitacion era la que estaba al lado de los ascensores, aunque ponia que estaba insonorizada habia ruido de estos por la noche.

Las camas super comodas y sabanas suaves, parecia que dormias en una nube. Habitacion super luminosa con vistas a la catedral. El bano tenia ventana, importante para la acumulacion de humedad tras la ducha o para los malos olores despues de ir al bano.

Tienen secador para el pelo, jabon de manos y gel/champu.

El desayuno bastante normalito. Algo de embutido y salado como huevos revueltos, salchichas y bacon. Poca fruta. Seccion de cereales, bolleria del super, infusiones, cafe, leche y agua de botella fresca y del tiempo.
review_translated_text:
Our room was the one next to the elevators, although it said it was soundproof there was noise from them at night.

Super comfortable beds and soft sheets, it seemed like you were sleeping on a cloud. Super bright room with views of the cathedral. The bathroom had a window, important for the accumulation of humidity after a shower or for bad odors after going to the bathroom.

They have a hair dryer, hand soap and gel/shampoo.

Pretty average breakfast. Something cold and salty like scrambled eggs, sausages and bacon. Little fruit. Cereal section, supermarket pastries, infusions, coffee, milk and fresh and seasonal bottled water.

name: Ricardo Silva
review_text: This was just an overnight stop so all it was required was a clean room and decent breakfast in the morning. Achieved all my needs. I had the cathedral view and it was very nice.

name: TRINITARIO RAMON CARCELES PEREZ
review_text: El desayuno era bastante pesimo,  con fruta en mal estado, tomate triturado de lata y poca variedad.
review_translated_text: Breakfast was quite lousy, with spoiled fruit, canned crushed tomatoes and little variety.

name: Dani Martinez Jimenez
review_text: Tras tener una reserva con mas de una semana de antelacion y tras mas de 600 kilometros de viaje, me llevo la sorpresa de llegar y no tenerla. Dicen enviarme un correo avisando pero mi buzon sigue esperando ese correo, ademas de un trato despectivo por parte de la recepcion. No me dan las prestaciones que ellos ofrecen y, encima, la habitacion que me han dado al mismo precio es al lado de los ascensores. No volvere a repetir en este sitio...y no lo recomendaria dada mi experiencia personal.
review_translated_text: After having a reservation more than a week in advance and after more than 600 kilometers of travel, I was surprised to arrive and not have it. They say they will send me an email warning but my mailbox is still waiting for that email, in addition to disrespectful treatment from the reception. They don't give me the services they offer and, on top of that, the room they gave me at the same price is next to the elevators. I will not return to this site again...and I would not recommend it given my personal experience.

name: Trip.com Member
review_text: This hotel is in an excellent location. Close to landmarks, shops, and bus stations. The staff was extremely helpful and friendly. The breakfast was very good and well stocked. The rooms were very comfortable and the showers had good water pressure. There was an emergency light over the door that was on all night making it difficult to sleep. I would stay here again.

name: Fernando Cepeda
review_text: No puedo recomendarlo, el aire acondicionado no funciona, el ruino con el exterior es terrible, el semaforo de la calle se mete dentro, yo no regresare, tu no vengas.
review_translated_text: I can't recommend it, the air conditioning doesn't work, the ruin outside is terrible, the street light goes inside, I won't come back, don't come.

name: Maria Pilar Vidorreta
review_text: Un hotel agradable con un servicio extraordinario amabilidad y las habitaciones acogedoras
review_translated_text: A pleasant hotel with extraordinary service, friendliness, and cozy rooms.

review_text: La habitacion muy bien pero sin cafeteria.... maquina de cafe averiada toda la semana y bastante ruido en las habitaciones que dan a la avenida.....una nevera en la habitacion no estaria de mas........la atencion impecable
review_translated_text: The room was very nice, but there was no coffee maker. The coffee machine was out of order all week, and there was a lot of noise in the rooms facing the avenue. A refrigerator in the room wouldn't be a bad idea. The service was impeccable.

name: Lydie AUBRIL
review_text:
Tres bon rapport qualite prix , acces rapide au centre historique 1km environ
Grande chambre, nous etions au 11em avec vue sur cathedrale de Burgos
review_translated_text:
Excellent value for money, quick access to the historic center (about 1 km).
Large room, we were on the 11th floor with a view of Burgos Cathedral.

name: jesus rami
review_text: Definitivamente un hotel.
review_translated_text: Definitely a hotel.

name: Antonio Asensi
review_text: Excelente ubicacio, impecable limpieza, el personal muy agradable , si vuelvo a Burgos este sera mi hotel de referencia
review_translated_text: Excellent location, impeccable cleanliness, very pleasant staff, if I return to Burgos this will be my reference hotel

name: Jesus Andreu
review_text:
Muy buena atencion...y servicio...
Por poner una pega.....no hay nevera en la habitacion.
Desayuno buffet...cantidad...variado...muy rico
review_translated_text:
Very good service...and attention...
On one downside......there's no refrigerator in the room.
Buffet breakfast...ample...varied...very delicious

name: Bernard Gerin
review_text:
Hotel conventionnel... petite chambre.. situe a 15 min a pied du centre... parfait
Petit dejeuner copieux..  dommage de devoir payer le parking 15 euros la nuit
review_translated_text:
Conventional hotel... small room... located 15 minutes' walk from the center... perfect
Hearty breakfast... shame about having to pay 15 euros a night for parking

name: ana serrano manzanares
review_text:
Hemos estado una noche y todo genial!
A 6 min andando de la catedral que se hacen amenos
review_translated_text:
We stayed one night and everything was great!
6 minutes walk from the cathedral that is pleasant

name: sara vazquez
review_text: Hotel super bien ubicado, garaje subterraneo comunicado directamente con las plantas del hotel (muy comodo), las chicas de recepcion muy amables. Si tengo que poner un contra es que las habitaciones se ven algo envejecidas aunque estaban MUY LIMPIAS, si que es verdad que se notaba que eran viejitas .
review_translated_text: Super well located hotel, underground garage connected directly to the hotel floors (very comfortable), very friendly reception girls. If I have to put a con, it is that the rooms look a little aged although they were VERY CLEAN, it is true that you could tell that they were old.

name: RUNAS
review_text: Habitacion perfecta cerca casco antiguo cerca parking gratis
review_translated_text: Perfect room near the old town and free parking

name: francisco navarro herrera
review_text: Hemos estado la semana pasada y ha estado todo muy bien. La habitacion limpia y grande asi como muy luminosa. Atencion muy amable en la recepcion y muy buena ubicacion, apenas 10 minutos de la catedral. Muy recomendable
review_translated_text: We were there last week and everything was very good. The room was clean and large as well as very bright. Very friendly attention at the reception and very good location, just 10 minutes from the cathedral. Highly recommended

name: Oscar Puigarnau
review_text: El hotel esta un poco dejado y la habitacion pequena, para una estancia de paso es correcta pero no para mas dias.
review_translated_text: The hotel is a bit run down and the room is small; it's fine for a short stay, but not for more than a few days.

name: Joao Medeiros
review_text: Tudo perfeito! Otima localizacao
review_translated_text: Everything perfect! Great location

name: Paola
review_text: Hotel in zona periferica ma solo ad una decina di minuti dal centro storico di Burgos. Stanze piuttosto piccole ma, rarita, bagno con bidet. Molto gentili e disponibili le ragazze della reception. Possibilita di parcheggio gratuito nelle vicinanze dell'albergo. Ci sono diversi bar per poter fare la colazione al di fuori dell'hotel.
review_translated_text: Hotel in the outskirts but only about ten minutes from the historic center of Burgos. Rooms are quite small but, a rarity, a bathroom with bidet. The girls at the reception are very kind and helpful. Possibility of free parking near the hotel. There are several bars where you can have breakfast outside the hotel.

name: Olivia Botella
review_text:
Colchon comodo, buen descanso
Buena calidad precio
A un paso del centro
review_translated_text:
Comfortable mattress, good rest
Good quality price
One step away from the center

name: Maria Viyella Dominguez
review_text: El hotel esta reformado y esta muy bien. La ubicacion es fantastica y el personal es muy amable. Volveremos.
review_translated_text: The hotel is renovated and is very good. The location is fantastic and the staff is very friendly. We will return.

name: Paul Samuel
review_text: This is a low cost hotel in a reasonable location. It is tired and needs a refresh, but the rooms are fine & clean, though lacking amenities. Bit of a walk to the city centre, but close to a supermarket which was useful.  It was sweltering in my room due to no air conditioning before May and was initially told there was nothing they could do. However, they did change me to a lower level out of the sun which was appreciated.

name: Robert Marti
review_text:
Hotel bien comunicado y cercano al centro. Ideal para hacer turismo en Burgos.
Bano algo envejecido pero todo correcto en la habitacion.
La atencion del personal es agradable y atenta.
Sin embargo, mi experiencia ha sido negativa ya que reserve por internet un habitacion con terraza que luego no estaba disponible. Es decir, las fotos que ponen en la web no corresponden a la realidad. Al menos, en este caso.
Pedimos el cambio a la habitacion con terraza, pero no fue posible ya que la tenian ocupada.
Asi pues, muy buena voluntad en atencion al cliente pero errores de bulto en el sistema de reservas.
review_translated_text:
Hotel with good connections and close to the city center. Ideal for sightseeing in Burgos.
The bathroom is somewhat dated, but everything in the room is fine.
The staff is pleasant and attentive.
However, my experience was negative because I booked a room with a terrace online, which turned out to be unavailable. In other words, the photos posted on the website don't reflect reality. At least not in this case.
We requested an upgrade to a room with a terrace, but it wasn't possible because it was already booked.
So, great customer service, but significant errors in the reservation system.

name: Eva Maria Sanchez Garcia
review_text: Muy dispuestos y super majos. No esta en el centro de todo pero si muy cerca.
review_translated_text: Very helpful and super nice. It's not in the center of everything, but it's very close.

name: Nad J85
review_text: Tres bon accueil, la receptionniste parlait parfaitement le francais malgre ce qu'elle nous indiquait. Chambre suffisamment spacieuse, salle de bain agreable. Proche centre ville. On entend un peu les bruits de la ville mais l'hotel est silencieux. Le petit dejeuner est delicieux avec du choix.
review_translated_text: Very warm welcome, the receptionist spoke French perfectly despite what she told us. Sufficiently spacious room, pleasant bathroom. Near city center. You can hear a little noise from the city but the hotel is quiet. The breakfast is delicious with plenty of choice.

name: Nieves Herrero
review_text:
Habitacion muy espaciosa y limpia, perfecta.
La ubicacion tambien esta muy bien porque en diez minutos estas en el puente del rio.
review_translated_text:
Very spacious and clean room, perfect.
The location is also very good because in ten minutes you are at the river bridge.

name: Felipe Prieto Bueno
review_text:
Hotel tranquilo, comodo y silencioso.
Buen desayuno.
A 5 minutos andando del centro historico.
Apartamento a lado hotel sin zona azul de pago.
review_translated_text:
Quiet, comfortable and silent hotel.
Good breakfast.
5 minutes walk from the historic center.
Apartment next to hotel without blue payment zone.

name: LucianaSarkozy
review_text: Ficamos uma noite nesse hotel durante o Caminho de Santiago. Ficamos num quarto com banheiro privativo. Bom quarto e banheiro, bem limpos. Funcionarios atenciosos. O cafe da manha era muito bom. Ele mao e muito perto do centro historico, mas e possivel ir a pe, sem problemas.
review_translated_text: We stayed one night at this hotel during the Camino de Santiago. We had a room with a private bathroom. The room and bathroom were nice and clean. The staff were attentive. The breakfast was very good. It is not very close to the historic center, but you can walk there without any problems.

name: fran_oism555
review_text: Correct pour une nuit sans plus. Les 3 etoiles auraient besoin d'un rafraichissement pour etre meritees surtout au niveau du mobile tres rudimentaire..|Bien place pour la visite de la ville, belle vue sur Burgos aux etages superieurs, dispose d'un parking prive en sous-sol.|Accueil tres agreable et en francais. Petit dejeuner tres convenable avec une grande variete de mets sucres et sales.
review_translated_text: Decent for one night, nothing more. The 3 stars would need a refresh to be deserved, especially with the very basic mobile phone. |   Well located for visiting the city, beautiful view of Burgos from the upper floors, has private parking in the basement. | Very pleasant welcome, in French. Very decent breakfast with a wide variety of sweet and savory dishes.

name: Cristina Masserano
review_text: Lo consiglio tutto ottimo qualita prezzo eccellente
review_translated_text: I recommend it all, excellent quality/price ratio

name: ALBERTO "Coyote"
review_text: Estuvimos dos noches, para ver un poco de Burgos, y la verdad es que no esta mal el hotel. La atencion a los clientes es correcta, nos informaron el dia de la llegada de donde podiamos comer, ya que era la hora de comer y nos recomendaron ir a un restaurante cercano, que no estuvo mal. El desayuno lo llevabamos incluido y no es ninguna maravilla, pero esta bien, correcto y tenian leche de avena, que es la que bebe mi pareja. Esta ubicado cerca del centro y te puedes mover a pie desde el a todas partes.
review_translated_text: We stayed two nights, to see a little of Burgos, and the truth is that the hotel is not bad. The customer service is correct, they informed us on the day of arrival where we could eat, and what time it was to eat and they recommended we go to a nearby restaurant, which was not bad. We had breakfast included and it is not wonderful, but it is good, correct and they had oat milk, which is what my partner drinks. It is located near the center and you can walk from it to everywhere.

name: LJCC-2002
review_text: Es un hotel muy decente. Muy bien comunicado y centrico, ideal para hacer turismo en Burgos. Las habitaciones son algo pequenas, pero acorde con la categoria del hotel. Parecido con el desayuno, adecuado pero nada especial.|La atencion del personal si que es muy agradable, por lo que si no va a pasar uno mucho tiempo en el hotel, es una muy buena eleccion.
review_translated_text: It's a very decent hotel. Very well connected and centrally located, ideal for sightseeing in Burgos. The rooms are somewhat small, but in keeping with the hotel's category. The breakfast is similar: adequate but nothing special. The staff is very friendly, so if you're not spending much time at the hotel, it's a very good choice.

name: Luis Javier Codon Cornejo
review_text:
Es un hotel muy decente. Muy bien comunicado y centrico, ideal para hacer turismo en Burgos. Las habitaciones son algo pequenas, pero acorde con la categoria del hotel. Parecido con el desayuno, adecuado pero nada especial.
La atencion del personal si que es muy agradable, por lo que si no va a pasar uno mucho tiempo en el hotel, es una muy buena eleccion.
review_translated_text:
It is a very decent hotel. Very well connected and central, ideal for sightseeing in Burgos. The rooms are somewhat small, but in line with the category of the hotel. Similar to breakfast, adequate but nothing special.
The attention of the staff is very pleasant, so if you are not going to spend a lot of time in the hotel, it is a very good choice.

name: Alonso Sanchez-Muliterno Bauza
review_text: Las almohadas son como dormir sobre una hoja de papel. Se acaba con dolor de cuello. Entra a la habitacion mucha luz desde el pasillo y el bano es muy estrecho.
review_translated_text: Pillows are like sleeping on a sheet of paper. It ends with neck pain. A lot of light enters the room from the hallway and the bathroom is very narrow.

name: Vic0223
review_text: La estancia en este hotel ha sido decepcionante. La suciedad y el excesivo ruido han arruinado por completo la experiencia. Es fundamental que los hoteles mantengan un ambiente limpio y tranquilo para garantizar el descanso y la comodidad de sus huespedes. Espero que tomen medidas para mejorar estas condiciones en el futuro. Antes estas quejas el hotel no ofrece ninguna solucion. Nada recomendable hospedarse aqui. No corresponden a un hotel de 3 estrellas, podria catalogarse como un hostal.
review_translated_text: The stay at this hotel was disappointing. The dirt and excessive noise have completely ruined the experience. It is essential that hotels maintain a clean and quiet environment to ensure the rest and comfort of their guests. I hope they take steps to improve these conditions in the future. Before these complaints the hotel does not offer any solution. It is not recommended to stay here. They do not correspond to a 3-star hotel, it could be classified as a hostel.

name: Santiago Masa Lora
review_text: EL mando a distancia sin pilas, habitacion pequena y el colmo el aire acondicionado averiado. Entre en la habitacion 702 a la 18:00h el sol incidia directamente  en la habitacion toda la tarde se fue calentando y dentro hacia mas calor que en Mordor. Era imposible estar alli y me dicen desde recepcion que ya lo saben que no pueden hacer nada ya que todas las habitaciones estan igual... increible que reserven habitaciones asi y sin compensarte nada.
review_translated_text: The remote control without batteries, small room and the last straw was the broken air conditioning. I entered room 702 at 6:00 p.m. the sun was shining directly into the room all afternoon, it was getting warmer and it was hotter inside than in Mordor. It was impossible to be there and they told me from reception that they already know that they can't do anything since all the rooms are the same... incredible that they reserve rooms like that and without compensating you anything.

name: Ishtar Salgado
review_text: Hemos estado super bien,limpio,centrico,el personal muy agradable volveremos sin duda
review_translated_text: We have had a great time, clean, central, very nice staff, we will definitely return

name: Maria Jose Manzano
review_text: A 10- 15 minutos andando de la catedral. Nosotros pudimos aparcar al lado del hotel pero el hotel tiene parking que se agradece. Desayuno adecuado. Habitaciones amplias
review_translated_text: 10-15 minutes walk from the cathedral. We were able to park next to the hotel but the hotel has parking which is appreciated. Adequate breakfast. Spacious rooms

name: 304patr_ciar
review_text: Grande chambre tres confortable.|Salle de bain avec baignoire.|Personnel accueillant.|Possibilite d'avoir 1 lit bebe dans la chambre.|Rien a dire sur la proprete. Tout etait parfait.|Je recommande.||Le seul petit bemol c'est qu'il n'y a pas beaucoup de choix au petit dejeuner.
review_translated_text: Large, very comfortable room.|Bathroom with bathtub.|Welcoming staff.|Possibility of having 1 baby bed in the room.|Nothing to say about the cleanliness. Everything was perfect.|I recommend.||The only small downside is that there is not much choice at breakfast.

name: Maria Vazquez Celada
review_text: PUBLICIDAD ENGANOSA!. No he tenido la ocasion de probar este hotel porque pese a que se ofertan como experiencia en cajas regalos de hasta 150EU nunca tienen disponibilidad para canjear un bono aunque si para contratar directamente con ellos. Es vergonzoso el uso publicitario que hacen a traves de cajas de experiencias, en nuestro caso, wonderbox, para que nunca puedas canjear la caja. En tres ocasiones lo he intentado y es imposible confirmar una reserva. Lamentable!
review_translated_text: MISLEADING ADVERTISING! I have not had the opportunity to try this hotel because although they are offered as an experience in gift boxes of up to EU150, they are never available to redeem a voucher, although they are available to contract directly with them. The advertising use they make through experience boxes, in our case, wonderbox, so that you can never redeem the box is shameful. I have tried three times and it is impossible to confirm a reservation. Regrettable!

name: Estelars rs
review_text:
Habitacion increible, limpia, con unas vistas espectaculares desde la planta 8 y un maravilloso atardecer. El bano es grande y tiene un espejo enorme. La cama muy comoda. No es muy grande la habitacion, pero esta genial para pasar un finde. El personal es muy amable. Nosotros cogimos el desayuno un dia que son 9EU cada uno, no es excesivamente abundante pero esta bien, un poco caro en mi opinion. La fruta te la traen partida lo cual me general algo de desconfianza, prefiero que esten las piezas entera. Por lo demas me gusto bastante, es muy bonito por dentro. En cuanto a la ubicacion, en 10 minutos estan en el centro o menos, ademas es linea recta osea que genial, bastante bien. Hay supermercados cerca y se puede aparcar gratis al lado del
hotel. La zona es muy tranquila y nada peligrosa
review_translated_text:
Incredible, clean room, with spectacular views from the 8th floor and a wonderful sunset. The bathroom is large and has a huge mirror. The bed very comfortable. The room is not very big, but it is great to spend a weekend. The staff is very friendly. We had breakfast one day which is EU9 each, it is not excessively abundant but it is okay, a little expensive in my opinion. The fruit is brought to you broken, which makes me somewhat distrustful, I prefer the pieces to be whole. Otherwise I really liked it, it's very pretty inside. As for the location, in 10 minutes you are in the center or less, plus it is a straight line, which is great, quite good. There are supermarkets nearby and you can park for free next to the
hotel. The area is very quiet and not dangerous.

review_text: Hostales y pensiones mucho mejores que lo que nos han dado. Habitacion extremadamente pequena. Cama de menos de 1,35, hay que pasar de perfil para pasar al otro lado, literal. No se corresponde para nada con las fotos. El bano en proporcion tiene mas metros. Muebles muyyyy estropeados. Parece una habitacion de uso individual. Solo hay enchufe en un lado de la cama. Ultima planta. No merece tres estrellas.

It doesn't match the photos at all. The bathroom has more meters in proportion. Very damaged furniture. It looks like a single occupancy room. There is only a plug on one side of the bed. Last floor. It doesn't deserve three stars.

review_text: Hemos pagado 122EU y no corresponde el precio con la habitacion que nos han dado en un  principio,habitacion diminuta,olia mal,las paredes manchadas,le he comentado a la chica de recepcion,muy atenta y muy maja me ha dado dos llaves mas para elegir yo misma un habitacion,hemos elegido "la mejor,la mas amplia "pero no quiere decir que sea buena,paredes en las 3habitaciones sucias,esta por lo menos huele a limpio..pero un mantenimiento no vendria mal y por supuesto una bajada de precio,si me piden 60EU pues me parece justo pero por 122EU pues no corresponde..
review_translated_text: We paid 122EU and the price does not correspond with the room they initially gave us, tiny room, smelled bad, stained walls, I told the girl at reception, very attentive and very nice, she gave me two more keys to choose a room myself, we chose "the best, the largest" but it does not mean that it is good, walls in the 3 rooms are dirty, at least it smells clean.. but some maintenance would not hurt and of course a price reduction, if they ask me for 60EU then it seems fair to me but for 122EU then it is not right.

name: Fiz Newington
review_text: We had a large comfortable twin room with excellent modern bathroom.  Exceeded our expectations for the price.  Garage parking (EU10 ?) was convenient and we saved that by using cafe close by for breakfast.

name: Gonzalo Quintian
review_text: Este hotel tiene una relacion calidad/precio muy buena. Esta bien ubicado y tiene un desayuno muy rico. Ademas, todo es super rapido. Si vuelvo a dormir en Burgos sera mi primera opcion.

review_text: El hotel esta a unos 10 minutos caminando a la catedral, el personal de recepcion muy amable, habitaciones amplias y comodas, la unicapega que no nos funcionaba la calefaccion y l primera noche pasamos un poco de frio, el desayuno lo cogimos solo un dia, tenian lo basico algo de cereales y fruta,  algo de bolleria, quesos y panecillos , beicon y tomate, mermelada, zumo y una maquina de cafe, poco mas pero estaba rico, las almohadas algo bajas el colchon bien, en resumidas lo recomiendo pero son desayuno

name: Santiago Garcia Martin
review_text: Estupendo..cercano a la CATEDRAL y a las zonas de tapeo...GENIAL..buen servicio y sin agobio..comida ( sin quejas en general )sirven ellos en las mesas..
review_translated_text: Great...close to the CATHEDRAL and the tapas areas...GREAT...good service and no hassle...food (no complaints in general) they serve at the tables...

name: Jokin De Carlos dominguez
review_text: Bien ubicado. A 6 minutos del centro paseando. Las habitaciones bien equipadas y confortables. El personal muy amable. Te aconsejan sobre lo que preguntes, pero con conocimiento y en mi caso con acierto. Desayuno completisimo, muy variado, de buena calidad y economico.
review_translated_text: Well located. 6 minutes from the center by walking. The well-equipped and comfortable rooms. Very friendly staff. They advise you on what you ask, but with knowledge and in my case correctly. Very complete breakfast, very varied, of good quality and economical.

name: Laura Bermejo Yago
review_text:
Para pasar una noche de imprevisto por que no tengas opcion mejor. Hotel aceptable.
Pero para estar mas de una noche, yo no lo recomiendo. La habitacion super pequena apenas hay espacio entre la cama y la pared en ninguno de los dos lados de la cama, no te esperes encontrar mini nevera por que no la vas a encontrar, tampoco hay caja fuerte, y la TV no tiene para meter un PENDRIVE.

review_text: Bien ubicado, precio razonable. Limpio y comodo.
