name: Miranda Celada de Sasia
review_text:
Hotel muy bien localizado, a 20 minutos del monasterio de las Huelgas y a 10-15 del museo de la Evolucion Humana y el casco antiguo.
Tuvimos una habitacion con bonita vista a la catedral. La habitacion tenia un buen tamano y los armarios tenian mucha capacidad. El bano y la ducha tambien estaban bien. Lo unico a mencionar seria la insonorizacion de las habitaciones, ya que las puertas dejan pasar el ruido de lo que pasa dentro y fuera de ellas.
El personal super amable y educado. Tienen servicio de consigna para las maletas previo al check-in o posterior al check-out.
review_translated_text:
Hotel very well located, 20 minutes from the Monastery of Las Huelgas and 10-15 from the Museum of Human Evolution and the old town.
We had a room with a nice view of the cathedral. The room was a good size and the closets had plenty of capacity. The bathroom and shower were also good. The only thing to mention would be the soundproofing of the rooms, since the doors let in the noise of what is happening inside and outside them.
Super friendly and polite staff. They have a left-luggage service for luggage before check-in or after check-out.

name: Trip.com Member
review_text: Great and convenient location. Walking distance from the bus station and the main attractions. Room was quite spacious, very clean and well-maintained. Staff were friendly and helpful as well. Highly recommend this place in Burgos as it is really worth it for the price.

review_text: Por nuestra experiencia es un hotel simple, sin florituras. Bien para hacer noche en Burgos. No lo elegiriamos para una estancia prolongada, o si buscase un hotel mas completo.||La habitacion esta bien, tamano justo. El bano estaba limpio.||El trato del personal fue bueno. No lo destacaria.||El desayuno nos parecio bueno, con un poco de todo, sin llegar a ser un super desayuno. Habia lo tipico (huevos revueltos, bacon, panes, bolleria industrial...)||Pedimos parking. Cuesta 15EU por noche. Es un aparcamiento compartido con la comunidad de vecinos del edificio donde esta el hotel. NO disponen de cargador de coche electrico ni enchufes de pared. El acceso no esta mal.||En general por el precio que pagamos estaba bien. (85EU la noche)
review_translated_text: In our experience, it's a simple, no-frills hotel. It's fine for an overnight stay in Burgos. We wouldn't choose it for a longer stay, or if I were looking for a more complete hotel. The room was fine, just the right size. The bathroom was clean. The staff was good. I wouldn't say much about it. We found the breakfast to be good, with a bit of everything, but not a super breakfast. It had the usual fare (scrambled eggs, bacon, bread, baked goods, etc.). We asked for parking. It costs EU15 per night. It's a shared parking lot with the apartment building's residents. There are no electric car chargers or wall outlets. Access isn't bad. Overall, for the price we paid, it was fine. (EU85 per night)

name: Melya Photographie
review_text:
Passage a cet hotel lors d'un retour du Portugal vers la France . Hotel bien situe, le personnel a l'accueil accueillant et aimable et parle le francais . Chambre correcte pour une nuit avec une belle vue sur la cathedrale mais ne merite pas le prix de 106EU. L'hotel et chambre sont malgre tout modernes compare a d'autres hotel de Burgos .
Points negatifs : le parking au sous sol 15EU
Le petit dejeuner a 9EU alors qu'il n'y a aucun choix ! Quelques croissants, et du pain, beurre miel et 1 seul confiture, une carafe de jus d'orange, 3 tranches de pasteque et un bol de fruit en conserve, omelette saucisse et jambon. C'est tout, pas de boissons variees ni de yahourt ou plus de choix en fruits ou viennoiseries ou mets sales... bref ca vaut pas 9EU.
La chambre bien plus abimee que sur les photos officielles, et le poteau dans la chambre qui gene.
review_translated_text:
Visiting this hotel when returning from Portugal to France. Well located hotel, the staff are welcoming and friendly and speak French. OK room for one night with a nice view of the cathedral but does not deserve the price of EU106. The hotel and room are nevertheless modern compared to other hotels in Burgos.
Negative points: parking in the basement 15EU
Breakfast for EU9 even though there is no choice! A few croissants, and bread, butter, honey and 1 jam, a carafe of orange juice, 3 slices of watermelon and a bowl of canned fruit, sausage and ham omelette. That's it, no varied drinks or yogurt or more choice of fruit or pastries or savory dishes... in short, it's not worth EU9.
The room is much more damaged than in the official photos, and the post in the room is in the way.

Proche du centre ville a pied donc la nuit est calme. Stationnement le long de la rue gratuit il faut reussir a trouver une place sinon acces parking payant. Nois n'avons pas teste le petit dejeuner.  Chambre triple pas trop grande mais c'est souvent le cas. Salle de bain spacieuse.  Sens le propre
review_translated_text: We stayed for just one night. Very pleasant and professional hostess. The best part was speaking French with this friendly young girl. Close to the city center on foot so the night is quiet. Free parking along the street, you have to manage to find a space otherwise there is paid parking access. We did not try the breakfast.  Triple room not too big but that's often the case. Spacious bathroom.  Sense the clean

name: P. V.
review_text: El hotel en si esta bien, un 3 estrellas. Habitaciones solo puedo hablar de las del ultimo piso, unas vistas impresionantes de Burgos, con una terraza tres veces la habitacion.
review_translated_text: The hotel itself is fine, a 3 star. I can only speak about the rooms on the top floor, impressive views of Burgos, with a terrace three times the room.

name: Loli Fernandez
review_text: Un hotel estupendo, limpio, habitacion con unas vistas geniales, super tranquilo, cama grande y bano genial, el desayuno muy bueno y variado y en 5 minutos estas en el centro, sin duda repetiria
review_translated_text: A great hotel, clean, room with great views, super quiet, big bed and great bathroom, very good and varied breakfast and in 5 minutes you are in the center, I would definitely repeat

name: ArgosFran Peleteria Rediseno
review_text: Buen servicio muy amables las habitaciones muy comodas y muy cerca de la catedral
review_translated_text: Good service, very friendly, very comfortable rooms and very close to the cathedral

name: Diego RODRIGUEZ FERNANDEZ
review_text:
Lo mejor que tiene es la ubicacion.
Muy cerca de la catedral y el centro donde se puede comer en gran cantidad de locales.
Habitacion bastante pequena.
Tuvimos que pedir un cambio de habitacion
review_translated_text:
The best thing about it is the location.
Very close to the cathedral and the center where you can eat in a large number of places.
Quite small room.
We had to request a room change

name: Diego Hernandez
review_text: Habitaciones sencillas, la limpieza y el estado general algo mejorable, ruido por la manana por los pasillos. Lo mejor el precio para la ubicacion que tiene ya que esta a 10 minutos de la catedral.
review_translated_text: Simple rooms, cleanliness and general condition could be improved, and some noise from the hallways in the morning. The best thing about the hotel is the price for its location, which is 10 minutes from the cathedral.

name: xusita69
review_text: Calidad precio  caro si lo comparo con alojamientos de supuesta inferior categoria.|Aparcamiento carisimo 15EU por dia. ( Compartido  con varios edificios). Dimos varias vueltas y no encontramos ningun aparcamiento. Preguntamos a la recepcionista si habia algun sitio cercano para aparcar y que fuera gratuito. Segun ella solo en la calle. Por una resena me entero que hay un parking gratuito a dos calle a la izquierda del hotel. La ubicacion es buena, se puede ir andando a todos los sitios.
review_translated_text: Price-performance ratio is expensive compared to supposedly lower-category accommodations. Parking is extremely expensive at EU15 per day (shared with several buildings). We drove around several times and couldn't find any parking. We asked the receptionist if there was any free parking nearby. According to her, it was only on the street. From a review, I learned there was free parking two blocks away to the left of the hotel. The location is good; you can walk everywhere.

name: Xus Garcia
review_text: Me siento enganada porque creia que habia contratado una habitacion en mejores condiciones. Lo encuentro cara si lo comparo con alojamientos de supuesta inferior categoria que he estado. Y hacerme creer que no era facil aparcar en las inmediaciones. Cuando habia un parking gratuito a cinco minutos del hotel. Tuve que pagar 15 EU por dia, ( carisimo). Cuando es un parking comunitario con otros edificios.
review_translated_text: I feel cheated because I thought I had booked a room in better conditions. I find it expensive if I compare it with supposedly lower category accommodations that I have been to. And make me believe that it was not easy to park nearby. When there was free parking five minutes from the hotel. I had to pay EU15 per day, (very expensive). When it is a community parking lot with other buildings.

name: Anas
review_text: Le personnel est tres accueillant. La nuit bruyante du aux arrivees tardives. Ne prenez pas les chambres du dernier etage car vous entendrez la machinerie des ascenseurs. Petit dejeuner moyen. Vu le prix c'est pas top. Si vous etes de passage ca repondra a vos attentes. Parking safe dans l'hotel partage avec la residence d'a cote.
review_translated_text: The staff is very welcoming. The noisy night due to late arrivals. Do not take rooms on the top floor as you will hear the elevator machinery. Average breakfast. Considering the price it's not great. If you are passing through it will meet your expectations. Safe parking in the hotel shared with the residence next door.

name: Javi A.
review_text: DECEPCIONANTE, NO VAYAIS. Me confirman que tienen disponibilidad para unas fechas, luego les dices que tienes caja WonderBox y te deniegan la disponibilidad. Solo les importa facturar y se ve que solo quieren la publicidad de WonderBox, nada mas. Atencion pesima, no vale la pena.
review_translated_text: DISAPPOINTING, DON'T GO. They confirm they have availability for certain dates, then you tell them you have a WonderBox, and they deny you availability. They only care about billing, and it's obvious they only want the WonderBox advertising, nothing else. Terrible service, not worth it.

name: Anna Lane
review_text:
Un hotel muy sencillo, habitaciones muy pequenas y con la ducha mal construida,  se salia todo el agua. Lo comentamos pero era algo que se veia que pasaba a todo el mundo ya que los marcos de la puerta estaban todos hinchados de la humedad.
La cama pequena, pero comoda y las sabanas y toallas, muy bien, limpias.
El servicio muy amable, agradable y atento.
review_translated_text:
A very simple hotel, with very small rooms and a poorly constructed shower that kept leaking water. We mentioned it, but it was something that seemed to happen to everyone, as the door frames were all swollen from moisture.
The bed was small but comfortable, and the sheets and towels were very nice and clean.
The service was very friendly, pleasant, and attentive.

name: David Benedi
review_text:
Un hotel muy centrico, moderno, con buenos accesos y limpio
Desayuno increible
review_translated_text:
A very central, modern hotel, with good access and clean
Amazing breakfast

name: Pablo
review_text: Muy buena relacion calidad precio, ademas nos toco magnificas vistas en el noveno piso
review_translated_text: Very good value for money, we also had magnificent views on the ninth floor

name: David 567
review_text: Calidad precio ubicacion excelente esta bien, si necesito otras veces de sus servicios no lo dudare en volver
review_translated_text: Quality price location excellent, it's fine, if I need your services again I will not hesitate to return

name: Paul R.
review_text: Hotel de 3 estrellas limpio y centrico. Se instalaros unos familiares un d!fin de semana y quedaron muy contentos.
review_translated_text: Clean and central 3-star hotel. Some relatives moved in one weekend and they were very happy.

name: Cristina Gomez
review_text: Hotel sencillo pero muy confortable y limpio, cama comoda, facil aparcar cerca si vas en coche. Desayuno variado y los camareros reponen con mucha frecuencia.
review_translated_text: Simple but very comfortable and clean hotel, comfortable bed, easy parking nearby if you go by car. Varied breakfast and the waiters refill very frequently.

name: Bnji CO
review_text: La clim de la chambre pas top mais bon emplacement a 10 mins du centre a pied, places de parking gratuites face a l'hotel.
review_translated_text: The air conditioning in the room is not great but good location 10 minutes from the center on foot, free parking spaces in front of the hotel.

name: aitor renilla
review_text: Nos atendieron muy amablemente, aunque la habitacion era pequena estaba muy limpia y el hotel tambien, el parking es un poco lioso si nunca has estado, el desayuno no es gran cosa por el precio, mejor desayunar fuera en alguno de los bares de la zona.
review_translated_text: They treated us very kindly, although the room was small it was very clean and so was the hotel, the parking is a bit confusing if you have never been, the breakfast is not a big deal for the price, better to have breakfast outside in one of the bars in the area.

name: Merce Canalias
review_text: Perfecte
review_translated_text: perfect

name: FRANCISCO GUERRERO
review_text:
Hotel de tres estrellas. Lo mejor los empleados del hotel. Las cenas mejorables.
Gracias a todos y especialmente  a Gema por su atencion.
Si el grupo vuelve a Burgos  seguro que repetiremos
review_translated_text:
Three-star hotel. The hotel staff is the best. Dinner could be better.
Thank you all, and especially Gema, for her attentiveness.
If the group returns to Burgos, we'll definitely be back.

name: A. Gonzalez
review_text: Muy centrico
review_translated_text: Very central

name: Guido Tuveri
review_text: Dalla nostra camera, all'undicesimo piano, c'era una vista sensazionale. E un hotel estremamente confortevole. In piu, c'e un grande garage sotterraneo, in cui abbiamo parcheggiato la nostra moto. Staff, organizzazione, colazione, wifi, tutto di nostro gradimento.
review_translated_text: From our room, on the 11th floor, there was a sensational view. It is an extremely comfortable hotel. In addition, there is a large underground garage, where we parked our motorcycle. Staff, organization, breakfast, wifi, everything to our liking.

name: Sara Gonzalez
review_text: Encantada con el hotel, tuvimos un problema sanitario a 24 horas de nuestra estancia en el mismo y nos facilitaron la cancelacion gratuita sin tener porque aceptarlo. Aunque este viaje se haya truncado por salud, no me cabe duda que iremos a disfrutar de sus instalaciones en cuanto podamos organizar de nuevo el viaje a Burgos
review_translated_text: Delighted with the hotel, we had a health problem 24 hours into our stay and they provided us with free cancellation without having to accept it. Although this trip has been cut short due to health reasons, I have no doubt that we will go to enjoy its facilities as soon as we can organize the trip to Burgos again.

name: Franca Ronco
review_text: Ottimo
review_translated_text: Optimal

name: enrique sanchez serrano
review_text: Todo perfecto a excepcion del ascensor, no puedo subir escaleras y nos costo mas de diez minutos subir del garaje a la habitacion
review_translated_text: Everything was perfect except for the elevator, I can't climb stairs and it took us more than ten minutes to get from the garage to the room

name: Michael Beavan
review_text: The 2 lady receptionist were so helpful. Room was clean and tidy.

name: Rebo
review_text: Paseando por Burgos nos hemos alojado aqui.  Muy bueno todo! El Parking genial, todo ha estado perfecto.  Central y bien aislado de ruidos
review_translated_text: Walking through Burgos we stayed here.  Everything is very good! The parking was great, everything was perfect.  Central and well isolated from noise

name: Cesar Yusto
review_text:
Habitaciones limpias, pero le hace falta alguna reforma, no hay bide en todas las habitaciones, la banera esta tan gastada que te juegas el tipo cuando estas dentro. Pedir alfombra antideslizante sino caida segura.
No hay servicio de cafeteria, que se agradeceria para una copa a la tardecer.
No hay restaurante,
Desayuno bufet  correcto y abundante.
review_translated_text:
Clean rooms, but they need some renovation, there is no bidet in all the rooms, the bathtub is so worn out that you risk your nerve when you are inside. Ask for a non-slip mat but for a safe fall.
There is no cafeteria service, which would be appreciated for an evening drink.
There is no restaurant,
Correct and abundant buffet breakfast.

name: JOSE MARIA TEJERO ESTOPANAN
review_text: En general muy bien.el servicio muy atento
review_translated_text: Overall very good. Very attentive service

name: Manfred Graschl
review_text: Sehr modern und sauber, Garage moglich. Die Altstadt und vor allem der faszinierende Dom sind gut zu Fuss erreichbar.
review_translated_text: Very modern and clean, garage possible. The old town and especially the fascinating cathedral are easily accessible on foot.

name: Nieves G.
review_text: Hotel con buena ubicacion, cercano al centro de la ciudad. Si eres usuario de  los accesos son buenos y tanto la habitacion como el bano muy grande.. Repetiremos!
review_translated_text: Hotel with a good location, close to the city center. If you're a  user, the access is easy, and both the room and bathroom are very large. We'll stay again!

name: gemma jerez
review_text:
Nosotros fuimos para un viaje de fin de semana y salvo algunos detalles la verdad es que fue bastante bien.
Las vistas de la habitacion eran bonitas ya que era un piso alto y daba a la catedral, ademas al estar un poquito alejado del centro (a poco mas de 5min) no tuvimos problemas de ruido. Tampoco con las habitaciones de al lado, pero se veia que no estaban al completo.
La habitacion estaba bien, amplia y con una cama de matrimonio bastante comoda, lo unico las almohadas eran bajitas, que para mi perfecto pero mi novio tuvo que usar tambien la que habia suplementaria.
Como punto a favor todo estaba bastante limpio pero se nota que necesita un lavado de cara, un poco de pintura y algunos arreglos y sustituciones. La mesa de la habitacion (pongo foto) parecia cogida de la basura, en el bano no habia escobilla y a pesar de ser un bano de tamano decente la salida de la ducha resultaba incomoda al tener el WC justo delante. Tambien estaria bien que hubiese una segunda silla.
Pero vamos, en general bien.
review_translated_text:
We went for a weekend trip and except for a few details, the truth is that it went quite well.
The views from the room were beautiful since it was a high floor and overlooked the cathedral, and since it was a little far from the center (a little more than 5 minutes) we had no noise problems. Nor with the rooms next door, but it was clear that they were not complete.
The room was good, spacious and with a fairly comfortable double bed, the only thing was the pillows were low, which was perfect for me but my boyfriend also had to use the extra one.
As a plus point everything was quite clean but it shows that it needs a facelift, a little paint and some repairs and replacements. The table in the room (I'll post a photo) looked like it was taken from the trash, there was no toilet brush in the bathroom and despite it being a decent-sized bathroom, the shower outlet was uncomfortable having the toilet right in front of it. It would also be nice if there was a second chair.
But come on, generally good.

name: mario gomez gallo
review_text: Muy centrico y limpio. Facil para sillas de ruedas
review_translated_text: Very central and clean. Wheelchair accessible.

name: Verdynka
review_text:
Nice and decent hotel for the moneys. The only minus was we got a room beside the elevator so we could hear the wires running all morning. We was located on the second floor, when we checked in you could smell weed everywhere on the floor sadly enough.

Kind staff and they was talking decent English at least enough to a quick chat.

name: Ludivine Pons
review_text: Emplacement parfait pour visiter Burgos a pied ! Accueil en francais par une charmante hotesse. Certaines chambres ont une vue grandiose sur la cathedrale. Petit dejeuner complet et bon. Le parking payant en sous sol est un plus.
review_translated_text: Perfect location for exploring Burgos on foot! A charming hostess greets you in French. Some rooms have a magnificent view of the cathedral. A comprehensive and delicious breakfast is provided. The paid underground parking is a plus.

name: puri rezola
review_text: Todo perfecto....nos parecio muy asequible ,esta muy centrico y el personal muy atento
review_translated_text: Everything was perfect...we found it very affordable, it is very central and the staff was very attentive

name: Dirk C.E. Ludtke
review_text: Bisschen runtergekommene Zimmer, schlechte Schallisolierung der Fenster zur Strasse.. Fur den Preis zu teuer
review_translated_text: A bit run-down rooms, poor soundproofing of the windows facing the street. Too expensive for the price

name: Milagros Mayo
review_text: Hotel con buena ubicacion ,la recepcion muy amables pero las habitaciones aunque aparentemente tienen buena pinta ,tienen una sola silla ,el colchon de muelles incomodisimo ,soy discapacitada y si una persona sin discapacidad ,descansaria mal en el ,para un discapacitado peor ,la ducha no adaptada pedi una banqueta para poder ducharme y tuve que insistir hasta que me la trajeron ,ni que decir tiene que todavia estoy esperando que me cambien de habitacion ,como ellos me dijeron para ver si en una de dos camas me adaptaba mejor ,en limpieza tb pobre ,no podia desayunar  sino pagaba buffet ,cuando yo solo queria un cafe y poco mas ,deben mejorar  muchas cosas  para estar a la altura de un hotel con tres estrellas
review_translated_text: Hotel with a good location, the reception is very friendly but the rooms, although apparently they look good, have only one chair, the spring mattress is very uncomfortable, I am disabled and if a person without a disability would rest badly on it, for a disabled person it would be worse, the shower is not adapted, I asked for a stool to be able to shower and I had to insist until they brought it to me, it goes without saying that I am still waiting for them to change my room, as they told me to see if In one with two beds I adapted better, the cleanliness was also poor, I couldn't have breakfast unless I paid for a buffet, when I only wanted a coffee and little else, many things must improve to live up to a three-star hotel

name: JUANJC
review_text:
Una habitacion amplia de matrimonio con una sola silla, sin ningun cajon, ni nevera ni caja de seguridad como en otros hoteles de tres estrellas.
Los cristales bien sucios eso si y el colchon de muelles mas duro que una piedra.
Me sorprende que en la cafeteria del hotel no se pueda pedir un cafe con leche y una tostada y que te obliguen a pedir el buffet para desayunar cuando no queremos tanto desayuno ni lo tomamos nunca.
Es en el primer hotel que nos pasa esto.
review_translated_text:
A large double room with a single chair, without any drawer, refrigerator or safe like in other three-star hotels.
The windows were very dirty and the spring mattress was harder than a rock.
I'm surprised that in the hotel cafeteria you can't order a coffee with milk and toast and that they force you to order the buffet for breakfast when we don't want that much breakfast nor do we ever eat it.
It is the first hotel that this happens to us.

name: By Galiza Calidade
review_text:
Habitaciones ,cama matrimonial amplia y muy comoda para descansar!!
Bano top

Servicio ,profesionales!! El detalle el dia del check in ,muy destacable!!

Ubicacion estrategica sin lugar a dudas!!

Inversion garantizada desde Galicia a Burgos!!

Recomendable

review_translated_text:
Rooms , large double bed and very comfortable to rest!!
Top bathroom

Service , professionals!! The detail on the day of check in, very remarkable!!

To make matters worse, I mentioned it when leaving the hotel and they told me that it is something recurring, they should inform me before formalizing the reservation.

review_text: Cumple expectativas, calidad precio correcta, segun hotel de tres estrellas. Recepcion muy amables, habitacion suficiente, colchon y cama mejorables

Ubicacion y personal... fenomenal.
Hotel viejo con pocas comodidades en el desayuno bastante caos aunque es cierto que esta bien el buffet, creo que le sobra 1 estrella

Location and staff... phenomenal.
Old hotel with few amenities. Breakfast is a bit chaotic, although the buffet is good. I think it deserves one star.

review_text:
El desayuno buffet muy poca variedad y lo poco que habia como estamos fuera de temporada y no se debe acabar lo guardan y lo vuelven a servir al dia siguiente. Lo se porque el embutido estaba seco, el bacon seco, y los Donuts duros. Considero que en vez de poner 20 lonchas de cada y guardarlo si pusieran 5 y cuando se acaben se repone estaria todo mucho mas bueno y en condiciones. Hoy ademas se habia acabado la leche caliente y me han traido una jarrita pequena con la que no he tenido suficiente y me han dicho si quieres mas me lo pides. Pero cuando me lo he acabado como el camarero no estaba ya he dicho da igual, no espero mas, que ya habia esperado anteriormente para pedirla. Entiendo que es fuera de temporada pero se puede solucionar de mil maneras distintas, como por ejemplo pidiendo lo que quieres y que no tengan expuesto nada para que te lo saquen recien cortado y no de 2-3 dias.
Por lo demas el hotel bien, la cama comoda y la habitacion limpia.
response_from_owner_text:
Buenos dias Marta, 

lo primero, agradecemos que se haya tomado la molestia de valorar y comentar su estancia en el hotel.

En primer lugar, la comida es fresca, por lo general la temperatura suele ser algo menos fria y no es necesario poner la calefaccion muy alta. 
Puesto que hoy no habia muchas personas a la hora que han bajado a desayunar, nuestra companera penso que habiendo un bebe podria pasar frio y subio la temperatura bastante mas de lo habitual. De ahi que se resecase el embutido.


 El embutido lo cortan todas las mananas los companeros puesto que la cocina del hotel esta equipada con una maquina para ello.

Por otro lado, no entiendo muy bien su disconformidad con tener que esperar. El companero, como bien aclara usted se encontraba atendiendo a otro de los clientes que estaba desayunando a lo largo de la hora y media que estuvieron desayunando en el comedor. Creo que es suficientemente obvio que, cuando acabase con los otros clientes , estaria predispuesto a ayudarlos en todo lo que estuviese en su mano.

En cualquier caso, seguiremos trabajando en mejorar. 

Feliz dia.

Dpto. de Recepcion.
review_translated_text:
The breakfast buffet had very little variety, and since it's off-season and they probably won't run out, they put it away and re-serve it the next day. I know this because the cold cuts were dry, the bacon was dry, and the donuts were hard. I think instead of putting out 20 slices of each and putting them away, if they put out 5 and replenish them when they run out, everything would be much better and in better condition. Today, they also ran out of hot milk, and they brought me a small jug, which I didn't have enough of. They said, "If you want more, just ask for it." But when I finished it, since the waiter wasn't there, I said, "It doesn't matter, I won't wait any longer," as I had already waited to ask for it. I understand it's off-season, but it can be solved in a thousand different ways, such as asking for what you want and not having anything on display so they can bring it to you freshly cut, not 2-3 days old.
Otherwise, the hotel was fine, the bed was comfortable, and the room was clean.

We deeply regret that your stay was so unsatisfactory.

As a matter of fact, 3-star hotels generally have rooms with 1.35m beds, as permitted by law.

Also, in the future, please don't hesitate to contact any employee to either change rooms if possible, or to exchange your pillows for ones you prefer so you can rest as comfortably as possible.

Have a nice day.
Reception Department.

name: cipriano Jean-Francois
review_text:
Dommage que ce soit bruyant avec la route !
Sinon bel accueil !
Jolie chambre.
review_translated_text:
Too bad it's noisy with the road!
Otherwise nice welcome!
Nice room.

name: ROBERTO MORENO
review_text: El hotel perfecto y la gente igual, lo que no se puede hacer que si pone que el desayuno es a las 8:00,que se empiece a montar a las 8:00,nos tuvimos que ir si desayunar cuando pagamos el Buffett del desayuno, segun la gente del hotel (que fueron encantadores)era por orden de la empresa
review_translated_text: The hotel is perfect and the people are just as perfect. What you can't do is that if it says breakfast is at 8:00, you have to start setting up at 8:00. We had to leave without breakfast when we paid for the breakfast buffet. According to the hotel staff (who were lovely), it was by order of the company.

name: David H
review_text:
Wi-Fi was basically unusable. Constantly disconnecting unless you're on the ground floor.

I put laundry in at 12, I was told it would be ready in the morning, then I was told it would be done at 1. Finally at 3 it was finished. How am I supposed to stay there for one night and have my laundry done at 3pm the next day?? Plans would be impossible to make if this were so. In addition, I was told the laundry would be 4 euros (should've set off alarm bells in my head). It ended up being 33 Euros for 3 pairs of socks, 2 shirts and one pair of pants...

I know this is not the staffs fault so I don't put it on them but this was arguably the most frustrating hotel experience I've ever had in my life.

name: YO
review_text:
Ubicacion y precio los esperados. Reservamos por su website pocos dias antes, sin desayuno (nos parecio un poco caro 8EU) pero cuando llegamos decidimos desayunar, y la sorpresa fue cuando vimos en la habitacion un cartel que tenia los precios del desayuno (9EU). Bueno
.. desayunaremos. Vaya decepcion. Un buffet bastante cutre. Ademas "te amenazan" con una sancion administrativa (son la Administracion???????) de hasta 200EU si fumas en la habitacion. !Por favor.....!. Penoso.
No volveria en absoluto.
Para intentar abrir la ventana tendrias que mover el escritorio.........
Los empleados muy frios e impersonales.
Las camareras parecen de "tudela" te tutean como si fueses de la familia.
response_from_owner_text:
Buenas tardes Luis, 
al reservar el desayuno por booking le pone claramente que, si no lo reserva en regimen de alojamiento y desayuno, el costo sera de 9 euros al llegar al alojamiento y contratarlo.
 Si no reserva por booking y hace la reserva desde la pagina del hotel, le sale el precio del desayuno 9 euros. En definitiva, si hace la reserva del desayuno por cualquier metabuscador o directamente con el hotel, el precio aparece y es 9 euros si lo hace al llegar al hotel. Por lo que no entiendo su 'sorpresa' cuando se repite el precio en cualquier lugar a la hora de querer contratarlo una vez llegan los clientes al hotel.
Por otro lado, considero que emplear la palabra 'amenaza' es un tanto impreciso, principalmente porque ese 'consejo' al final, es unicamente para beneficio del cliente puesto que es un hotel en el que esta prohibido fumar y no obligamos a nadie a cumplir las normas, simplemente aconsejamos lo que consideramos que beneficie en cualquier momento.
Por ultimo, lamento que la imagen de nuestro personal sea asi. Si de algo se caracteriza el personal es de tener resenas muy positivas por su cercania y predisposicion a la hora de tomar contacto con los clientes y ayudarlos en todo lo que este en nuestra mano.
Lamentamos que no haya disfrutado de su estancia.
Feliz dia! 
Clara G.
review_translated_text:
Location and price as expected. We booked through their website a few days before, without breakfast (we thought it was a bit expensive, EU8) but when we arrived we decided to have breakfast, and the surprise was when we saw a sign in the room that had the breakfast prices (EU9). Well
.. we will have breakfast. What a disappointment. A pretty shabby buffet. Furthermore, they "threaten" you with an administrative fine (are they the Administration?????????) of up to EU200 if you smoke in the room. Please...... Painful.
I wouldn't go back at all.
To try to open the window you would have to move the desktop.........
Very cold and impersonal employees.
The waitresses seem like "tudela" they address you as if you were family.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Good afternoon, Luis,
When you book breakfast through Booking.com, it clearly states that, if you don't book it as a bed and breakfast package, the cost will be EU9 upon arrival at the accommodation and booking.
If you don't book through Booking.com and make the reservation through the hotel's website, the breakfast price will be EU9. Ultimately, if you book breakfast through any metasearch engine or directly with the hotel, the price appears and it's EU9 upon arrival at the hotel. Therefore, I don't understand your "surprise" when the price is repeated everywhere when you want to book it once guests arrive at the hotel.
On the other hand, I think using the word "threat" is somewhat imprecise, mainly because that "advice," in the end, is solely for the benefit of the guest, since this is a smoke-free hotel, and we don't force anyone to comply with the rules; we simply advise what we consider beneficial at any given time.
Finally, I regret that the image of our staff is this way. If there's one thing the staff is known for, it's having very positive reviews for their friendliness and willingness to connect with guests and help them in any way they can.
We're sorry you didn't enjoy your stay.
Have a great day!
Clara G.

name: Eli _Ciosa
review_text: It's about 10 minutes from the cathedral by walk. It was easy to find the road. The room condition was not bad, seemed like little bit old but quite clean. The most of all....wokers r very kind and lovely.

name: Angela Calvo
review_text: Muy limpio y muy bien sutuado
review_translated_text: Very clean and very well done

name: Mabel Lorenzo
review_text: Un buen lugar para descansar
review_translated_text: A good place to rest

name: Soledad Pello
review_text: Nada recomendable  la atencion pesima  las habitaciones viejas, pequenas y sin ningun tipo de detalle, le sobra una estrella para mi padecer. La cafeteria no funciona y no hay ni nevera en la habitacion.
response_from_owner_text:
Buenas tardes Soledad, 
lamentamos que su estancia haya sido tan poco satisfactoria. Agradecemos su comentario y tendremos en cuenta todo lo que ha apuntado para, en un futuro, poder mejorarlo.
Un saludo.
Dpto. de Recepcion.

response_from_owner_translated_text:

Best regards,
Reception Department

name: juan torrillas
review_text: Muy bien y un precio mejor....
review_translated_text: Very good and a better price....

name: Sqesl
review_text: Tipico hotel para visitar la ciudad, bien situado, opcion de parking aunque muy caro, si mo eres de los que vive para el coche lo puedes dejar en la calle, hay sitio de sobra y no es zona conflictiva, por poner una mejora seria la television, habitacion grande television muy pequena    resultado, necesitamos unos prismaticos para verla, por lo demas bien, despues de todo la mayoria usamos este tipo de hotel para dormir y ducharnos.
review_translated_text: Typical hotel for visiting the city, well located, parking option although very expensive, if you are not one of those who live for the car you can leave it on the street, there is plenty of space and it is not a conflict zone, to put an improvement would be the television, large room very small television result, we needed binoculars to see it, otherwise fine, after all most of us use this type of hotel to sleep and shower.

name: Pruden Rodriguez
review_text: Habitacion muy justa. Hotel con pocos servicios.Aparcas gratis alrededor y el centro de Burgos queda cerca.
review_translated_text: Very fair room. Hotel with few services. Free parking around and the center of Burgos is close.

name: Ainara Apezetxea
review_text: Fenomenal
review_translated_text: Phenomenal

name: Karen Alejandra Escobar Mendez
review_text: Hotel perfecto, las habitaciones impecables, la vista del piso 10 es preciosa, justo ves la catedral de Burgos, ademas a 10 minutos del centro, tiene todo cerca. Volveria a hospedarme alli sin duda alguna.
review_translated_text: Perfect hotel, impeccable rooms, the view from the 10th floor is beautiful, you can just see the cathedral of Burgos, also 10 minutes from the center, everything is close by. I would stay there again without a doubt.

name: Carmen Roz
review_text: El hotel no lo recomiendo, habitaciones super deterioradas, sin embargo la atencion brindada por Javier fue excelente. La habitacion estaba sucia con cabellos en el armario y bano. La verdad que no me gusto para nada. La cobija olia un poco mal y se ve que no la higienizan.
review_translated_text: I do not recommend the hotel, the rooms are very deteriorated, however the attention provided by Javier was excellent. The room was dirty with hair in the closet and bathroom. The truth is that I didn't like it at all. The blanket smelled a little bad and it seemed like they didn't sanitize it.

name: 105patrick35
review_text: meriterait un bon rafraichissement et les voilages n'ont pas du connaitre de lavage depuis un moment. Chambre relativement petite par contre belle salle de bains. Agreable accueil par Javier.||Dommage que le tarif soit le meme pour une chambre non renovee avec lit 140/190 que pour une chambre plus spacieuse et rafraichie avec lit 160/200. Bon petit dejeuner. Pas toujours evident d'avoir rapidement l'ascenseur||Reste le point fort de l'hotel ; son emplacement a quelques minutes a pied du centre historique. ||Aucun probleme de stationnement en surface quasiment a la porte de l'hotel.
review_translated_text: Could do with a good refresh and the curtains must not have been washed for a while. Relatively small room, but nice bathroom. Pleasant welcome by Javier.||Too bad the price is the same for a non-renovated room with a 140/190 bed as for a more spacious and refreshed room with a 160/200 bed. Good breakfast. Not always easy to get to the elevator quickly||The hotel's strong point remains; its location a few minutes' walk from the historic center. ||No problem with surface parking, almost at the hotel's door.

name: Victoria
review_text: Nos ofrecieron un parking sin avisarnos que era un servicio adicional. Ademas de ser un parking muy incomodo y aparcar 20 minutos (solo para bajar las maletas del coche) nos cobraron 15 EUROS. El personal NUNCA nos dijo que era un servicio pago. Lo unico que puedo decir es que la cama era comoda y la limpieza de la habitacion estuvo bien.
review_translated_text: They offered us parking without informing us that it was an additional service. In addition to the parking being very inconvenient and requiring us to park for 20 minutes (just to unload our luggage from the car), they charged us 15 euros. The staff NEVER told us it was a paid service. All I can say is that the bed was comfortable and the room was clean.

name: Flashbacks
review_text: Good price and nice place. Near the bus station and city center

name: RAFAEL GRACIA
review_text: La habitacion bien, y la comida tambien bien situado.
review_translated_text: The room was good, and the food was also well located.

name: Maria Jose Migoya San Miguel
review_text: Por fuera parece nuevo pero por dentro esta muy descuidado,el personal muy atento,no volveria
review_translated_text: From the outside it looks new but inside it is very neglected, the staff is very attentive, I would not return

name: Ferran
review_text: El parking es comparteix amb veins i es una mica mal iluminat i no gaire indicat per dins
review_translated_text: The parking lot is shared with neighbors and is a bit poorly lit and not very well indicated inside.

name: maria belen tur tashiro
review_text: Todo muy bien y la atencion excelente
review_translated_text: Everything was very good and the service was excellent

name: Simone Sportiello
review_text: Ottimo hotel nelle immediate vicinanze del centro citta. Camera con bagno con doccia/vasca ed un lavandino in vetro. Letto comodo. Camera pulita. Offre la colazione e la disponibilita di garage (15EU/giorno).
review_translated_text: Excellent hotel in the immediate vicinity of the city center. Room with bathroom with shower/tub and a glass sink. Comfortable bed. Clean room. It offers breakfast and garage availability (15EU/day).

name: Maryse_Damien
review_text: Mon fils et moi-meme avons pris 2 chambres dans l'hotel RICE BULEVAR a Burgos en Espagne le vendredi soir 02/09/2022 ou l'hotesse ne parlait pas le francais et nous a donne une chambre chacun au 2eme etage. J'ai regarde la proprete des draps et j'ai trouve sur la housse qui recouvre le matelas de grandes aureoles d'urine. j'ai tellement ete choquee que je l'ai retiree du lit et j'ai retourne le matelas. En allumant la lampe de chevet, j'ai trouve de la poussiere sous la table de nuit et sur le bas de la tete de lit en bois. Le lendemain, en ouvrant la fenetre pour aerer la chambre, j'ai constate que le rebord de la fenetre etait sale et que la vitre n'avait pas ete nettoyee alors qu'elle est dans la chambre donc accessible. Payer 65 EU par personne une chambre avec des prestations aussi mediocres ne sont pas dignes d'un hotel 3 etoiles. C'est une honte pour l'hotel et un vol pour le client qui doit, au vu du prix et des etoiles affichees, trouver une proprete irreprochable. Mon fils et moi, sommes tres decus et choques par les services de cet hotel que nous voulons signaler a la clientele pour qu'elle soit avertie.
review_translated_text: My son and I took 2 rooms in the RICE BULEVAR hotel in Burgos, Spain on Friday evening, 02/09/2022, where the hostess did not speak French and gave us a room each on the 2nd floor. I looked at the cleanliness of the sheets and found large urine stains on the cover that covers the mattress. I was so shocked that I removed it from the bed and turned the mattress over. When I turned on the bedside lamp, I found dust under the nightstand and on the bottom of the wooden headboard. The next day, when I opened the window to air the room, I noticed that the window sill was dirty and that the glass had not been cleaned even though it is in the room and therefore accessible. Paying EU65 per person for a room with such poor services is not worthy of a 3-star hotel. This is a disgrace for the hotel and a robbery for the customer who, given the price and the number of stars displayed, should find the cleanliness impeccable. My son and I are very disappointed and shocked by the services of this hotel and we want to bring this to the attention of customers so that they are warned.

name: Henning Kasper
review_text: Grosses Durchreise Hotel. 10 Minuten zu Fuss von der Altstadt entfernt.
review_translated_text: Large transit hotel. 10 minutes walk from the old town.

name: Yolanda Rodriguez Trujillo
review_text:
Pasamos el puente de Agosto en una de las habitaciones con terraza y las vistas de Burgos espectaculares con la Catedral de fondo, ademas esta situado en una zona tranquila, pero muy cerca del Centro.
La habitacion no es muy grande, pero la terraza contrarresta esto.
El personal muy profesional y agradable, permiten dejar el coche en el parking aunque hayas hecho el Check-out.
review_translated_text:
We spent the August long weekend in one of the rooms with a terrace and spectacular views of Burgos with the Cathedral in the background. It is also located in a quiet area, but very close to the Center.
The room is not very big, but the terrace counteracts this.
The staff is very professional and pleasant, they allow you to leave the car in the parking lot even if you have checked out.

name: Fran Pla
review_text: Buen sitio para dormir, muy buena ubicacion, cerca de la catedral, y del centro, lo unico que el desayuno si lo quieres incluir es demasiado caro para la gastronomia y lugares que hay alrededor para poder hacerlo
review_translated_text: Good place to sleep, very good location, close to the cathedral, and the center, the only thing that if you want to include breakfast is too expensive for the gastronomy and places around to be able to do it

name: Benito Monsalve
review_text: Correcto
review_translated_text: Correct

review_text: Vistas de la catedral magnificas desde el 9o. Pequenos desconchones de pintura y algun mueble con danos.
review_translated_text: Magnificent views of the cathedral from the 9th floor. Minor paint chips and some damaged furniture.

name: Luis Javier Diaz Llorente
review_text: Muy bien el hotel, y en el trato personal tambien. No estaba abierta la cafeteria o bar.

name: Eliane De Freitas
review_text: Fue maravilloso. Personal muy amable, educados, todo muy limpio libre de tabaco. Esta fenomenal
review_translated_text: It was wonderful. Very friendly, polite staff, everything very clean, tobacco-free. It's phenomenal

name: Francisco Sangenis Exposito
review_text: Ideal para visitar Burgos
review_translated_text: Ideal for visiting Burgos

name: Mohamed Kamboua
review_text: Ont a sejourner 2 fois dans cette hotel en juillet et en aout les chambres sont correct mais pas de frigo dans les chambres et le prix et cher pour l'emplacement et la qualite ! 90euros la chambre et 15euros pour le parking souterrain.
review_translated_text: We stayed at this hotel twice in July and August. The rooms are OK, but there are no fridges in the rooms, and the price is expensive for the location and quality! 90 euros for the room and 15 euros for underground parking.

name: J Gomes
review_text: Um bom hotel,  mas a necessitar de alguma atualizacao.
review_translated_text: A good hotel, but in need of some updating.

name: Elena Moreno
review_text: Hotel urbano parco con un precio excesivo para lo que ofrecen. Las fotos de las habitaciones ofertadas en Booking no se corresponden con la realidad. Aparecen las suites cuando en realidad estas reservando la estandar. Las camas dobles eran pequenas y la habitacion nada espaciosa.
review_translated_text: Spacious urban hotel with an excessive price for what it offers. The photos of the rooms offered on Booking do not correspond to reality. The suites appear when you are actually booking the standard one. The double beds were small and the room was not spacious at all.

name: Carlos Royo
review_text:
A favor:
Hotel de estilo moderno y funcional. Muy bien ubicado. A tan solo 10 minutos o menos andando de la catedral. Hay aparcamiento libre a dos minutos del hotel aunque no me hizo falta porque en la misma calle del hotel suele haber huecos.

En contra:
El mobiliario de la habitacion tiene signos de mucho desgaste y uso. Algunos ruidos de tuberias, golpe de ariete, que durante la noche no resultan agradables.
El desayuno deja bastante que desear.  En este caso, los productos son de escasa calidad y la variedad brilla por su ausencia. El tomate rallado de lo peor que he conocido, tomate de bote. Los zumos son nectares de poca calidad y del embutido, jamon o jamon cocido ya ni hablamos. Por 9 euros (es lo que cobran) y por menos he conocido mejores desayunos en otros hoteles.
No hay nevera en la habitacion.
review_translated_text:
In favor:
Modern and functional style hotel. Very well located. Just 10 minutes or less walk from the cathedral. There is free parking two minutes from the hotel although I didn't need it because there are usually spaces on the same street as the hotel.

Against:
The furniture in the room has signs of a lot of wear and use. Some pipe noises, water hammer, which are not pleasant at night.
Breakfast leaves a lot to be desired.  In this case, the products are of poor quality and the variety is conspicuous by its absence. The worst grated tomato I have ever known, canned tomato. The juices are low quality nectars and we don't even talk about sausage, ham or cooked ham. For 9 euros (that's what they charge) and for less I have known better breakfasts in other hotels.
There is no refrigerator in the room.

name: Oscar Reinaldo
review_text: Muy centrico. Muy limpio. Agradable y sorprendente atencion en recepcion. Para repetir.
review_translated_text: Very central. Very clean. Pleasant and surprisingly attentive reception. Will definitely stay again.

name: mox79
review_text: Buon hotel, stanza e bagno puliti. Non troppo distante dal centro, che e facilmemte raggiungibile. |Hanno il parcheggio privato a pagamento, ma e possibile anche trovarlo nelle vicinanze, fuori dalla struttura. |Colazione non fatta.|Staff disponibile, buon rapporto qualita / prezzo.
review_translated_text: Good hotel, clean room and bathroom. Not too far from the center, which is easily reachable. |They have private parking for a fee, but it is also possible to find it nearby, outside the structure. |Breakfast not made.|Helpful staff, good quality / price ratio.

name: JORDI RIOS
review_text: Hotel de 3 estrellas bien ubicado y con buenas habitaciones. El desayuno muy completo. Parquing en el hotel con acceso directo en ascensor. Proximo a la catedral.
review_translated_text: A well-located 3-star hotel with good rooms. The breakfast was very comprehensive. Parking is available at the hotel with direct elevator access. Close to the cathedral.

name: Juan Araque
review_text:
Buena ubicacion cerca del centro y sin necesidad de pagar parking ya que por la zona se aparca facil. Andando al centro se llega enseguida.
El personal de recepcion muy amable. Las habitaciones muy correctas y limpias. Agradecer que me ofrecieran 2 habitaciones conjuntas y comunicadas desde el interior.
review_translated_text:
Good location near the center and without the need to pay parking since parking is easy in the area. Walking to the center you can get there right away.
Very friendly reception staff. The rooms are very correct and clean. Thank you for offering me 2 joint rooms connected from the inside.

name: Manuel Martinez
review_text: Buen par precio/prestaciones. Muy cerca del centro historico de la catedral.
review_translated_text: Good price/performance pair. Very close to the historic center of the cathedral.

name: Semaro
review_text:
Se puso a llover en la habitacion al encender el aire acondicionado.
Nos lo tomamos a risa, pero no nos hizo gracia.
No nos cambiaron de habitacion porque no habia mas libres en el hotel. Lo unico que hicieron fue traernos toallas (de lo cual no tiene la culpa el personal).
La unica compensacion fue un 10% de descuento (escasa compensacion para dormir sin aire y con goteras).
review_translated_text:
It started raining in the room when I turned on the air conditioning.
We laughed at it, but we didn't find it funny.
They didn't change our room because there were no more vacancies in the hotel. The only thing they did was bring us towels (which is not the staff's fault).
The only compensation was a 10% discount (meager compensation for sleeping without air and leaks).

name: Fernando Herrera
review_text: Buen hotel, todo bien. Quizas un poco elevado el precio
review_translated_text: Good hotel, everything good. Maybe the price is a little high

name: Gael V8 (GaelV8)
review_text:
L'hotel est plutot bien situe
Pour le tarif, nous avons paye 105.84EU (nuit du 12 au 13 aout 2022)
Quartier populaire, pas tres loin des sites touristiques.
La chambre est un peu desuete mais correcte.
Le petit dejeuner est bien et le prix raisonnable.

Les points negatifs :

* Le parking... J'ai plusieurs remarques.
1/ la difficulte a trouver les emplacement au -2 et l'eclairage dans le parking (tres sombre)
2/ le tarif tres tres excessif (15EU la nuit...)
3/ sortir du parking... La signalisation pour trouver la sortie est inexistante.
4/ il faut revenir a l'accueil pour rendre le badge de sortie du parking.

* La difficulte de communiquer autrement qu'en espagnol... Ceci semble etre commun a la majeure partie de l'Espagne...
review_translated_text:
The hotel is quite well located
For the price, we paid EU105.84 (night from August 12 to 13, 2022)
Popular area, not very far from tourist sites.
The room is a little outdated but OK.
The breakfast is good and the price reasonable.

The negative points:

* The parking lot... I have several comments.
1/ the difficulty in finding locations at -2 and the lighting in the parking lot (very dark)
2/ the very very excessive price (15EU per night...)
3/ exit the car park... The signage to find the exit is non-existent.
4/ you must return to reception to return the parking exit badge.

* The difficulty of communicating other than in Spanish... This seems to be common to most of Spain...

name: Manuel Almeida Pereira
review_text: A 3*** hotel, simple but well organized, clean and comfortable. Bedrooms are not big but enough for one night stay in the middle of a long travel for a good rest. Breakfast is good and with sufficient quality and quantity.

name: Frederic
review_text: Hotel tres tres bien place avec parking
review_translated_text: Very well located hotel with parking

name: Anastasiya Gryukanova
review_text: Habitacion pequena, se escucha musica de una discoteca cerca. Personal amable y el desayuno es lo mejor del hotel!
review_translated_text: Small room, you can hear music from a nearby nightclub. Friendly staff and breakfast is the best thing about the hotel!

name: Al varo
review_text:
Hotel barato en las afueras de burgos.
La habitacion tiene vistas a la catedral. El dia anterior me mandaron un email para que pagara un extra por tener vistas a la catedral. Pese a no pagarlo las segui teniendo.
Tiene mucho ruido. La habitacion estaba en una sexta planta y se escuchaba el trafico de la calle adyacente toda la noche. El ascensor y los conductos del aire tambien hacen ruido.
El wifi del hotel no funciona bien
En la habitacion solo hay enchufe en una de las mesillas.
Se aparca bien por la zona (cerca hay un aparcamiento disuasorio gratuito) y no esta dentro de la zona de estacionamiento regulado.
review_translated_text:
Cheap hotel on the outskirts of burgos.
The room has views of the cathedral. The day before they sent me an email asking me to pay extra to have views of the cathedral. Despite not paying for it, I still had them.
It has a lot of noise. The room was on the sixth floor and you could hear the traffic from the adjacent street all night. The elevator and air ducts also make noise.
The hotel wifi does not work well
In the room there is only a plug on one of the nightstands.
There is good parking in the area (there is a free park and ride nearby) and it is not within the regulated parking area.

name: Raul Coca
review_text: Habiamos estado con anterioridad en el hotel y al repetir ha sido algo peor, hicimos la reserva desde su web con una promocion y la habitacion que nos dieron era minima. Por lo demas todo correcto, el personal muy amable.
review_translated_text: We had previously been to the hotel and when we repeated it was something worse, we made the reservation through their website with a promotion and the room they gave us was minimal. Otherwise everything is correct, the staff is very friendly.

name: Dolores Duran
review_text: La situacion es buena, con  sitio para aparcar cerca y lo mas destacable  que esta limpio.Las habitaciones necesitarian un poco de mantenimiento y los pasillos igual
review_translated_text: The location is good, with parking nearby and the most notable thing is that it is clean. The rooms could use a little maintenance and the hallways as well.

name: Christophe Auriac
review_text: Tres bon rapport qualite prix a deux minutes de la cathedrale. Possible parking a 15 Euros. Petit dejeuner a 9 euros. En revanche l entree ou la sortie du parking n est pas pratique puisqu il faut aller chercher l hotesse pour vous ouvrir. Petit soucis de comprehension l hotesse d accueil ne parlait ni anglais ni francais.
review_translated_text: Very good value for money two minutes from the cathedral. Possible parking for 15 Euros. Breakfast at 9 euros. On the other hand, entering or exiting the car park is not practical since you have to go find the hostess to let you in. Small problem with understanding, the receptionist spoke neither English nor French.

name: Maria P
review_text: Hotel con buena ubicacion, limpio, sencillo pero con todo lo necesario. Buena relacion calidad precio
review_translated_text: Hotel with a good location, clean, simple but with everything you need. Good value for money

name: MARIA PILAR VALLEJO CHAVES
review_text: Muy buena ubicacion. Andando 10 minutos a la catedral. El personal super atento y encantador.
review_translated_text: Very good location. Walking 10 minutes to the cathedral. The staff is super attentive and charming.

name: Celia Macias
review_text: Muy agradable, la relacion costo beneficio es muy buena, los empleados atienden muy bien, muy serviciales
review_translated_text: Very nice, the cost-benefit ratio is very good, the employees serve very well, very helpful

name: Elvira Montins Llach
review_text: Muy correcto todo ya la ubicacion muy buena para poder aparcar y llegas al centro un menos de 10 minutos.
review_translated_text: Everything is very correct and the location is very good to be able to park and you can get to the center in less than 10 minutes.

name: Peter cache
review_text: Todo bien, aunque la habitacion era pequena. En recepcion te atienden bien
review_translated_text: Everything was fine, although the room was small. They serve you well at reception.

name: Jose Ant. Jimenez
review_text: Instalaciones antiguas.
review_translated_text: Old facilities.

name: JPL45BIS
review_text: Correct pour une escale d'une nuit sans plus. 3 etoiles, faut le dire vite.|Bien situe pour la visite de la ville et dispose d'un parking prive.|Accueil tres agreable et en francais. Petit dejeuner tres convenable avec une grande variete de mets sucres et sales.
review_translated_text: Decent for a one-night stopover, nothing more. 3 stars, it must be said quickly.|Well located for visiting the city and has private parking.|Very pleasant welcome, in French. Very decent breakfast with a wide variety of sweet and savory dishes.

name: Arantxa Martinez S.
review_text:
La atencion de recepcion fue lo unico bueno, eso y las vistas de la habitacion.
Todo estaba muy bien hasta que fui a tomar una ducha y las toallas estaban sucias (habia una mancha mas que sospechosa, como de ojete). Las camas tenian ruedas y cuando apoyabas la espalda en el cabecero se movian. Quince euros por dejar el coche en el parking una noche me parece excesivo. No creo que vuelva.
response_from_owner_text:
Buenas tardes Arantxa, 

lamentamos profundamente la situacion a la que tuvo que enfrentarse.
 Las camareras de pisos trabajan mucho y aunque no es excusa fue un error. Hubiese sido tan simple como solicitar a recepcion un cambio de toallas y los companeros de recepcion hubiesen estado encantados de ayudarle en todo lo que hubiese sido posible.
Los parking subterraneos con acceso directo al hotel, por lo general, son siempre de pago el cualquier establecimiento. Por otro lado, si el precio le parece abusivo, siempre comentamos desde recepcion las posibilidades que existen en los alrededores del hotel ya que es zona blanca, un barrio residencial y una zona segura para aparcar el coche.
Un saludo.
Clara G.
review_translated_text:
The reception service was the only good thing, that and the views of the room.
Everything was very good until I went to take a shower and the towels were dirty (there was a very suspicious stain, like an eyelet). The beds had wheels and when you put your back on the headboard they moved. Fifteen euros to leave the car in the parking lot one night seems excessive to me. I don't think I'll come back.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Good afternoon, Arantxa,

We deeply regret the situation you had to face.
The housekeepers work very hard, and while that's no excuse, it was a mistake. It would have been as simple as asking reception for a change of towels, and the reception staff would have been happy to help in any way possible.
Underground parking with direct access to the hotel generally requires a fee. However, if the price seems unreasonable, we always discuss parking options in the area surrounding the hotel with reception, as it's a private parking zone, a residential neighborhood, and a safe place to park your car.
Best regards.
Clara G.

name: Climber12909555191
review_text: The hotel is very tired , cracked tiles, nowhere in whole hotel to get a coffee. Complicated parking system which I thought was free. Said pet friendly, then on checkout said they didn't allow dogs and wanted to charge 30 euros for extra cleaning, in spite of seeing the dog on check in. Cafe where breakfast is served wouldn't serve us a coffee to take away unless we had full breakfast.|Plus side, room ok but air con only blew warm air and it was 35 degrees.

name: Krux Guridi
review_text: Fantastico. Cerca del centro y con desayuno continental!!! Para repetir!!!!
review_translated_text: Fantastic. Close to the center and with continental breakfast!!! To repeat!!!!

name: Jesus Rodriguez
review_text: Muy bien situado tuvimos habitacion con vistas a la catedral. Habitaciones sin pegas y buffet de desayuno muy completo y bien atendido.
review_translated_text: Very well located we had a room with views of the cathedral. Rooms without problems and a very complete and well attended breakfast buffet.

name: Claudia Alberti
review_text: Confortable
review_translated_text: Comfortable

name: Jordi Martinez
review_text: Hotel acogedor, relativamente cerca del centro historico de la ciudad, el tamano de la habitacion esta muy bien, limpio y personal muy atento.
review_translated_text: Cozy hotel, relatively close to the historic city center. The room size is very good, clean, and the staff is very attentive.

name: Rocio De Nova
review_text: El sitio un poco antiguo, limpio y muy bien situado.
review_translated_text: The place is a little old, clean and very well located.

name: Diana Mancheno Lorente
review_text: Me aloje por trabajo y fue un acierto. Esta en una zona tranquila de Burgos donde se puede aparcar facilmente y a diez minutos de la catedral. La estancia fue perfecta! La habitacion limpia y reformada, el bano impoluto, la cama super comoda. El bufet del desayuno tambien fue muy bueno. Repetire sin duda!
response_from_owner_text:
Muchas gracias por su valoracion Diana!
Feliz dia!
Clara G.
review_translated_text: I stayed for work and it was a success. It is in a quiet area of   Burgos where you can park easily and ten minutes from the cathedral. The stay was perfect! The clean and renovated room, the immaculate bathroom, the super comfortable bed. The breakfast buffet was also very good. I will repeat without a doubt!
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Thank you so much for your feedback, Diana!
Have a great day!
Clara G.

name: Jose Antonio Lopez Lopez
review_text: Hotel sencillo. Esta a unos 15-20 minutos del centro. Habitaciones funcionales pero ya muy anticuadas. Ascensores lentos. Salvo recepcion no hay practicamente servicio. Bar cerrado. Cenas no muy buenas. Desayuno muy sencillo.
review_translated_text: Simple hotel. It is about 15-20 minutes from the center. Functional rooms but already very dated. Slow elevators. Except reception there is practically no service. Closed bar. Dinners not very good. Very simple breakfast.

name: Sodapop pop
review_text: Hotel muy sencillito, un poco anticuado. Lo mejor es su situacion, cercano al centro, aunque la zona mas proxima no hay mucho comercio ni hosteleria. Habitaciones sencillas, television pequena, bano con cables al aire del secatoallas que ademas no funciona. Retrete sin precinto de limpieza. Gel/champu encastrado en la pared. No hay amenities, siendo un 3* me esperaba algo mas en este sentido. Desayuno muy sencillo, sin nada a destacar, poca bolleria y dulce en general, cafe de poca calidad. Los ascensores tardan una barbaridad, hay 2.
review_translated_text: Very simple hotel, a little dated. The best thing is its location, close to the center, although the nearest area does not have much commerce or hospitality. Simple rooms, small television, bathroom with cables exposed to the towel rail that also does not work. Toilet without cleaning seal. Gel/shampoo built into the wall. There are no amenities, being a 3* I expected something more in this regard. Very simple breakfast, with nothing to highlight, few pastries and sweets in general, low quality coffee. The elevators take forever, there are 2.

name: Martha Solanas
review_text: Nos dijeron que tenian restaurante y cafeteria, cuando llegamos a las 21:00 despues de 9 horas de viaje nos dijeron que tanto el restaurante como la cafeteria estaban cerrados pero no por la hora sino porque ya no disponian de esos servicios, UN ENGANO!!! no debe salir en la web que tienen estos servicios si realmente no los ofrecen. La persona de la recepcion despues de nuestras quejas se quedo exactamente igual, muy antipaticos y nada profesionales. Las habitaciones muy pequenas. Ni lo recomendamos ni volveremos, de hecho teniamos reserva para una una noche mas y la anulamos.
review_translated_text: They told us that they had a restaurant and cafeteria, when we arrived at 9:00 p.m. after a 9-hour trip they told us that both the restaurant and the cafeteria were closed but not because of the time but because they no longer had those services, A DECEPTION! It should not appear on the website that they have these services if they really do not offer them. The person at the reception after our complaints remained exactly the same, very unfriendly and unprofessional. Very small rooms. We neither recommend it nor will we return, in fact we had a reservation for one more night and we canceled it.

name: Ma JOSE DIAZ
review_text: Vistas preciosas, personal amable,pero necesita una gran reforma, calidad precio deja basta te q desear
review_translated_text: Beautiful views, friendly staff, but needs a major overhaul. The quality and price leaves a lot to be desired.

name: Sefa Martinez
review_text: Para repetir.
review_translated_text: To repeat.

name: Raoul Servert
review_text: Lo unico que necesita es una remodelacion de los pasillos y las puertas que estan viejas
review_translated_text: The only thing it needs is a remodeling of the hallways and doors that are old.

name: David Sotelo (DGoliath969)
review_text:
Excelente ubicacion, a 10min del centro. Zona tranquila. Cama comoda, personal muy amable, solo le falta a las habitaciones un poco de mantenimiento, cortinaje abandonado y medio roto, mobiliario aviejado, mamparas rotas, ...

Excellent location, 10 minutes from the center. Quiet area. Comfortable bed, very friendly staff, the rooms only need a little maintenance, abandoned and half-broken curtains, aged furniture, broken screens, ...
But nothing that would prevent a good rest

name: Agustin Montero
review_text: El hotel esta en reformas. Yo estuve en la planta 10 y las habitaciones no estas finalizadas. Pero su cama es comoda. El desayuno buffet. Correcto
review_translated_text: The hotel is undergoing renovations. I was on the 10th floor and the rooms are not finished. But your bed is comfortable. The buffet breakfast. Correct

review_translated_text: Careful! Liar receptionists. They tell you some things on the phone, and others at reception. Impossible to use gift coupons.

name: Paula Suarez Hernandez
review_text: Calidad precio muy caro.

name: Susana Avoguadra

review_text: Cerquita de la catedral, con sitio para aparcar el coche en muchas calles aledanas (depende la epoca del ano). Habitacion comoda y grande.
review_translated_text: Close to the cathedral, with space to park your car in many surrounding streets (depending on the time of year). Comfortable and large room.

name: Kepa Caballero Rivera
review_text: Salvo las sabanas del primer dia que estaban sucias todo correcto, el trato bueno y amable
review_translated_text: Except for the sheets on the first day that were dirty, everything was fine, the treatment was good and friendly.

name: Laida Berasain Guerras
review_text: Muy bien situado. La cama muy comoda.  El lavabo es muy bonito. En siete minutos estas en la catedral. La pena que no acepten mascotas.
review_translated_text: Very well located. The bed was very comfortable. The bathroom was very nice. You're at the cathedral in seven minutes. It's a shame they don't allow pets.

review_text: Excelente hotel. Muy bien ubicado y un trato excelente
review_translated_text: Excellent hotel. Very well located and excellent treatment

name: Mar Sanchez
review_text: No dispone de servicio para cenas, solo desayuno
review_translated_text: There is no dinner service, only breakfast

name: ana alvarez
review_text:
Mi estancia fue desastrosa. Tanto las dos habitaciones que me dieron.La 602 para ser exacto fue pesima(los ruidos de la calle, insonorizacion fatal y el aire se filtra por las ventanas)moviendose las cortinas,el ruido del ascensor cada vez que se usa es como un tanque y no deja dormir. No volveremos.
La recepcionista, creo que se llama Magdalena es muy agradable. Nos ofrecio otra habitacion y lo que ella no sabia era que era peor que la anterior.
review_translated_text:
My stay was disastrous. Both the two rooms that they gave me. 602 to be exact was terrible (the noises from the street, terrible soundproofing and the air leaks through the windows), the curtains moving, the noise of the elevator every time it is used is like a tank and does not allow me to sleep. We will not return.
The receptionist, I think her name is Magdalena, is very nice. She offered us another room and what she didn't know was that it was worse than the previous one.

name: Ernesto Iglesias
review_text: Muy sobrio y buena atencion. Habitacion y bano confortables. Yo le pondria 8 puntos.
review_translated_text: Very sober and good attention. Comfortable room and bathroom. I would give it 8 points.

name: los rubios amos amos
review_text: Personal amable,situacion  inmejorable. Limpieza Ok.Tamano de habitacion un poco ajustada.
review_translated_text: Friendly staff, unbeatable location. Cleaning Ok. Room size a little tight.

name: armelleperrier
review_text: Nous avons reserve 2 chambres en avril 2022. L'hotel etait cher par rapport aux prestations proposees et on nous a demande de payer des notre arrivee.|La literie etait peu confortable avec des petits lits sur roulettes qui bougeaient a chaque fois que nous nous tournions.|La chambre disposait de peu de prises electriques pour recharger les appareils (2 en debranchant la lampe).|Dans la salle de bains le distributeur de savon etait sale et vide et il n'y avait pas de bouchon dans la baignoire. Dans la salle de bains de l'autre chambre il fallait contourner les toilettes pour acceder a la douche.|Le petit dejeuner etait tres moyen avec peu de choix et des jus de fruits coupes a l'eau et trop sucres. |Le seul point positif de l'hotel est son emplacement a proximite du centre historique et de la cathedrale.
review_translated_text: We booked 2 rooms in April 2022. The hotel was expensive compared to the services offered and we were asked to pay upon arrival.|The bedding was uncomfortable with small beds on wheels that moved every time we turned.|The room had few electrical outlets for charging devices (2 by unplugging the lamp).|In the bathroom the soap dispenser was dirty and empty and there was no plug in the bathtub. In the bathroom of the other room you had to go around the toilet to access the shower.|The breakfast was very average with little choice and fruit juices cut with water and too sweet. |The only positive point of the hotel is its location close to the historic center and the cathedral.

name: Miguel Angel Diaz de lecea Casero
Joaquin Cuco
review_text:
HOTEL

Que un hotel de estas carazteristicas aproveche para cobrarte por una habitacion 147EU por una noche en Semana Santa..,es una verguenza.

El hotel en si necesita una buena renovacion...,pq se ha quedado en los 70.
Las habitaciones son pequenisimas,viejas,incomodas y feas.Asi como el mobiliario,la television,la cama,el supuesto escritorio y las ventanas.

Si a eso le sumas que tu ventana de a la carretera principal te vas a hartar de oir trafico toda la noche.

El aire acondicionado no funcionaba..,el calor en la habitacion insoportable.
Pegado a la puerta de entrada (puerta mal acabada por donde se colaba toda la luz del pasillo en la noche)..,tiene una luz de emergencia que te ilumina toda la habitacion...,perfecto para dormir.

Ni una misera botella de agua de bienvenida y por supuesto..,no hay nevera para tener tus propias cosas.

Me queje en recepcion cuando me dieron la habitacion y les explique mi opinion respecto a el precio y lo que me estaban dando.
Por lo visto todas las habitaciones son iguales.

El desayuno al dia siguiente era correcto.Poco que anadir.
Y he de reconocer que el personal atendio mi queja y me trataron bien.

Me tiro el ano viajando y alojandome en hoteles de todo tipo y sinceramente este no se acercaria ni a un hostal de carretera de 2 estrellas.

Por un alojamiento asi no se deberia de pagar mas de 50EU la noche.
review_translated_text:
HOTEL

That a hotel with these characteristics takes the opportunity to charge you EU147 for a room for one night during Easter... is a shame.

The hotel itself needs a good renovation..., because it has remained in the 70s.
The rooms are tiny, old, uncomfortable and ugly, as well as the furniture, the television, the bed, the supposed desk and the windows.

If you add to that that your window faces the main road, you're going to get sick of hearing traffic all night.

The air conditioning did not work..., the heat in the room was unbearable.
Attached to the entrance door (poorly finished door where all the light from the hallway filtered in at night)..., it has an emergency light that illuminates the entire room..., perfect for sleeping.

Not even a measly welcome bottle of water and of course..., there is no refrigerator to have your own things.

I complained to the reception when they gave me the room and I explained my opinion regarding the price and what they were giving me.
Apparently all the rooms are the same.

Breakfast the next day was correct. Little to add.
And I must admit that the staff attended to my complaint and treated me well.

I spent the year traveling and staying in hotels of all kinds and honestly this one wouldn't even come close to a 2-star roadside hostel.

For accommodation like this you should not pay more than EU50 a night.

name: Yomissma
review_text: En la recepcion el personal muy amable y simpatico. No me gusto que no tuvieran la opcion de dar cafe sin coger el desayuno. Pensaran que asi se aseguran el dinero del buffet,pero realmente pierden clientes ya que nosotras podiamos haber bajado dos dias u no bajamos ninguno por tener el servicio al cliente tan cerrado. Y tambien deberian de llamar a los cristaleros para limpiar la calima jejeje. Por todo lo demas muy contenta,la habitacion limpia, espaciosa y las camas comodas y bien hechas.
review_translated_text: At the reception the staff were very kind and friendly. I didn't like that they didn't have the option of giving coffee without having breakfast. They will think that this way they secure the money from the buffet, but they actually lose customers since we could have gone down two days or not at all due to having customer service so closed. And they should also call the glaziers to clean the haze hehehe. For everything else, very happy, the room was clean, spacious and the beds were comfortable and well made.

name: xema zubia
review_text: Un peligro la salida del parking del hotel. Mi coche es un Opel astra. Al intentar salir no se abria la puerta. La marcha atras es imposible por la estrechez y por estar en curva. Al final se abrio la puerta ni se como. Un susto morrocotudo.  Luces del bano cenitales, crean sombras. Resto bien
review_translated_text: A danger when exiting the hotel parking lot. My car is an Opel astra. When trying to leave the door did not open. Reversing is impossible due to the narrowness and being in a curve. In the end the door opened, I don't know how. A terrible scare.  Overhead bathroom lights create shadows. Rest well

name: Mari Carmen Alcocer
review_text: Por fuera parece bastante bueno, pero luego las habitaciones resultan un poco viejas y ya bastante mal cuidado en algunos aspectos. La limpieza tambien es mejorable...
review_translated_text: From the outside, it looks pretty good, but the rooms seem a bit dated and already quite poorly maintained in some areas. The cleanliness could also be improved...

name: alvaro cardizales
review_text:
Solamente estuve alojado, no puedo ayudarte con el servicio de comidas.
La ubicacion es perfecta.
Las instalaciones estan muy bien, las habitaciones bien equipadas y limpias.
Quizas, si tengo que decir algo en contra, algo ajustado el tamano de la habitacion doble, al menos la que me toco a mi.
review_translated_text:
I was only staying, I can't help you with the food service.
The location is perfect.
The facilities are very good, the rooms well equipped and clean.
Maybe, if I have to say something against it, I adjusted the size of the double room a little, at least the one I had.

name: Antonio Rodriguez
review_text: Sitio tranquilo y comodo, aunque le hace falta algo de mantenimiento. Por lo demas muy bien.
review_translated_text: Quiet and comfortable location, although it needs some maintenance. Otherwise, very good.

name: Antonio Cea
review_text: Hotel bien ubicado a Diez minutos de centro
review_translated_text: Hotel well located ten minutes from the center

name: Giancarlos Baca Camacho
review_text:
Muy bonito esteticamente pero la cama parecia una piedra, mejor dormir en el suelo, al menos la de la 602. No se como sera el resto de camas.
La ubicacion muy buena , se puede aparcar en los alrededores, etc.

review_translated_text:
Very nice aesthetically but the bed looked like a stone, better to sleep on the floor, at least the one in 602. I don't know what the rest of the beds will be like.
The location is very good, you can park nearby, etc.
That's why I give it one star.

name: salwa star
review_text: good

Foto's mooier dan in realiteit.
Kamer niet groot, ok.
Verwarming te hoog 's nachts.

Locatie zeer goed, kleine wandeling naar kathedraal.

Photos more beautiful than in reality.
Room not big, ok.
