name: comteHarbourg
review_text: L'accueil est laborieux , les hotesses parlent a toutes allures aussi bien en espagnol qu'en anglais ,  sans faire le moindre effort pour vous expliquer qu'il faut reprendre votre voiture , rentrer dans le parking public attenant , stationner sur une place reservee et signalee H au sol et qu'ensuite un couloir vous amenera a un ascenseur qui vous montra a l'etage de votre chambre . Heureusement , une belle chambre spacieuse et bien equipee pour un rapport qualite/prix excellent hors saison  . Merci .
review_translated_text: The reception is laborious, the hostesses speak at full speed in both Spanish and English, without making the slightest effort to explain to you that you have to take your car, enter the adjoining public parking lot, park in a reserved space marked H on the ground and that then a corridor will take you to an elevator which will show you to the floor of your room. Fortunately, a beautiful spacious and well-equipped room for excellent value for money out of season. Thank you.

name: Juan Jose Ubeda pacha
review_text: Hotel bueno en relacion calidad precio ,hay aparcamiento gratuito como a unos 300 metros,muy bien situado

review_translated_text: Very well located, close to everything but not in the center

name: Eva Darkstar
review_text:
Bano y habitacion amplios con cama grande y comoda. Personal amable e instalaciones muy limpias.
El desayuno variado y completo. Buena ubicacion a 10 minutos andando de tiendas, mercado y casco viejo
review_translated_text:
Spacious bathroom and bedroom with large and comfortable bed. Friendly staff and very clean facilities.
The varied and complete breakfast. Good location 10 minutes walk from shops, market and old town

name: laurent brazet
review_text: Proprete, accueilli tres bien, confortable et parking pratique.

review_text: Buenas camas y buen servicio lo recomiendo

review_translated_text: The best location. The rooms are large and clean, nothing more. The worst thing is the buffet breakfast, very little. It's not bad but for the price they charged me I honestly expected something more.

name: Daniel Diaz Vila

name: Ah Thien Kan John

name: Daniel Vazquez
review_text: Buen hotel cerca de la catedral para descansar y calentarse despues de visitar la ciudad. La calefaccion y la ducha funcionan fenomenal. Superlimpio y cumple con los protocolos Covid
review_translated_text: A good hotel near the cathedral to rest and warm up after visiting the city. The heating and shower work perfectly. Super clean and complies with Covid protocols.

name: Aradia Rocha Bouzo
review_text: Buena relacion calidad-precio. El hotel esta aproximadamente a diez minutos como mucho andando del centro de  Burgos. review_translated_text: Good value for money. The hotel is approximately ten minutes at most walking distance from the center of Burgos.  We spent one night in this hotel, the rooms are good and we slept quite well, there were no annoying noises from other guests or the street. The receptionists were very friendly.

name: 489murielb
review_text: Hotel parfaitement situe, confortable, parking pratique, chambre spacieuse,claire, propre, bien chauffee, tout est satisfaisant. Tout peut etre effectue a pied pour visiter la ville et acceder aux restaurants.
review_translated_text: Perfectly located, comfortable hotel, convenient parking, spacious, bright, clean, well-heated room, everything is satisfactory. Everything is within walking distance to visit the city and access restaurants.

name: Pablo
review_text: Todo perfecto. A 10 min de la catedral, con parking gratuito cerca. El servicio de 10, muy amables y discretos.
review_translated_text: Everything was perfect. 10 minutes from the cathedral, with free parking nearby. The service was excellent, very friendly and discreet.

name: Anabel Chamorro
review_text:
Teniamos una habitacion doble que era minuscula. Nunca habia estado en un hotel con una habitacion tan pequena, la maleta ni entraba por el espacio entre la cama y la pared. Las camas eran obviamente cortas, ya que no hay espacio para mas. La luz de emergencia, que no se puede apagar, iluminaba toda la habitacion. Las mesillas sin enchufes. La TV esta super mal ubicada. En el bano no hay calefaccion y en Burgos precisamente calor no hace.
Y lo peor de todo: los ruidos. Toda la noche escuchando los ascensores. Casi imposible dormir con todos los ruidos que constantemente hacian los ascensores.

Muy mala experiencia.
review_translated_text:
We had a tiny double room. I'd never been to a hotel with such a small room; my suitcase wouldn't even fit through the space between the bed and the wall. The beds were obviously short, as there wasn't enough room for more. The emergency light, which couldn't be turned off, illuminated the entire room. The bedside tables had no outlets. The TV was extremely poorly located. There was no heating in the bathroom, and in Burgos, it's not exactly warm.
And worst of all: the noise. I listened to the elevators all night. It was almost impossible to sleep with all the noise the elevators were constantly making.

A very bad experience.

name: Francesc De Toro Perpinya
review_text: Hotel correcto por el precio
review_translated_text: Correct hotel for the price

name: Julian Lopez
review_text: Hotel de tres estrellas con condiciones de Hostal. La cama en cuanto te giras suena, el radiador del bano no funciona, calefaccion funciona pero no regula la temperatura, cafeteria cerrada, la almohada como un folio. En fin para una noche y ducharte bien. Pero ya esta. La chica recepcionista majisima y un placer tratar con ella
review_translated_text: Three-star hotel with Hostel conditions. The bed rings as soon as you turn over, the bathroom radiator doesn't work, the heating works but doesn't regulate the temperature, the cafeteria is closed, the pillow feels like a sheet of paper. Anyway, for one night and take a good shower. But that's it. The receptionist girl is lovely and a pleasure to deal with her.

name: Carolina
review_text:
Hay que destacar la atencion de Magdalena la chica de recepcion, muy amable y atenta en todo momento. El senor del desayuno igualmente muy servicial y amable. El desayuno muy variado y delicioso los 9EU lo valen y mas cuando no hay muchas opciones en la calle a tempranas horas de la manana. Sin duda vale la pena tomarlo.

La habitacion muy limpia y acorde al precio de la estancia.  Sin duda de tener que volver a Burgos nos volveriamos a quedar en este Hotel.

De facil acceso desde la autopista y para caminar al centro de la ciudad es super facil. No hay que mover el coche para nada.
review_translated_text:
We must highlight the attention of Magdalena, the girl at the reception, very friendly and attentive at all times. The breakfast man was also very helpful and friendly. The very varied and delicious breakfast is worth the EU9 and even more so when there are not many options on the street in the early hours of the morning. It is definitely worth taking.

The room was very clean and in line with the price of the stay.  Without a doubt, if we had to return to Burgos we would stay at this Hotel again.

Easy access from the highway and walking to the city center is super easy. You don't have to move the car at all.

name: ANDRES CASSOL
review_text: Excelente ubicacion, buena atencion y precio
review_translated_text: Excellent location, good service and price

name: Marcos Jimenez
review_text:
Buenas, queria comentar acerca de la gastronomia de este lugar ya que no tienen ningun cuidado con las alergias de los comensales.
He de recalcar la actuacion de un gran camarero, Andres.
Por lo demas he de decir que los elementos no son los optimos (Poca calidad)
En el resto de aspectos un 8/10
review_translated_text:
Hello, I wanted to comment on the gastronomy of this place since they do not take any care with the diners' allergies.
I have to emphasize the performance of a great waiter, Andres.
For the rest I have to say that the elements are not optimal (Poor quality)
In the rest of the aspects an 8/10

name: Mi Carmen
review_text: Bien ubicado, a 8 minutos de la catedral, buenas habitaciones , calidad- precio
review_translated_text: Well located, 8 minutes from the cathedral, good rooms, quality-price

name: FionaMGT
review_text: The Bulevar is a modern high rise hotel, close to the city centre.||||The room was clean with  an en suite with soap dispensers and facial soap.||||The staff were very friendly and helpful. A map was provided and places where we could have dinner. They were more than happy to print out our forms required for our trip back to the UK.||||You can park outside the Hotel to check in. Then you are directed to the underground garage where there are lifts to take you up to your floor.

name: ESTHER CAROLINA HERNANDEZ MENDOZA
review_text: Me encanta y mas la catedral es muy bella
review_translated_text: I love it and the cathedral is very beautiful.

name: Tinkerbelle
review_text: Habitaciones muy bonitas, camas super suaves y el bano bastante comodo. Lo unico es la luz de emergencia dentro de la habitacion no te deja dormir. Desayuno super rico y a buen precio. El personal es super atento y amable
review_translated_text: Very nice rooms, super soft beds and quite comfortable bathroom. The only thing is the emergency light inside the room does not let you sleep. Super rich breakfast and at a good price. The staff is super attentive and friendly

name: Fran Sanchez-Molero Munoz
review_text: Todo bien, limpio, cerca del centro. La unica pega que se oye bastante el ruido de las habitaciones de al lado.
review_translated_text: Everything good, clean, close to the center. The only drawback is that you can hear quite a bit of noise from the next rooms.

name: Carla Caballero
review_text: La ubicacion muy buena, pero la verdad es que las camas no eran muy comodas
review_translated_text: The location was very good, but the truth is that the beds were not very comfortable.

name: Manuel da Silva
review_text: Hotel tres bien tenu
review_translated_text: Very well maintained hotel

name: teresa preto
review_text: Muito bem situado, agradavel, muito limpo, atendimento excelente. Pequeno almoco apetitoso. O colchao fazia cova, de resto tudo bem. Recomendo
review_translated_text: Very well located, pleasant, very clean, excellent service. Delicious breakfast. The mattress was a hole, otherwise everything was fine. I recommend it

name: NOA OG
review_text:
Buena atencion y habitacion
.
review_translated_text:
Good service and room
.

name: Trini
review_text: Hotel tranquilo, recepcionistas  amables.
review_translated_text: Quiet hotel, friendly receptionists.

name: Olalla Barreiro Costa
review_text: Personal muy atento pero las habitaciones deberian de pasar un mantenimiento y aumentar el tamano de la cama. El lugar del desayuno era pequeno y resultaba confuso el camino del buffet.
review_translated_text: Very attentive staff but the rooms should undergo maintenance and increase the size of the bed. The breakfast place was small and the path to the buffet was confusing.

name: Miguel Cortes Delgado
review_text: Servicio muy bueno y atento, la habitacion cumplia las expectativas a la perfeccion. Lugar muy tranquilo y silencioso. En 5 minutos andando estas en pleno centro de Burgos. Sin duda repetiria.
review_translated_text: Very good and attentive service, the room met expectations perfectly. Very calm and quiet place. In 5 minutes walk you are in the heart of Burgos. I would definitely repeat.

name: Migue Perez
review_text:
Realizamos la reserva para el dia 7 de Diciembre ( pero siguiendo las recomendaciones de la DGT decidimos volver a casa un dia antes, por lo que no pudimos asistir al alojamiento. Tratamos de contactar con el establecimiento para que valorasen la posibilidad de anular la reserva con algo de reembolso y directamente nos ha resultado imposible hablar con ellos, no se han dignado a contestarnos y al escribir una resena en booking nos han anulado la reserva para eliminar nuestro comentario. ESTA GENTE NO ES DE FIAR.  Anulan mi reserva sin devolver el dinero para evitar opiniones negativas!
Evidentemente no puedo evaluar las habitaciones, pero con gente tan poco profesional mejor no tratar nunca.

No recomendable.

PD: Espero vuestra contestacion a este mensaje, aunque probablemente ni siquiera se dignen tampoco a contestar por esta plataforma.
review_translated_text:
We made a reservation for December 7th (but following the DGT recommendations, we decided to return home a day early, so we couldn't stay at the hotel). We tried to contact the establishment to consider canceling the reservation with a refund, but we were unable to speak to them directly. They didn't bother to reply, and when we wrote a review on Booking.com, they canceled the reservation to remove our comment. THESE PEOPLE CAN'T BE TRUSTED. They canceled my reservation without refunding my money to avoid negative reviews!
Obviously, I can't review the rooms, but it's best not to deal with such unprofessional people.

Not recommended.

P.S.: I look forward to your reply to this message, although they probably won't even bother to reply on this platform either.

name: Neus Moya Martinez
review_text: Pequeno acojedor pero el colchon y las almohadas muy incomodas , trato excel*lente
review_translated_text: Small cozy but the mattress and pillows are very uncomfortable, excellent treatment

name: francisco maderuelo ulloa
review_text: Normalidad, para una noche.
review_translated_text: Normality, for one night.

name: Francisco Javier Morales Sanchez de Prados
review_text: Todo muy correcto, si eso la aclimatacion de las habitaciones (soy un poco lagartija y me va el calor, estan mas fresquitas que los pasillos), pero perfecto y muy cerca de todo.
review_translated_text: Everything was fine, except for the acclimatization of the rooms (I'm a bit of a lizard and I like the heat, so they're cooler than the hallways), but it's perfect and very close to everything.

name: M. LUISA TORO
review_text: Cerca del centro, parking en el mismo hotel,  la habitacion de matrimonio aunque pedi una mejor, era muy pequena
review_translated_text: Close to the center, parking in the same hotel, the double room, although I asked for a better one, was very small

name: bego CALAVIA
review_text: Buen enclave, tranquilo. Recepcion super resolutivos
review_translated_text: Good location, quiet. Super responsive reception

name: Nube
review_text:
Burgos

(Nota 3)

Les indique que el agua caliente no funcionaba y se quedaron tan panchos. Vamos ni una disculpa. La habitacion amplia y la cama bien. Suciedad en las ventanas. El wifi no va bien. Desayuno aceptable.
No lo recomiendo.
review_translated_text:
Burgos

(Note 3)

I told them that the hot water wasn't working and they were so upset. Let's not even apologize. The room was spacious and the bed was good. Dirt on the windows. The wifi is not working well. Acceptable breakfast.
I don't recommend it.

name: sandra
review_text: Buena atencion en recepcion, en cuanto a la habitacion aun que decia prohibido fumar  el escritorio estaba lleno de quemaduras. El aseo general bueno.
review_translated_text: Good service at reception, as for the room, even though it said no smoking, the desk was full of burns. Good general cleanliness.

name: Marisol Aranda Lindez
review_text: Muy bien situado en Burgos muy limpio y el desayuno normal !!se puede repetir las camas muy buenas
review_translated_text: Very well located in Burgos, very clean and the breakfast was normal! The beds were very good.

name: Daniel Seller
review_text:
Tuvimos una experiencia mala el primer dia. Nos dieron una habitacion donde el deterioro de los materiales era manifiesto a todas luces. Para colmo, al ducharnos el agua invadio la habitacion.
Pero la verdad es que el personal de recepcion lo soluciono rapido. Nos cambiaron de habitacion y las circunstancias mejoraron.
Deberian haber evitado ofrecer estas habitaciones que estan en mal estado y reformarlas. Con 3 estrellas se puede tener mejor imagen.
El desayuno bueno y abundante. El personal muy atento y educado. La limpieza inmejorable.
Desde nuestras habitaciones no se divisa la catedral, solo los edificios del entorno, pero esta a unos minutos andando.
review_translated_text:
We had a bad experience the first day. They gave us a room where the deterioration of the materials was clearly evident. To make matters worse, when we showered the water invaded the room.
But the truth is that the reception staff solved it quickly. They changed our room and the circumstances improved.
They should have avoided offering these rooms that are in poor condition and renovated them. With 3 stars you can have a better image.
Good and abundant breakfast. The staff very attentive and polite. The unbeatable cleanliness.
From our rooms you cannot see the cathedral, only the surrounding buildings, but it is a few minutes walk away.

name: Teresa
review_text: La ubicacion del hotel es buena y resulta comodo, aunque el precio me parecio excesivo para lo que ofrecen. El bano necesita una reforma. Se salia el agua por el suelo cada vez que usabamos la ducha. Ademas anunciaban servicio de cafeteria y cuando llegamos alli resulta que nos dicen que estaba cerrada.
review_translated_text: The hotel's location is good and comfortable, although the price seemed excessive for what it offers. The bathroom needs renovation. Water spilled onto the floor every time we used the shower. They also advertised a cafeteria, but when we arrived, they told us it was closed.

name: remedios lora pedreno
review_text: Solo estuvimos una noche , habitacion muy limpia, el desayuno estuvo bien  lo mejor es k esta en el centro y por la manana aprobamos unas horitas para conocerlo un poco ,fuimos andando a la catedral, plaza mayor ,mirador ,arco......
review_translated_text: We only stayed one night, the room was very clean, the breakfast was good, the best thing is that it is in the center and in the morning we spent a few hours getting to know it a little, we walked to the cathedral, main square, viewpoint, arch......

name: Angel S. Luque Exposito
review_text: Correcto. Un problema con los ascensores el ultimo dia estropeo la estancia.
review_translated_text: Correct. A problem with the elevators on the last day spoiled the stay.

name: Laura
review_text: Cerca de la catedral, facil aparcamiento en la calle en zona gratuita, habitacion y desayuno bien
review_translated_text: Close to the cathedral, easy street parking in a free area, good room and breakfast

name: Jose Ramon Carro
review_text: Esta centrico para el fin de semana esta bien relacion precio calidad competitivo
review_translated_text: It is central for the weekend, it is good, competitive quality-price ratio

name: AKUTA SAME
review_text: Bien pero la habitacion olia a tabaco que echaba para atras  no se como no la habian ventilado. Por lo demas bien.
review_translated_text: Good but the room smelled of cigarettes which was bad, I don't know why they hadn't ventilated it. Otherwise good.

name: Manuel Jovani
review_text: Excelente trato y limpieza. A pocos minutos de la catedral. Desde el se sale facilmente de Burgos. El desayuno, aunque buffet, te servian ellos, era sencillo y con pocas opciones en tipos de pan sobre todo. El parking muy bien.
review_translated_text: Excellent treatment and cleanliness. A few minutes from the cathedral. From there you can easily get out of Burgos. The breakfast, although buffet, they served you, was simple and with few options in types of bread, especially. The parking is very good.

name: Miguel Casanova
review_text: Muy buena relacion calidad precio
review_translated_text: Very good value for money

name: Stephanie Battaglieri
review_text: Vraiment tres bien pour le prix. Personnels agreables la dame de l'accueil m'a indique les sites a visiter ( enormement de choses a proximite ville magnifique ). Je recommande
review_translated_text: Really good for the price. Pleasant staff, the lady at reception showed me the sites to visit (lots of things nearby, a magnificent city). I recommend

name: Jaime Martin
review_text: El hotel no esta mal, el desayuno no merece nada la pena.
review_translated_text: The hotel is not bad, the breakfast is not worth it at all.

name: Jean Bernard
review_text: Paid 50 euros for a night, was clean, nice shower, good service and close to center.

name: Olga Fernandez
review_text: Esta en buen sitio tanto para acceder a la salida de la ciudad como para darte una vuelta por el centro. Las habitaciones son amplias y estan muy limpias. Eche de menos la cafeteria-restaurante, que esta cerrada. Solo funciona para desayunos pagando 9 euros de buffet (sin posibilidad de nada mas)
review_translated_text: It is in a good location both to access the exit of the city and to take a walk around the center. The rooms are spacious and very clean. I missed the cafeteria-restaurant, which is closed. It only works for breakfasts paying 9 euros for a buffet (without the possibility of anything else)

name: Ruben
review_text: La verdad es que solo pasamos una noche en el hotel pero cumplio mis expectativas. La habitacion estaba bien, muy limpia, cama comoda y bien amueblada. El bano un poco anticuado me parecio lo mas flojo. Personal muy amable. La ubicacion es excelente ya que se encuentra a 10 min andando de la catedral y en los alrededores se puede aparcar sin tener que pagar. Eso si, no es facil aparcar cerca
review_translated_text: The truth is that we only spent one night at the hotel but it met my expectations. The room was good, very clean, comfortable bed and well furnished. The slightly dated bathroom seemed the weakest to me. Very friendly staff. The location is excellent since it is a 10-minute walk from the cathedral and you can park in the surrounding area without having to pay. However, it is not easy to park nearby.

name: Eneko R. Larrinaga
review_text:
Un hotel de 3 estrellas...la habitacion bien, los ascensores o excasos o lentos... El buffet desayuno muy bien y el personal muy muy bien.

La ubicacion buena, no esta en todo el meollo pero en 7 minutos andando estas en la parte vieja.

La zona para aparcar chungo, el hotel tiene garaje pero no lo he usado.

Lo peor, unas butacas individuales semicirculares tapizadas que habia en las habitaciones que tenian una pinta de viejas...que caso debe asco dejar la ropa (ya no digo sentarse).

Si vuelvo a Burgos...volvere? Si tranquilamente volveria.

Otro fallo, no tiene para cenar...aunque hay restaurantes por la zona.
review_translated_text:
A 3-star hotel... the room was fine, the elevators were either scarce or slow... The breakfast buffet was very good, and the staff was very, very friendly.

The location was good; it's not in the center of town, but you're in the old town in a 7-minute walk.

The parking was a bit tricky; the hotel has a garage, but I didn't use it.

The worst thing was the semicircular upholstered single armchairs in the rooms that looked old... how disgusting it must be to leave your clothes (not to mention sitting down).

If I go back to Burgos... will I come back? Yes, I would definitely come back.

Another drawback: there's no dining options... although there are restaurants in the area.

name: Adela Pedrosa Congosto
review_text: De lo mejor de Burgos.
review_translated_text: One of the best in Burgos.

review_text: Muy buena ubicacion, las mesas de las habitaciones un poco debiles
review_translated_text: Very good location, the tables in the rooms are a little weak

review_translated_text: Expensive, tiny rooms

review_text: Bien situado, asequible, comodo y limpio. Una buena parada para hacer noche.

name: marnick crombez
review_text: Proper net hotel . Veilige ondergrondse parking. Vriendelijke mensen aan de receptie. Goed en gevarieerd ontbijt. 600 meter van de kathedraal. Aan te raden.
review_translated_text: Neat hotel. Secure underground parking. Friendly people at the reception. Good and varied breakfast. 600 meters from the cathedral. Recommended.

name: MARIA
review_text: Muy tranquilo para un buen descanso y se esta muy calentito, sus camas tienen un buen colchon, px decir algo, las almohadas demasiado bajas, pero en el armario t dejan dos mas px si las necesitas. Asi q para repetir
review_translated_text: Very quiet for a good rest and it is very warm, their beds have a good mattress, px to say the least, the pillows are too low, but they leave two more px in the closet if you need them. So to repeat

name: John Chat English
review_text:
Me gusto el trato en general. Desaparecio un libro de mi cuarto pero me lo encontraron en seguida.
Tal vez un poco carillo siendo un hotel de tres estrellas.
review_translated_text:
I liked the treatment in general. A book went missing from my room but they found it right away.
Maybe a little expensive for a three-star hotel.

name: JUAN GABRIEL GARCIA BLANCO
review_text: Hotal comodo facil aparcar y silencioso y limpio.
review_translated_text: Comfortable hotel, easy to park, quiet and clean.

name: Jose Maria Oriol
review_text: Aceptable
review_translated_text: Acceptable

name: Jose Dominguez
review_text: Trato amable buenas vistas
review_translated_text: Friendly treatment good views

name: Jose Miguel Llido Perez
review_text: Buena atencion por parte de los empleados, limpias habitaciones y tranquilidad
review_translated_text: Good attention from employees, clean rooms and tranquility

name: Caridad Saucedo Manzano
review_text: Genial, volvere seguro
review_translated_text: Great, I'll be back for sure.

name: Baizan-Lobo. Marino
review_text: Relacion calidad precio, buena, personal muy amable y profesional, desayuno bien con una atencion esmerada, cerca del centro sin problema y ademas aparcamiento gratuito en los alrededores.
review_translated_text: Value for money, good, very friendly and professional staff, good breakfast with careful attention, close to the center without problem and also free parking in the surroundings.

name: Miguel Pena
review_text: E hotel esta cerca del centro de la ciudad, a 5 minutos de la catedral andando. aparcamiento disponible en la proximidades. Hotel correcto y personal agradable. Atienden en varios idiomas a los turistas.
review_translated_text: The hotel is close to the city center, a 5-minute walk from the cathedral. Parking is available nearby. The hotel is decent and the staff is friendly. They provide assistance to tourists in several languages.

name: Xavier Ordovas Bolsa
review_text: perfecto buen personal habitaciones muy correctas. a 10 mitutos del centro solo un pero. aparcar cerca del hotel es practicamente imposible el hotel tiene parking preguntar precio
review_translated_text: Perfect, good staff, very decent rooms. 10 minutes from the center. Only one drawback: Parking near the hotel is practically impossible. The hotel has parking. Ask for prices.

name: Eusebio Torrejon
review_text: Instalaciones normalitas, las camas estan bien, el bufete del desayuno es asistido, escaso y de baja calidad
review_translated_text: Average facilities, beds are fine, breakfast buffet is assisted, scarce and of low quality

name: Yana (Pav)
review_text:
Otel udobno raspolozhen - peshkom progulyatsya do starogo goroda. Iz okon vid na sobor.
V celom vse skromno, est vse neobhodimoe. Takzhe nalichie parkovki platnoy. Prichem u zdaniya otelya mnogo svobodnyh mest.
review_translated_text:
The hotel is conveniently located - a short walk to the old city. The windows overlook the cathedral.
In general, everything is modest, there is everything you need. Also, there is paid parking. And there are many free spaces near the hotel building.

name: Juan Manuel Aponte Gutierrez
review_text: Un hotel pequeno, pero muy acogedor , lo recomiendo para visitar la Catedral de Burgos
review_translated_text: A small, but very cozy hotel, I recommend it to visit the Cathedral of Burgos

name: pedro gonzalez
review_text: para ser 4 estrellas pocos servicios , la excusa el covid.
review_translated_text: To be 4 stars there are few services, the excuse is covid.

name: Susana Zubiaurre
review_text: La cama no es muy comoda, por lo demas el trato es agradable .
review_translated_text: The bed is not very comfortable, otherwise the treatment is pleasant.

name: Alberto Garin Castaner
review_text: La habitacion me ha gustado, muy comoda. El desayuno no porque lo tienen mal organizado, hay un camarero que sirve y se tarda mucho. Entiendo lo del covid, pero ahora ya podian dar mas libertad
review_translated_text: I liked the room, very comfortable. Breakfast wasn't as planned, as it's poorly organized. There's only one waiter who serves, and it takes a long time. I understand the COVID situation, but they could have given us more freedom now.

name: bayoucitymami
review_text: Gema gave us perfect, professional and hospitable service.  She was very helpful, efficient, and friendly.  We felt like everything was very COVID safe and clean.  The room was small, but had all we needed.  The location was close to the center of town, but enough away to be nice and quiet.

name: Rosa Salmeron
review_text:
La ubicacion del Hotel es muy buena, esta situado a 10 minutos de la Catedral. Otra cosa buena que tiene es que es accesible para silla de ruedas.
Pero la limpieza de la habitacion no era la mas adecuada, y el colchonse notaba que  estaba viejo xq se hundia del centro.
Hemos estado en el puente del Pilar y creo que los precios de la habitacion son muy elevados hasta para esas fechas
review_translated_text:
The location of the Hotel is very good, it is located 10 minutes from the Cathedral. Another good thing about it is that it is wheelchair accessible.
But the cleaning of the room was not the most adequate, and the mattress could be seen to be old because it sank from the center.
We have been on the Pilar bridge and I think that the room prices are very high even for those dates

name: zusine soret
review_text:
Lo bueno:
hotel con buenos alrededores para aparcar sin pagar en zona azul. Facil acceso para entrar y salir. El personal muy amable. La habitacion superlimpia.
Lo malo:
Habitacion super pequena, entra la cama doble super justa.
El colchon horroroso!!! Super blando, hace que no descanses.
El desayuno bueno pero es un rollo que siendo bufet, tengas que pedirle a los camareros. No ves bien lo que hay, y se forman colas para pedir. Ya se que es por seguridad covid, pero en la gran mayoria de hoteles, te dan unos guantes y te explican las normas para que actues con precaucion.
review_translated_text:
The good:
Hotel with good surroundings to park without paying in the blue zone. Easy access to get in and out. Very friendly staff. The super clean room.
Bad:
Super small room, the double bed fits super tight.
The horrible mattress!!! Super soft, it makes you not rest.
The breakfast is good but it is a bummer that being a buffet, you have to ask the waiters. You don't see well what's there, and queues form to order. I know it's for Covid safety, but in the vast majority of hotels, they give you gloves and explain the rules so you can act with caution.

name: Sara L. S.
review_text: Muy buena atencion al cliente
review_translated_text: Very good customer service

name: PAQUI RODRIGUEZ
review_text:
Primero, publicidad enganosa. Nos dieron una habitacion enana, mucho mas pequena que la que anunciaban en sitios de reserva como Booking.

Segundo, nos intentan estafar con el precio. Hicimos la reserva por telefono y no nos mandaron ningun documento. Reservamos dos habitaciones por 100EU la noche cada una (en total nos salia por algo mas de 700EU la estancia de tres dias, incluyendo desayuno). A la hora de pagar nos intentan cobrar mas de 1000EU por habitacion. La empleada de recepcion no nos da ninguna solucion, se niega a reconocer el error de su companera al gestionar la reserva y no llama a ningun superior que nos pueda ayudar.
Tambien niega nuestro derecho a una hoja de reclamaciones hasta que la policia local de Burgos llega al local. Una verguenza.

Nada recomendable.
review_translated_text:
First, misleading advertising. They gave us a tiny room, much smaller than the one advertised on booking sites like Booking.

Second, they tried to scam us with the price. We made the reservation by phone and they didn't send us any documents. We booked two rooms for EU100 a night each (the total cost was just over EU700 for a three-day stay, including breakfast). When it came time to pay, they tried to charge us more than EU1,000 per room. The receptionist offered us no solution, refused to acknowledge her colleague's error in handling the reservation, and didn't call any superior who could help us.
They also denied us our right to a complaint form until the local Burgos police arrived at the property. Disgraceful.

Not at all recommended.

name: Jose Juan Garcia Rodriguez
review_text: Hicimos un reserva en septiembre para el puente de octubre. Nos dijeron que serian 100EU la noche una habitacion triple (para un total de tres noches). Vamos a pagar y nos sacan una factura de 1000EU por habitacion (mas del triple de lo que reservamos). No nos dan ningun tipo de solucion y no reconocen el error. La empleada de recepcion insisten en que ese fue el precio que reservamos y no quiere llamar a ningun superior ni darnos la hoja de reclamaciones hasta que paguemos este robo. Nada recomendable
review_translated_text: We made a reservation in September for the October long weekend. They told us it would be EU100 a night for a triple room (for a total of three nights). We go to pay and they give us a bill for EU1000 per room (more than triple what we booked). They do not give us any type of solution and do not recognize the error. The receptionist insists that this was the price we reserved and does not want to call any superior or give us the claim form until we pay for this theft. Not recommended

review_text: Grata sorpresa. Limpio y buen trato, la relacion calidad precio muy buena. M iba a kedar una noxe, tenia pagado el desayuno, pero al dia siguiente me encontre indispuesto y tuve k kedarme 2. M llamaron 2 veces para saber como estaba, me ofrecieron medicamentos y comida sin coste adicional y no me cobraron el desayuno k no pude disfrutar. Si vuelvo a esta maravillosa ciudad historica seguro k me vuelvo a alojar aki. Dar las gracias a todos los empleados.
review_translated_text: Pleasant surprise. Clean and good treatment, very good quality-price ratio. I was going to stay one night, I had paid for breakfast, but the next day I found myself unwell and had to stay 2 times. They called me 2 times to find out how I was, they offered me medicine and food at no additional cost and they did not charge me for the breakfast that I could not enjoy. If I return to this wonderful historic city I will definitely stay here again. Thank all employees.

name: Laura MC
review_text:
Entiendo que son tiempos de crisis y que no quieren perder clientes, pero la falta de transparencia no me parecen formas.
Realice una reserva por medio de su web. Casualmente la manana de la reserva a eso de las 11h me llaman y me dicen que tienen un problema con la caldera y que debido a mi reserva sin cancelacion me reubican en otro hotel que tienen a 6km de este. Lo que me ofertan es mas viejo (tiene una estrella mas, que es su argumento), esta en una zona que implica desplazarme a diario para las gestiones que iba a hacer (elegi el hotel bulevar porque necesitaba esa ubicacion y disponia de zona blanca de aparcamiento), y a reganadientes teniendo en cuenta que no tengo margen de maniobra, acepto, eso si, negocioando que el parking de la nueva ubicacion no deben cobrarmelo (que fue su intencion en su primera llamada). Aun asi, como estaba solo a 15min de distancia, a mi llegada voy directa al hotel Bulevar para ver si se habia solucionado el supuesto incidencia o si era posible cambiar de hotel al dia siguiente. Y !sorpresa! el hotel esta cerradisimo, con un aspecto de llevar asi tiempo. Ademas cuando fui a realizar las gestiones que debia llevar a cabo esos dias al lado de dicho hotel se mostraron sorprendidos porque pudiera reservarlo, me dijeron que llevaba tiempo cerrado, no supieron decirme el tiempo exacto pero estaban convencidos de que llevaba asi mas de un mes
No entiendo que sigan ofertando este hotel si no esta abierto, no es forma de conseguir reservas
review_translated_text:
I understand that these are times of crisis and they don't want to lose customers, but the lack of transparency doesn't seem right to me.
I made a reservation through their website. Coincidentally, on the morning of the reservation, around 11:00 a.m., they called me and told me they had a problem with the boiler and that, due to my non-cancellable reservation, they were relocating me to another hotel 6 km away. The hotel they offered me was older (it has one more star, which is their argument), and it was in an area that required daily travel for the errands I was going to run (I chose the Bulevar Hotel because I needed that location and it had a white parking area). Reluctantly, considering I have no room for maneuver, I accepted, though I negotiated that they wouldn't charge me for parking at the new location (which was their intention in their initial call). Even so, since it was only 15 minutes away, upon arrival I went directly to the Bulevar Hotel to see if the alleged problem had been resolved or if it was possible to change hotels the next day. And surprise! The hotel is completely closed, looking as if it's been like that for a while. Also, when I went to make the arrangements I needed to make next to the hotel for those days, they seemed surprised that I could reserve it. They told me it had been closed for a while. They couldn't tell me the exact time, but they were convinced it had been like that for over a month.
I don't understand why they keep advertising this hotel if it's not open; it's no way to get reservations.

name: HELMANTICA DEMIELES
review_text: Cuidado al reservar, esta cerrado. Respondieron a mis emails y me dieron incluso tarifa, pero cuando llegue al hotel estaba totalmente cerrado. Persianas bajadas. Las palabras de la cristalera con letras quitadas,...no daba sensacion de que casualmente ese dia no trabajaran de forma puntual. Pregunte a la gente que vi pasar por si habia otra entrada y resulta que por lo que me dijeron llevaba tiempo cerrado. No lo entiendo. Les escribi diciendoles que estaba en la puerta y no volvi a obtener respuesta.
review_translated_text: Be careful when booking, it's closed. They responded to my emails and even gave me a rate, but when I arrived at the hotel, it was completely closed. Blinds down. The words on the window with letters removed... it didn't give the impression that they might not be working punctually that day. I asked the people I saw passing by if there was another entrance, and it turns out, from what they told me, it had been closed for a while. I don't understand. I wrote to them telling them it was at the door and never got a reply.

review_text: Servicio sencillo pero correcto, lo esperado es un hotel de tres estrellas. Habitacion corriente , buena cama, a 700 metros de la catedral. Correcto . Nos hospedamos una noche de camino a Cantabria.
review_translated_text: Simple but correct service, what is expected is a three-star hotel. Ordinary room, good bed, 700 meters from the cathedral. Correct . We stayed one night on the way to Cantabria.

review_text:

La relacion calidad - precio no esta mal.

review_text:

review_translated_text:

Congratulations to everyone.

review_text:

review_text: Stayed here just for on night, super clean and amazing location, the breakfast could of been a little better tho, other than that it was lovely stay

review_text:
Es un hotel muy bien ubicado puesto que en 12 minutos estas en el centro (catedral y toda la zona) ademas de la buena atencion del personal.
Muy limpias las habitaciones y el colchon muy comodo.
review_translated_text:

The rooms are very clean and the mattress is very comfortable.

name: Carlos Almeida
review_text: Hotel moderno, limpo e confortavel. Perto do centro da cidade.

review_text:
El hotel esta bien. Adaptado a mi silla de ruedas, me hubiera gustado probar la habitacion con terraza, ya en las fotos es una pasada. Se siguen los protocolos de Covid de una manera sensata y sin agobios.
El bufe del desayuno esta genial, los mayores lo agradecimos pero a los mas peques les encanto, fue una experiencia de desayuno diferente.
Lo recomiendo, por precio, por el personal, por el servicio y porque se puede ir en silla de ruedas.
review_translated_text:
The hotel is fine. Adapted to my wheelchair, I would have liked to try the room with a terrace, as in the photos it is amazing. Covid protocols are followed in a sensible and stress-free manner.
The breakfast buffet is great, the older ones appreciated it but the little ones loved it, it was a different breakfast experience.
I recommend it, for price, for the staff, for the service and because you can go in a wheelchair.

name: Maria Andres Sanz
review_text:
Hace frio en plano verano por la noche y no te dan opcion a poner la calefaccion. Las mantas estan sucias sin limpiar. He pedido una nueva y me la han traido mas sucia. 0 higiene y en epoca de coronavirus. Cuesta mucho creerselo.

Ademas en la habitacion doble normal no puedes acceder con facilidad a un lado de la cam y tampoco del escritorio. Tambien cuesta entrar en el bano por el tamano pequeno de la habitacion y su estructura.
review_translated_text:
It's cold in summer at night and they don't give you the option to turn on the heating. The blankets are dirty without cleaning. I asked for a new one and they brought it to me dirtier. 0 hygiene and in times of coronavirus. It's very hard to believe it.

Also in the normal double room you cannot easily access one side of the bed or the desk. It is also difficult to enter the bathroom due to the small size of the room and its structure.

review_text: Todo perfecto
review_translated_text: Everything perfect

name: Carole Dupanloup
review_text:
Plus un 3 etoiles passer votre chemin
Client depuis 2014 nous avons vu le niveau baisser. Aujourd'hui :
TV chaine de 1 a 15 rien. Puis 3 malheureuses chaines....
Douche : les joints des murs se fissurent
Rideau de la chambre en vrac et dechire
Le lit ; surtout ne pas bouger....il se promene
Le prix : 105 EU. Heureusement vu sur un site 53EU j'ai annule puis refait la resa.  Dommage notre vu pour un client ancien pas cool... sans doute pas content que nous ayons modifie a la baisse le prix ...
Wifi... ben pas reussi a se connecter
Dejeuner non pris car trop tardif
Prix parking 15EU juste abusif
Positif : si pas le covid proche de la ville.
Conclusion...l'an prochain on change.
review_translated_text:
No longer a 3-star hotel, move on.
As a customer since 2014, we've seen the standard drop. Today:
TV channels from 1 to 15, nothing. Then 3 miserable channels...
Shower: the wall joints are cracking
Bedroom curtain loose and torn
The bed; definitely don't move... it's moving around
The price: EU105. Luckily, I saw it on a website for EU53, so I canceled and then rebooked. Too bad, our view for a long-time customer, not cool... probably not happy that we changed the price down...
WiFi... well, couldn't connect
Lunch not taken because it was too late
Parking price: EU15, just excessive
Positive: if not for the COVID-19 situation, close to the city.
Conclusion... we'll change next year.

name: Yolanda Llorente
review_text: Hotel comodo, limpio, ubicado a 5-10 minutos a pie del centro de Burgos. Pudimos aparcar en la zona sin problemas.
review_translated_text: Comfortable, clean hotel located a 5-10 minute walk from the center of Burgos. We were able to park nearby without any problems.

name: Paulinsky
review_text: Salvo la gente que pasa por el pasillo que se escucha, la insonorizacion de la habitacion estaba muy bien porque no se escuchaban ruidos. La cama doble era muy comoda y se dormia bien. El tamano de la habitacion era mas que correcto. El bano era muy grande y las toallas eran suaves. Tiene 3 cortinas, una opaca, una blanca y la decorativa, asi que si las colocabas bien no entraba la luz de fuera. Nuestra habitacion (la 209) daba a la calle pero si no abrias la ventana no se escuchaban los coches. Pudimos aparcar en la misma calle del hotel. El centro esta a unos 10 minutos andando. La temperatura de la habitacion era buena. Tiene enchufes a ambos lados de la cama.
review_translated_text: Except for the people walking in the hallway, which can be heard, the room's soundproofing was very good, as no noise was audible. The double bed was very comfortable, and we slept well. The room was more than adequate. The bathroom was very large, and the towels were soft. It had three curtains: one blackout, one white, and a decorative one, so if you positioned them properly, no outside light came in. Our room (209) faced the street, but if you didn't open the window, you couldn't hear the cars. We were able to park on the same street as the hotel. The city center is about a 10-minute walk away. The room temperature was good. There were electrical outlets on both sides of the bed.

name: Cesar Parga
review_text: Un hotel muy bien situado, estas al un poso del casco historico, la fachada es muy moderna pero el interior esta falto de mantenimiento y necesita una reforma motivada por el desgaste.
review_translated_text: A very well located hotel, you are just a stone's throw from the historic center, the facade is very modern but the interior lacks maintenance and needs renovation due to wear and tear.

name: hbcnpowa
review_text: Hotel malisimo, le sobra una estrella y media. La habitacion con telas de arana en las lamparas con arana incluida, retrete roto, habitacion doble y te dejan lo justo para 1 persona, sin servicio de habitaciones, sin nevera ni caja de seguridad, sin cafeteria! Lo unico positivo es que las camas son comodas.
review_translated_text: Terrible hotel, one and a half stars to spare. The room with spider webs on the chandeliers, broken toilet, double room and they leave you just enough for 1 person, no room service, no refrigerator or safe, no cafeteria! The only positive thing is that the beds are comfortable.

Si la habitacion contigua esta habitada, reza porque no ronquen los huespedes. Ha sido una noche sin dormir por los ruidos. Elige otro hotel o compra tapones para los oidos

If the next room is inhabited, pray that the guests don't snore. It has been a sleepless night because of the noises. Choose another hotel or buy earplugs

review_text: Es un buen hotel, en buena zona, muy cerca del centro historico de Burgos y buena relacion calidad precio.
review_translated_text: It is a good hotel, in a good area, very close to the historic center of Burgos and good value for money.

name: Txomin Jorge Pascual
review_text: Hotel muy nuevo y bien situado a tan solo 500 metros de la catedral sin ser extrictamente situado en los aledanos a esta, pero igualmente tan cercano y lejano de bullicio o gentio de la zona gotica.... Siendo nuevo y tan actual si q se echa mucho muchisimo en falta una mininevera o Minibar q de seguro siempre animara al visitante a tener opcion de tomar algun refresco o bebida fria en los dias calidos y calorosos del verano, q tbn en Burgos los tienen...
review_translated_text: A very new and well-located hotel, just 500 metres from the cathedral, but not strictly located near it, but equally close and far from the hustle and bustle of the Gothic quarter. Although it is new and modern, it does miss a mini-fridge or minibar, which will certainly encourage visitors to have the option of having a soft drink or a cold beverage on hot summer days, which Burgos also has.

name: Angela Carrillo
review_text:
Ubicacion buena, no esta en el mismo centro y la zona es tranquila. Esta a 700 metros de la catedral de Burgos.
Personal muy amable.
Estaba muy limpio.
Calidad precio perfecta, volveria a este hotel si volviera a Burgos.
review_translated_text:
Good location, it is not in the center and the area is quiet. It is 700 meters from Burgos Cathedral.
Very friendly staff.
It was very clean.
Perfect price quality, I would return to this hotel if I returned to Burgos.

review_text: El hotel me parece muy correcto amplio y comodo el unico problema que no funcionaba el aire acondicionado
review_translated_text: The hotel seems very correct, spacious and comfortable, the only problem is that the air conditioning did not work.

name: Mari Jose Lopez Palomo
review_text: La habitacion con terraza tiene dos camas, en las fotos del hotel te dice que es cama de matrimonio. Muy cerca del centro pero en zona tranquila. Todo correcto.
review_translated_text: The room with terrace has two beds, the hotel photos tell you that it is a double bed. Very close to the center but in a quiet area. Everything correct.

review_text:

A 10 minutos andando de la catedral. Buena atencion en recepcion. Para pasar un par de noches, genial, por lo que cuesta, esta muy bien.
review_translated_text:
Room a little small, but there is a large closet at the entrance where you can store clothes and suitcases, so nothing to say. Large bathroom, clean room, perhaps missing some more plugs (there is one free in the room and another in the bathroom).
10 minutes walk from the cathedral. Good service at reception. To spend a couple of nights, great, for what it costs, it's very good.

review_text: Instalaciones pasables cojimos Media pension y la cena no se la comerian ni los perros poca fria y ....mal hecha y aun querian cobrar dos euros y medio por una botella pequena de gaseosa...les daria cero

review_text: Cerca del centro, personal amable y todo limpio, pero las cortinas dejan pasar la luz, por lo que si uno necesita total oscuridad para dormir ya no puede hacerlo cuando amanece.
review_translated_text: Close to the center, friendly staff and everything clean, but the curtains let in light, so if you need total darkness to sleep you can't do it when it's dawn.

name: Jose Manuel Langa
review_text: Todo satisfactorio, me molesto la luz de emergencia. Por lo demas genial.

review_text: Hotel bueno de 3 estrellas pero se mereceria mas....atencion muy buena del personal....cerca de la catedral y cerca de la estacion de autobuses..muy recomendable!!!!
review_translated_text: Good 3 star hotel but it deserves more....very good attention from the staff....close to the cathedral and close to the bus station...highly recommended!!!!

review_text: Hotel molto bello con camere confortevoli .E' dotato di parcheggio a pagamento  riservato ai clienti.Cosa molto importante e che si trova molto vicino al centro storico di Burgos che e quindi raggiungibile a piedi. E' stata un'ottima scelta di soggiorno.
review_translated_text: Very nice hotel with comfortable rooms. It has paid parking reserved for customers. A very important thing is that it is located very close to the historic center of Burgos which can therefore be reached on foot. It was a great choice to stay.

review_translated_text: Hotel in the center. Friendly

name: Alberto
review_text: Hotel cercano al centro de Burgos.....habitaciones individuales amplias, bano y ducha muy limpios....almohadas (que para mi es una de las cosas que siempre me tiran para atras de un hotel) bastantes comodas.....100% recomendable
review_translated_text: Hotel close to the center of Burgos.....spacious single rooms, very clean bathroom and shower....pillows (which for me is one of the things that always puts me off a hotel) quite comfortable.....100% recommended

name: Miguel Antonio Nicolosi
review_text:
Buenisima opcion... La atencion genial de todos los chicos. Siempre predispuestos a ayudarte.
Muy cerca del centro
review_translated_text:
Great option... The staff was fantastic. Always willing to help.
Very close to the center.

name: Alf RoDel
review_text: Agradable, atentos, buen servicio, aunque lamento que pongan el Zumo de Naranja de bote !!!!
review_translated_text: Pleasant, attentive, good service, although I regret that they put the Orange Juice in a bottle!!!!

name: Marco Rossi
review_text: Stanze e bagno spaziosi, colazione ottima. Praticamente in centro e con parcheggio sotterraneo collegato.
review_translated_text: Spacious rooms and bathroom, excellent breakfast. Practically in the center and with connected underground parking.

name: TerryD08
review_text: Good location just a short walk to the lovely centre.  Hotel is very average with no frills.  Breakfast just ticks average - staff helpful.  We booked as they have parking at an extra charge.  Bit of a faff getting into garage and great care needed at entrance if you have a large car as there is a tight bend (as the scrapes on the wall testify).

name: Angel Garcia
review_text: Centrico
review_translated_text: Central

name: Luis Carrascosa
review_text: Un hotel muy buen situado, moderno, muy bonito, lo unico malo fue la limpieza de la habitacion, era un poco insuficiente, habia plasticos tirados en el suelo, la lampara sucia y la television con un poco de polvo. Por lo demas muy recomendable, por la atencion y por la situacion.
review_translated_text: A very well-located, modern, and very nice hotel. The only downside was the room cleanliness. It was a bit inadequate, with plastic strewn on the floor, a dirty lamp, and a slightly dusty television. Otherwise, highly recommended for the service and location.

name: eusebio rodaballo
review_text: Buena atencion, bien situado precios ajustados y habitacion correcto, volveria
review_translated_text: Good service, well located, reasonable prices and correct room, I would return

name: ROSA M MARIN SANCHEZ
review_text: Hotel muy limpio y silencioso. A 5 minutos andando del centro. Cama amplia e increibles vistas. Desayuno correcto, tipo buffet, es pequeno pero tiene de todo. La atencion del personal buena tambien.
review_translated_text: Very clean and quiet hotel. 5 minutes walk from the center. Large bed and incredible views. Correct breakfast, buffet style, it is small but has everything. The staff's attention is also good.

name: Marcos Benavent Colomo
review_text: Hotel muy comodo, bien situado. Las habilitaciones son amplias y confortables, y el colchon bastante nuevo. Aunque las habitaciones dan a la calle, esta bien aislado acusticamente
review_translated_text: Very comfortable hotel, well located. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, and the mattress is quite new. Although the rooms face the street, it is well insulated acoustically.

name: Francisco Bofill Pages
review_text: Bon hotel .Situat a 10 minuts del centre de Burgos. Hem passat dues nits molt be. Personal molt amable, esmorzar molt be, habitacions insonoritzades, parquing al mateix hotel, preu raonable. Recomenable.
review_translated_text: Good hotel. Located 10 minutes from the center of Burgos. We spent two nights very well. Very friendly staff, very good breakfast, soundproofed rooms, parking at the hotel, reasonable price. Recommended.

name: Esther Lizondo
review_text: Hotel a 10 minutos del centro y a la vez tranquilo. La atencion espectacular. El unico pero de lo pongo a la cama que era un poco blanda y el segundo dia me levante con dolor de espalda
review_translated_text: Hotel 10 minutes from the center and at the same time quiet. Spectacular attention. The only downside is that I put it on the bed, which was a little soft and on the second day I woke up with back pain.

name: Alberto Gutierrez
review_text: Como de costumbre, limpio, atentos, calidad precio bueno.
review_translated_text: As usual, clean, attentive, good value for money.

name: sara barreda de la fuente
review_text: Muy caro
review_translated_text: Very expensive

name: susanwalsh
review_text: This hotel is on a ringroad not too far from the centre of the city but not quite as close as reviews suggested. It is characterless and has no public spaces. Our room was comfortable though there was a pillar down the centre of the room close to where my husband got out of bed. Breakfast was adequate though a bit of a scrum the first morning due to a large school party being in the hotel.

name: Carla Arenas
review_text: El hotel esta bien. Habitacion amplia, bano amplio, limpio y completo, personal muy atento y en muy buena ubicacion (apenas 10 minutos del centro historico), pero el colchon, al menos en nuestra habitacion muy malo. Estuvimos 3 noches con mi pareja y acabamos los 2 con dolor de espalda, la ultima noche apenas dormimos. En resumen, perfecto para una noche.
review_translated_text: The hotel is fine. Large room, large, clean and complete bathroom, very attentive staff and in a very good location (just 10 minutes from the historic center), but the mattress, at least in our room, very bad. We stayed 3 nights with my partner and both of us ended up with back pain, the last night we barely slept. In short, perfect for one night.

name: Vivian Pena Ol
review_text: Muy bueno, limpio moderno  buena atencion
review_translated_text: Very good, clean, modern, good service

name: Ola Malmqvist
review_text: Very Nice. Good Location. Nice centrum. Good value.

name: MIGUEL ANGEL CONEJO GUTIERREZ
review_text: Malos productos y mal servicio. Hay una camarera borde que mejor se dedique a otros menesteres
review_translated_text: Bad products and bad service. There is a waitress who better dedicates herself to other duties.

name: jose luis de carlos
review_text: Muy buen hotel y centrico.
review_translated_text: Very good and central hotel.

name: Rocio Larrey Garcia
review_text: Hotel a 10/15 minutos andando del centro. El personal en general muy agradable y atento a todas las necesidades. La habitacion amplia, siempre limpia y muy tranquila. El desayuno buffet estaba bien. El garaje (15EU por noche) aunque algo escondido tenia plazas suficientes y algunas de ellas eran muy espaciosas.
review_translated_text: Hotel 10/15 minutes walk from the center. The staff in general is very pleasant and attentive to all needs. The room is spacious, always clean and very quiet. Buffet breakfast was good. The garage (EU15 per night), although somewhat hidden, had enough spaces and some of them were very spacious.

name: Alicia miller
review_text: Beautiful hotel

name: Manuel Peluqueros
review_text: Bien,muy limpio y acogedor.el colchon de primera.y muy cerquita del centro.recomendable 100%
review_translated_text: Good, very clean and cozy. The mattress is top-notch. And very close to the center. 100% recommended.

name: Gloria Conesa
review_text: Calidad precio acorde.
review_translated_text: Matching price quality.

name: Halcon Peregrino
review_text: Muy funcional y comodo, a un paso del centro de Burgos
review_translated_text: Very functional and comfortable, just a step away from the center of Burgos

name: Manolo Mateos
review_text:
Habitaciones confortables e impolutas

Si vas con bebe avisalo con antelacion, te pueden proporcionar una cuna de viaje

Los banos son anchos si viajas en silla de ruedas

En la plaza de detras esta la piscina municipal si quieres hacer un poco de deporte

Hay aparcamiento en los alrededores

La cafeteria es barata y el servicio agradable, merece la pena quedarse a tomar algo
review_translated_text:
Comfortable and spotless rooms

If you are going with a baby, let us know in advance, they can provide you with a travel cot

The bathrooms are wide if you travel in a wheelchair

In the square behind is the municipal swimming pool if you want to do a little sport.

There is parking nearby

The cafeteria is cheap and the service is pleasant, it is worth staying for a drink

name: Miguel Angel Saul
review_text: Buenas habitaciones.
review_translated_text: Good rooms.

name: Ester Gaudo
review_text: Bien. Limpio y comodo
review_translated_text: Good. Clean and comfortable.

name: Darsad
review_text: Buen hotel. Habitacion amplia y comoda, sin ruidos. El bano muy bien, el personal atento y colaboradores. Desde luego si vuelvo a Burgos regresare
review_translated_text: Good hotel. Large and comfortable room, without noise. The bathroom is very good, the staff is attentive and helpful. Of course if I return to Burgos I will return

name: Owen Marsh
review_text: Good price and location. Generous room size

name: Delfin Rodriguez
review_text:
PROS:

Hemos estado cinco noches en este hotel y, en general, la estancia ha sido muy comoda. La habitacion amplia, las camas muy comodas, limpieza correcta, zona donde aparcar sin problemas y sin necesidad de contratar el parking del hotel. Tampoco contratamos el desayuno bufet pero desayunabamos en la cafeteria. El personal muy amable.

CONTRAS:

El ultimo dia tuvimos un pequeno problema con el termostato del mando de la ducha que no regulaba bien la temperatura del agua pero ya nos ibamos y no pudimos averiguar como se solucionan esos problemas y con que diligencia.

EN RESUMEN:

Hotel de tres estrellas correcto tanto las instalaciones como el personal y con buena ubicacion para visitar la ciudad.
review_translated_text:
PROS:

We have stayed five nights at this hotel and, in general, the stay has been very comfortable. The spacious room, the very comfortable beds, proper cleaning, an area where you can park without problems and without the need to hire the hotel parking. We also did not hire the breakfast buffet but we had breakfast in the cafeteria. Very friendly staff.

CONS:

The last day we had a small problem with the thermostat on the shower control that did not regulate the water temperature well, but we were already leaving and we couldn't figure out how to solve these problems and how diligently.

IN SUMMARY:

Three-star hotel with good facilities and staff and a good location for visiting the city.

name: Tina Castano Celestino
review_text: La habitacion no era comoda y el desayuno muy caro para el buffet que ofrecian.
review_translated_text: The room was not comfortable and the breakfast was very expensive for the buffet they offered.

name: Pilar
review_text: No esta mal, pero la columna que tiene la habitacion no ayuda a dar mejor valoracion. Se podria haber resuelto con imaginacion
review_translated_text: It's not bad, but the column that the room has doesn't help give a better rating. It could have been solved with imagination.

name: David Sanchez
review_text: Excesivo precio del buffet desayuno , ademas de baja calidad , variedad escasa
review_translated_text: Excessive price of the breakfast buffet, in addition to low quality, limited variety

name: mic54m
review_text: Anche se non si trova in centro, e assai comodo per raggiungere i principali luoghi di interesse. Al contempo l'area non e congestionata e permette il parcheggio libero delle auto. L'albergo e in ottimee condizioni, stanze ampie e luminose, bagno pulito e comodo. La colazione e di buon livello e permette una scelta interessante. Lo consiglio.
review_translated_text: Even though it is not in the center, it is very convenient to reach the main places of interest. At the same time, the area is not congested and allows free parking for cars. The hotel is in excellent condition, large and bright rooms, clean and comfortable bathroom. The breakfast is of a good standard and allows an interesting choice. I recommend it.

name: Maria Belen F. Victoria
review_text: Fantastico hotel
review_translated_text: Fantastic hotel

name: 861EnricoM
review_text: L'Hotel si trova facilmente arrivando dalle autostrade. Un edificio d'angolo in un grande complesso, moderno e semplice. Se si arriva presto, si puo trovare una camera ai piani altri con una vista spettacolare sul vicino centro storico, grazie alle finestre a tutta parete con poltrona davanti. Non chiedere le tende di notte, fintanto  che i monumenti rimangono illuminati !!
review_translated_text: The Hotel is easy to find coming from the highways. A corner building in a large complex, modern and simple. If you arrive early, you can find a room on the other floors with a spectacular view of the nearby historic center, thanks to the floor-to-ceiling windows with an armchair in front. Do not ask for curtains at night, as long as the monuments remain illuminated !!

name: Antonio J Bautista E
review_text: Muy acogedor, limpio, centrico. Buen desayuno. Personal atento. Y la vista!
review_translated_text: Very cozy, clean, and centrally located. Good breakfast. Attentive staff. And the view!

name: nicarchi
review_text: Ottimo hotel, posizione centralissima, a pochissima distanza dalla Cattedrale, camere ampie pulite e ben arredate, buona colaziome. ||La mattina del nostro arrivo, sono state recapitate li 6 biciclette con le quali avremmo percorso il Cammino di Santiago, e le hanno accettate senza problemi
review_translated_text: Excellent hotel, very central location, a short distance from the Cathedral, large, clean and well-furnished rooms, good breakfast. ||The morning of our arrival, 6 bicycles were delivered there with which we would have traveled the Camino de Santiago, and they accepted them without problems

name: Alvaro Nunez Garcia
review_text: NO se descansa por ruido de trafico. El hotel en calidad precio no esta mal. Esta ubicado bastante bien pero para mi la pega esta en que tiene unas ventanas de chici y nabo y dos avenidas que dan al hotel asique no hay forma de pegar ojo para el que tenga el sueno ligero.  Yo no vuelvo a pisarlo pase una noche que cada autobus o camion que pasaba me despertaba y tenia tapones puestos y estaba en la novena planta. La camas estan bien y son recientes.
review_translated_text: There is NO rest due to traffic noise. The hotel is not bad in terms of quality and price. It is located quite well but for me the drawback is that it has chic and turnip windows and two avenues that face the hotel so there is no way for a light sleeper to sleep a wink.  I won't set foot there again. One night, every bus or truck that passed woke me up and I had earplugs in and I was on the ninth floor. The beds are good and recent.

name: coedujin
review_text:
peureonteu yeojigweonbun sangdanghi cinjeolhago siseol ggaeggeushabnida.
bureugoseu daeseongdangdo injeobhaguyo.
review_translated_text: The front desk staff is very friendly and the facilities are clean. Burgos Cathedral is also nearby.

name: Carles Torras
review_text: muy bien
review_translated_text: very good

name: Ana Blazquez
review_text: Relacion calidad precio estupenda. Y el trato del personal inmejorable
review_translated_text: Great value for money. And the treatment of the staff is unbeatable.

name: Juan Carlos Mendoza Fernandez
review_text: Calidad precio premium.
review_translated_text: Premium price quality.

name: Leiidy V.V
review_text: Perfecto servicio
review_translated_text: Perfect service

name: Enrique de la Cuesta
review_text: Buen lugar, bien ubicado y cafeteria agradable
review_translated_text: Good place, well located and nice cafe

name: Hilario Rodriguez Reyes
review_text: Paredes sucias, toallas sucias, averia en bano, solo 1 persona ( recepcion ) en todo el hotel. Estuvimos mas de una hora esperando por mantenimiento para la averia y salimos porque no llegaban, arreglan a medias, toda la noche goteando agua en el inodoro. Primero dicen nos cambian de habitacion y despues nos dicen que no porque el hotel esta lleno. Desayuno muy pobre, sin minibar en habitacion. No recomiendo para nada. Le sobra una estrella. Por cierto pedimos hojas de reclamacion.
review_translated_text: Dirty walls, dirty towels, bathroom breakdown, only one person (reception) in the entire hotel. We waited over an hour for maintenance to fix the problem and left because they didn't arrive. They fix it half-heartedly, and the toilet dripped all night. First they say they'll change our room, and then they say they won't because the hotel is full. Very poor breakfast, no minibar in the room. I don't recommend it at all. It needs one star. By the way, we asked for complaint forms.

name: Jose Antonio Garcia
review_text: Hotel muy bien situado, con bonitas vistas a la catedral, desde los pisos superiores y personal muy agradable.
review_translated_text: Very well located hotel, with beautiful views of the cathedral from the upper floors and very pleasant staff.

name: Maria margarita Ramirez Sanchez
review_text:
Acabamos de llegar desde Gran Canarias para pasar cinco dias en Burgos y nos hemos encontrado con una habitacion q tiene el bano con agua en el suelo la cual sale de la taza del bano q esta rota , y las toallas del lavamanos manchadaz de rojo
En el hotel solo esta el recepcionista ,nadie de mantenimiento, nos dijo que iba a llamar y que ya venian, mas de una hora despues, seguimos esperando.
El recepcionista tubo q dejar su puesto de trabajo solo y venir a la habitacion a secar agua y cambiar las toallas.
review_translated_text:
We just arrived from Gran Canaria to spend five days in Burgos and found a room with a bathroom with water on the floor, coming from the broken toilet bowl, and the towels in the sink stained red.
Only the receptionist was there at the hotel, no maintenance personnel. He told us he would call and that they would be on their way. More than an hour later, we were still waiting.
The receptionist had to leave his desk and come to the room alone to dry the water and change the towels.

name: Maria Luisa
review_text: No esta mal!
review_translated_text: Not bad!

name: Lucia Jandula
review_text: Muy cerca del centro, hotel excelente calidad precio, habitaciones espaciosas, modernas y camas muy comodas!!! Es la segunda vez que visitamos el hotel. Personal muy atento. Muy recomendable
review_translated_text: Very close to the center, excellent value for money, spacious, modern rooms, and very comfortable beds! This is our second visit to the hotel. Very attentive staff. Highly recommended.

name: Gerardo Tenreiro Vazquez
review_text: Bien situado, comodo y moderno. Pero algunos pequenos defectos y desayuno un poco soso.
review_translated_text: Well located, comfortable and modern. But some small defects and breakfast a little bland.

name: M Del Mar Matilla
review_text: Muy buen precio. Habitacion excelente
review_translated_text: Very good price. Excellent room.

name: Francisco Molina
review_text: Cerca del centro y muy agradable.
review_translated_text: Close to the center and very nice.

name: Sonia Tejero
review_text: Buen trato.Buffet desayuno muy bueno y completo.Se puede aparcar cerca e ir andando a la catedral y al casco antiguo.
review_translated_text: Good treatment. Very good and complete breakfast buffet. You can park nearby and walk to the cathedral and the old town.

name: sonia lopez pazos
review_text: Cogimos dos habitaciones porque vamos con dos adolescentes. Decir que el personal de recepcion un 10, las habitaciones correctas. Desayunamos en la cafeteria (no cogimos buffet), y el camarero fue muy atento y agradable. La ubicacion ideal, es un paseo hasta la catedral. El aparcamiento (si no quieres dejarlo en el hotel) cercano y publico. Volveriamos.
review_translated_text: We took two rooms because we are going with two teenagers. Say that the reception staff a 10, the rooms correct. We had breakfast in the cafeteria (we didn't have a buffet), and the waiter was very attentive and pleasant. The ideal location is a walk to the cathedral. Parking (if you don't want to leave it at the hotel) is nearby and public. We would return.

name: Abo Abo
review_text: Sin mas.
review_translated_text: Without further ado.

name: Amparo Iniguez Cuevas
review_text: Muy limpio y la atencion del personal muy amable
review_translated_text: Very clean and the staff was very friendly.

name: elbar71 elbar71
review_text: Comodo
review_translated_text: Comfortable

name: Raul Rocha
review_text: Perfecto
review_translated_text: Perfect

name: MARI CARMEN OLAYA MILLANA
review_text: Muy cerca del centro y a la vez zona tranquila. Limpio y desayuno excelente. El parking un poco caro. Recomendable
review_translated_text: Very close to the center and at the same time quiet area. Clean and excellent breakfast. Parking a little expensive. Advisable

name: Maritzia
review_text: Mucho mejor de lo imaginado. Muy cerca del centro, delante de la universidad, magnifica ubicacion. Todo muy limpio, habitacion y cama muy comodos. Desayuno muy completo y variado. Muy amables.
review_translated_text: Much better than imagined. Very close to the center, in front of the university, magnificent location. Everything very clean, very comfortable room and bed. Very complete and varied breakfast. Very friendly.

name: JOSE ANTONIO
review_text: Para pasar una noche esta bien situado
review_translated_text: To spend a night it is well located

name: jose antonio carron cortes
review_text: Cerca del centro de Burgos
review_translated_text: Near the center of Burgos

name: Lina Belchior
review_text: Agradavel preco/localizacao /simpatia dos empregados
review_translated_text: Nice price/location/friendly staff

name: Rosa Maria Martinez Catela
review_text:
Lo unico bueno es la limpieza y la cercania a la catedral.
Habitacion pequena, sin mini bar, sin bide con mala distribucion en el bano y la conexion wifi que funciona a ratos. Si te toca habitacion cerca del ascensor tienes que aguantar los ruidos que hace. La cafeteria pesima,. No volveria.
review_translated_text:
The only good thing is the cleanliness and the proximity to the cathedral.
Small room, without mini bar, without bidet with poor distribution in the bathroom and the Wi-Fi connection that works at times. If you have a room near the elevator you have to put up with the noises it makes. The terrible cafeteria. I wouldn't go back.

name: Francesco Di Sario
review_text: ottimo hotel, camere grandi e pulite. a meno di 10 minuti a piedi dal centro storico. Prezzo onesto e ottima colazione.
review_translated_text: excellent hotel, large and clean rooms. less than 10 minutes walk from the historic center. Fair price and excellent breakfast.

name: Nicole Chevallereau
review_text: Hotel parfait mais personnel moyen pour les Francais
review_translated_text: Perfect hotel but average staff for the French

name: Maria Ortiz
review_text: Habitaciones muy bien cuidadas, con todos los detalles basicos y muy buena higiene.
review_translated_text: Very well-kept rooms, with all the basic details and very good hygiene.

name: 701shaunt
review_text: Hotel just a 10 minute walk away from the old town of Burgos. All the modern amenities you can ask for. Breakfast was good with a decent choice. The only minus for me was the cost to park the motorcycle 8 euros a night. Which is a bit steep. But I suppose it was secure. All in a we would stay here again.

name: Luis Lopez
review_text: Olia mucho a tabaco y el colchon muy duro y no habia shampoo, ni acondicionador,ni crema en el bano. No me gustado!
review_translated_text: It smelled strongly of tobacco, the mattress was very hard, and there was no shampoo, conditioner, or body wash in the bathroom. I didn't like it!

name: Josean Grapa
review_text: Muy bien el hotel
review_translated_text: Very good hotel

name: Ignacio Garcia Gamero
review_text: Correcto. Buena situacion. Habitacion enana.
review_translated_text: Correct. Good location. Tiny room.

name: Vicente Gimilio
review_text: Un hotel que me atendio muy bien en un momento dificil. Excelente en atencion, equipamiento y limpieza. Volvere.
review_translated_text: A hotel that treated me very well during a difficult time. Excellent service, amenities, and cleanliness. I'll be back.

name: Ionut Eugen
review_text: Bien
review_translated_text: Good

name: M. G.
review_text: Buen hotel, bien ubicado, siendo facil aparcar en calles cercanas, las habitaciones son comodas y amplias. El personal fue agradable, lo recomiendo para cualquier tipo de visita de la ciudad.
review_translated_text: Good hotel, well located, easy to park in nearby streets, the rooms are comfortable and spacious. The staff was nice, I recommend it for any type of city visit.

name: Jean-Michel Bombar
review_text:
Hotel un peu bruyant et qui meriterait un coup de jeune en particulier dans la salle de bain.
L'acces au parking est tres tres exigu.
review_translated_text:
The hotel is a bit noisy and could use a bit of a facelift, especially in the bathroom.
Access to the parking lot is very tight.

name: Manuel Carbo
review_text: Un hotel centrico y con buenos precios pero con problemas de climatizacion si se va en epoca de calor.
review_translated_text: A centrally located hotel with good prices but with air conditioning problems if you go in the hot season.

name: luis beda diaz diaz
review_text: Me encanta la habitacion y la atencion del personal de Recepcion.
review_translated_text: I love the room and the attention of the reception staff.

name: Itho
review_text:
Hotel en plein Burgos a 5 min de la voie rapide et a 10 min a pied du centre historique (cathedrale, resto...)
Chambre climatisee, confortable (baignoire), propre de bonne taille pour 45 euros. Double vitrage et climatisation sont les bienvenues en plein ete.
Seul bemol (d ou les 4 etoiles) le parking: 15 euros en plus et l entree/sortie se fait par le meme acces et prenez en compte la taille de votre voiture (807 pour nous...c etait juste pour acceder aux voies de sortie)
review_translated_text:
Hotel in the heart of Burgos, 5 minutes from the expressway and 10 minutes on foot from the historic center (cathedral, restaurant, etc.)
Air-conditioned room, comfortable (bath), clean, good size for 45 euros. Double glazing and air conditioning are welcome in the middle of summer.
The only downside (hence the 4 stars) is the parking: 15 euros more and entry/exit is via the same access and take into account the size of your car (807 for us...it was just to access the exit routes)

name: Tito Hortiguela
review_text: Nos atienden maravillosamente, las habitaciones comodas y buen precio.
review_translated_text: We were treated wonderfully, the rooms were comfortable, and the price was good.

name: H Koussour
review_text:
Super
Hotel propre et acceuil parfait.
review_translated_text:
Great
Clean hotel and perfect welcome.

name: Giuseppe Taglieri
review_text: Camere molto ben tenute e pulite.  Personale molto gentile. Ottima posizione, l'hotel e a meno di 10 minuti dal centro citta.  Ottima anche la colazione.  Dispone di un parcheggio interno anche se in zona e facile trovare parcheggio.
review_translated_text: Very well kept and clean rooms.  Very kind staff. Great location, the hotel is less than 10 minutes from the city centre.  Breakfast was also excellent.  It has internal parking although it is easy to find parking in the area.

name: KISHA SAKORI BLOG
review_text: Hotel con relacion calidad-precio intermedio. Se nota que lo han reciclado y mejorado aunque todavia  le queda. El colchon no me fue muy comodo, el bano estaba bien y a destacar el secador de pelo ya que siempre son minis y este es de Rowenta tamano normal. Las vistas quizas lo mejor.
