Lo mejor que he visto en el hotel ha sido la cama, que me ha parecido bastante comoda, aunque no parezca nada del otro mundo. La recepcion que han estado ahi para ayudar en todo lo que necesitabamos y la limpieza en general.
Lo que me ha decepcionado del hotel han sido algunas cosillas como que en el champu que hay en el bano esta muy aguado, el parking es de pago (15EU) y no es nada orientativo, es complicado encontrar donde estan las plazas y luego la puerta para entrar al hotel. Despues la mesa que hay en la habitacion es de muy mala calidad y apenas se puede utilizar para trabajar.
El desayuno Buffett no sabria definirlo como bueno o malo, tiene variedad y algunas cosas estan muy bien, pero luego otras como la tortilla, bacon y salchichas son un poco incomestibles.
En fin, no esta mal.. esta bien de precio, pero algunas cosas las deberian mejorar un poco.
review_translated_text:
I've stayed at this hotel for several nights, and I've had mixed feelings. On the one hand, it's a three-star hotel, so you can't expect all the luxury, and the truth is, I was pleasantly surprised at first.
The best thing I saw at the hotel was the bed, which I found to be quite comfortable, even though it didn't seem like anything special. The reception staff were there to help with anything we needed, and the overall cleanliness.
What disappointed me about the hotel were a few minor issues, such as the watery shampoo in the bathroom, the paid parking (EU15) and no clear directions, and it's difficult to find the parking spaces and even the door to enter the hotel. The table in the room is of very poor quality and barely suitable for working.
I couldn't define the breakfast buffet as good or bad. It has a variety and some items are very good, but others, like the omelet, bacon, and sausages, are a bit inedible.
Well, it's not bad... it's a good price, but some things could be improved a bit.

review_text: The hotel is very handy for the city centre, the cathedral & river walks being only a short five minute walk away.   The hotel itself is modern & clean, with free wifi.   The staff were very helpful & efficient, but the room was only just OK, clean, but smallish, nothing to write home about.   Breakfast was buffet style & again adequate, but again nothing to rave about.   The hotel has generous secure parking, but at 15 euros per night extra, I think expensive.   Burgos is a fantastic Spanish city & one I've driven through or around for many years & I'm glad that this time we decided to stop & explore.   If you want to eat, don't go into the city centre, just explore the barrio the hotel is situated in, there is more choice & better value for your money.

name: Javier Esteve Medina
review_text: La recepcion en el hotel ha sido correcta, una vez entras en la habitacion esta todo muy limpio y ordenado. Tiene secador y banera para los amantes del bano y el relax y un expendedor de jabon en abundancia. Las vistas son excepcionales, en nuestro caso si asomabas la cabeza por la ventana podias contemplar la catedral de Burgos. Los empleados del hotel son muy amables y diligentes en su trabajo. La ubicacion es ideal, ya que, ademas de que en Burgos a todo se puede ir andando, en este caso se tiene la catedral muy cerca. Hay buffet libre de desayuno en el restaurante del hotel y hay cafeteria. Todo lo que tomes en la cafeteria has de pagarlo en recepcion, algo que a mi personalmente no me gusta mucho, porque hace el servicio lento. En general recomiendo el hotel 100 por cien.
review_translated_text: The reception at the hotel was excellent. Once you enter the room, everything is very clean and tidy. It has a hairdryer and bathtub for those who love to soak and relax, and a soap dispenser with plenty of supplies. The views are exceptional; in our case, if you stuck your head out the window, you could see Burgos Cathedral. The hotel staff are very friendly and diligent in their work. The location is ideal, as not only is everything in Burgos within walking distance, but in this case, the cathedral is very close. There is an open breakfast buffet in the hotel restaurant and a cafeteria. Everything you order in the cafeteria must be paid for at reception, something I personally don't like very much, as it makes the service slow. Overall, I recommend the hotel 100%.

La proprete des chambres et plutot moyenne (toile d'araignee au plafond, poussiere au dessus de la tete de lit), la literie pas top
La superficie de la chambre est suffisante pour un arret d'une nuit, evitez les grosses valises. Notre chambre donnait sur la rue et elle n'etait pas trop bruyante (peu de passage).

The cleanliness of the rooms is rather average (cobwebs on the ceiling, dust above the headboard), and the bedding is not great.
The room size is sufficient for an overnight stay; avoid large suitcases. Our room overlooked the street and wasn't too noisy (little traffic).

We didn't have breakfast there, so I can't comment on it. However, there is a cafeteria in the hotel.

review_text:
La atencion del personal inmejorable, muy atentos e incluso nos facilitaron un mapa de la ciudad y nos recomendaron los mejores lugares para comer.
El hotel esta muy cerca del centro, andando hasta la catedral hay apenas 5 minutos y el aparcamiento en la calle es gratuito, no hay zona de parquimetros.
Las vistas desde el hotel son fantasticas, se ve gran parte de la ciudad y la catedral.
La habitacion muy acogedora, buen tamano, todo muy limpio, cuidado y con una temperatura muy agradable. Contaba con Tv plana de unas 19 pulgadas, una butaca y una silla en la habitacion. Un gran detalle es que teniamos un par de libros en la habitacion con informacion sobre la ciudad, monumentos, restaurantes...
Tiene un pequeno bar frente a la recepcion donde se puede desayunar de buffet por 8EU o tomar un cafe con bolleria por 2,5EU. El bar en general esta bien, el unico pero es que cada vez que abrian la puerta que da a la calle nos moriamos de frio.
review_translated_text:
The staff was unbeatable, very attentive and even gave us a map of the city and recommended the best places to eat.
The hotel is very close to the center, it takes just 5 minutes to walk to the cathedral and parking on the street is free, there is no parking meter area.
The views from the hotel are fantastic, you can see much of the city and the cathedral.
The room was very cozy, good size, everything was very clean, well cared for and with a very pleasant temperature. It had a 19-inch flat TV, an armchair and a chair in the room. A great detail is that we had a couple of books in the room with information about the city, monuments, restaurants...
It has a small bar in front of the reception where you can have a buffet breakfast for EU8 or have a coffee with pastries for EU2.5. The bar in general is good, the only drawback is that every time they opened the door that faces the street we froze to death.

review_text:
Decepcion.
Haciendo el check in, nos informan que nos ubican en una habitacion con amplia terraza y vistas a la catedral, en la ultima planta del hotel. Entendemos que es un detalle positivo del hotel, hasta que llegada la noche no paramos de escuchar el motor del ascensor y una alarma que sonaba cada tres horas. El ruido del motor del ascensor, asi como el ruido que hace el ascensor cada vez que para en una planta (hay 11 plantas)  hace que no peguemos ojo.
A la manana siguiente cuando dejamos el hotel, se lo comentamos a la persona que habia en recepcion y su reaccion es hacerse la loca; vamos, que ni siquiera nos pide disculpas, como si no fuese su problema.

Desde luego que no recomiendo este hotel, si lo que quieres es dormir.
review_translated_text:
Disappointment.
Upon checking in, they inform us that they will place us in a room with a large terrace and views of the cathedral, on the top floor of the hotel. We understand that it is a positive detail of the hotel, until nightfall we did not stop hearing the elevator motor and an alarm that sounded every three hours. The noise of the elevator motor, as well as the noise that the elevator makes every time it stops on a floor (there are 11 floors) makes us not sleep a wink.
The next morning when we left the hotel, we mentioned it to the person at the reception and his reaction was to act crazy; Come on, he doesn't even apologize to us, as if it weren't his problem.

I certainly do not recommend this hotel, if what you want is to sleep.

name: Carlos Marquez Arellano
review_text:
Experiencia bastante mejorable. Pasamos un fin de semana y la sensacion que nos quedo no fue para repetir. El hotel es caro para lo que ofrece. Cuando estuvimos uno de los ascensores estaba roto, lo que para subir a una octava planta, las escaleras no eran la solucion mas apetecible. Reservamos una cama de matrimonio y cuando llegamos a la habitacion eran dos individuales, que no pudimos cambiar por aforo completo. Las camas no estaban en buenas condiciones y los somieres parecian que se iban a romper en pedazos. El bano muy reducido, solo ofrece champu y gel (en el mismo bote).
La habitacion no cuenta con nevera. Las vistas si fueron muy bonitas y estaba cerquita del centro. El buffet bastante limitado, estaba bueno pero no habia mucho para elegir. Tambien ofrece aparcamiento por un suplemento, pero no merece la pena ya que se aparca bien en los alrededores. A pesar de todo ello, el servico del hotel ha sido muy amable.

Es un hotel que no ofrece la calidad de las 3 estrellas, y que si realmente quiere ver relacion calidad / precio, no lo encontrara.
review_translated_text:
The experience could be much better. We spent a weekend there and the feeling we were left with was one we wouldn't repeat. The hotel is expensive for what it offers. When we were there, one of the elevators was broken, so taking the stairs wasn't the most desirable option to get to the eighth floor. We booked a double bed, but when we got to the room, there were two singles, which we couldn't exchange because the room was full. The beds weren't in good condition, and the bed frames looked like they were going to fall apart. The bathroom was very small, offering only shampoo and body wash (in the same bottle).
The room didn't have a refrigerator. The views were very beautiful, and it was close to the center. The buffet was quite limited; it was good, but there wasn't much to choose from. Parking is also available for an additional fee, but it's not worth it since parking is available nearby. Despite all this, the hotel staff was very friendly.

It's a hotel that doesn't offer the quality of a 3-star hotel, and if you're really looking for value for money, you won't find it.

name: P FC
review_text:
La pension Hilton fue increible, casi parecia que estaba en la casa del terror de las ferias, con ruidos de gente y los techos crujiendo, me llego a quedar 1 noche mas e igual se me cae encima el hostal. Por no hablar de las medidas de higiene, una gran experiencia extrasensorial que incluye alucinaciones y un gran riesgo de muerte.
Lo que mas me gusto es la zona de juegos que incluye, con sus juegos tan caracteristicos de adivina de que parte del cuerpo son esos pelos o jugar a ser electricista e intentar arreglar la television.
El bano increible (siempre que te guste el olor a pis). Sin dejar de hablar de la mini banera, que la cortina se te pegaba al cuerpo, no se como consiguieron las 2 estrellas.
Sin duda no volveria
review_translated_text:
The Hilton pension was incredible, it almost seemed like I was in the horror house of the fairs, with the noise of people and the ceilings creaking, I managed to stay 1 more night and the hostel still fell on me. Not to mention hygiene measures, a great extrasensory experience that includes hallucinations and a great risk of death.
What I liked the most is the games area it includes, with its characteristic games of guessing what part of the body those hairs are from or pretending to be an electrician and trying to fix the television.
The incredible bathroom (as long as you like the smell of pee). Without stopping to talk about the mini bathtub, the curtain stuck to your body, I don't know how they got the 2 stars.
I definitely wouldn't go back

review_translated_text: Site located in the heart of Gamonal, close to shops and all kinds of services. Very suitable for stays of several days.

name: fernando lobato villagra
review_text:
Unico en su especie, fantastico, increible, lo tiene todo.
Complicaciones con el check-in? Nada! Aqui puedes entrar hasta la cocina sin llave, sin tarjeta y sin identificacion. Tu y cualquiera.
Frio por las noches? No problemo! Aqui tienes una capa de refuerzo entre las sabanas formada por cientos de pelos
no-necesariamente-humanos para estar calentin.
Sin dinero para drogas? Tranquilo! En las juntas de los azulejos y los cantos de las ventanas tienes una coleccion surtida de hongos para colocarte por inhalacion, cortesia de la casa.
Adiccion a las pantallas? No en el Hilton! Ni la tele ni el wifi acapararan tu atencion, ya que no funcionan.
Harto del consumismo obsceno? Estas de suerte! En el Hilton puedes ayudar al planeta durmiendo sobre un colchon de tercera mano y un somier rescatado del vertedero. Viva el reciclaje!
Alergia a la lejia? Pues estas de enhorabuena, porque en el Hilton hace anos que no se usa lejia (ni sanytol ni detergente ni jabon ni...)

Diviertete jugando al "pelusa o chinche"! Practica nuevas variantes del escondite con el dueno/encargado/recepcionista! Averigua la fuente de los diversos olores pestilentes que pueblan el establecimiento. La diversion nunca se acaba en el Hilton. Hasta te puedes sentir tentado de llamar a la policia para que vayan a disfrutarlo en persona. Muchos clientes lo han hecho ya.

No has dormido en un sitio asi en tu vida. Al menos, pagando no.
review_translated_text:
One of a kind, fantastic, incredible, it has it all.
Complications with check-in? Nothing! Here you can enter the kitchen without a key, without a card and without identification. You and anyone.
Cold at night? No problem! Here you have a layer of reinforcement between the sheets made up of hundreds of hairs
not-necessarily-human to be horny.
No money for drugs? Don't worry! In the joints of the tiles and the edges of the windows you have an assorted collection of mushrooms to inhale, courtesy of the house.
Addiction to screens? Not at the Hilton! Neither the TV nor the Wi-Fi will capture your attention, since they do not work.
Fed up with obscene consumerism? You're in luck! At the Hilton you can help the planet by sleeping on a second-hand mattress and a box spring rescued from the landfill. Long live recycling!
Allergy to bleach? Well, you're in luck, because bleach hasn't been used at the Hilton for years (no sanytol, no detergent, no soap, no...)

Have fun playing "fluff or bug"! Practice new variants of hiding with the owner/manager/receptionist! Find out the source of the various foul odors that populate the establishment. The fun never stops at the Hilton. You may even be tempted to call the police to come and enjoy it in person. Many clients have already done it.

You haven't slept in a place like this in your life. At least, not paying.

review_text: Lo bueno es que puedes entrar con perros, por lo demas las habitaciones huelen a tabaco, el mantenimiento es escaso, las mantas no se lavan y por ello me he pasado la noche con alergia y con asma. name: Opinion de usuario
review_text: La verdad que deja mucho que desear, nada que ver con las fotos que tienen puestas. En el bano el techo de la ducha todo descascarillado, moho y sucidad... La habitacion mas de lo mismo, abrir la cama y ver pelos dentro como si no se cambiasen las sabanas, tenian pinta de sobradas asqueroso, sin armario ni nada, la TV no iba bien y encima tenia una marana de cables como se puede ver en las fotos, y unos olores. El suelo sucio y zonas pegajosas en el suelo, interruptores... Y debajo de la cama... Llamamos varias veces a quejarnos pero no nos atendieron. Asi que toco conformarse y que pasase la noche rapido... Encima mucho ruido y jaleo, afortunadamente solo fue una noche, para olvidar vamos. Pongo fotos para que juzguen ustedes mismos. Un saludo.
review_translated_text: The truth is that it leaves a lot to be desired, nothing to do with the photos they have posted. In the bathroom, the shower ceiling was all chipped, mold and dirt... The room was more of the same, opening the bed and seeing hair inside as if the sheets had not been changed, they looked disgusting, without a closet or anything, the TV was not working well and on top of it it had a tangle of cables as you can see in the photos, and some smells. Dirty floor and sticky areas on the floor, switches... And under the bed... We called several times to complain but they did not answer us. So we had to settle and make the night go by quickly... On top of that there was a lot of noise and commotion, fortunately it was only one night, let's forget it. I put photos so you can judge for yourselves. All the best.

name: Xavier Serra Cantallops
review_text:
Toda una experiencia...
Reserve por booking atraido por su precio. Supuse que no habria ningun lujo y que iba a un hotel low cost.
Al lir legando a Burgos por la carretera , llame por telefono para avisar de la hora de llegada. La respuesta fue que, cuando estuviera enfrente volviera a llamar.
Lo hice: Al llegar, llame. No veia el lletrero del hostal. El 165 esta entre un bar y un super. Cierto que hay una placa que pone HR y dos estrellas. (No se como se ha calificado, pero alli esta)
Como iba diciendo, llame, me responden diciendo que toque al interfono....se abre la puerta de abajo...y me da indicaciones por telefono, rollo "Caso Bourne". (Faltaba la musica de suspense). Entro,  subo escaleras, abro una puerta en el primer piso, que no se cierra porque tiene un celo para evitar cerrarse... Accedo ya dentro del hostal.... bajon...parecia un picadero. Cierto es que no oi ningun gemido en ningun momento, por tanto, tal vez, manias mias. ...

No muy limpio...paredes con humedades, oscuro...por telefono, se me dice que mi habitacion es la primera a la izquierda....abro ...la llave esta dentro.... Habitacion pequena (normal)
Da a un patio interior comunitario (no se puede acceder ..son las vistas)....huele a hierba y a sobaco....eso si....las sabanas limpias....todo un detalle.

Me indican tambien por telefono,, donde esta el lavabo comunitario....bueno....el vater com orina en los lados lo limpie yo con papel de vater. Lo de la ducha...y su cortina....para otro capitulo.

Puede que, por ese precio no se pueda pedir mas. Pero no lo tengo claro.

Cumpli mi funcion.... dormi una noche en Burgos a bajo precio....pero con mal cuerpo
review_translated_text:
Quite an experience...
I booked through booking attracted by its price. I assumed there would be no luxury and that I was going to a low-cost hotel.
Upon arriving in Burgos on the highway, I called by phone to inform them of my arrival time. The answer was that when he was in front he would call again.
I did it: When I arrived, I called. I didn't see the sign for the hostel. 165 is between a bar and a supermarket. It is true that there is a plate that says HR and two stars. (I don't know how it was rated, but there it is)
As I was saying, I called, they answered me by telling me to ring the intercom... the downstairs door opens... and they give me instructions over the phone, "Bourne Case" stuff. (The suspense music was missing). I enter, I climb stairs, I open a door on the first floor, which does not close because it is very jealous to avoid closing... I now enter the hostel... downturn... it seemed like a riding ring. It is true that I did not hear any moans at any time, therefore, perhaps, my quirks. ...

Not very clean...walls with damp, dark...on the phone, I am told that my room is the first one on the left...I open...the key is inside.... Small room (normal)
It overlooks a communal interior patio (it cannot be accessed...it's the views)....it smells like grass and armpits....that's right...the clean sheets...quite a detail.

They also tell me by phone, where the community toilet is....well....the toilet with urine on the sides, I cleaned it with toilet paper. About the shower...and its curtain...for another chapter.

Maybe, for that price you can't ask for more. But I'm not clear.

I fulfilled my function... I slept one night in Burgos at a low price... but with a bad body

No lo recomiendo para nada, es preferible quedarse en el coche y lavarte en las fuentes de la calle.
review_translated_text:

I give it enough attention, since there isn't even any at the hostel reception (I mean we spent more than 20 minutes calling and they didn't open the door for us). We arrived yesterday (for 2 nights EU71) and left within hours. A Hostel does not have shared bathrooms and is dirty, and what can we say about the room.
I do not recommend it at all, it is preferable to stay in the car and wash in the street fountains.

name: Dani. P.
review_text:
Pues en general el alojamiento fue muy malo. La television no funcionaba no conectaba con la antena (adjunto foto), la habitacion y el pasillo tenia olor a tabaco (se lo comente al dueno pero me dijo que estaba prohibido, pero debe ser que tienen poco control sobre el alojamiento), en la puerta habia mucha basura de las habitaciones (adjunto foto), las chica de la habitacion numero 5 no pararon de molestar desde que llegaron a las 21 y 22 de la noche y a las 6 de la manana. El bano estaba sucio (adjunto foto), en la cama habia restos de pelos de mujer (adjunto foto), la cama incomoda y mucho ruido.
Pues en general el alojamiento fue muy malo. No tengo nada que comentar positivo, es cierto que el chico que me atendio por telefono era amable, pero no supo resolver el problema del tabaco, me molestaba mucho el tabaco.
review_translated_text:
Well, in general the accommodation was very bad. The television did not work, it did not connect to the antenna (attached photo), the room and the hallway had a smell of tobacco (I mentioned this to the owner but he told me that it was prohibited, but it must be that they have little control over the accommodation), at the door there was a lot of garbage from the rooms (attached photo), the girls in room number 5 did not stop bothering me since they arrived at 9 and 10 pm and at 6 in the morning. The bathroom was dirty (photo attached), there were remains of women's hair on the bed (photo attached), the bed was uncomfortable and a lot of noise.
Well, in general the accommodation was very bad. I have nothing positive to comment, it is true that the boy who answered me on the phone was friendly, but he did not know how to solve the tobacco problem, tobacco bothered me a lot.

review_text: Coincido con otros usuarios en que esto de hostal no tiene nada, mas bien seria una pension (con todo el respeto hacia las pensiones). Mal olor en todo el lugar. name: Borja Maron Garcia
review_text:
Por donde puedo empezar para describir esta broma llamada hotel digna de camara oculta?

El hostal si es que se le puede llamar asi al entresuelo de un bloque de edificios os aseguro que vivio mejores epocas; si me portase podria decir que la decoracion es vintage pero si me dices que aqui la pena viene a fumar crack o me pueden quitar un rinon me lo creo

La decoracion te  catapulta a los 80, las habitaciones parece que no han sido ventiladas en los ultimos 20 anos, no nos dejaron toalla para la ducha pero mejor por que ese bano parecia de rodaje de pelicula de terror, una calidad digna de la union sovietica

Pero oye tiene tele (atada con un candado), tiene balcon con un mueble cerrado que prefiero no hacer preguntas

Lo unico que da luz a tanta oscuridad es el cuadro de puzzle de perro

Antes de alojaros aqui pensarlo dos veces

ACTUALIZACION: se han inventado que use las toallas que no nos dieron para lavar a los perros que no tenemos y por ende no llevamos; en la llamada realizada para pedir explicaciones dan largas

Aparte de carentes de limpieza, mentirosos!
review_translated_text:
Where can I begin to describe this joke called a hotel, worthy of a hidden camera?

The hostel, if you can call it that, the mezzanine of a block of flats has seen better days. If I were well-behaved, I could say the decor is vintage, but if you tell me people come here to smoke crack or they might take my kidney, I'd believe you.

The decor catapults you back to the 80s. The rooms look like they haven't been aired in the last 20 years. They didn't give us a towel for the shower, but that's even better because that bathroom looked like something out of a horror movie set, a quality worthy of the Soviet Union.

But hey, it has a TV (locked with a padlock), and it has a balcony with a locked cabinet that I'd rather not ask about.

The only thing that sheds light on so much darkness is the dog puzzle.

Before staying here, think twice.

UPDATE: They've come up with a scheme that lets me use the towels they didn't give us to wash the dogs we don't have and therefore don't bring. When I called to ask for an explanation, they gave me the runaround.

Aside from being unclean, they're liars!

name: Jema Sil
review_text:
Es accesible para PMR. Tiene una plataforma salva escaleras, y ascensor. No tiene habitacion adaptada. Esta en una calle principal un poco alejada del centro , dicen que es un hostal pero mas bien lo veo como una pension , el bano es compartido con 9 habitaciones mas o menos. La salida es antes de las 12 y a mi  antes de las 11 de la manana ya me estaban tocando la puerta para que saliera . Sali cuando pude.
Esta bien que dejen entrar a perros, perros que no molesten a los demas mientras dormimos. Pero los ladridos no me dejaban dormir.
review_translated_text:
It is accessible to PMR. It has a stair-saving platform and an elevator. It does not have an adapted room. It is on a main street a little far from the center, they say it is a hostel but I see it more like a pension, the bathroom is shared with more or less 9 rooms. Departure is before 12 and before 11 in the morning they were already knocking on my door to let me out. I went out when I could.
It's okay to let dogs in, dogs that don't bother others while we sleep. But the barking didn't let me sleep.

review_text: The rooms are really cold, the wifi doesn't work, if it's only to sleep at night it's nice but for young people it's not really great as neighbors complains even about talking noises.

review_translated_text: A little old, but does the job, it's good for sleeping. Afterwards, you have to visit the center.

name: GreyMountain
review_text: This is not a bad hostel, especially at the price. It is well located, being on a main road into the city centre and with good amenities nearby. However, our room was falling apart (loose fittings), there was no lock on the toilet door, and for some reason, the toilet was raised on a plinth (giving a new meaning to spending time on the throne). The room  must have last been decorated somewhere in the mid 70s. No wifi at all and there is no 24-hour reception, as advertised. However, despite its shortcomings, the receptionist was friendly and helpful and we would certainly consider staying there again.

name: Lucy_
review_text:
Esta situado en la avenida, unos 3 kilometros del centro conectado por un autobus de linea que te lleva y trae por 1,2 EU.  La zona no tiene problema de aparcamiento ya que las calles alrededor no tienen zona azul.
El hostal era antiguo, con muebles rotos, bano muy estropeado y azulejos con la silicona negra, cortinas feas y viejas. Aunque las sabanas estaban limpias y las toalla que te deja en el bano tambien, se vean muy usadas (o eso quise pensar).
Una cosa que me da mucho asco es que la banera tiene cortinas de plastico... y estaban amarillas por debajo.  No ponen toallas de bano ni gel de ducha ni nada por estilo. Solo estaba el bote de lavarse las manos.
Pasamos los dias con mucha calor, no tiene aire acondicionado, la ventana se abre con mucha dificultad. Nos toco ventana a la avenida por lo que dormimos con mucho ruido. Pero tambien es mala suerte que haga tanto calor, supongo que no es lo habitual.
review_translated_text:
It is located on the avenue, about 3 kilometers from the center connected by a regular bus that takes you and brings you back for EU1.2.  The area does not have a parking problem since the surrounding streets do not have a blue zone.
The hostel was old, with broken furniture, a very damaged bathroom and tiles with black silicone, ugly and old curtains. Although the sheets were clean and the towels left in the bathroom were also clean, they looked very used (or so I wanted to think).
One thing that really disgusts me is that the bathtub has plastic curtains... and they were yellow underneath.  They don't provide bath towels or shower gel or anything like that. There was only the hand washing bottle.
We spent the days very hot, there is no air conditioning, the window opens with great difficulty. We had a window facing the avenue so we slept with a lot of noise. But it's also bad luck that it's so hot, I guess it's not usual.

review_text: Muy buena administracion su gente ,, sus pisos ordenados ,, todo muy buen estado

review_text: Pongo buena valoracion porque la realidad es lo que se coge. Es un hostal para llegar y dormir coger y largarte pero cumple con su funcion. Tiene buena ubicacion las camas son comodas con sabanas de verdad (pena que haya coincidido con una ola de calor si no dormir tapado seria de 10) ha hecho bastante calor tambien pero hace calor hasta en los sobacos de un grillo. La atencion ha sido muy buena, tambien el precio ha sido bastante economico
review_translated_text: I give a good rating because reality is what you get. It is a hostel to arrive and sleep, take and leave but it fulfills its function. It has a good location, the beds are comfortable with real sheets (it's a shame that it coincided with a heat wave if not sleeping covered up it would be 10) it has been quite hot too but it is hot even in a cricket's armpits. The service has been very good, the price has also been quite affordable.

name: E. Hovsepyan
review_text:
I am mixed on how I should write this review. In theory, it did everything I asked it to, no problems. Check-in is quick, staff are great, with a smile. Parking is free, plenty of spaces. Location is great, seems to be in the city centre and the price, well, put it this way, it's cheaper than 5 of us having Macdonald's. So, on paper, it's great. However, it's a bit like eating cold chips or touching a cold radiator.
The decor is dated and is in dire need of replacement. Mostly, it's clean. Light bulbs missing (perhaps to save on electricity?). The TV just didn't want to work. Remote control was very filthy.
The room I stayed in, didn't have it's own toilet, had to use shared facilities. Which in fairness, were clean, somewhat tiny. Bedding seemed clean, although I didn't dare to look further than I needed to. I did have a hand basin in the room however.
And finally for some reason the authorities in Burgos insisted on emptying the huge rubbish bins outside the window pre 5am. I am talking those huge recycle containers full of glass bottles!!
Having said all this, when I am driving through Spain next, I will most penalty stay here again. Cheap and within a couple of mins from the main North-South motorway, so not detouring much.

review_text: Muy mala experiencia, reserve a traves de Booking porque veniamos de emergencia para un funeral de Barcelona y nos quedamos en la puerta del la entrada ,pasando el portal y nadie abria, llamamos por telefono y nos dicen que no tiene habitaciones. Me parece que tendrian que tener actualizado el sistema con Booking.

Por donde empezar, una vez que llegamos nos llevamos una desagradable sorpresa al ver lo sucio que estaba todo, la colcha estaba negra, el aseo muy muy viejo, con la silicona de la pared negra!!!, la habitacion llena de humedad y mejor no hablar del olor a tabaco que habia en los pasillos, SI NO SE PUEDE FUMAR EN UN ESPACIO QUE COMPARTIMOS TODOS QUE EL DUENO TOME MEDIDAS, !NO QUE PASE OLIMPICAMENTE!

review_translated_text:
Where to start, once we arrived we were unpleasantly surprised when we saw how dirty everything was, the bedspread was black, the toilet was very very old, with the silicone on the black wall!!!, the room was full of humidity and it was better not to mention the smell of tobacco that was in the corridors, IF YOU CAN'T SMOKING IN A SPACE THAT WE ALL SHARE, LET THE OWNER TAKE MEASURES, NOT FOR IT TO HAPPEN OUT!
Definitely, I don't know how it can have the two-star category, since it is NOT worth it at all.

name: Laura Mendez
review_text:
Estabamos de paso, asi que solo nos quedamos una noche.
Pros: La ubicacion es fantastica, en una avenida principal y a solo 30 minutos caminando del centro (simplemente bajando la avenida). La mujer que nos atendio para el check-in nos explico muy amablemente como podiamos acercarnos al centro, que podiamos ver, donde podiamos cenar, etc. y nos facilito un plano. En la habitacion, las camas eran comodas.
Contras: El techo, tanto en la habitacion como en el bano, estaba lleno de humedad. La banera y los azulejos del bano tenian la silicona podrida. Los muebles eran muy viejos; de hecho, la silla estaba a punto de romper. Incluso las colchas se veian ya muy sobadas (algo que puede cambiarse facilmente).
En definitiva, no es una habitacion ideal, pero si la intencion es simplemente tener un sitio para dormir, es una buena opcion, barata para la ubicacion en la que se encuentra.
review_translated_text:
We were passing through, so we only stayed one night.
Pros: The location is fantastic, on a main avenue and just a 30-minute walk from the center (just walk down the avenue). The woman who helped us check in very kindly explained how to get to the center, what to see, where to have dinner, etc., and provided us with a map. In the room, the beds were comfortable.
Cons: The ceiling, both in the room and the bathroom, was full of moisture. The bathtub and bathroom tiles had rotten silicone. The furniture was very old; in fact, the chair was about to break. Even the bedspreads looked very worn (something that can be easily replaced).
In short, it's not an ideal room, but if your goal is simply to have a place to sleep, it's a good, inexpensive option for its location.

Cuando pagas por una habitacion lo minimo que esperas es que este limpia y tuve que dormir con mi chaqueta puesta por no usar las mantas que olian a pies. name: Jacinto Baguena
review_text: Atendido por gente muy amable,  que me aconsejaron estupendamente y nos acogieron maravillosamente a mi perrica Noa y a mi y donde estubimos alojados varios dias muy comodamente como si de nuestra casa fuera!! Muy Agradecidos para repetir y aconsejar!!
review_translated_text: Served by very friendly people, who advised me wonderfully and welcomed my dog   Noa and me wonderfully and where we stayed for several days very comfortably as if it were our home!! Very grateful to repeat and advise!!

name: Andrea Juliana Uribe Mancipe
review_text: La relacion calidad precio esta muy bien, muy amable el recepcionista con buena informacion para turismo.
review_translated_text: The price-quality ratio is very good, the receptionist is very friendly with good information for tourism.

name: Giorgio TROTTER
review_text: Semplice e curato
review_translated_text: Simple and neat

name: Vera Gonzalez
review_text: Queriamos hacer noche en Burgos, mi chico, mi perro y yo. Tuvimos la suerte de encontrar este hostal donde los perretes son bienvenidos sin coste adicional, lo unico que no pueden estar solos en la habitacion. Llegamos super tarde, pero el chico MUY MUY amablemente nos abrio la habitacion. Un cuarto pequenico con terraza, todo muy limpio y con un lavabo. Cogimos la opcion de bano compartido, cada 3 cuartos hay un vater, un lavabo y una banera/ducha. La verdad que dormimos los 3 super bien. Al dia siguiente al irnos fue todo muy facil y agil. Gracias!
review_translated_text: We wanted to spend the night in Burgos, my boy, my dog   and I. We were lucky to find this hostel where dogs are welcome at no additional cost, the only thing is that they cannot be alone in the room. We arrived super late, but the guy VERY VERY kindly opened the room for us. A small room with a terrace, all very clean and with a sink. We took the shared bathroom option, every 3 rooms there is a toilet, a sink and a bathtub/shower. The truth is that the 3 of us slept very well. The next day when we left, everything was very easy and agile. Thank you!

name: Gerard Torrent
review_text: Economico y buena atencion.
review_translated_text: Economical and good service.

name: Jose Manuel
review_text: Bien para pasar una noche con la familia

review_text: Lo unico bueno la cama. Muy justo para dormir y poco mas
review_translated_text: The only good thing was the bed. Very good for sleeping and little else

name: Luis Chico esquina
review_text: La habitacion limpia ,buen sitio,,trato correcto y buen precio....el unico pero ,el bano compartido.
review_translated_text: The clean room, good location, correct treatment and good price....the only but, the shared bathroom.

name: Carmen Lema
review_text: Sencillo, limpio, personal amable y buena relacion calidad precio. Es recomendable
review_translated_text: Simple, clean, with friendly staff and good value. Highly recommended.

name: Alina Maria Oiegas

name: danamanson
review_text: Nos hospedamos en este hostal con motivo de una visita a unos amigos. Se encuentra a 20 min andando de la catedral y a 15 del Museo de Evolucion Humana. Ideal para familias por su precio. Ademas admiten mascotas y cuenta con alojamiento de bicicletas, pues esta situado en pleno paso del Camino de Santiago.
review_translated_text: We stayed at this hostel while visiting friends. It's a 20-minute walk from the cathedral and a 15-minute walk from the Museum of Human Evolution. It's ideal for families due to its affordable price. It's also pet-friendly and offers bicycle storage, as it's located right on the Camino de Santiago.

name: Joserry Garcia
review_text: Si vuelvo a la ciudad no dudare en visitarles nuevamente, pero hay cosas que mejorar.. Animo!!!!!
review_translated_text: If I return to the city I will not hesitate to visit them again, but there are things to improve... Cheer up!!!!!

name: Tayyab Ahmed

review_translated_text: Very good place but a little expensive, they should lower the prices a little

review_text: Que buena atencion y economico 22 e

review_text: Un Hostal que deberia ser pension, limpieza escasa, y habitacion justita para dos personas.||No hay parking y por la zona es bastante dificil aparcar.||Lo bueno es parada bus en la puerta,para ir al centro, y muchas cafeterias y restaurantes donde desayunar y comer al rededor de dicho hostal
review_translated_text: A hostel that should be a guesthouse. Poor cleanliness and a small room for two people. There's no parking, and parking is quite difficult in the area. The good thing is that there's a bus stop right outside to get downtown, and there are plenty of cafes and restaurants around the hostel where you can have breakfast and lunch.

name: Jesus Abraira
review_text: Es un lugar con una buena ubicacion,personal amable y las habitaciones limpias. Para mi ha sido una buena estancia
review_translated_text: It is a place with a good location, friendly staff and clean rooms. For me it has been a good stay

review_text: Genial cal8dad precio
review_translated_text: Great quality price

name: Miriam F. Garcia (Miri)
review_text: Habitacion amplia y con camas grandes,  de 105 cm, muy comodas,  bano privado y tv, calidad precio muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Spacious room with large beds, 105 cm, very comfortable, private bathroom and TV, quality-price highly recommended.

name: Dad
review_text: Hotels sans pretention. Toilette commun sur le palier. Quartier sans interet. Ideal pour les personnes en transit.
review_translated_text: Unpretentious hotels. Common toilet on the landing. Uninteresting neighborhood. Ideal for people in transit.

name: Tamara Aragon
review_text: Dormi en una habitacion de las que compartes el bano. La habitacion muy limpia, el mobiliario es antiguo pero esta todo en buenas condiciones. La cama comoda y la atencion de la recepcion muy bien. El unico pero las toallas, que eran un poco asperas, imposible usarlas, pero bueno llevabamos las nuestras asi que no tuvimos problema. El bano compartido muy limpio. Buen sitio si estas de paso o buscas un alojamiento barato. Y lo mas importante, aceptan perros sin coste adicional.
review_translated_text: I slept in a room where you share the bathroom. The room is very clean, the furniture is old but everything is in good condition. The bed was comfortable and the reception was very good. The only thing but the towels, which were a little rough, impossible to use, but well we brought our own so we didn't have a problem. The shared bathroom very clean. Good place if you are passing through or looking for cheap accommodation. And most importantly, they accept dogs at no additional cost.

name: Delta346
review_text: Lo unico destacable es la simpatia de la persona que nos atendio a la llegada. El portal olia rancio, la habitacion que nos toco, tenia las sabanas rotas y otras manchadas de algo rojo anaranjado. La tele atada con cadenas y el bano muy viejo y mal mantenido. La mesa de la tele y una mesilla con migas de pan. Las ventanas muy viejas y apenas se podian cerrar bien. El cordon de la persiana con mucha suciedad. En fin la experiencia .
review_translated_text: The only thing worth mentioning was the friendliness of the person who greeted us upon arrival. The entrance smelled musty, the room we were assigned had torn sheets and some were stained with something reddish-orange. The TV was chained, and the bathroom was very old and poorly maintained. The TV stand and a nightstand were covered in breadcrumbs. The windows were very old and barely closed properly. The blind cord was very dirty. In short, the experience .

name: elizabethmK6589RP
review_text: El hostal es sencillo pero esta muy bien. La limpieza es extraordinaria y el personal tambien. Hay un autobus en la puerta que te lleva al centro, asi que es muy comodo.||El chico de recepcion nos dio un plano y nos explico todo muy bien.
review_translated_text: The hostel is simple but very nice. The cleanliness is extraordinary, as is the staff. There's a bus right outside that takes you downtown, so it's very convenient. The guy at reception gave us a map and explained everything very well.

name: Alain A
review_text: Hotel bon marche (26 EU), a 3 km du centre de Burgos. L'accueil est tres correct, les chambres aussi. Les toilettes sont communes. Convient tout a fait pour une nuit.
review_translated_text: Inexpensive hotel (EU26), 3 km from the center of Burgos. The welcome is very good, as are the rooms. Toilets are shared. Perfectly suitable for one night.

name: Maria De lemos
review_text: Trop impersonnel. Draps pas repasses et troues, serviettes reches. Nous avons bien dormi quand meme.
review_translated_text: Too impersonal. Sheets were unironed and had holes in them, and towels were rough. We slept well, though.

name: Helena Bastos
review_text: Excelente optimo preco
review_translated_text: Excellent great price

name: Jose Alberto Pena Gonzalez
review_text: En el bano huele a pis. La limpieza en general deja mucho que desear. Las mantas del armario huelen a pies.
review_translated_text: The bathroom smells like urine. The overall cleanliness leaves much to be desired. The blankets in the closet smell like feet.

name: Alejandro Salamanca
review_text: No puedes pedir mas por el precio que tiene, tiene lo justo y necesario para pasar una noche, no hay jabon ni champu para la ducha.
review_translated_text: You can't ask for more for the price, it has just what you need to spend a night, there is no soap or shampoo for the shower.

name: Fran Corseta
review_text: Hotel genial servicio impecable
review_translated_text: Great hotel, impeccable service

name: El Canal Del Canal
review_text: Genial , muy centrico y buen servicio de habitaciones
review_translated_text: Great, very central and good room service

name: Jose Millan Leon
review_text: Espantoso. El segundo peor alojamiento que he conocido. Sucio. La habitacion un cuchitril indigno donde no solo no habia armario sino ni siquiera una silla donde sentarse. Una sola mesita de noche en una habitacion <<doble>>. Y caro para lo que ofrece.
review_translated_text: Frightening. The second worst accommodation I have ever known. Dirty. The room was an undignified hovel where not only was there no closet but not even a chair to sit on. A single nightstand in a "double" room. And expensive for what it offers.

name: Losilda
review_text: Opcion increiblemente barata (y mas considerando que fuimos en Semana Santa).  La verdad que estuvimos de ruta por otras ciudades y ya fue la ultima noche la que pasamos en este alojamiento (dado que Burgos es una ciudad que ya habiamos visitado previamente y simplemente nos caia "de paso" para ir acercandonos hacia casa y hacer mas corto el camino de vuelta).||||Por el precio de la habitacion daba casi hasta miedo pensar lo que podias encontrarte; y cierto es que una vez entras al portal te viene un poco de olor a rancio y que la persona en recepcion te recibe con pintas literalmente "de andar por casa", pero sinceramente para mi es algo irrelevante dado que en el portal pasas 10 segundos para subir a la habitacion y el trato en recepcion fue impecable, te dan un mapa cosa que no ocurre siempre (y menos si no preguntas y menos en un hostal), te dan informacion de sitios que visitar etc y tienes total libertad de entrar y salir a cualquier hora sin necesidad de que haya nadie.||||La zona en la que se encuentra no es centrica, pero tienes un autobus que te lleva a ella en la misma puerta hasta la 1 de la manana (y se puede ir andando si se quiere en un paseo de una media hora), de igual modo tienes bares en la misma calle, entidades bancarias etc, por lo que aunque no es una zona centrica si que es una zona bien comunicada.||||Cama comoda, de tamano correcto, respecto al bano compartido, al menos en nuestro caso, lo unico que compartiamos (entre 3 habitaciones) era un cuarto con un retrete, ya que dentro de la propia habitacion si que habia un cuarto de bano que disponia de banera/ducha y de un lavabo, por lo que para ducharte que quiza si que sea lo que requiera de mayor intimidad y tiempo no habia problema.  Y en tal caso de las 3 habitaciones que compartiamos dicho cuarto, dos ibamos juntos por lo que es menor inconveniente aun en el caso de que vayais varios amigos dado que seran con ellos con los que compartais dicho espacio.||||Probablemente no seria una opcion que elegiria siempre, pero si que lo recomendaria sobre todo por su precio, que es imbatible; y ademas dado su precio, sorprende para bien.
review_translated_text: Incredibly cheap option (especially considering we went during Easter). The truth is that we were on a tour of other cities and it was our last night in this accommodation (given that Burgos is a city we had already visited previously and it was simply "passing by" to get closer to home and make the return trip shorter).||||For the price of the room, it was almost scary to think what you could find; and it is true that once you enter the building you get a bit of a musty smell and the person at reception greets you with a look literally "of walking around the house", but honestly for me it is something irrelevant given that in the building you spend 10 seconds to go up to the room and the treatment at reception was impeccable, they give you a map which does not always happen (and less if you do not ask and less in a hostel), they give you information on places to visit etc and you have total freedom to come and go at any time without needing anyone to be there. ||||The area in which it is located is not central, but you have a bus that takes you there at the same door until 1 in the morning (and you can walk if you want in a half hour walk), in the same way you have bars on the same street, banks etc, so although it is not a central area it is a well connected area. ||||Comfortable bed, of correct size, regarding the shared bathroom, at least in our case, the only thing we shared (between 3 rooms) was a room with a toilet, since inside the room itself there was a bathroom with a bathtub/shower and a sink, so showering, which may require more privacy and time, was no problem. And in that case, of the 3 rooms that we shared said room, two of us were together, so it's even less of an inconvenience if you're going with several friends, since you'll be sharing said space with them. ||||It probably wouldn't be an option I would always choose, but I would recommend it, especially because of its price, which is unbeatable; and given its price, it's surprisingly pleasant.

name: sherlockh108
review_text: Muy barato, por el precio no exijo ni que las habitaciones sean grandes, ni que este cerca del centro incluso ni siquiera que la cama sea comoda. Lo unico que quiero es limpieza, y aqui brillaba por su ausencia. La habitacion olia a tabaco, el cabecero de la cama y la mesilla tenian mucho polvo. Una toalla estaba llena de pelos, las mantas y las sabanas igual. Se veian limpias pero con pelos, no se si de personas o de animales, porque puedes alojarte con tu perro en este hostal. Tuve que pedirle que me cambiaran las sabanas, las nuevas no tenian pelos pero venian todas roidas. No le vendria mal un cambio de ropa de cama y de toallas. Como punto positivo el dueno fue muy amable.
review_translated_text: Very cheap. For the price, I don't expect large rooms, proximity to the city center, or even comfortable beds. All I want is cleanliness, and it was conspicuously absent here. The room smelled of tobacco, the headboard and nightstand were very dusty. One towel was covered in hair, as were the blankets and sheets. They looked clean but had hair on them, I don't know if it was from people or animals, because you can stay with your dog in this hostel. I had to ask them to change the sheets; the new ones were hairless but all worn. A change of bed linen and towels would be nice. On the positive side, the owner was very friendly.

name: hakuna_matata_27_0
review_text: Segun entras al portal huele fatal, sigues subiendo y el olor empeora en los pasillos y ya dentro de la habitacion es insoportable (hace falta un ambientador enserio) no hay quien lo aguante. Se oye cualquier ruido gente que hace sus necesidades, ruidos del pasillo, a los de al lado TODO hay que ir con tapones !|El bano compartido asqueroso no te puedes duchar de lo sucio que esta. |Es preferible pagar 20 EU mas y dormir en un sitio mas decente,al final no descansas aqui. Muy Mal! No repetiremos  jamas.|
review_translated_text: As you enter the building, it smells terrible. You continue up and the smell gets worse in the hallways, and once inside the room, it's unbearable (an air freshener is really needed). You can't stand it. You can hear every noise: people doing their business, noises from the hallway, noises from those next door, EVERYTHING. You have to use earplugs! The shared bathroom is disgusting; you can't even shower because it's so dirty. It's better to pay EU20 more and sleep somewhere more decent; in the end, you won't get any rest here. Very bad! We will never come back.

name: Carlos Diaz
review_text:
Esta bien si eres un grupo de gente joven. Si sois una familia con ninos o buscais comodidad y descanso, buscad otro sitio.
Por lo demas, esta bien comunicado con el centro con la linea de autobuses 01 que pasa cada 7 minutos. No sirven desayunos aunque hay una cafeteria justo debajo. El personal muy amable. Hacen las habitaciones, aunque no nos avisaron de ello.
En cuanto al parking, el propio hostal no dispone de el pero en la calle de atras hay de sobra y si lo consigues, en la propia avenida.
review_translated_text:
It's okay if you are a group of young people. If you are a family with children or are looking for comfort and rest, look for another place.
Otherwise, it is well connected to the center with the 01 bus line that runs every 7 minutes. They do not serve breakfast although there is a cafeteria just below. Very friendly staff. They make the rooms, although they did not warn us about it.
As for parking, the hostel itself does not have it but there is plenty on the street behind and if you can get it, on the avenue itself.

name: Fertxu Gar Bar
review_text: Txatarraza, yo no vuelvo
review_translated_text: Txatarraza, I'm not coming back

review_text: ' un poco sucio

review_text: Pas mal comme hotel.
review_translated_text: Not a bad hotel.

review_text: Muy bien
review_translated_text: Very good

name: anita122006
review_text: Mas llegar al hostal el hombre nos recibio en pijama y zapatillas de andar por casa pero aun asi fue muy amable, nos dio un mapa de la ciudad  y nos explico las cosas para visitar y los sitios mejores para comer, este fue el unico momento que vimos al dueno no le volvimos a ver mas en todo el tiempo que estuvimos alojados por mas que le buscamos el hombre no esta casi nunca en recepcion, el hostal se encontraba limpio y tranquilo, este hostal te dice que tiene wifi pero la wifi va a ratos no siempre se conecta de tres dias que estuve solo fue un dia, lo que menos me gusto es que se puede fumar en la habitacion y todo olia a tabaco sobre todo las colchas y las cortinas daban un olor fuerte.
review_translated_text: But upon arriving at the hostel the man greeted us in pajamas and slippers but he was still very friendly, he gave us a map of the city and explained the things to visit and the best places to eat, this was the only time we saw the owner, we did not see him again the entire time we were staying, no matter how much we looked for him, the man was almost never at reception, the hostel was clean and quiet, this hostel tells you that it has wifi but the wifi is intermittent, it does not always connect out of three days that I stayed it was only one day, what I liked least is that you can smoke in the room and everything smelled of tobacco especially the bedspreads and the curtains gave off a strong smell.

name: Juan Gutierrez Garcia
review_text: Es un sitio que merece la pena visitar. Es precioso lo dice un Albaceteno
review_translated_text: It's a place worth visiting. It's beautiful, says an Albacete native.

name: Fco Reivaj
review_text: Barato y muy bien para su precio
review_translated_text: Cheap and very good for its price

name: Marri
review_text:
MUY POCA SERIEDAD. Muy mala experiencia con el Hostal Hilton y la persona (hombre) que lo lleva. Tras llamar hace un par de semanas para reservar 3 habitaciones dobles para 6 personas que habia visto por booking, el hombre me dice que haga la reserva telefonica directamente con ellos. Acepto, me confirma las habitaciones y me dice que esta todo correcto. A mi sorpresa, llamo hoy ( a dos dias del dia de la reserva) para confirmar hora de llegada y me dice que no hay ninguna reserva con mi nombre, que ha debido de ser un error y que estan completos. No me ofrece ninguna solucion y me entero llamando a otras pensiones que este fin de semana hay un congreso en Burgos. Que casualidad que nuestra reserva haya desaparecido....... Muy poca seriedad,
NO ACONSEJO RESERVAR NADA TELEFONICAMENTE CON ESTE HOSTAL.
review_translated_text:
VERY LITTLE SERIOUSNESS. Very bad experience with the Hilton Hostel and the person (man) who runs it. After calling a couple of weeks ago to reserve 3 double rooms for 6 people that I had seen through booking, the man told me to make the telephone reservation directly with them. I accept, he confirms the rooms and tells me that everything is correct. To my surprise, I called today (two days from the day of the reservation) to confirm arrival time and they told me that there is no reservation with my name, that it must have been a mistake and that they are full. He doesn't offer me any solution and I find out by calling other pensions that there is a conference in Burgos this weekend. What a coincidence that our reservation has disappeared....... Very little seriousness,
I DO NOT ADVISE BOOKING ANYTHING BY TELEPHONE WITH THIS HOSTEL.

name: BeatrizD982
review_text: Este hostal nos sorprendio para bien. El precio fue inmejorable.||Esta alejado del centro, pero esta muy bien conectado con el autobus, ya que tiene una parada casi en la puerta y los autobuses pasan cada 7 minutos. Estuvo bien, ya que dejamos el coche aparcado por alli cerca del hostal (sin tener que pagar) y nos movimos en autobus.||El personal del hostal fue muy amable con nosotros en todo momento.||La habitacion era antigua, pero muy limpia. Sabanas totalmente limpias y colchones comodos. Bano tambien limpio.||Como pega pondre que se oia a la gente ducharse y caminar.
review_translated_text: This hostel pleasantly surprised us. The price was unbeatable. It's far from the center, but it's very well connected to the bus station, with a stop right outside the door and buses running every 7 minutes. This was good, as we left our car parked near the hostel (without having to pay) and got around by bus. The hostel staff was very friendly to us at all times. The room was old but very clean. The sheets were perfectly clean and the mattresses comfortable. The bathroom was also clean. One drawback is that we could hear people showering and walking.

name: Dav Lav
review_text: Mala gente
review_translated_text: Bad people

name: francor513
review_text: Attrape nigauds. ||Ajouter 2 petits lits pour transformer une chambre classique en chambre quadruple, et en profiter pour doubler le tarif, j'appelle ca de l'escroquerie.||Salle de bain indigne d'un hotel.||Absence de climatisation, pas meme un petit ventilo. Pour des temperatures estivales, un peu limite.||Absence du receptionniste a notre arrivee (19h), heureusement que l'un de nos forfaits etait en international (donc tarifs hors forfait) pour joindre un interlocuteur avec lequel il fallait parler espagnol. (Heureusement, j'ai QQ notions).||Revisez votre espagnol et votre anglais; le francais est soi-disant pratique (mais pas par tous!)
review_translated_text: Fool trap. ||Adding 2 small beds to transform a classic room into a quadruple room, and taking advantage of it to double the price, I call that a scam.||Bathroom unworthy of a hotel.||No air conditioning, not even a small fan. For summer temperatures, a bit limited.||No receptionist upon our arrival (7 p.m.), luckily one of our packages was international (so rates outside the package) to reach someone with whom we had to speak Spanish. (Luckily, I have some knowledge).||Revise your Spanish and your English; French is supposedly spoken (but not by everyone!)

name: mbarambiop
review_text: Un hostal en una de las calles principales de Burgos pero esta un poco alejado del centro. Precio calidad esta bien ya que es una opcion muy economica. El personal muy amable con ganas de ayudar y asesorar sobre la ciudad en todo momento.
review_translated_text: A hostel on one of Burgos' main streets, but a bit far from the center. The price/quality ratio is good, as it's a very affordable option. The staff is very friendly and eager to help and provide advice about the city at all times.

name: Tania
review_text: Llegada al casco antiguo rapida con el bus cogiendo la linea 1 hay autobuses cada 7 min que suben y bajan de forma ininterrumpida hasta las 23:45h a partir de esa hora cada media hora hay bus para bajar. La recepcion del hotel explica todo con detalle y resolviendo todas las dudas.
review_translated_text: Arrive at the old town quickly with the bus taking line 1, there are buses every 7 minutes that go up and down uninterruptedly until 11:45 p.m. from that time onwards, there is a bus going down every half hour. The hotel reception explains everything in detail and resolves all questions.

Hotel pequeno y sencillo ,rustico., con jatdin.Lugar tranquilo , bien ubicado para conocer la comarca.
Desayuno correcto y variado.
Encargada, Yolanda, muy servicial.Nos preparo recorridos para conocer los alrededores  y estuvo siempre a nuestra disposicion para lo que necesitaramos.

Small, simple, rustic hotel with a private balcony. Quiet location, well located for exploring the region.
Breakfast is decent and varied.
The manager, Yolanda, is very helpful. She arranged tours for us to explore the surrounding area and was always available for anything we needed.

name: Nieves Marcos Paniagua
review_text:
Hemos estado en el puente del 1 de mayo,durmiendo alli tres dias.
Nos dieron la hb que esta justo enfrente de la puerta de entrada y la verdad que esperabamos otra cosa: en el WC teniamos que tener todo dentro de neceser porque no hay ninguna estanteria,no tiene ninguna ventana de ventilacion el WC  y al encender la luz se ponia un extractor en marcha que tardaba unos 10 m en callarse una vez apagada la luz.
No hay TV en la habitacion ,pero lo peor de todo es que esos dias hacia bastante frio y teniamos que llamar todos los dias a Yoli para que encendiera la calefacion...llegabamos casi todos los dias sobre las 20:30 o 21:00 de la noche y estaba fria la habitacion...al llamarla se ponia en marcha y a las 22:00 se apagaba de nuevo,no se si era porque solo estabamos hospedados nosotros, pero se supone que uno paga para sentirse comodo.
El ruido de la caldera era molesto, pues esta en la pared colindante en esta hb, aunque hubieramos preferido escucharlo que pasar frio.
Lo que no puedo criticar es la simpatia de Yoli, pero prefiero menos simpatia y mas comodidad.
response_from_owner_text: Siento mucho la molestia. Intentaremos mejorar nieves
review_translated_text:
We stayed there for the May 1st long weekend, sleeping there for three days.
They gave us the room right across from the entrance door, and honestly, we expected something else: in the bathroom, we had to keep everything inside our toiletries because there were no shelves, the bathroom had no ventilation windows, and when we turned on the light, an extractor fan would turn on, which took about 10 minutes to turn off once the light was turned off.
There's no TV in the room, but the worst part was that it was quite cold those days, and we had to call Yoli every day to turn on the heating... We arrived almost every day around 8:30 or 9:00 PM, and the room was cold... When we called her, it would turn on, and at 10:00 PM, it would turn off again. I don't know if it was because we were the only ones staying, but you're supposed to pay to be comfortable.
The noise of the boiler was annoying, as it's on the adjacent wall in this room, although we would have preferred to hear it than be cold.
What I can't criticize is Yoli's friendliness, but I prefer less friendliness and more comfort.
response_from_owner_translated_text: I'm very sorry for the inconvenience. We will try to improve snow

name: Julie Malherbe
review_text:
Nous sommes arrives la par malchance apres une panne de voiture sur l'autoroute espagnole. Accueillis a 5 en pleine nuit, nous sommes restes presque 2 jours. Le service est parfait, le resto et la biere/tapas tres bons ! ( bien qu'un peu sale pour un palais francais mais il suffit de demander et ca s'arrange!). Menu a 13 euros pour 2 plats et un dessert, ce n'est vraiment pas assez cher ! Il n'y aura rien a faire autour, seulement parfaire son talent aux flechettes. Les chambres sont simples mais propres.

Je tiens a vous remercier encore pour votre gentillesse, votre accueil et votre aide lors de notre sejour. Vous avez adouci notre difficile periple !

En revanche, si comme nous votre voiture est au garage d'a cote, prenez garde!!
review_translated_text:
We arrived there by bad luck after a car breakdown on the Spanish highway. Welcomed at 5 in the middle of the night, we stayed almost 2 days. The service is perfect, the restaurant and the beer/tapas very good! (although a little salty for a French palate but you just have to ask and it will work out!). Menu at 13 euros for 2 dishes and a dessert, it's really not expensive enough! There will be nothing to do around, only perfect your darts skills. The rooms are simple but clean.

I would like to thank you again for your kindness, your welcome and your help during our stay. You made our difficult journey easier!

On the other hand, if like us your car is in the garage next door, be careful!!

review_text:
Un buen lugar para pasar la noche y comer algo durante un viaje que lleve mas de un dia. Llegue por la noche despues de hacer 1000km de carretera. Pedi un plato combinado para cenar (no incluido en el precio de la habitacion) que estaba bueno.
Tienen bar por si se quiere tomar algun trago.
La habitacion era lo que se le pedia, que fuese tranquila y limpia para poder descansar despues de un largo viaje y poder afrontar otros 700km al dia siguiente. Pequena y sencilla, con TV, WiFi, y un bano limpio, muy bien.
El unico punto negativo fue el desayuno. El cafe estaba ok, pero la tostada con mermelada era muy poco para el precio. Fuera este detalle, el resto muy bien.
Aceptaron mi tarjeta de debito.
review_translated_text:
A good place to spend the night and eat something during a trip that takes more than one day. I arrived at night after traveling 1000km on the road. I ordered a combination plate for dinner (not included in the room price) which was good.
They have a bar if you want to have a drink.
The room was what was requested, that it be quiet and clean so that we could rest after a long trip and be able to face another 700km the next day. Small and simple, with TV, WiFi, and a clean bathroom, very good.
The only negative point was the breakfast. The coffee was ok, but the toast with jam was too little for the price. Aside from this detail, the rest is very good.
They accepted my debit card.

name: Edith Hernandez Real
review_text:
No lo recomiendo para nada el sitio, en festivo el menu 12EU tienen 5 platos a escoger de primero y 5 segundo, de postre 3 opciones nos dieron. De primer plato pedi una ensalada que la lechuga tenia toda la parte del tronco anaranjada y en algunos trozos los bordes tambien,  de atun una pinchada de tenedor literalmente, no salia esa caballa de las fotos... Debio de ser en tiempos mejores, ya que el local muy anticuado y poco limpio, las vinagreras sucias y el aceite de girasol. De segundo un filete con patatas.. Mega fino, como diria mi abuela.. Se ve Madrid... Del postre sota caballo y rey.. Helado de palo, macedonia que ni la pedimos y flan.. El flan lo termino comiendo mi pareja... La gaseosa venia abierta de cocina, asi que probablemente la rellenen. Lo increible es que por pedir dos huevos fritos con patatas para una nina pequena nos cobraron 7EU de verguenza autentica y para colmo pide la nina ketchup y nos traen un  ketchup que estaba como el agua, lo prueba la camarera y dice que esta picante.. Y nos trae otro de otra marca y caducado desde Enero ( casi casi.. 10meses)
Ni una disculpa.. Y el trato por el personal que nos atendio en el comedor desde el comienzo hasta final con malas caras. Parecen que estan amargados.
Espero que sirva esta opinion, les aseguro que el sitio, la comida y el personal es tal y como lo describo y somos una pareja que comemos de todo. Si eres una persona muy escogida.. No te molestes ni en parar.
review_translated_text:
I do not recommend the place at all, on holidays the EU12 menu has 5 dishes to choose from as a starter and 5 main dishes, for dessert they gave us 3 options. For the first course I ordered a salad whose lettuce had the entire part of the trunk orange and in some pieces the edges as well, of tuna literally pricked with a fork, that mackerel in the photos did not come out... It must have been in better times, since the place was very old-fashioned and not very clean, the cruets were dirty and the sunflower oil. For the main course, a steak with potatoes.. Mega fine, as my grandmother would say.. You can see Madrid... For dessert, horse and king... The incredible thing is that for ordering two fried eggs with potatoes for a little girl, they charged us EU7, out of sheer shame, and to make matters worse, the girl asked for ketchup and they brought us a ketchup that was like water, the waitress tried it and said it was spicy... And she brought us another one from another brand that had expired since January (almost almost... 10 months).
Not even an apology... And the treatment by the staff who served us in the dining room from the beginning to the end with bad faces. They seem like they are bitter.
I hope this opinion helps, I assure you that the place, the food and the staff are just as I describe and we are a couple who eats everything. If you are a very chosen person... Don't even bother stopping.

Buen servicio, sitio tranquilo

review_text: Lovely cute place, with amazing people. Great value for money.

name: Miriam Fernandes
review_text: Pessoas afaveis, mas o local precisa de limpeza, pela qualidade dos quartos penso que o preco seja acima do que realmente vale.
review_translated_text: Friendly people, but the place needs cleaning, considering the quality of the rooms I think the price is higher than it is really worth.

name: Davorin Jurgec
review_text:
Zelo prijazni gostitelji, dobra domaca hrana,   dobro vino in super cena.
Urejena soba, cisto.
Zelo priporocam.
review_translated_text:
Very friendly hosts, good homemade food, good wine and a great price.
Tidy room, clean.
I highly recommend it.

name: Martha Mejia
review_text:
El personal es muy amable y las habitaciones aunque son un poco viejas tienen mantenimiento y estan bien cuidadas,lo que no me gusto es que no tiene paneles acusticos por lo que se escucha el ruido en la noche y puede que no tengas buen descanso .
El parque acuatico es grande pero el agua esta muy fria al interior aunque el jardin estaba limpio y cuidado .
Si eres una persona que te gusta la aventura este lugar puede agradarte,para un buen descanso escogeria algo mas.
review_translated_text:
The staff is very friendly and the rooms, although they are a little old, are well maintained and maintained. What I didn't like is that it doesn't have acoustic panels so you can hear the noise at night and you may not have a good rest.
The water park is large but the water is very cold inside although the garden was clean and well-kept.
If you are a person who likes adventure, you may like this place, for a good rest I would choose something else.

name: Maria Jose Fernandez Romera

name: jokin lopez
review_text: Un camping k deja mucho k desear,los banos sin papel,ni tapas,ni agua caliente,si kieres ducha caliente pagas para nada,pk el agua sale igual d fria,no tiene lavanderia ni super,las piscinas algo pasable,pero el agua esta medio amarilla,sin animacion para los crios,los jardines dejados y muy estropeados y sin sombras,creo k deberian hacer una gran reforma.
review_translated_text: A campsite that leaves a lot to be desired, the bathrooms without paper, or lids, or hot water, if you want a hot shower you pay for nothing, because the water comes out just as cold, it has no laundry or supermarket, the pools are somewhat passable, but the water is half yellow, no entertainment for the kids, the gardens left and very damaged and without shade, I think they should do a big renovation.

name: Gabriela Perez
review_text:
Estupendas piscinas para pasar el dia con ninos. El agua esta fresquita pero aun asi los toboganes son irresistibles para mayores y pequenos en dias de calor! Ideal para pasar el dia, se puede comer alli unas pizzas, hamburguesas  o bocadillo o tambien se puede llevar comida y comer en los jardines de la piscina. Se puede llevar sombrillas, sillas...etc.
Muy amables en todo momento.
Buen plan para pasar un dia caluroso con ninos.
review_translated_text:
Great pools for spending the day with kids. The water is cool, but the slides are still irresistible for both adults and children on hot days! Ideal for spending the day; you can eat pizzas, burgers, or sandwiches there, or you can also bring food and eat in the pool gardens. You can bring umbrellas, chairs, etc.
Very friendly staff at all times.
A great way to spend a hot day with kids.

name: joni. bl
review_text: Es un quiero y no puedo... instalaciones grandes y con buenas ideas pero, sinceramente, algo desangelado y desfasado. Las piscinas molan mucho y tienen muchas posibilidades, pero se quedaron alejas y descuidadas (al igual que la habitacion del motel) la limpieza no es pulvra y el bar nada del otro mundo.... Por el precio que vale no esta mal, y de hecho ofrece muchas cosas, pero no se... sitio de paso para 1 o 2 dias sin mas...
review_translated_text: It's an I want and I can't... large facilities with good ideas but, honestly, somewhat soulless and outdated. The pools are very cool and have many possibilities, but they were left far away and neglected (like the motel room), the cleanliness is not great and the bar is nothing out of this world.... For the price it is not bad, and in fact it offers many things, but I don't know... just a stopover for 1 or 2 days...
