name: ana aguera
review_text: Me refiero a las piscinas exclusivamente: mucha gente irrespetuosa que te invade el sitio y fuma porros al lado tuyo aunque estes en familia con ninos pequenos. Poco personal para observar estos comportamientos y hacer que los ninos hagan caso en los saltos al agua donde pueden causar un accidente a alguien por tirarse de cualquier manera y sin respetar distancias para no caer encima de nadie. En el bar atencion muy mala. No te hacen caso. Especialmente una chica con el pelo largo pelirroja.
review_translated_text: I am referring exclusively to the swimming pools: many disrespectful people who invade your place and smoke joints next to you even if you are with a family with small children. Not enough staff to observe these behaviors and make children pay attention when jumping into the water where they can cause an accident to someone by jumping in any way and without respecting distances so as not to fall on top of anyone. Very bad service at the bar. They don't pay attention to you. Especially a girl with long red hair.

name: rafael gomez martin
review_text: Las piscinas es un poco de andar por casa, hay alguna carencia, pero por lo demas no esta del todo mal
review_translated_text: The pools are a bit of a walk around the house, there are some shortcomings, but otherwise it's not bad at all

name: idoiac413
review_text: 188 euros nos costo estar dos noches, dos adultos y un nino de 6 anos , con sus dos respectivos dias de entrada a las piscinas, el dia de llegada te hacen entrar a las 15 ( normal porque tienen que arreglar las habitaciones), justo en nuestra llegada, dia 2 de agosto hacia frio ( con chaqueta )y lluvia y no pudimos disfrutar esa tarde, el domingo pedimos la posibilidad de entrar a la piscina, aunque fuera hasta las 15 horas ya que uno de los dos dias que has pagado no te han permitido entrar, la respuesta fue que teniamos que pagar 24 euros para poder entrar, 188 euros que no hacen justicia a la comodidad y las instalaciones.
review_translated_text: 188 euros cost us to stay two nights, two adults and a 6 year old child, with their two respective days of entry to the pools, on the day of arrival they make you enter at 3 pm (normal because they have to clean the rooms), just on our arrival, August 2, it was cold (with a jacket) and rainy and we could not enjoy that afternoon, on Sunday we asked for the possibility of entering the pool, even if it was until 3 pm since one of the two days you have paid they did not allow you to enter, the answer was that we had to pay 24 euros to be able to enter, 188 euros that does not do justice to the comfort and the facilities.

name: Julian Sanchez
review_text: Falta de educacion.   La camarera no sabe tratar con el publico, despues de quejarme por la tardanza de las tapas, q encima estaban frias.
review_translated_text: Lack of manners. The waitress doesn't know how to deal with people, after I complained about the delay in the tapas, which were also cold.

name: Pac0ja
review_text: Fuimos a pasar un dia a las piscinas del camping, a pesar de que las instalaciones son buenas, parecian pasables.... Pero, lo peor, el trato de una camarera en la cafeteria, bastante encarada. La verdad, las piscinas del plantio son fabulosas y sin necesidad de ir en coche
review_translated_text: We went to spend a day at the campsite's pools. Although the facilities are good, they seemed passable... But the worst part was the way the waitress at the cafeteria treated us, who was quite rude. Honestly, the pools at the campsite are fabulous, and you don't even have to drive.

name: Yadretty Hernandez
review_text: Gozimos
review_translated_text: Gossip

name: No lo puedo creer Espana
review_text: Solo estuve en la piscina y en el bar. Personal muy atento.
review_translated_text: I only went to the pool and the bar. The staff was very attentive.

name: valeryg621
review_text: Excelente atencion piscinas limpias mucho cesped se puede comer o sino comes o desayunas en el bar se pueden llevar mascotas pero a la piscina no pueden aceder la gente muy maja tambien para pasar un dia en familia y espectacular todo lo recomiendo volveria.
review_translated_text: Excellent service, clean pools, lots of grass where you can eat or eat or have breakfast at the bar. Pets are allowed, but they are not allowed in the pool. The people are very nice, too, and it's a great place to spend a day with the family. Everything is spectacular. I recommend it and would return.

name: Iban Marciano
review_text: Muy amable el personal. Nos dejaron tirados en la calle los del Hostal Campus (nunca vayais) y en el Motel Picon del Conde nos atendieron muy amablemente a las 00:00h y nos esperaron para que no nos quedasemos en la calle.
review_translated_text: The staff was very friendly. The people at Hostal Campus left us stranded on the street (never go there), and at Motel Picon del Conde, they kindly greeted us at midnight and waited for us so we wouldn't be left on the street.

name: isabelle flohic
review_text: De passage a Monasterio de Rodilla un dimanche soir, j'ai apprecie de venir manger au Picon del Conde. Accueil chaleureux et authentique. Une cuisine simple et de qualite, on se sent a l'aise comme chez des amis !
review_translated_text: While passing through Monasterio de Rodilla on a Sunday evening, I enjoyed coming to eat at Picon del Conde. Warm and authentic welcome. Simple, quality cuisine, you feel comfortable like staying with friends!

name: Reinona Chofia
review_text: El trato es super agradable y la habitacion muy comoda y calida
review_translated_text: The treatment is super nice and the room is very comfortable and warm.

name: Irene Villamartin Oviedo
review_text: Se esta quedando muy viejo ya
review_translated_text: It's getting very old now

name: simon GODE
review_text: Les prix on trop augmentes  aujourd'hui  26 euros pour passer une nuit c est trop cher et l electricite dijoncte souvent .
review_translated_text: Prices have increased too much today. 26 euros to spend a night is too expensive and the electricity often cuts out.

name: JEAN JACQUES GOURVES
review_text: Acceuil parfait. Des personnes d'un service irreprochable. Des chambres confortables. Tout a ete au mieux y compris le restaurant, plats de qualite.
review_translated_text: Perfect welcome. The staff provided impeccable service. Comfortable rooms. Everything was excellent, including the restaurant, which offered quality food.

name: Joy-Ellen Kasper
review_text: Voor een doorreis een prima plek.. Voor 50 euro moet je ook niet klagen. Wel veel lawaai van de snel weg!!
review_translated_text: A great place for a transit... For 50 euros you shouldn't complain. A lot of noise from the highway!!

name: Patrick von Brosinsky
review_text:
Nette Gaststatte mit super leckeren Kaffe  wir waren hier 22.9.23 mit Fahrrad und haben 4 leckere Kaffe getrunken  Preise super angenehm  und tolle Einrichtung 

Danke das fur den tollen Service
Wir waren sehr erfreut.. 

Sehr zu empfehlen bei den Preisen
review_translated_text:
Nice restaurant with super delicious coffee  We were here on September 22, 2023, by bike and drank four delicious coffees  Super reasonable prices  and great decor 

Thank you for the great service
We were very pleased.. 

Highly recommended for the prices

name: Olatz Garmendia
review_text:
Despues de pagar 23,5EU la entrada no hemos estado ni dos horas. Piscinas horribles, en 1982 serian la bomba pero en 2023 necesitan una gran reforma. La nina se ha hecho una quemadura importante en el pie porque el tobogan no tenia suficiente agua, a los lados estaba seco.  Puedes rodar Scream 5 en las piscinas tranquilamente, la decoracion es cutre y da un poco de miedo. El agua de las duchas frias.
No vuelvo ni de cona.
review_translated_text:
After paying EU23.50 for admission, we weren't even there for two hours. The pools are horrible; in 1982 they would have been amazing, but in 2023 they need a major overhaul. The little girl got a bad burn on her foot because the slide didn't have enough water; the sides were dry. You can safely shoot Scream 5 in the pools; the decor is tacky and a little scary. The water in the showers is cold.
I'm not going back, no way.

name: inaki cerqueira
review_text: Era nuestro ultimo dia de vacaciones y... madre mia! Las fotos enganan mucho!! Las piscinan y el recinto en general muy cutre! De los anos 70 sin nada moderno! Instalaciones que podian ser las mejores de espana! Pero si invittieran dinero! Pagas 8,50 adultos y 6,50 ninos! Muy caro ! No merece la pena! Las duchas son regaderas y los chorros con cubos de la huerta! CUTRESSS INVERTIR PARA COBRAR 8,50 !! Sino bajar los precios!! MUY CARO TODO! Duchas frias , y los toboganes muy peligrosos,
review_translated_text: It was our last day of vacation and... my goodness! The photos are very deceiving!! The swimming pools and the grounds in general are very shabby! From the 70s without anything modern! Facilities that could be the best in Spain! But if they invited money! You pay 8.50 adults and 6.50 children! Very expensive! It's not worth it! The showers are watering cans and the jets are with buckets from the garden! CUTRESSS INVEST TO COLLECT 8.50!! But lower the prices!! EVERYTHING VERY EXPENSIVE! Cold showers, and very dangerous slides,

name: Lino Miguel Mendes
review_text:
Uma experiencia pra nao voltar a repetir,quarto  sujo e cheio de teias de aranhas,cama muito mal feita e os lencois muito amarelados em vez de brancos.quarto cheirava mal e tinha coco de cao no chao.toalhas da casa de banho rasgadas e com cotao. Sanita muito em cima do duche que voce pra voce fazer suas necessidades tem de ser de pernas abertas. Lavatorio sujo e com dois copos de plastico igualmente sujos e virados pra baixo em cima do Lavatorio sujo.
(Fiquei no quarto numero 7)
Nao aconselho
review_translated_text:
An experience not to be repeated, dirty room full of spider webs, very poorly made bed and very yellowish sheets instead of white. Room smelled bad and there was dog poop on the floor. Bathroom towels were torn and full of fluff. Toilet very close to the shower so you have to open your legs to do your business. Dirty sink with two equally dirty plastic cups upside down on top of the dirty sink.
(I stayed in room number 7)
I do not recommend it

name: Rosa Maria Sanchez Duran
review_text: Es un lugar sucio ante todo. La entrada a las instalaciones de la piscina 9EU, y por ese precio, habria que encontrar unas instalaciones a la altura. Todo lo contrario. Las piscinas con el agua turbia, todo el barro del suelo se mete dentro de las piscinas, dado que las duchas de acceso no solo no funcionan, sino que tienen telaranas. Los banos, muy muy sucios. Las duchas sin agua caliente. Las zonas del cesped, muchas son tierra. La socorrista vigila dos piscinas... y si eso no fuera poco, las instalaciones son gestionadas por una familia de padres e hijos, que estan delante de los demas clientes, insultando a los clientes. Lamentable que no se ponga orden a todo esto.
review_translated_text: It is a dirty place above all. Admission to the pool facilities is EU9, and for that price, you should find facilities to match. Quite the opposite. The pools with cloudy water, all the mud from the ground gets into the pools, since the access showers not only do not work, but they have cobwebs. The bathrooms, very very dirty. Showers without hot water. The grass areas, many are dirt. The lifeguard watches over two swimming pools... and if that were not enough, the facilities are managed by a family of parents and children, who are in front of the other clients, insulting the clients. It is unfortunate that all this is not put in order.

name: Severine "Sev 28" Rhattas
review_text: Hotel agreable avec chambres spacieuses et salle de bain. Les proprietaires sont chaleureux et font tout pour rendre le sejour agreable. Chambres de 2 a 4 personnes. Beau parc aquatique.
review_translated_text: Pleasant hotel with spacious rooms and bathroom. The owners are warm and do everything to make your stay pleasant. Rooms for 2 to 4 people. Beautiful water park.

name: Maria Campos
review_text:
Las instalaciones estan muy antiguas, tanto del parque acuatico como el hostal, eso si, limpio si que estaba.
Demasiado caro para lo que es, ya que encima no hay una oferta gastronomica a los alrededores y hay quite ir hasta Burgos
review_translated_text:
The facilities are very old, both the water park and the hostel, but it was clean.
Too expensive for what it is, since there is no gastronomic offer in the surroundings and it is quite difficult to go to Burgos

name: 177gabix
review_text: No volveria me gaste 200 euros para 4 horas trato brusco encima me dejaron en la calle con la caravana un despifarro de dinero para lo que se supone lo que ai 4 toboganes y nada mas comida pesima bocadillos otra cosa nada todo caro sin mass no volveria a este lugar prefiero un descanso de la autopista
review_translated_text: I would not return. I spent 200 euros for 4 hours. They treated me rudely and left me on the street with the caravan. A waste of money for what is supposed to be there: 4 slides and nothing else. Terrible food, sandwiches, nothing else. Everything was expensive. Without further ado, I would not return to this place. I prefer a break from the highway.

name: gabi GPL
review_text: Trato pesimo todo caro me dejaron en la calle con la caravana gastandome un dineral en solo un dia la comida solo bocadillos sin mas no volveremos para cuatro toboganes que no merecen la pena la espera el trato ni nada de lo que ai prefiero un area de servicio mas varato y mas divertido
review_translated_text: Terrible treatment, everything was expensive, they left me on the street with the caravan, spending a fortune in just one day. The food was just sandwiches, nothing more. We will not return for four slides that are not worth the wait, the treatment or anything. I prefer a cheaper and more fun service area.

name: Sherpa43496223446
review_text: La habitacion muy anticuada y sucia. Los colchones horribles,parecia un colchon de agua de todo lo que se movia, y en unos de ellos habia una mancha enorme, yo juraria que de sangre.|Las almohadas del grosor de un folio.|En el bar ya podia esperar y esperar por que no te atendia nadie. La gente se colaba descaradamente y nadie decia nada. |En una ocasion estuve 40 minutos esperando en la barra pero parece que yo era invisible.|La camarera me quito de las manos la carta de los bocadillos y me dice de muy malas formas ,de donde has cogido eso, esa no es. Y le dije pues dame por favor la buena. Espere 20 minutos mas y no me la dio. |Tambien tiene prioridad a todo el cliente externo que viene solo a la piscina, los que estan hospedados son los ultimos tanto para hacer el check in como para pedir unos helados. O al menos esa fue nuestra sensacion.|De la comida no puedo hablar por que no nos atendieron ninguno de los 3 dias, asi que no la pude probar.|Permiten animales,me parece que esta genial poder ir con tu perro aunq en la zona de las piscinas no pueden entrar. Y lo que no me gusto fue tener a un perro ladrando sin parar desde las 8am.|Pienso que parar ser un 2 estrellas y las condiciones que esta es caro.|Lo unico que se salva a mi parecer fue la piscina, necesita un buen mantenimiento pero esta decente.|No volveremos |
review_translated_text: The room was very outdated and dirty. The mattresses were horrible; they felt like water mattresses because of all the movement, and one of them had a huge stain--I swore it was blood. The pillows were as thick as a sheet of paper. At the bar, I could wait and wait because no one served me. People were brazenly cutting in line, and no one said anything. On one occasion, I waited at the bar for 40 minutes, but it seemed I was invisible. The waitress snatched the sandwich menu out of my hands and said rudely, "Where did you get that? It wasn't that one." And I said, "Please give me the correct one." I waited 20 more minutes, and she didn't give it to me. She also gives priority to all external guests who come alone to the pool; those who are staying are the last to check in and order ice cream. Or at least that was our feeling. | I can't speak about the food because they didn't serve us on any of the 3 days, so I couldn't try it. | They allow pets, I think it's great to be able to go with your dog although they're not allowed in the pool area. And what I didn't like was having a dog barking non-stop since 8am. | I think for a 2-star hotel and the conditions it's in it's expensive. | The only saving grace in my opinion was the pool, it needs good maintenance but it's decent. | We won't be back |

name: JESUS CASARES
review_text: Un buen sitio para disfrutar en familia y las camareras muy majas
review_translated_text: A good place to enjoy with the family and the waitresses are very nice

name: Roberto Martinez de Guerenu
review_text:
Lentos; demasiado lentos. Especialmente en fechas y horas en las que es de suponer que deben estar preparados. Servicio que pasa de todo y te despachan con el tradicional ..."hago lo que puedo" para esconder que les da igual. EspecialmEnte cuando se te cuelan por todos lados, banistas y todo tipo de viajero sin escrupulos que no respetan orden de llegada a la hora de pedir y no tienes ganas de montar el numero porque no sabes si renir al geta o quejarte al camarero por no llamar la atencion al subsodicho.
Si tienes esta ruta,... siempre encontraras un turista / banista ( en verano) dispuesto a exigir su hamburguesa y su polo de fresa a toda costa y va a hacerte perder tiempo. No veras muchos camiones parados por aqui. Eso lo dice todo
review_translated_text:
Slow; too slow. Especially on dates and times when they're supposed to be ready. Service that ignores everything and sends you off with the traditional "I'll do my best" to hide the fact that they don't care. Especially when you're cut in line everywhere, bathers and all kinds of unscrupulous travelers who don't respect the order of arrival when ordering, and you don't feel like making a scene because you don't know whether to scold the idiot or complain to the waiter for not calling the aforementioned person out.
If you take this route, you'll always find a tourist/bather (in summer) willing to demand their burger and strawberry popsicle at all costs, and they'll waste your time. You won't see many trucks stopped around here. That says it all.

name: Sonia Bartolome Macias
review_text:
No le gustan los ninos,protestan por todo, y son ninosssss !!! se come muy bien muy buena cocinera,sitio descuidado,los duenos pasan
Las piscinas bien pero el agua esta helada.....
review_translated_text:
She doesn't like children, they complain about everything, and they are children!!! The food is very good, the cook is very good, the place is run down, the owners are nice.
The pools are fine, but the water is freezing.....

name: Pablo Oro
review_text: Es un motel camping de 2 estrellas. Teniendo eso en cuenta, las habitaciones estan muy bien, la comida es estupenda, las piscinas muy divertidas para echar el dia en familia y el trato marivolloso. Esta a menos de media hora de Burgos y de los yacimientos de Atapuerca. Ideal para pasar unos dias divertidos en familia.
review_translated_text: It is a 2 star camping motel. Taking that into account, the rooms are very good, the food is great, the pools are very fun to spend the day with the family and the treatment is wonderful. It is less than half an hour from Burgos and the Atapuerca sites. Ideal for spending some fun days with the family.

name: Alfonso Gonzalez Blanco

name: pelagrillas
review_text: Diria que es sorprendente en su totalidad, tanto para bien como para mal. Visto en perspectiva, podriamos considerarlo el precursor de los actuales parques acuaticos y de atracciones: un camping que en su dia el dueno intento dinamizar anadiendo atracciones de todo tipo, pero todo en plan manual y casero. Nos podemos encontrar cubos que tiran agua amarrados con cuerdas y girando sobre una varilla, o toboganes al limite de las paredes, o piscinas que tan pronto haces pie y de repente cae a 2m de profundidad. Seguramente si vinieran a inspeccionarlo en detalle no le dejarian pasar mas de una, es todo como un poco surrealista en ese aspecto, parece que no hay ni una medida de seguridad, ni se controla aforos, ni altura de los ninos , ni se dan paso en los toboganes, con todo el riesgo que eso conlleva. Por lo tanto, te puedes pasar un dia genial con los ninos, eso si, continua vigilancia, no perder de vista a los ninos en ningun momento y supervisar todos los movimientos, porque como digo, no creo que se haya revisado cada atraccion. Por otro lado como digo, puedes disfrutar de un buen dia de agua y atracciones, a pocos kms de Burgos por un precio asequible, llevandote la comida y saliendo bastante economico. Recomiendo pero con vigilancia total sobre los ninos.
review_translated_text: I'd say it's completely amazing, both for better and for worse. In retrospect, we could consider it the precursor to today's water parks and amusement parks: a campsite that the owner once tried to revitalize by adding all kinds of attractions, but all done in a homemade, manual way. We can find buckets squirting water tied with ropes and rotating on a rod, or slides at the very edge of the walls, or pools that suddenly drop 2 meters deep as soon as you step foot. Surely if they came to inspect it in detail, they wouldn't let you in more than one; it's all a bit surreal in that regard. It seems there are no safety measures in place, no capacity controls, no children's height controls, and no access on the slides, with all the risks that entails. Therefore, you can have a great day with the kids, just make sure you keep a constant watch, keep an eye on them at all times, and supervise every movement, because as I said, I don't think every attraction has been inspected. On the other hand, as I said, you can enjoy a great day of water sports and attractions just a few miles from Burgos for an affordable price, bringing your own food and working out quite cheaply. I recommend it, but be sure to keep a close eye on the children.

name: antoniobM2504ED
review_text: Cuando se paga una entrada de 9,50 por persona te imaginas algo mas cuidadas las intalaciones o algun tipo de servicio que justifique su precio. Da lo mismo que entres a las 11 o que lo hagas a las 6 de la tarde, pagas lo mismo, cierran a las 8 de la tarde.||Faltan zonas de sombra, sillas o mesas que habia antes, algun tipo de reforma o mantenimiento en instalaciones y sobre todo FALTA SEGURIDAD. En estas instalaciones se hace imprescindible que alguien controle cuando alguien se puede lanzar del tobogan y cuando hay que esperar por haber alguien justo en la salida del mismo para que no haya choques. A mi hijo le golpeo un senor que se tiro justo despues de el golpeandole en la cabeza y aunque fue solo un susto podia haber sido mortal por la velocidad que se alcanza al tirarse y el peso de la persona. Hay dos socorristas que estan a la entrada, juntos sentados en una mesa, con el movil y a la sombra, detras de las instalaciones sin tener ningun tipo de visibilidad de lo que sucede en las piscinas.||Imagino que si estan es para cumplir normativa por si va una inspeccion, pero si se quedan en el bar harian el mismo trabajo. ||Estubimos varios amigos toda la jornada y no fue algo puntual, fue todo el dia esta actitud,  al fondo donde esta el tobogan del gorila esta sin vigilar y controlar, agradeceria se investiguen estas instalaciones antes que suceda algo que haya que lamentar. Imagino que un socorrista tendria que estar en cada zona, para eso hay dos. Lamentable
review_translated_text: When you pay 9.50 per person for admission, you'd expect better-maintained facilities or some kind of service that justifies the price. It doesn't matter if you enter at 11 or 6 p.m., you pay the same; they close at 8 p.m. There are no shaded areas, chairs, or tables that were there before. The facilities need some kind of renovation or maintenance, and above all, there's a lack of security. These facilities require someone to monitor when someone can slide down and when they have to wait, ensuring there's someone right at the exit to avoid collisions. My son was hit by a man who jumped off right after him, hitting him in the head. Although it was just a scare, it could have been fatal given the speed at which the slide is reached and the weight of the person. There are two lifeguards at the entrance, sitting together at a table, using their cell phones in the shade, behind the facilities, with no visibility of what's happening in the pools. I imagine they're there to comply with regulations in case of an inspection, but if they stayed at the bar, they'd be doing the same job. Several friends of ours were there all day, and it wasn't a one-time incident; this behavior was the whole day. The back, where the gorilla slide is, is unmonitored and uncontrolled. I would appreciate it if these facilities could be investigated before something regrettable happens. I imagine a lifeguard should be in each area; that's why there are two. Regrettable.

review_text: Nous sommes restes 1 semaine dans ce camping. Nous avons passe un tres bon sejour. Nous etions sur un emplacement en toile de tente. Celui ci etait spacieux ombrage. Les sanitaires ne sont pas de premiere jeunesse mais tres propres . Attention c est 1euro pour 12 mn d eau chaude et la douche est difficile a regler.  ||Il y a un bar qui propose de tout du pain des cafes des petits dejeuner Burger pizzas etc .. l accueil y est chaleureux et souriant.  ||Le gros point fort de ce camping est l espace aquatique avec differentes piscines toboggans pour les grands et les petits ainsi qu un grand espace pour les adeptes du bronzage.
review_translated_text: We stayed 1 week at this campsite. We had a very good stay. We were on a tent pitch. It was spacious and shaded. The toilets are not new but very clean. Be careful, it costs 1 euro for 12 minutes of hot water and the shower is difficult to regulate. ||There is a bar that offers everything from bread, coffee, breakfast, burgers, pizzas, etc. The welcome is warm and friendly. ||The big highlight of this campsite is the aquatic area with different pools, slides for adults and children, as well as a large area for sunbathers.

name: Manuel A. Fdez.
review_text: Las mejores pincinas de todo Burgos.
review_translated_text: The best pincinas in all of Burgos.

name: Roberto Gallo
review_text: Un sitio que es tan cutre que llega a ser divertido, los toboganes de lo peligro que son son la ostia, yo voy ahi con 6 anos y me traumo, ahora ya no, falta de cuidado pero bueno, para pasar el dia bien, por cierto, algo de marketing para la juventud de 16-25.
review_translated_text: A place that is so trashy that it becomes fun, the slides are so dangerous, I go there when I'm 6 years old and I'm traumatized, not anymore, lack of care but hey, to have a good time, by the way, some marketing for 16-25 youth.

name: Jose Antonio Hernando
review_text: Horrible. Apartamentos peligrosos y poco limpios. Camping con poco mantenimiento, muy descuidado. El trato poco agradable, hasta rineron a unos ninos por acercarse a una jaula de pajaros. Imagino que las piscinas son lo que llaman la atencion, pero si buscas alojarte...a media hora tienes mejores, mucho mejores, opciones. Continua camino
review_translated_text: Awful. Dangerous and unclean apartments. Camping with little maintenance, very neglected. The unpleasant treatment, they even scolded some children for approaching a bird cage. I imagine that the pools are what attract attention, but if you are looking to stay... half an hour away you have better, much better, options. Continue on the way

name: Jacques Busschers
review_text:
Perfecte locatie, alles dicht.
Maar deze is open en we kunnen eten.
review_translated_text:
Perfect location, everything close.
But this one is open and we can eat.

name: alejandro perez lopez
review_text:
Buena atencion, buena calefaccion.
Mucha humedad en la cama, el bano aunque esta limpio, esta muy envejecido y no se entra.
review_translated_text:
Good service, good heating.
A lot of humidity in the bed, the bathroom, although clean, is very old and cannot be entered.

name: Maria Victoria D'Angelo
review_text: Nos han encantado las piscinas. El personal muy agradable y el sitio genial. Para ser en Burgos la temperatura del agua estaba bastante bien. Ideal para familias con nin@s. Todas las instituciones en buen estado y todas las piscinas actividades. Repetiremos sin duda el proximo ano!
review_translated_text: We loved the pools. Very nice staff and great place. For being in Burgos, the water temperature was quite good. Ideal for families with children. All institutions in good condition and all pools activities. We will definitely repeat next year!

name: Edna Rome
review_text: Es original.
review_translated_text: It's original.

name: Ruben
review_text:
En cuanto a las piscinas.
Las instalaciones dejan bastante que desear. Los toboganes estan anticuados y no dan seguridad. Las piscinas estan viejas y el agua turbia. Instalaciones poco cuidadas en general. Relacion calidad precio, caro. (7'60EU)
review_translated_text:
As for the pools.
The facilities leave a lot to be desired. The slides are outdated and unsafe. The pools are old and the water is cloudy. The facilities are generally poorly maintained. Price-performance ratio is expensive. (EU7.60)

name: Adrian Lopez
review_text:
Esta bastante bien pero es muy caro
9EU todo el dia, con 7EU esta mas que pagado
review_translated_text:
It's pretty good but it's very expensive
EU9 all day, EU7 is more than paid

name: Maria Victoria Sancholuz
review_text: Ideal para estar en familia los dias de calor. Las piscinas inigualables, para todas las edades... excelente atencion
review_translated_text: Ideal for spending time with the family on hot days. The unrivaled pools, for all ages... excellent service

name: Escorpiuse Escorpiuse
review_text:
Solo fuimos por las piscinas, a pasar el dia. El precio me parecio alto, 9EU adultos y 7EU ninos. Como aspectos positivos, los toboganes son muy divertidos, puedes llevarte tu propia comida, que puedes tomar en las mesas de la instalacion, y puedes entrar y salir si llevas puesta la pulsera que te dan al pagar.
Como aspectos negativos: el agua de las piscinas estaba muy lechoso (no te veias is pies a 1 metro bajo el agua, y no eramos tantos banandonos para tener ese aspecto), algunas terminaciones en cemento que pretenden dar una imagen de rusticidad ofrecen puntas y filos que pueden producir heridas. Los banos (de hombres, al menos) casi todos cerrados por averia y la limpieza brillaba por su ausencia. Los botones de las duchas y pediluvios, tapados con cinta adhesiva (?para que no se usaran?). Habia una zona del jardin inundada por alguna fuga de agua de los toboganes grandes... En fin, muchos detalles descuidados para el precio que se paga. La cafeteria me parecio un poco carilla. El cafe no me gusto.
review_translated_text:
We just went to the pools to spend the day. The price seemed high to me, EU9 adults and EU7 children. On the positive side, the slides are a lot of fun, you can bring your own food, which you can eat at the tables in the facility, and you can go in and out if you wear the bracelet they give you when you pay.
As negative aspects: the water in the pools was very milky (you couldn't see your feet 1 meter under the water, and there weren't so many of us bathing to have that appearance), some cement finishes that try to give an image of rusticity offer points and sharp edges that can cause wounds. The bathrooms (men's, at least) were almost all closed due to breakdowns and cleanliness was conspicuous by its absence. The buttons for the showers and footbaths, covered with adhesive tape (so they wouldn't be used?). There was an area of   the garden flooded due to a water leak from the large slides... In short, many neglected details for the price paid. The cafeteria seemed a bit expensive to me. I didn't like the coffee.

name: Ian Leyva
review_text: Genial para descansar
review_translated_text: Great to rest

name: Erika
review_text: Un sitio muy bueno con grandes piscinas.. Se puede ir solo a las piscinas por 7 50 el dia. Piscinas grandes y limpias eso si algun mas fresquito que otra pero estuvimos muy agusto
review_translated_text: A very nice place with large pools. You can go to the pools alone for 7.50 a day. The pools are large and clean, although some are cooler than others, but we enjoyed it very much.

name: Rossana Leguizamon
review_text: Son muy amables y buen precio, no hay quejas, nos habiamos alojado alguna vez y super bien, fuimos con nuestra mascota y genial, este ano volvimos por la piscina!! Recomendadisimo!!
review_translated_text: They are very friendly and have a good price, no complaints, we had stayed before and it was great, we went with our pet and it was great, this year we returned for the pool!! Highly recommended!!

name: FerPucela 78
review_text:
Muy caro para el servicio que ofrece...
Habitaciones pequenas, mobiliario viejo y destrozado, olor a canerias. Los toboganes solo valen los centrales, el resto son muy rudimentarios y con falta de mantenimiento.
No lo recomiendo.
review_translated_text:
Very expensive for the service offered...
Small rooms, old and destroyed furniture, smell of pipes. The slides are only worth the central ones, the rest are very rudimentary and lack maintenance.
I don't recommend it.

name: marisa penacoba
review_text: Piscinas muy buenas para pasar u  dia en familia, con diversion asegurada
review_translated_text: Very good pools to spend a day with the family, with guaranteed fun.

name: rebeca esteban
review_text: Hola buenas desearia saber si las piscinas estan abiertas
review_translated_text: Hello, I would like to know if the pools are open.

name: Gemma Diaz
review_text: Muy bonito, las piscinas geniales
review_translated_text: Very nice, great pools

name: Gallen Jean - Baptiste
review_text:
Bonne decouverte sur la route entre la Bretagne et l'Andalousie !
Hote tres accueillant, bonne restauration, chambre tres correcte !
review_translated_text:
Good discovery on the road between Brittany and Andalusia!
Very welcoming host, good food, very decent room!

name: Ainhoa Astarloa Eguiguren
review_text: Perfecto para ir con ninos, las piscinas estan genial!
review_translated_text: Perfect to go with children, the pools are great!

name: David Sousa Garay
review_text: Las piscinas espectaculares
review_translated_text: The spectacular pools

name: Cylia 05
review_text: Me encanta, ademas cunado ibamos de galicia a barcelona y a la vuelta en conche siempre parabamos ahi, y aunque nunca llegue a ir en verano para la piscina es un lugar muy pero que muy acogedor y los duenos son super majos con un trato muy cercano
review_translated_text: I love it, also when we went from Galicia to Barcelona and on the way back by car we always stopped there, and although I never got to go in summer for the pool, it is a very, very cozy place and the owners are super nice with a very friendly treatment

name: moises cabeza varela
review_text: Buen hotel limpio y buen personal
review_translated_text: Good clean hotel and good staff

name: OCG
review_text:
!!Excelente!!
Instalaciones de camping y piscinas sencillas y sin lujos pero que se disfrutan un monton.
Personal familiar de trato cercano, con ganas de agradar a los clientes.
No apto para "tikis-mikis" dado que son unas instalaciones gestionadas y mantenidas a nivel familiar y con meritoria voluntad y buena intencion. Sin embargo en ocasiones pueden verse desbordados al no estar preparadas las instalaciones para un excesivo numero de visitantes simultaneo.
review_translated_text:
Excellent!!
Camping facilities and swimming pools are simple and without luxuries, but they are very enjoyable.
Friendly family staff, eager to please customers.
Not suitable for "tikis-mikis" since they are facilities managed and maintained at a family level and with meritorious will and good intentions. However, sometimes they can be overwhelmed because the facilities are not prepared for an excessive number of simultaneous visitors.

name: Fernando Serna Sanchez
review_text: El lugar no esta mal, el menu no esta acorde al precio, la atencion muy buena.
review_translated_text: The place is not bad, the menu is not in line with the price, the service is very good.

name: Manuel Martin Pons
review_text: Buenos precios
review_translated_text: Good prices

name: Victor Valentin Caceres Rodriguez
review_text: Fuimos por las piscinas y no nos decepcionaron. Son muy rusticas pero los ninos se lo pasaron genial
review_translated_text: We went for the pools and they did not disappoint us. They are very rustic but the children had a great time

name: Raquel Alonso
review_text: Las piscinas muy bien. Fuimos con miedo x los comentarios pero nos parecio tan grave. Lo pasamos muy bien. Y las hamburguesas de alli buenisimas
review_translated_text: The pools are very good. We went with fear because of the comments but it seemed so serious to us. We had a great time. And the burgers there are delicious.

name: Estrella Lopez
review_text: Decepcion. Todo sucio y en mal estado.
review_translated_text: Disappointment. All dirty and in poor condition.

name: Marcos
review_text: Esta muy bien
review_translated_text: It's very nice

name: Arturro
review_text: Parking przy plazy,  sporo miejsc, nawet w piatek 30.08, Spoko dojscie do plazy gdzie jest ratownik, prysznice, restauracje, szkolki serfingu, fale daja poplywac A i surfowac
review_translated_text: Parking by the beach, plenty of places, even on Friday, August 30, Easy access to the beach with a lifeguard, showers, restaurants, surfing schools, waves for swimming and surfing

name: Jesus Fidel Heras
review_text: Demasiado caro para los toboganes que hay y en las duchas no hay agua caliente y en los vestuarios ni un colgador para dejar la ropa
review_translated_text: Too expensive for the slides there are and there is no hot water in the showers and in the changing rooms there is not even a hanger to leave clothes

name: Riki
review_text: Nada mas entrar el camarero,un chico joven,un borde que para que. Es antipatico y chulo como el solo. 9EU por persona u esta todo sucio,el suelo de las piscinas desconchado q te corta los pies,los toboganes estan reventados. En el bar mejor no pedir nada porque tienes que vender un rinon para pagar,ya se donde no volver.
review_translated_text: As soon as you walk in, the waiter, a young guy, is a real jerk. He's unfriendly and arrogant as hell. EU9 per person and everything is dirty, the pool floors are chipped and cut into your feet, and the slides are busted. It's best not to order anything at the bar because you'll have to sell a fortune to pay. I already know where I won't go back.

name: hakim el attar
review_text: Ce n'est pas le grand luxe mais c'est propre, la personne qui s'est occupe de notre accueil etait tres sympathique,convient tres bien pour les enfants (piscines, toboggans, pleine de jeux)
review_translated_text: It's not luxurious but it's clean, the person who looked after us was very friendly, very suitable for children (swimming pools, slides, lots of games)

name: Irina Gueorguiev
review_text:
Deceptionnos
Chambre peu agreable, la longueur du lit fait 1m80 au max, ( je mesure 1m60, j avais les pieds dehors) mauvaise literie, et il ne faut pas etre claustrophobe pour prendre une douche. C'est vetuste, ainsi le rideau de douche doit dater de... longtemps, entre autres. Petite odeur de canalisation desagreable.Alors du coup on se dit que vu le prix par rapport aux prix espagnols, c'est parce qu'on paie la piscine. Un gros parc aquatique. Fermee a notre arrivee elle n9uvre qua 11h30 le matin, donc il fallait liberer la chambre, on ne pourra pas dire si elle valait le coup. Situe sur la nationale. Bref, pas genialos.
review_translated_text:
Deceptionnos
Unpleasant room, the length of the bed is 1m80 at max, (I'm 1m60, I had my feet out) bad bedding, and you don't have to be claustrophobic to take a shower. It's dated, so the shower curtain must be... a long time ago, among other things. Small unpleasant smell from the pipes. So we say to ourselves that given the price compared to Spanish prices, it's because we are paying for the swimming pool. A big water park. Closed when we arrived, it only opened at 11:30 in the morning, so we had to vacate the room, we won't be able to say if it was worth it. Located on the national road. In short, not great.

name: ainhoa bahillo
review_text: Estuvimos un dia a final d julio. Nos quedamos por q ya habiamos pagado!! Lugar anclado en el pasado. Habitaciones pequenas y sucias. De la piscina . No se ni como describirlo!! Sucio,descuidados,el ambiente..desagradable...muchisima gente ,mal educada..parecia una comuna ! Nunca en la vida me ha pasado algo asi. La atencion del personanal ...pesima! Una familia q no tiene ni idea d tratar a los clientes...nunca en la vida vuelvo ahi!!! Relacion calidad precio...UN ROBO!!!
review_translated_text: We stayed for a day at the end of July. We stayed because we had already paid!! A place stuck in the past. Small, dirty rooms. The pool... I don't even know how to describe it!! Dirty, unkempt, the atmosphere... unpleasant... too many people, rude... it felt like a commune! Nothing like that has ever happened to me in my life. The staff... terrible! A family that has no idea how to treat customers... I will never go back there again!!! The price-quality ratio... A STEAL!!!

name: Alex Jimenez
review_text: Una decepcion. Pensamos estaria bien al reservar por las fotos y piscina. Todo lo contrario...Mala atencion. Todo muy sucio. La piscina un horror.... Muy sucia, desatendido, mucha gente, caro.... Habitaciones decepcionantes... No volvere jamas.
review_translated_text: A disappointment. We thought it would be a good idea when we booked, given the photos and the pool. Quite the opposite... Poor service. Everything was very dirty. The pool was horrible... Very dirty, neglected, crowded, expensive... Disappointing rooms... I'll never return.

name: ingridtheodoral
review_text: Komend vanuit Zuid Spanje op deze camping overnacht.|De eigenaren waren uiterst vriendelijk maar dar kon de ervaring helaas niet goed maken.|De plaatsen zijn ruim, er is voldoende capaciteit in de sanitaire voorzieningen maar helaas niet schoon! Geen bril op het toilet en geen WC papier. Je moet betalen voor warm water en het terrein mag wel eens opgeruimd worden.|Maar wat vooral tegen viel was het eten!|Wij hadden een hamburger met slappe niet gare patat. Bier was lekker en koude asperges uit blik en vis in de tomaten/paprika saus zonder smaak. Het toetje durfde we niet aan. Het kost niet veel maar dan heb je ook niets!
review_translated_text: Coming from the South of Spain, stayed overnight at this campsite. |The owners were extremely friendly but unfortunately that could not make up for the experience. |The pitches are spacious, there is sufficient capacity in the sanitary facilities but unfortunately not clean! No toilet seat and no toilet paper. You have to pay for hot water and the site could do with being tidied up. |But what was especially disappointing was the food! |We had a hamburger with limp, undercooked fries. Beer was tasty and cold canned asparagus and fish in tomato/paprika sauce without taste. We did not dare to have dessert. It does not cost much but then you have nothing!

name: jose manuel garcia gonzalez
review_text: Un bonito sitio para pasar un fin de semana y desconectar sobre todo en verano con piscina y cerca de la capital para hacer visitas
review_translated_text: A nice place to spend a weekend and unwind, especially in summer, with a pool and close to the capital for sightseeing.

name: Jose Marquez
review_text: Piscinas originales
review_translated_text: Original pools

name: Diana Garcia
review_text: Hemos estado acampados en el camping,  y tengo que senalar que la limpieza de los banos brilla por su ausencia,  telaranas por todas las duchas  a la altura de la cabeza,  te cobran 1 euro por una ducha caliente de 12 minutos de los cuales el primero tienes que esperar a que salga,  luego sale hirviendo o fria  no fuimos capaces de templar la,  mi hijo de 4 anos llorando Porq le quemo el agua porque sale de repente,  las parcelas con suciedad,  la luz salta continuamente,  el cuarto de la lavadora parecia sacado de pelicula de terror,  sucisimo, lleno de telaranas por todos lados,  es un camping que si supieran sacarle partido tendria mas visitas,  lo tienen muy dejado y el precio que te cobran es para que lo tuvieran impoluto, las piscinas estan muy bien si estuvieramos en los 90,n aquellos anos seguro que eran nuevas,  piscinas amarillas de no limpiarlas,  trozos de las paredes de la piscina en el fondo de ellas,  y el precio que tienen no es para que esten asi,  por lo que cobran deberian de tener mejor mantenimiento.  Esto si segun llegas son super agradables, luego no volvi a hablar con ellos.  Otro punto en contra es tener que dar toda la vuelta para pasar por el bar a la piscina,  habia gente que venia a pasar el dia a la piscina aparcando dentro del camping, no tienen ningun control de quien entra o sale de el, con el consiguiente que te pueda desaparecer algo. Perros campando a sus anchas, cagando en las parcelas,  culpa de los duenos claro y del camping de no ser mas estrictos.  Podria seguir,  pero creo que con esto ya es suficiente
review_translated_text: We have been camping at the campsite, and I have to point out that the cleanliness of the bathrooms is conspicuous by its absence, cobwebs in all the showers at head height, they charge you 1 euro for a 12-minute hot shower of which the first one you have to wait for it to come out, then it comes out boiling or cold, we were not able to temper it, my 4-year-old son crying because the water burned him because it comes out suddenly, the plots with dirt, the light constantly jumps, the washing machine room seemed straight out of a horror movie, very dirty, full of cobwebs everywhere, it is a campsite that if they knew how to take advantage of it would have more visitors, they have it very neglected and the price they charge you is so that they would have it spotless, the pools are very good if we were in the 90s, in those years they were surely new, pools yellow from not being cleaned, pieces of the walls of the pool at the bottom of them, and the price they have is not for them to be like that, so they charge should have better maintenance.  This is if when you arrive they are super nice, then I never spoke to them again.  Another point against is having to go all the way around to go through the bar to the pool, there were people who came to spend the day at the pool parking inside the campsite, they have no control over who enters or leaves it, with the consequence that something could disappear. Dogs roaming freely, shitting on the plots, the fault of the owners and the campsite of course for not being stricter.  I could go on, but I think this is enough.

name: Incognito S
review_text: Alles is te duur en aan onderhoud toe. Geen goede voorzieningen betaal je EU45  voor een campersplek en nog EU4.50 elektriciteit voor 1 nacht. Pizza is van karton en daar betaal je nog EU8 voor. Niet te vergeten... om te douchen moet 1 euro betalen voor warm water. En levensgevaarlijk  om te douchen met je slippers de vloer is van plafuis en heel erg glad. Yo nunca mas torno a venir. Muy malo muy caro para las instalaciones  tan precarias como estas
review_translated_text: Everything is too expensive and needs maintenance. No good facilities, you pay EU45 for a camper spot and another EU4.50 for electricity for 1 night. Pizza is made of cardboard and you pay EU8 for that. Not to forget... to shower you have to pay 1 euro for hot water. And life-threatening to shower with your slippers, the floor is made of tile and very slippery. Yo nunca mas torno a venir. Muy malo muy caro for the installations that are precarious as they are

name: Alberto Gutierrez
review_text: Las piscinas son un lugar agradable para pasar el dia en pareja o amigos, diferentes piscinas y la mar de divertidas
review_translated_text: The pools are a nice place to spend the day with your partner or friends, different pools and a lot of fun.

name: Francisco Javier Pineda Trossell
review_text: Lugar a solo 20 min. De Burgos, sitio bastante ideal para ir en Familia. Piscina de varias profundidades para grandes y pequenos, toboganes cascadas etc. Areas para picnic y ademas amplio. Recomendado para escapadas de fin de semana, tiene el Bar con buena carta y ademas si asi lo prefieres puedes llevar tus bebidas y snack. Hay areas de Cabanas y de autocaravanas. Precios bien solidarios. Si algo podrian mejorar seria detalles minimos en cuanto a mantenimiento en areas y servicios. Algo de pintura y senalizacion. Del resto muy agradable.
review_translated_text: Place just 20 min. From Burgos, a very ideal place to go with your family. Swimming pool of various depths for adults and children, waterfall slides, etc. Picnic areas and also spacious. Recommended for weekend getaways, it has a Bar with a good menu and if you prefer you can bring your drinks and snacks. There are areas for cabins and motorhomes. Very supportive prices. If they could improve something it would be minimal details regarding maintenance in areas and services. Some paint and signage. The rest is very pleasant.

name: Elizabeth Esquitin
review_text: Descuidado. Para lo que cobran, podrian invertir en mantenimiento.
review_translated_text: Careless. For what they charge, they could invest in maintenance.

name: audrey riccardi
review_text: Accueil sympathique et personnel aussi camping spacieux et ils louent aussi des chambres 2 piscines avec des jeux ideal pour les enfants
review_translated_text: Friendly welcome and staff also spacious campsite and they also rent rooms 2 swimming pools with games ideal for children

name: MARTA IZQUIERDO
review_text: Ideal para ir con ninos, las piscinas son una maravilla para ellos y para los mayores. Las raciones que sirven son grandes y muy buenas. Y los bocadillos imposibles de mejorar. Encantados con la estancia. Volveremos en cuanto tengamos ocasion de hacerlo.
review_translated_text: Ideal to go with children, the pools are wonderful for them and for the adults. The portions they serve are large and very good. And the sandwiches impossible to improve. Delighted with the stay. We will return as soon as we have the opportunity to do so.

name: Josin Garcia
review_text: Yo creo que se donde volver el ano que viene.
review_translated_text: I think I know where to go back next year.

name: Maria Angeles Pueyo Gastelua
review_text: Me encanta el sitio y el trato personal muy bueno
review_translated_text: I love the place and the personal treatment is very good

name: Maria Cifuentes
review_text: Las habitaciones del motel son muy incomodas. Y abren muy tarde para el desayuno. La limpieza no es muy profunda
review_translated_text: The motel rooms are very uncomfortable. And they open very late for breakfast. Cleaning isn't very thorough.

name: Dirk I.
review_text: Wir haben jetzt, im Juli 2019, das zweite mal hier ubernachtet und waren beide male (04/2018 + 07/2019) sehr zufrieden. Das Zimmer (12) war stets sehr sauber.  Eine Heizung ist vorhanden. In der Hauptsaison ist das schone Freibad geoffnet und der Eintritt ist fur Hotelgaste kostenlos.
review_translated_text: We stayed here for the second time in July 2019 and were very satisfied both times (April 2018 and July 2019). The room (room 12) was always very clean. Heating is available. The beautiful outdoor pool is open during peak season, and admission is free for hotel guests.

name: Angel Rodriguez
review_text: Nos acercamos desde Burgos capital porque esta a un paso. Las instalaciones no estan nada mal oensadas pero necesitan mucho mantenimiento para el precio que cobran. Si estuvieran mejor cuidadas o acorde a su mantenimiento cobradas, con lo cerca que esta de Burgos y su alfoz estarian llenas en verano
review_translated_text: We approach from Burgos capital because it is just a step away. The facilities are not bad at all but they need a lot of maintenance for the price they charge. If they were better cared for or according to their maintenance charges, with how close it is to Burgos and its alfoz they would be full in summer

name: Ruben C
review_text: Camping categoria baja para el precio que tiene, las duchas a 1EU sale un chorro de agua, los servicios sin papel, las parcelas no estan del todo mal con mucha sombra, las piscinas estan bien varios toboganes para el disfrute de los ninos, el mantenimiento deja que desear apenas 2 socorristas, los toboganes anticuados y deteriorados, lo unico ha salvar es el trato del personal
review_translated_text: Low category campsite for the price, the showers for EU1 have a stream of water, the services are paperless, the pitches are not bad at all with a lot of shade, the pools are good, several slides for the children to enjoy, the maintenance leaves something to be desired, just 2 lifeguards, the slides are outdated and deteriorated, the only saving grace is the treatment of the staff.

name: Francois BOITEL
review_text: Arret pour 1 nuit voisin parti parce que pas d'eau chaude douche payante toilettes fermes hier soir cher pour les prestations !
review_translated_text: Stopped for 1 night, neighbor left because of no hot water, paid shower, toilets closed last night, expensive for the services!

name: Andrea Mompo
review_text: Es la segunda vez que voy xq es exquisita la atencion del personal y hacia nuestras mascotas! No he podido disfrutar de las super piscinas ya que ha coincido la estancia cn lluvia, pero volvere sin duda. PERFECTO CALIDAD PRECIO
review_translated_text: This is my second visit because the staff and our pets are so attentive! I wasn't able to enjoy the superb pools because it was raining during my stay, but I will definitely be back. GREAT VALUE FOR MONEY

name: raquel gonzalez
review_text: Hoy me ha dado mucha pena, tras 3 anos consecutivos ibamos a esas piscinas y hoy hemos decidido no volver mas; el agua casi esta verde las duchas de las piscinas llenas de suciedad e incluso moho. Los toboganes tienen la pintura rota y se cortan o se pueden romper el pantalon,  de hecho lo hemos visto. Bueno en general un sitio que puede ser estupendo por todos sus toboganes y piscinas, pero con esa suciedad y deterioro no volvemos.
review_translated_text: Today I was very sad, after 3 consecutive years we went to those pools and today we have decided not to return again; The water is almost green, the pool showers are full of dirt and even mold. The slides have broken paint and they cut or can tear their pants, in fact we have seen it. Well, in general, a place that can be great for all its slides and pools, but with that dirt and deterioration we won't return.

name: Antonio Blanco
review_text: Tetrico

name: Sergio Martinez
review_text: Esta genial y buen trato
review_translated_text: It's great and good treatment

name: Josu Martin
review_text: Esta muy bien para unos dias con ninos, muchas piscinas y un bar con bocatas y raciones a un precio razonable. Relacion calidad precio muy buena. Todos son muy atentos y familiares.
review_translated_text: It is very good for a few days with children, many swimming pools and a bar with sandwiches and portions at a reasonable price. Very good quality-price ratio. Everyone is very attentive and familiar.

name: Loliynataly
review_text: Las piscinas estan super guai,
review_translated_text: The pools are super cool,

name: Errakel Esteban
review_text: Buen sitio para pasar un fin de semana en familia y con animales . Las piscinas te hacen disfrutar de este camping. Los perretes estan bastante agusto, parcelas separadas con setos y bastante amplitud, con un aceso en la parte trasera, a un camino de parcelaria donde se pueden dar un buen paseo .La parte mala  del camping es dispone de agua caliente mediante pago de 1EU 12min. Y la limpieza es un poco por encima . Nosotros venimos con autocaravana y decidimos usar nuestro bano y ducha
review_translated_text: Good place to spend a weekend with family and animals. The swimming pools make you enjoy this campsite. The dogs are quite comfortable, separated plots with hedges and quite spacious, with an access at the back, to a field path where you can take a good walk. The bad part of the campsite is that it has hot water for a payment of EU1 12min. And the cleanliness is a bit above. We came with a motorhome and decided to use our bathroom and shower

name: Neftmero "Nefty"
review_text: Buen sitio....
review_translated_text: Good place....

name: Javier Imaz
review_text:
Vaya por delante que la comida no era mala pero el servicio...
El bano indica que cobra 0.5EU si no eres cliente pero resulta que no hay jabon, no hay papel y sale un chorrito de agua del grifo... Ya que cobras da algo a cambio, no?
Te cobran por adelantado y te dejan la comanda en la barra. Sera coincidencia pero en la panera habia 2 panes de hoy y el resto de ayer o antes de ayer. Como anecdota, eramos tres en la mesa y al pedir la bebida, una botella de agua para la mesa, nos dice: te doy dos vasos? En fin, ha sido gracioso. Nos ha dado para comentar un rato.
review_translated_text:
Go ahead, the food was not bad but the service...
The bathroom indicates that it charges EU0.5 if you are not a customer but it turns out that there is no soap, there is no paper and a trickle of water comes out of the tap... Since you charge, you give something in return, right?
They charge you in advance and leave your order at the bar. It may be a coincidence but in the bread basket there were 2 loaves from today and the rest from yesterday or the day before yesterday. As an anecdote, there were three of us at the table and when we ordered the drink, a bottle of water for the table, he told us: can I give you two glasses? Anyway, it was funny. He gave us a while to comment.

name: Itziar Gallego Demiguel
review_text: Un lugar donde ir con ninos y mascotas para relajarse ,el trato hacia el cliente es muy hogareno  , esta muy centrico para visitar museos y hacer senderismo
review_translated_text: A place to go with children and pets to relax, the customer service is very homely, it is very central to visit museums and go hiking

name: Nuria Maria Garcia Gordillo (Nuria)
review_text: Espectacular el parque acuatico
review_translated_text: Spectacular water park

name: Andoni Zabala Bolumburu
review_text: Para pasar un dia de piscina, Con un minimo de limpieza, me acostumbre a ducharme con telaranas, y un minimo de mantenimiento seria de notable. El agua de las piscinas no debe depurar lo suficiente para la cantidad de gente que estabamos y las medidas de seguridad no son su fuerte. Para gente sin remilgos. Los toboganes hicieron su funcion, nos lo pasamos bien.
review_translated_text: To spend a day at the pool, With a minimum of cleaning, I got used to showering with cobwebs, and a minimum of maintenance would be notable. The water in the pools must not be purified enough for the number of people we were there and safety measures are not their strong point. For people without squeamishness. The slides did their job, we had a good time.

review_text: Tres mauvaise experience. Poste electrique non conforme. Poste de vidange pour ccar inexistant. Aucun point d eau. Tout ca pour la somme de 7EU20 la nuit. Pas d accueil avant 10 h le matin. Par personne 4EU50 et 1EUla douche chaude 12mn.... A eviter.. Dommage assez bien situe pour se poser une nuit..

No reception before 10 a.m. in the morning. Per person 4EU50 and 1EU for a hot shower 12 minutes.... Avoid.. Too bad, quite well located to stay for a night..

The people are nice but the campsite is very neglected, the sinks are in poor condition, many spider webs everywhere and no hot water, and the bathrooms, if you want to shower with hot water, cost one euro.
I expected something else.

review_text: Increible
review_translated_text: Incredible

review_text: Esta muy bien

name: Fernando Orge
review_text: Camping muy desatendido, falta de personal para su mantenimiento. Todo esta muy viejo y desatendido. Los banos carecen de un orden de limpieza. Las piscinas son lo mejor aunque el mantenimiento tambien deja mucho que desear. Es caro por lo que ofrecen aunque el trato es agradable. El camping queda totalmente a desmano de todo y si llevas bicicletas para moverte tambien te cobran, esto ultimo creo que es un poco abuso.
review_translated_text: Very neglected campsite, lack of personnel for its maintenance. Everything is very old and neglected. The bathrooms lack a cleanliness order. The pools are the best although the maintenance also leaves a lot to be desired. It is expensive for what they offer although the service is pleasant. The campsite is completely far from everything and if you bring bicycles to get around they also charge you, the latter I think is a bit of an abuse.

name: Patricia Vicente
review_text:
Paramos aqui porque vimos a piscina da estrada quando estavamos a ir para Burgos.
O parque tem tudo para ter 5* mas perde pelo cuidado. As casas de banha nao estao em condicoes e tem de se pagar 1EU pelo duche quente. O restaurante serve comida congelada e e um bocado demorado.
Dei 3* pela piscina.
review_translated_text:
We stopped here because we saw the swimming pool from the road when we were heading to Burgos.
The park has everything it needs to be rated 5* but it loses out due to the lack of maintenance. The bathrooms are not in good condition and you have to pay EU1 for a hot shower. The restaurant serves frozen food and is a bit slow.
I gave the swimming pool a 3*.

name: ziggynimes30
review_text: Espace aquatique sympa.|L hotel est vraiment vetuste, sdb limite avec douche qui fuie....|La literie est assez moyenne et la proprete est juste convenable.|Le restaurant est simplement pas bon, mauvaise cuisine, frites surgeles, desserts industriels... |
review_translated_text: Nice aquatic area.|The hotel is really old, borderline bathroom with a leaking shower....|The bedding is quite average and the cleanliness is just okay.|The restaurant is simply not good, bad food, frozen fries, industrial desserts... |

name: Mario Sagredo
review_text: Tienen unas piscinas de 10
review_translated_text: They have swimming pools of 10

name: Rafael Jaime Gimenez Carazo
review_text: Sitio muy tranquilo, y la idea de montar un parque acuatico es Top. Solo fuimos a conocer el sitio en una visita de un dia y volveremos para pasar 2 o 3 dias. A los chicos les encanto. Los duenos gente cercana y afable.
review_translated_text: Very quiet place, and the idea of   setting up a water park is Top. We only went to see the site on a one-day visit and we will return to spend 2 or 3 days. The boys loved it. The owners are close and friendly people.

name: Yose Molina Almoguera
review_text: Piscina muy bonitas pero frias y si te quieres duchar con agua caliente tienes que pagar 1EU y tienes 12minutos
review_translated_text: Very nice pool but cold and if you want to shower with hot water you have to pay EU1 and you have 12 minutes

name: Xalyma Ma
review_text: Esta todo muy limpio,los duenos muy majos,menos una camarera morena que parece que esta siempre enfadada y es una borde!las habitaciones muy bien, nosotros cogimos tiempo malo, las piscinas muy bien genial para los ninos.El menu demasiado caro para comer hay que tirarse a bocata.el desayuno pasable.
review_translated_text: Everything is very clean, the owners are very nice, except for a dark-haired waitress who seems to be always angry and is a bitch! The rooms are very good, we had bad weather, the pools are very good, great for the children. The menu is too expensive to eat, you have to go for a sandwich. The breakfast is passable.

name: Angeles herrero rodriguez
review_text: Muy bien. Piscina chula
review_translated_text: Very good. Cool pool.

name: Susana R.
review_text: Volvemos todos los anos aunque los precios de las piscinas me parecen un poco caros.
review_translated_text: We come back every year, although the pool prices seem a bit expensive to me.

name: Pedro Laginha
review_text: The staff was friendly but apart from that there isn't much good to say. Not a good experience for me and on a next road trip I will plan to avoid this hotel. I booked 2 rooms for my family. One smelled of urine and the bed sheets had a lingering smell of tobacco. In the other room the shower head had nothing to hang it on and the shower drain was clogged. As the water level raised in it some sort of dirty foam started floating. There was only shower gel in the rooms (no shampoo) and even that was in extremely short supply; each of the miniscule packs was not enough for one person to wash themselves. On this trip through France, Spain and Portugal we had incredibly better stays for almost half of the price we paid for this one.

name: carolinehL1765HX
review_text: Chambre particulierement vetuste. Douche bouchee. Pommeau de douche involontairement multijets ! Television mal placee. La WI FI fonctionne pas. Du salpetre ou je ne sais quoi tombe des murs. Pas de vue sur l'exterieur. Mauvaise odeur. Ne vaut absolument pas 65 EU la nuit ! A fuir !!!
review_translated_text: Particularly dilapidated room. Blocked shower. Unintentionally multi-jet shower head! Poorly positioned television. Wi-Fi doesn't work. Saltpeter or something is falling from the walls. No view of the outside. Bad smell. Absolutely not worth EU65 a night! Avoid!!!

name: Rosa Cald
review_text: Muy buen lugar para ir en familia
review_translated_text: Very good place to go with family

name: Pedro M Miguelez
review_text: Ha mejorado mucho desde la ultima vez. La zona de cesped mas cuidada, nuevos toboganes, ideal para pasar el dia con los ninos.
review_translated_text: It's improved a lot since last time. The lawn is more manicured, and there are new slides, perfect for spending the day with the kids.

name: Eduardo Murciano Garcia
review_text: Los trabajadores son el alma de este lugar. Con su amabilidad lo hacen 5 estrellas
review_translated_text: The staff are the soul of this place. Their kindness makes it a 5-star hotel.

name: ENRIQUE GOMEZ
review_text: Hoy hemos estado disfrutando de las piscinas y los toboganes acuaticos, y como no habia demasiada gente he podido disfrutar los hasta terminar agotado de tanto utilizarlos.
review_translated_text: Today we enjoyed the pools and water slides, and since there weren't too many people, I was able to enjoy them until I was exhausted from using them so much.

name: David C
review_text:
Es un camping que al lado tiene unas piscinas con toboganes para ninos y adultos.
Hay servicio de restaurante tambien puedes llevar la comida.
A disfrutar de ellas!!!
review_translated_text:
It is a campsite that next door has swimming pools with slides for children and adults.
There is restaurant service you can also bring food.
Enjoy them!!!

name: Sara Rodriguez
review_text: El lugar es ideal. Y la atencion excelente. Lo recomendamos. Ha sido una sorpresa amanecer en este rincon del mundo.
review_translated_text: The location is ideal. And the service is excellent. We recommend it. It was a surprise to wake up in this corner of the world.

name: Solene Seynhaeve
review_text:
Draps propres sol propre dans les chambres mais odeur epouvantable dans les chambres probleme d'egouts surement
Tres genant
review_translated_text:
Clean sheets clean floor in the rooms but terrible smell in the rooms probably sewer problem
Very annoying

name: Anca Detesan
review_text: El camping fenomenal y la zona de las piscinas muy bonito todo. Los duenos muy amables. Por poner una pega los banos del camping no creo que  los ha limpiado los cinco dias que yo estuve.
review_translated_text: The campsite was fantastic, and the pool area was very nice. The owners were very friendly. One drawback: I don't think the campsite bathrooms were cleaned during the five days I was there.

name: Josu Gomez
review_text: Horrible esta todo en mal estado el servicio nefasto fuimos pa dos dias y nos fuimos antes
review_translated_text: Horrible, everything is in poor condition, the service is disastrous. We went for two days and left early.

name: teresags
review_text: Es algo caro para los servicios que presta, si vas de camping esta bien, la zona de piscina es estupenda para los ninos, pero el alojamiento en habitaciones caluroso y algo antiguo
review_translated_text: It is somewhat expensive for the services it provides, if you go camping it is fine, the pool area is great for children, but the accommodation in rooms is hot and somewhat old.

name: Cemi Nady
review_text:
Nous etions au camping. Les emplacements sont bien mais il y a peu de bornes d'electricite.
Super parc aquatique. Par contre les sanitaires sont vraiment sales !!! Et les douches payantes : 1EU les 12 min.....
review_translated_text:
We stayed at the campsite. The pitches are good, but there are few electrical hookups.
Great water park. However, the restrooms are really dirty!!! And the showers cost EU1 for 12 minutes...

name: Rafaela Pizarro
review_text:
Los banos estan muy sucios y mal cuidados muy poco limpieza,  no me importa pagar por ducharme pero limpios claro!!
Las piscinas son superchula pero el agua turbia y mal cuidadas
Con un poco mas de mantenimiento y limpieza estaria genial el camping
review_translated_text:
The bathrooms are very dirty and poorly maintained, very little cleaning, I don't mind paying to shower but clean of course!!
The pools are super cool but the water is cloudy and poorly maintained
With a little more maintenance and cleaning the campsite would be great

name: Pkis Pkis
review_text: El camping muy muy sucio los banos con un olor insoportable sin ningun tipo de higiene desde hace mucho tiempo encima tienes que pagar 1EU en las duchas para agua caliente. Las piscinas el agua muy turbia, manojos de pelos flotantado duchas en mal estado. El entorno esta chulo pero todo esta muy deteriorado es una pena que no lo cuiden. Por una vez esta bien no volveria  nunca.
review_translated_text: The campsite is very, very dirty. The bathrooms have an unbearable smell. They haven't maintained any hygiene for a long time. On top of that, you have to pay EU1 for hot water in the showers. The pools have very cloudy water, clumps of floating hair, and the showers are in poor condition. The surroundings are nice, but everything is in very bad shape. It's a shame they don't take care of it. For once, it's okay. I would never go back.

name: Vallejo (Vallejo)
review_text: Buen camping, buena sombra, te atienden genial, son muy amables los camareros y tiene una piscina muy chula con toboganes donde pasar un buen dia, recomiendo 100%!
review_translated_text: Good camping, good shade, they serve you great, the waiters are very friendly and it has a very cool pool with slides where you can spend a good day, I recommend 100%!

name: Marta o.p
review_text: Me encanta! He ido varios anos y vuelvo a repetir! Los duenos son muy majos y las piscinas son geniales.
review_translated_text: I love it! I've been going for several years and I'll be back! The owners are very nice and the pools are great.

name: Carol M.C
review_text: Agua sucia piscinas carisimas
review_translated_text: Dirty water, very expensive swimming pools

name: Beatriz Lopez
review_text: Si bien la piscina hace las delicias de los ninos, tanto la piscina como el camping estan sucios y mal senalizados. El personal del bar es agradable pero es un sitio caro en comparacion con los servicios prestados y el estado de las instalaciones. No merece la pena ni para pasar una noche.
review_translated_text: Although the pool delights children, both the pool and the campsite are dirty and poorly marked. The bar staff is nice but it is an expensive place compared to the services provided and the state of the facilities. It's not even worth spending one night.

name: Nuria Sole
review_text:
Las instalaciones del camping estan muy sucias.
Para tenen agua caliente en la duchas tienes que pagar, y me reitero, estan muy sucias.
En general, lo justo para pasar una noche.

The campground facilities are very dirty.
You have to pay to get hot water in the showers, and again, they're very dirty.
Overall, just enough for a one-night stay.

name: VICTOR PERDOMO
review_text: Las piscinas son lo mejor del camping
review_translated_text: The swimming pools are the best thing about the campsite

name: Johana Fernandez

review_translated_text: Very special place

name: oscar nunez

review_translated_text: Good charming campsite and very good swimming pools for the little ones. The only bad thing I have seen is that they charge you for the showers.

name: Olga Sarabia
review_text: Un lugar para pasar el dia muy divertido para los peques y no tan peques
review_translated_text: A very fun place to spend the day for the little ones and not so little ones

name: jairo tecno79
review_text: Un sitio fantastico !!! Genial para pasar el dia!!!
review_translated_text: A fantastic site!!! Great to spend the day!!!

name: Raquel San Millan
review_text: El senor que atiende el telefono muy desagradable. He preguntado por una informacion concreta y me ha respondido con malas formas y diciendo "que si, que buscalo en la pagina que ahi viene todo". Una persona asi no deberia estar atendiendo el telefono.
review_translated_text: The man answering the phone was very unpleasant. I asked for specific information, and he responded rudely, saying, "Yes, look it up on the website; everything is listed there." A person like that shouldn't be answering the phone.

name: Paco Mallor
review_text: La atencion excepcional....por lo demas, n3cesita algo mas de mantenimiento y solucionar los problemas de conexion(wifi)
review_translated_text: Exceptional attention....for the rest, it needs a little more maintenance and solving connection problems (wifi).

name: MELANIE FOSTER-SMITH
review_text: Fantastic, family friendly place. Great for camping or motelling. Wonderful swimming pool and lovely staff. Highly recommended.

name: Marga
review_text: Estupendo
review_translated_text: Great

name: Cesar R.A
review_text: Siempre que paso, paro, tomo un cafe, y tiene unas piscinas excelentes, lo recomiendo a toda la gente
review_translated_text: Every time I pass by, I stop, have a coffee, and it has excellent pools, I recommend it to all people

name: Leyre Guillen
review_text: El camping es sencillo. Hay bastante sombra. Las piscinas estan muy bien. Las instalaciones poco limpias. El trato muy bueno.
review_translated_text: Camping is simple. There is plenty of shade. The pools are very good. The facilities are not very clean. Very good treatment.

name: david alcalde velasco
review_text: Un sitio genial y super trankilo
review_translated_text: A great and super quiet place

name: Gerd Bex
review_text: Kamers beetje vochtig en ouderwets maar net en zeker hun prijs waard. Zeer goed voor overnachting op doorreis. Vriendelijk onthaal. Het menu was niet zo geslaagd maar de kleine gerechten in de bar waren voortreffelijk.
review_translated_text: Rooms a bit damp and old fashioned but clean and certainly worth their price. Very good for an overnight stay on the way. Friendly welcome. The menu was not so successful but the small dishes in the bar were excellent.

name: Dirk Genar
review_text:
Te duur, je moet ook betalen voor een fiets !
Sanitair is slecht onderhouden.
Restaurant is wel goed en niet te duur.
review_translated_text:
Too expensive, you also have to pay for a bike!
Sanitary facilities are poorly maintained.
Restaurant is good and not too expensive.

name: didier BZH
review_text: Bien mais pas de petit dejeuner avant 10h le dimanche
review_translated_text: Good but no breakfast before 10am on Sundays

name: Salva
review_text: PEOR IMPOSIBLE. Banos que no se puede uno agusto. Telaranas XXXL, parcelas embarradas. Parque infantil de los anos 70 u 80 y encima con roturas por todos lados. El personal muy bien. Pero las instalaciones, solo se salva un poco la piscina.
review_translated_text: WORSE IMPOSSIBLE. Bathrooms that you can't get comfortable with. XXXL cobwebs, muddy plots. Playground from the 70s or 80s and on top of that with tears everywhere. The staff very good. But the facilities, only the pool is saved a little.

name: Diego Garcia
review_text: Hay parking grande
review_translated_text: There is a large parking lot

review_text:
Personal muy atento y agradable, dispuesto a ayudar en todo momento.

Ambiente familiar y bastante tranquilo. Aunque algo antiguo, es acogedor y las habitaciones estan bien cuidadas.

No hay que olvidar que se trata de un dos estrellas, por lo que tampoco esperes un mar de comodidades. Sino mas bien un sitio donde descansar.
review_translated_text:
Very attentive and pleasant staff, ready to help at all times.

Family and quite quiet atmosphere. Although somewhat old, it is cozy and the rooms are well maintained.

We must not forget that it is a two-star hotel, so do not expect a sea of   comforts. But rather a place to rest.
