review_text: Camping  familiar las chicas de recepcion  muy amables.
review_translated_text: Family campsite, the reception girls were very friendly.

name: 539russw
review_text: After a very long drive we stayed here,the bar area was so dusty,there was dust everywhere!!!,The owner showed us to our room and it was spotless and when you closed the windows/blinds it was total darkness as we laid in the next morning but didn't mind,Oh and it was so quite,||The shower was useless as just gushed out all over the place but we didn't mind as were tired,||We had some dinner in the bar area and even the table we sat at was dirty but with all the old bottles and the building being very old the dust looked at home,

name: ANNICK RIBEIRO
review_text: Camping d'etape
review_translated_text: Stopover campsite

name: Ana Maria Ibanez
review_text: Camping muy chulo y con piscinas con toboganes para los ninos, lo malo que esta todo muy descuidado. Banos sucios y rotos, parcelas sin cuidar, a pesar de ser chula la piscina, el cesped esta muy descuidado y sucio de la gente que se acerca a pasar el dia.  En el bar, donde venden pan, a las 9 y media de la manana, aun no tenian el pan listo.
review_translated_text: Very cool campsite with swimming pools with slides for the children, the bad thing is that everything is very neglected. Dirty and broken bathrooms, unkept plots, despite the pool being cool, the grass is very neglected and dirty from the people who come to spend the day.  At the bar, where they sell bread, at 9:30 in the morning, they still didn't have the bread ready.

name: JOSE MARIA B D
review_text: Pobre para ser un camping con hotel
review_translated_text: Poor for a campsite with a hotel

name: Florian Bichet
review_text: Fuyez ! Situe entre une autoroute et une nationale : difficile de dormir! Sanitaires recents mais absolument pas entretenus : eviers bouches, douches froides ou brulantes et sans evacuation pour certaines, wc non desinfectes pendant plusieurs jours. Tarif plutot eleve pour le niveau de prestation! Bref, meme pour une nuit, l'escale reste difficile a vivre!
review_translated_text: Run away! Located between a highway and a national road: difficult to sleep! Recent but absolutely not maintained toilets: clogged sinks, cold or scalding showers and without drainage for some, toilets not disinfected for several days. Prices rather high for the level of service! In short, even for one night, the stopover remains difficult to live with!

name: Sergio Sam Tres
review_text:
Muy dejado todo.
Veinte vateres. Y todos rotos sucios y ninguno con papel.
Las parcelas sin cesped. Todas llenas de gravilla y cigarrillos viejos.
No hay basuras.
Poca agua caliente en las duchas y ninguna en las fregaderas.
La gente maja y silencio.
Las piscinas bastante bien.
22EU parcela y dos adultos
review_translated_text:
Everything is very neglected.
Twenty toilets. All broken and dirty, and none with toilet paper.
The pitches are grassless. All filled with gravel and old cigarette butts.
There's no trash.
Little hot water in the showers and none in the sinks.
The people are nice and quiet.
The pools are pretty good.
EU22 for a pitch and two adults.

name: Abel Gonzalez
review_text: Esperaba mas
review_translated_text: I expected more

name: Marta Hernaiz
review_text: Esta muy entretenido.
review_translated_text: It's very entertaining.

name: Oscar Crespo
review_text:
Positivo: Buena gente. Bonitos detalles. Toboganes chulos...
Negativo: Zonas abandonadas. Banos del camping deteriorados y sucios. Dejadez en general...
A pesar de todo, mis hijos se lo pasaron bomba que es lo que cuenta y yo tendre que guardarme mis escrupulos porque quieren volver.
review_translated_text:
Positive: Good people. Nice details. Cool slides...
Negative: Abandoned areas. Campsite bathrooms deteriorated and dirty. General laziness...
Despite everything, my children had a blast, which is what counts and I will have to keep my scruples to myself because they want to return.

name: Edna Filipa Melo Moreira
review_text:

name: Ramon Bab
review_text: One of the best camping I have ever been to .....

name: Juana Castejon
review_text: El camping.es.mediocre, las parcelas muy amplias y con sombra, es lo mejor que tiene, lo demas deberia mejorar.
review_translated_text: The camping is mediocre, the very large and shady pitches, is the best it has, the rest should improve.

name: Leyre "Leyre" Lerga Ibarlucea
review_text: En realidad fui a las piscinas, que estan muy bien para pasar un agradable dia de verano. Hay varias piscinas y varios toboganes, y sitio para tomar el sol, incluso mesas para poder comer tranquilamente, por lo que son ideales para un dia divertido en familia. Tambien hay bar y disponen de vestuarios y duchas.
review_translated_text: I actually went to the pools, which are a great place to spend a pleasant summer day. There are several pools and several slides, and a place to sunbathe, even tables for relaxing, making them ideal for a fun family day. There's also a bar and changing rooms and showers.

name: Marco Innocenti
review_text: Pessimo,  considerate un posto di fortuna solo x la notte,  non cenate mi raccomando!  Ampie piazzale ma sporche da escrementi di cane
review_translated_text: Terrible, consider it a makeshift place only for the night, don't have dinner please!  Large square but dirty with dog excrement

name: Julio Rodriguez
review_text: Muy familiar, impresionantes piscinas, un poco antiguo, pero buenos bungalows y servicio.
review_translated_text: Very familiar, impressive pools, a little old, but good bungalows and service.

name: Javi
review_text: Esta muy bien para ir con ninos, pero lo encuentro un poco descuidado. Hay zonas averiadas que no se arreglan, por lo que calidad precio lo veo descompensado. Por lo demas un sitio donde pasar el rato.
review_translated_text: It is very good to go with children, but I find it a little neglected. There are damaged areas that are not fixed, so I see the quality/price ratio as unbalanced. Otherwise a place to hang out.

name: Peter Theofiel Deckx
review_text:
Carisima, mas interesados en el movil que en los clientes. Menu muy basico por 12.50 euros !! Bocadillo pan muy duro y "viejo". Personal no amable y con ropas para hacer obras. NO PARA AQUI! !
STAY AWAY !!!
review_translated_text:
Very expensive, more interested in their phones than their customers. A very basic menu for 12.50 euros! The sandwiches were made with very hard, "old" bread. Unfriendly staff, dressed for construction. DO NOT STOP HERE! !
STAY AWAY !!!

name: orlando hernandez
review_text: MUY BUENAS PISCINAS
review_translated_text: VERY GOOD POOLS

name: bea fervi
review_text: Hemos estado 5 dias. Y lo recomiendo!!! Los duenos super majos, mejor imposible. Las bungalows estan perfectas y los toboganes impresionantes!!  Hay variedad, para todas las edades, puedes meter comida mesas sillas y pasar alli todo el dia. Para el precio que es en mas que un 10. Nosotros hemos ido con una nina de 8 anos y un bebe de 10 meses y volveremos seguro. Nada que ver los comentarios que pone. Alguna gente. Te desaniman y no es asi para nada.
review_translated_text: We have been there 5 days. And I recommend it!!! The owners are super nice, it couldn't be better. The bungalows are perfect and the slides are impressive!!  There is variety, for all ages, you can put food, tables, chairs and spend the whole day there. For the price, it is more than a 10. We have gone with an 8-year-old girl and a 10-month-old baby and we will return for sure. Nothing to do with the comments you post. Some people. They discourage you and that's not the case at all.

name: ruth garom
review_text: Super caro para lo que es. Cesped fatal cuidado, no estan abiertas todas las piscinas disponibles. Y lo peor de todo es que hay PULGAS, si, si, habeis leido bien, pulgas. Nada recomendable.
review_translated_text: Super expensive for what it is. Terribly maintained lawns, not all available pools are open. And worst of all, there are fleas--yes, you read that right, fleas. Not recommended at all.

name: francisco merchan
review_text: Buena comida, buena piscina y buen trato
review_translated_text: Good food, good pool and good treatment

name: Ruben Barriuso
review_text: Sin duda sus piscinas son las mejores!
review_translated_text: Without a doubt their pools are the best!

name: vanda jesus
review_text:
Bom acolhimento , lugar tranquilo , os donos muito simpaticos , afaveis e muito acessiveis . Uma boa piscina bons precos .
Quando faco a viagem Suica / Portugal com a minha familia e o sitio onde todos querem parar para passar a noite .
Espero voltar este ano e que a rececao seja a mesma . E os valores tambem.
E um lugar diferente mas de bom gosto .
Obrigado pelo acolhimento .
Recomendo dou 5 estrelas
review_translated_text:
Good hospitality, quiet place, very friendly, affable and approachable owners. A good pool and good prices.
When I travel from Switzerland to Portugal with my family, this is the place where everyone wants to stop for the night.
I hope to return this year and that the reception will be the same. And the prices too.
It's a different place but with good taste.
Thank you for the welcome.
I recommend it and give it 5 stars

name: JOSE LUIS LOPEZ
review_text: Soy camionero y realice mi descanso reducido de 24h en estas instalaciones, el personal es agradable y servicial, la comida muy buena acorde con el precio si tuviera que parar de nuevo en esta zona seria aqui mismo, tienen merendero en el exterior del camping con una fuente de la montana, pienso volver en verano para pasar unos dias con mi mujer, y una cosa mas, por favor si reclamais limpieza ser limpios, ordenados y aseados en las instalaciones todos hacemos usos de ellos y queremos encontrar las cosas limpias, por favor si quereis limpieza dejar limpio los espacios que utiliceis
review_translated_text: I am a truck driver and I took my short 24-hour break in these facilities, the staff is pleasant and helpful, the food is very good in line with the price. If I had to stop in this area again it would be right here. They have a picnic area outside the campsite with a mountain fountain. I plan to return in the summer to spend a few days with my wife. If you want cleaning, leave the spaces you use clean.

name: Sally Davies
review_text: Always good. Always friendly. We always return!

name: Adrian Dewambrechies
review_text: Servicio muy bueno, y sitio agradable para descansar un rato.
review_translated_text: Very good service, and a nice place to rest for a while.

name: SILVIA Sin mas
review_text: En verano las piscinas son impresionantes. Se esta muy bien.
review_translated_text: In summer, the pools are impressive. It's a great place.

name: Carol Rod
review_text: Muy buena idea el mini aqua Park para familias
review_translated_text: The mini aqua park is a very good idea for families.

name: Lorena Vidal
review_text: E pasado una noche en este camping y no volveria ni pagandome,solo se preocupan de la piscina,el camping esta totalmente abandonado,los banos llevan anos sin ver una fregona,telaranas y suciedad x todas partes,las duchas con pelos y suciedad de no haberse limpiado en muchos meses x no decir anos,el parqe infantil con chapas,palets,maderos......un vertedero,vamos.......asqeroso,nada recomendable
review_translated_text: I spent one night at this campsite and I wouldn't go back even if I paid for it, they only care about the pool, the campsite is completely abandoned, the bathrooms haven't seen a mop in years, cobwebs and dirt everywhere, the showers with hair and dirt from not having been cleaned in many months, not to mention years, the playground with sheets, pallets, wood......a landfill, come on.....disgusting, not recommended at all

name: Eva Personal
review_text: Las piscinas son increibles, se esta muy bien y el trato es agradable. Ideal para ninos y mayores.
review_translated_text: The pools are incredible, it is very good and the treatment is pleasant. Ideal for children and adults.

name: Laura Gadea

review_translated_text: dry grass

review_text: Accueil chaleureux. Lieux agreables  .super////////
review_translated_text: Warm welcome. Pleasant places.super////////

review_text: Unas piscinas muy buenas
review_translated_text: Some very good pools

name: rdrg
review_text: Tiene unas piscinas muy buenas con toboganes pero el camping es un poco cutre
review_translated_text: It has some very good pools with slides but the campsite is a bit shabby.

name: Enrique Curiel Sanz
review_text: Estuvimos en las piscinas. Estan muy bien para pasar el dia. Toboganes grandes para mayores y mas pequenos para los ninos. Buen vestuario con banos y duchas. Muy bien en general. El agua esta muy fria pero limpisima.
review_translated_text: We were in the pools. They are very good to spend the day. Large slides for adults and smaller ones for children. Good changing room with bathrooms and showers. Very good overall. The water is very cold but very clean.

name: sil bur
review_text: Las piscinas muy caras para lo que son, el cesped mal cuidado y seco. Para comer hay que esperar mas de una hora para unos bocadillos, el servicio muy lento, y las instalaciones en general estan sucias y mal cuidadas. Todo lleno de telas de arana. Ni lo recomiendo ni volvere.
review_translated_text: The pools are very expensive for what they are, the grass is poorly maintained and dry. To eat, you have to wait over an hour for sandwiches, the service is very slow, and the facilities in general are dirty and poorly maintained. Everything is covered in cobwebs. I don't recommend it, nor will I return.

name: Jose Santos
review_text: Las piscinas estan bastante bien, pero un poco dejadas, pero bueno es algo diferente a lo que hay en Burgos
review_translated_text: The pools are quite good, but a little neglected, but well it is something different from what there is in Burgos

name: Jimena Maria Pedrosa Arroyo
review_text: Todo perfecto!! Volveremos
review_translated_text: Everything was perfect!! We'll be back!

name: Angel Marino
review_text:
Such an amazing hidden gem in the middle of the province of Burgos. So peaceful and unique, we would love to stay there forever. The interiors are high class, the rooms are a delight, with all you need to disconnect and relax and a beautiful breakfast with fresh produce and local pastries. And the cherry on top of the cake is the lovely Dora, it was such a delight to talk to her.
I seriously recommend this rural accommodation full of surprises.

name: Buidi Mundadi
review_text: Wij hebben enorm genoten van ons verblijf in El Priorato. Het is een uniek pand dat knap werd gerenoveerd en waar authentieke en moderne elementen mooi in balans werden gebracht. El Priorato is gelegen in een rustig dorpje en een moie regio waar je veel andere locaties ook kan bezoeken. Het ontbijt was verzorgd en lekker en de hartelijke ontvangst van Dora was een kers op de taart van ons verblijf.
review_translated_text: We really enjoyed our stay at El Priorato. It is a unique building that has been beautifully renovated and where authentic and modern elements have been beautifully balanced. El Priorato is located in a quiet village and a beautiful region where you can also visit many other locations. The breakfast was well-cared for and delicious and the warm welcome from Dora was the icing on the cake of our stay.

review_text: Fuimos en familia con mi marido y mis hijas a una boda. El alojamiento es espectacular y el trato increible. Contacto en todo momento con el alojamiento para cualquier cosa que puedas necesitar.. Para repetir sin duda.
review_translated_text: My husband, my daughters, and I went as a family to a wedding. The accommodations were spectacular, and the service was incredible. We were always in touch with the property for anything we needed. We would definitely stay again.

name: Jesus Angel
review_text: Un lugar con un encanto muy especial. Tanto el lugar como las habitaciones reflejan el trabajo y dedicacion de la gente que lo ha construido, y que trabaja en su mantenimiento, con una dedicacion exclusiva. Volvere sin ninguna duda

name: Pedro Munoz
review_text: Lugar ideal si buscas una desconexion total del mundo urbano  basada en la tranquilidad y el descanso. La atencion de Dora, aunque se realiza por via whatsapp durante todo el proceso, esta pendiente en todo momento de facilitarte la llegada y la estancia enviandote instrucciones claras de como alojarte, asi como de opciones de visitas y oferta gastronomica en los alrededores. Las habitaciones son confortables, buena cama, buen bano y muy bien insonorizadas. No hay TV ni en las habitaciones ni en los espacios comunes para facilitar el descanso. Por la manana ofrecen un buen desayuno con variedad de productos locales.
review_translated_text: Ideal place if you are looking for a total disconnection from the urban world based on tranquility and rest. Dora's attention, although it is carried out via WhatsApp throughout the process, is available at all times to facilitate your arrival and stay by sending you clear instructions on how to stay, as well as options for visits and gastronomic offerings in the surrounding area. The rooms are comfortable, good bed, good bathroom and very well soundproofed. There is no TV in the rooms or common spaces to facilitate rest. In the morning they offer a good breakfast with a variety of local products.

name: Adolfo Arguelles
review_text:
Muy bonito hotel en un edificio rehabilitado con una buena dosis de creatividad y buen gusto. La habitacion espaciosa y muy comoda con una cama enorme y acogedora. El bano bien y durante la noche no escuchamos el minimo ruido.
Desayuno cuidado, variado y abundante. Dora y su companera muy amables y agradables. Si surge otra oportunidad repetiremos.
review_translated_text:
Very nice hotel in a renovated building with a good dose of creativity and good taste. The room was spacious and very comfortable with a huge and cozy bed. The bathroom was good and during the night we didn't hear the slightest noise.
Careful, varied and abundant breakfast. Dora and her companion very kind and pleasant. If another opportunity arises we will repeat.

name: Fernando Diez Ezquerra
review_text: Un lugar espectacular, 100% recomendable. La intervencion en el edificio es valiente y cuidada hasta el ultimo detalle. La atencion del personal y en concreto de Dora fue excelente. El entorno es preciosos con un monton de lugares que visitar. Como arquitecto fue una delicia poder descubrir cada rincon del edificio y de su decoracion, enhorabuena a todo el equipo!
review_translated_text: A spectacular place, 100% recommended. The intervention in the building is brave and cared for down to the last detail. The attention of the staff and specifically Dora was excellent. The surroundings are beautiful with lots of places to visit. As an architect it was a delight to be able to discover every corner of the building and its decoration, congratulations to the entire team!

name: Angel Poveda
review_text: La habitacion muy comoda y amplia, aunque falta luz en el bano. El desayuno bastante completo. Y la atencion del personal absolutamente familiar.
review_translated_text: The room was very comfortable and spacious, although there was a lack of light in the bathroom. The breakfast is quite complete. And the attention of the absolutely familiar staff.

review_text: Un sitio muy recomendable. Habitaciones muy amplias y comodas. Desayuno magnifico y el personal tambien

name: Rafa Coronas
review_text:
Un antiguo priorato restaurado con un gusto exquisito. Un perfecto equilibrio entre estilo rustico y moderno.
Desayuno riquisimo.
Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text:
An old priory restored with exquisite taste. A perfect balance between rustic and modern style.
Delicious breakfast.
Highly recommended.

name: paco fernandez
review_text:
Lugar con encanto.
Fuimos siete y todos de acuerdo
con estancia y buen trato.
review_translated_text:
Charming place.
There were seven of us and we all agreed
with stay and good treatment.

name: marta caruana montes
review_text: Priorato de Trespaderne es una joya en un entorno espectacular. Desde el momento en que llegas, el personal te hace sentir como en casa con su trato amable y cercano. El desayuno es delicioso, con productos de calidad que hacen que cada manana empiece de la mejor manera. Ademas, los alrededores son perfectos para los amantes de la naturaleza, con rutas impresionantes y paisajes que quitan el aliento. Para los apasionados de la caza, los cotos de corzos son simplemente espectaculares. Sin duda, un lugar para repetir. !100% recomendado!
review_translated_text: Trespaderne Priory is a gem in a spectacular setting. From the moment you arrive, the staff makes you feel at home with their friendly and welcoming approach. The breakfast is delicious, with quality products that make every morning start off on the right foot. The surroundings are perfect for nature lovers, with stunning trails and breathtaking landscapes. For hunting enthusiasts, the roe deer hunting grounds are simply spectacular. Definitely a place to return to. 100% recommended!

name: Juan Carlos Delgado
review_text:
Encantadora casona restaurada o reconstruida sobre un antiguo Priorato conservando la esencia de tiempos pasados en armonia con detalles constructivos y decorativos actuales.
Comodo, acogedor y tranquilo. Aparcas en la puerta y ya estas como en tu casa.
Desayunos sencillos y abundantes priorizando los productos locales y servidos con amabilidad y profesionalidad por Dora "la encantadora" que, desde antes de llegar, ya esta pendiente de cualquier detalle que te pueda ser util.
El plus de la perfeccion seria  que tuvieran un lugar donde ofrecer, por la noche,  cenas ligeras,  despues de pasar el dia recorriendo Las Merindades, dada la poca oferta que hay en el pueblo.
review_translated_text:
Charming house restored or rebuilt on an old Priory, preserving the essence of times past in harmony with current construction and decorative details.
Comfortable, cozy and quiet. You park at the door and you are already at home.
Simple and abundant breakfasts prioritizing local products and served with kindness and professionalism by Dora "the charming" who, even before you arrive, is already attentive to any detail that may be useful to you.
The added bonus of perfection would be that they had a place to offer light dinners at night, after spending the day touring Las Merindades, given the little offering there is in the town.

name: SILVIA LOPEZ
review_text: Alojamiento precioso, muy limpio, trato de Dora inmejorable y desayuno muy bueno.
review_translated_text: Beautiful accommodation, very clean, Dora's treatment was unbeatable, and the breakfast was very good.

name: Isabel Hinojosa Barrera
review_text: El mejor lugar para la relajacion y el descanso
review_translated_text: The best place for relaxation and rest

name: L. Alberto Ayllon
review_text: Una experiencia magnifica en un edificio totalmente restaurado. Buen servicio y habitaciones muy acogedoras.
review_translated_text: A magnificent experience in a completely restored building. Good service and very cozy rooms.

name: Beatriz
review_text: Excelente sitio para desconectar, trato impecable, un lugar maravilloso para pasar un fin de semana.
review_translated_text: Excellent place to disconnect, impeccable treatment, a wonderful place to spend a weekend.

name: Alfonso Regidor
review_text:
Un hotel con encanto. Una construccion increible, complementando la estructura originaria con detalles mas modernos.
Las habitaciones amplias y con vistas espectaculares, muy comodas.
Los espacios comunes, muy bonitos, sensacion de calidez y comodidad.
Los desayunos con productos de la zona, eran buenisimos.
Pero lo mejor de todo, es Dora, quien te atiende y te ayuda incluso antes de llegar, te aconseja, te cuida y hace todo lo posible para que tu estancia sea lo mas agradable posible.
Un lugar donde repetiremos seguro.
review_translated_text:
A charming hotel. An incredible construction, complementing the original structure with more modern details.
The spacious rooms with spectacular views, very comfortable.
The common spaces, very beautiful, feeling of warmth and comfort.
The breakfasts with local products were very good.
But best of all, it is Dora, who takes care of you and helps you even before you arrive, advises you, takes care of you and does everything possible to make your stay as pleasant as possible.
A place where we will repeat for sure.

review_text: Un lugar y servicio increible.

name: Manuel Rodriguez Moure
review_text:
Excelente estancia, las habitaciones son amplias y la cama muy comoda.
El desayuno es un poco sencillo pero muy bueno.
La amabilidad de Dora, tambien excelente.
Si volvemos por la zona, no dudariamos en repetir en el Priorato
review_translated_text:
Excellent stay, the rooms are spacious and the bed very comfortable.
Breakfast is a bit simple but very good.
Dora's kindness, also excellent.
If we return to the area, we would not hesitate to visit the Priorat again.

name: Nekane Bastero
review_text: Toda la casa es increible, decorada con muy buen gusto. No se escucha ningun ruido, el desayuno muy completo y una piscina super bonita (no nos pudimos banar porque es enero)
review_translated_text: The entire house is incredible, decorated with very good taste. You can't hear any noise, the breakfast is very complete and a super nice pool (we couldn't swim because it's January)

name: Alex Dantaes
review_text: Increible hotel rural en un lugar de encanto con una arquitectura impresionante. El trato de Dora excepcional y el desayuno riquisimo y muy rural. Repetire sin duda. Lugar perfecto para alojarte en contacto con la naturaleza y hacerte rutas por los alrededores.
review_translated_text: Incredible rural hotel in a charming place with impressive architecture. Dora's treatment was exceptional and the breakfast was delicious and very rural. I will repeat without a doubt. Perfect place to stay in contact with nature and take routes around the surroundings.

name: rutasd2021
review_text: Un hotel fantastico. Las habitaciones muy comodas y las zonas comunes y el servicio excelentes.  El desayuno muy bueno.  Tiene piscina que no pudimos usar. Trespaderne es un pueblo muy bonito, muchas cosas que hacer en la zona. Seguro que repetiremos
review_translated_text: A fantastic hotel. The rooms were very comfortable, the common areas and service excellent. The breakfast was very good. It has a pool, which we couldn't use. Trespaderne is a very pretty town, with lots to do in the area. We'll definitely be back.

name: Vintage Spain (rutasdevino)
review_text: Un alojamiento fantastico. Las habitaciones muy bien, y las zonas comunes impresionantes, asi como la atencion. Seguro que repetimos,
review_translated_text: Fantastic accommodation. The rooms were very nice, the common areas were impressive, as was the service. We'll definitely be back.

name: alvaro alvarado
review_text: Un hotel con mezcla moderna y mediaval, excelente servicio, habitaciones comodas, amplias y mu limpias, sin duda volveria.
review_translated_text: A hotel with a mix of modern and medieval, excellent service, comfortable, spacious and very clean rooms, I would definitely return.

name: Fernando Espinosa de los Monteros
review_text: Una delicia de sitio. Sorprendente por su diseno arquitectonico, magnifico, donde se hace convivir de forma elegante lo nuevo con lo antiguo, unos salones acogedores y comodos. Un espacio para cocinar precioso donde los desayunos son estupendos con producto local bueno. Unas habitaciones tranquilas y acogedores, donde la luz para leer en la cama se puede mejorar... El servicio que te atiende Dora es magnifico. Enhorabuena un gran hotel.
review_translated_text: A delightful place. Surprising for its magnificent architectural design, where the new and the old coexist elegantly, with cozy and comfortable lounges. A beautiful cooking space where breakfasts are superb with good local produce. The rooms are quiet and cozy, where the lighting for reading in bed could be improved... The service provided by Dora is magnificent. Congratulations on a great hotel.

name: Javier PU
review_text: Una arquitectura fantastica, llena de detalles, una atencion cuidada y atenta, y un desayuno memorable para una casa apta para una estancia cualquier epoca del ano. Estuvimos en dias de frio y niebla y el suelo radiante ayudo a asegurar aseguro al maximo el confort.
review_translated_text: Fantastic architecture, full of details, thoughtful and attentive service, and a memorable breakfast for a house suitable for a stay any time of year. We stayed on cold, foggy days, and the underfloor heating helped ensure maximum comfort.

name: Nacho Useros
review_text: Experiencia unica. Arquitectura en interiorismo de 10, ubicacion perfecta para descubrir toda la zona. Y por supuesto la parte humana, Dora pendiente de todo constantemente. Totalmente recomendable
review_translated_text: A unique experience. 10/10 interior design, perfect location for exploring the entire area. And of course, the human touch: Dora is constantly on hand to help. Highly recommended.

name: Juan Gurrea Rumeu
review_text:
El Priorato de Trespaderne es un lugar unico, que fusiona la elegancia historica con el confort moderno. Al llegar, te recibe la imponente casa senorial de piedra, que evoca siglos de historia y tradicion, pero la verdadera magia comienza al cruzar su umbral. Cada rincon ha sido disenado con una sensibilidad que logra envolver todos los sentidos; la arquitectura, los materiales y la decoracion estan pensados para transportar a los huespedes a una experiencia de tranquilidad y desconexion total.

Uno de los momentos mas destacados es el desayuno: una deliciosa variedad de productos frescos y de proximidad, que reflejan el sabor autentico de la region. Este detalle no solo enriquece la estancia, sino que tambien anade un toque genuino de la gastronomia local.

El Priorato de Trespaderne es ideal para cualquier tipo de escapada, ya sea romantica, en familia o entre amigos. Su entorno sereno y cuidadosamente ambientado garantiza una estancia memorable que deja deseos de volver.
review_translated_text:
Trespaderne Priory is a unique place, fusing historic elegance with modern comfort. Upon arrival, you are greeted by the imposing stone manor house, which evokes centuries of history and tradition, but the real magic begins when you cross its threshold. Each corner has been designed with a sensitivity that manages to involve all the senses; The architecture, materials and decoration are designed to transport guests to an experience of tranquility and total disconnection.

One of the highlights is breakfast: a delicious variety of fresh, local products that reflect the authentic flavor of the region. This detail not only enriches the stay, but also adds a genuine touch of local gastronomy.

Trespaderne Priory is ideal for any type of getaway, whether romantic, with family or friends. Its serene and carefully decorated environment guarantees a memorable stay that leaves you wanting to return.

Great breakfast, local products and quality. We recommend this place for a romantic and relaxing getaway surrounded by good architecture and nature.

name: Raquel Martinez Salaberria
review_text: El sitio es precioso, las habitaciones amplias y el desayuno espectacular. Gracias, Dora ha sido un placer .

name: Angelcc1
review_text: El mejor alojamiento para hacer una ruta por Las Merindades, desde Traspaderne quedan mano todos los lugares de interes. Mencion especial para este alojamiento, en un palacio reformado completamente, con todas las comodidades y unas zonas comunes confortables y acogedoras. Las habitaciones estandar estan bien, aunque se echa de menos poder colgar las perchas en los armarios. Desayuno con productos caseros  y de la tierra, y la persona que lo regenta es todo amabilidad y cordialidad. La mejor eleccion para esta zona.
review_translated_text: The best accommodation for a tour of Las Merindades, all the sights are within easy reach from Traspaderne. Special mention goes to this accommodation, located in a completely renovated palace, with all the amenities and comfortable and welcoming common areas. The standard rooms are fine, although the ability to hang clothes hangers in the closets is a plus. Breakfast features homemade, local products, and the owner is extremely kind and friendly. The best choice for this area.

name: Manuel Villagrasa
review_text: El Priorato de Trespaderne, un lugar para tener en cuenta los aficionados al turismo rural. Una restauracion exquisita. Dora, la encargada, encantadora.
review_translated_text: The Trespaderne Priory, a place to consider for fans of rural tourism. An exquisite restoration. Dora, the manager, charming.

name: Carolina Juncos
review_text:
Ha sido un lujo estar alojados alli!
El edificio es impresionante! La decoracion, el ambiente creado, la cocina abierta, las vistas....todo el conjunto lo hace un sitio unico!
La atencion y las indicaciones antes de llegar nos facilitaron todo, mil gracias a la persona que nos atendio, super amable atenta y detallista!
Lo recomendamos al 100%
review_translated_text:

The building is impressive! The decoration, the atmosphere created, the open kitchen, the views... the whole thing makes it a unique place!
The attention and instructions before arriving made everything easier for us, a thousand thanks to the person who helped us, super friendly, attentive and detail-oriented!
We recommend it 100%

name: Maleni Alvarez
review_text:
Mi pareja y yo hemos pasado el fin de semana en el Priorato. Ha sido una buenisima experiencia. El lugar es increible, limpio, acogedor, diferente..la reforma es espectacular, con muchisimo gusto. Las habitaciones espaciosas, la cama comodisima. Se agradece que no haya televisiones en ningun sitio. Invita al silencio y la tranquilidad...
El desayuno variado, de calidad, no falta de nada. Dora super carinosa y atenta. Parking en la puerta...
La piscina con vistas a la montana, un lujazo.
Todo para repetir!
review_translated_text:
My partner and I spent the weekend at the Priorat. It has been a very good experience. The place is incredible, clean, cozy, different... the renovation is spectacular, with great taste. The spacious rooms, the very comfortable bed. It is appreciated that there are no televisions anywhere. Invites silence and tranquility...
The varied, quality breakfast, nothing is missing. Dora super affectionate and attentive. Parking at the door...
The pool with mountain views, a luxury.
Everything to repeat!

name: 908albal
review_text: Es un alojamiento muy especial por ser un edificio historico restaurado donde esta todo cuidado al detalle manteniendo una mezcla muy bonita de clasico y moderno en su estilo, pero diria que resulta frio y poco personal , tanto el hecho de que el chek in sea a traves de mensajes y no haya nadie para recibirte cuando llegas , tu tienes que encontrar la llave , las claves para entrar ...y luego los desayunos son algo decepcionantes. No hay zumo. La fruta no esta en su punto para comerla. Los productos son muy repetitivos y poca opcion para escoger. No hay televisor en la habitacion y no la echas de menos pero si te apetece ponerla no la hay tampoco. Para lo que se paga a 120 euros por noche los servicios no son los adecuados a su supuesta categoria en mi opinion. |Deberia ser mas barato u ofertar mayor cartera de servicios para equilibrarlo.
review_translated_text: It's a very special accommodation, being a restored historic building where everything has been carefully looked after, maintaining a very nice blend of classic and modern in its style. However, I would say it feels cold and lacking in staff. Check-in is done via text messages and there's no one to greet you when you arrive; you have to find the key, the codes to get in... and then the breakfasts are somewhat disappointing. There's no juice. The fruit isn't ripe enough to eat. The products are very repetitive, and there's little choice. There's no TV in the room, and you don't miss it, but if you want to put one on, there isn't one either. For what you pay at 120 euros per night, the services are not adequate for its supposed category, in my opinion. |It should be cheaper or offer a broader range of services to balance it out.

review_text: Todo excelente, hemos echado en falta TV en la habitacion, al menos un cambio de toallas o, en su defecto,  un colgador pequeno de ropa. Muy recomendable para desconectar y disfrutar del entorno. El Priorato en si es espectacular.
review_translated_text: Everything was excellent, we missed a TV in the room, at least a change of towels or, failing that, a small clothes hanger. Highly recommended to disconnect and enjoy the surroundings. The Priory itself is spectacular.

name: Philippa McCombie
review_text: You feel like you are staying in a family home in this stunning conversion of an old priory. It has featured in architectural magazines. We stayed two nights before returning to the ferry from our main holiday destination. The whole building is stunning, the communal areas are beautifully decorated and relaxed, the rooms the same as well as having very large comfy beds. The staff are friendly and helpful and gave us recommendations on places to visit. The area is full of history and an impressive natural setting. The pool and pretty terrace were wonderful to cool down in, at the end of the day. It is worth coming to this little explored part of Spain just to stay in this gem of a hotel.

name: Dominik Hanel

name: Gustavo Prada
review_text:
Un lugar encantador. Una casona antigua, rehabilitada con muy buen gusto, aparcamiento para coches, piscina, terraza comun y un comedor comun en el que dan un buen desayuno. No hay restaurante para comidas o cenas. Nosotros viajabamos en bici y habia un sitio para que se quedaran seguras.
Esta ubicado bastante centrico en el pueblo, cerca de un supermercado, algo alejado de los restaurantes.
El registro es bastante peculiar pero eficaz: Hay una persona que se encarga de gestionar el hotel pero nosotros no la vimos hasta el desayuno. Un par de dias antes de la entrada te manda un mensaje de Whatsapp con un video, en el video te indica por que puerta tienes que entrar, como abrir un armario en el que hay varias cajitas, que se abren con combinacion de numeros y dentro esta la llave de tu habitacion. El codigo de numeros te lo manda por Whatsapp y haces la entrada. Esto es una ventaja cuando no sabes a que hora vas a llegar de pedalear.
Nos recomendo tambien por Whatsapp un restaurante, al que fuimos a cenar, cerca habia otro restaurante.
Por la manana estaba la chica encargada preparando un gran desayuno tipo buffet: Bien surtido, productos de calidad, cada habitacion en una mesa con mantel.
En el desayuno me sorprendio que estabamos alojados hasta 12 personas y en toda la estancia no nos habiamos encontrado con nadie.
Despues de desayunar pagas alli mismo a la chica.
Sorprendente
review_translated_text:
A charming place. An old mansion, tastefully renovated, with parking, a pool, a shared terrace, and a shared dining room where they serve a good breakfast. There's no restaurant for lunch or dinner. We were traveling by bike, and there was a place for them to stay safely.
It's located fairly centrally in the village, near a supermarket, a bit far from the restaurants.
Check-in is rather unusual but efficient: There's a person in charge of managing the hotel, but we didn't see her until breakfast. A couple of days before check-in, she sends you a WhatsApp message with a video. In the video, she tells you which door to enter through, how to open a cabinet containing several small boxes. These are opened with a combination of numbers, and inside is your room key. She sends you the number code via WhatsApp, and you check in. This is a plus when you don't know what time you'll be back from cycling.
She also recommended a restaurant via WhatsApp, which we went to for dinner; there was another restaurant nearby.
In the morning, the lady in charge was preparing a great buffet breakfast: well-stocked, with quality products, and each room had a table with a tablecloth.
At breakfast, I was surprised to find that there were up to 12 of us staying, and we hadn't encountered a single person during the entire stay.
After breakfast, you pay the lady right there.
Amazing!

name: 507guillaumee
review_text: It's one of the most peaceful and well decorated hotel that I have been to. name: 138lalo
review_text: Las instalaciones muy bien restauradas y sin modificar la esencia de la casona , la zona tranquila excepcional para pasar unos dias en familia desconectando .Dora atenta y agradable. La piscina ideal para estar con ninos. En definitiva un lugar para repetir.Por poner alguna pega la limpieza de los techos del salon que hay algunas aranas y telas de arana que deben ser limpiadas dan una imagen regular
review_translated_text: The facilities were very well restored without altering the essence of the house. The quiet area was exceptional for spending a few days relaxing with the family. Dora was attentive and pleasant. The pool was ideal for spending time with children. In short, a place worth returning to. The only drawback is the cleanliness of the living room ceilings. There are some spiders and cobwebs that need to be cleaned, giving it a mediocre appearance.

name: Jose Miguel Rodriguez Santos
review_text: El lugar es precioso y la atencion es muy buena. Si vienes en bici tienen un sitio especifico para guardarlas. La piscina muy buena para pegarse un chapuzon. Hay dos cosas que cambiaria; el sofa cama de la habitacion solana que es bastante malo y poner alguna cortinilla para el tema de luz, pero son cosas personales.
review_translated_text: The place is beautiful and the service is very good. If you come by bike, they have a specific place to store them. The pool is great for a dip. There are two things I would change: the sofa bed in the sunroom, which is quite bad, and putting in some curtains to block out the light, but these are personal choices.

name: Lita Marin
review_text: el hotel tiene un encanto unico! super limpio, super bonito, y esta muy bien ubicado para conocer los bellos pueblos alrededor! dora es divina!!! super bella persona, el desayuno esta increible! excelene atencion!!! volveremos!!!!
review_translated_text: The hotel has a unique charm! super clean, super pretty, and it is very well located to get to know the beautiful towns around! Dora is divine!!! super beautiful person, the breakfast is incredible! excellent attention!!! we will return!!!!

name: Belen Lantero
review_text: Una estancia de diez. Habitaciones perfectas, lugar con mucho encanto, todos los detalles cuidados. La atencion del personal perfecta,desayuno rico y abundante.  100% recomendable.

name: Barbara Pankhurst
review_text:
On arrival, we were warmly welcomed by Dora, who showed us where to park our motorcycles,  also giving us a tour of the quirky, beautifully restored 16c Priory. From the attractively furnished communal room to the terrace, garden, and swimming pool with a fabulous view of the mountains, all were a delight.
With 1 night booked, we decided to stay another. This meant changing rooms, but no problem, as it gave us the chance to experience 2 different rooms. Room No.1 even has a part glass floor. Both were clean and the beds were super comfortable.
The area, Merindades, is stunning with plenty of activities and attractions. A visit to the small city of Frias is a must.
For us, the icing on the cake was Dora, warm, friendly, helpful, and also providing us a tasty breakfast. Thank you Dora x

name: Margarita Illan
review_text: El Priorato es un pequeno hotel de 7 habitaciones levantado en el siglo XVII y reconstruido con mucho gusto, respetando su estructura antigua e introduciendo elementos nuevos que le dan mucho movimiento. Las habitaciones son amplias y comodas, el desayuno no es variado pero si de mucha calidad y servido con muchisima amabilidad por Dora, que es un encanto.
review_translated_text: The Priorat is a small 7-room hotel built in the 17th century and tastefully rebuilt, respecting its old structure and introducing new elements that give it a lot of movement. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, the breakfast is not varied but it is of high quality and served with great kindness by Dora, who is a delight.

Charming hotel and surroundings, and Dora... LOVELY!!!

name: Pedro Als
review_text: Supera las expectativas que tenia. La ubicacion es perfecta para recorrer las Merindades. Dejas el coche en el parking y entras en un edificio muy funcional moderno y acogedor, cuya rehabilitacion  ha respetado la esencia del Priorato antiguo. Lo mejor es la gestion y el mimo con que cuida todo y a todos Dora. Muy recomendable.
review_translated_text: Exceeds the expectations I had. The location is perfect for exploring the Merindades. You leave the car in the parking lot and enter a very functional, modern and welcoming building, whose rehabilitation has respected the essence of the ancient Priory. The best thing is the management and the care with which Dora takes care of everything and everyone. Highly recommended.

name: Ramon Casanal
review_text: Hotel con encanto situado en la localidad de Trespaderne. Tiene una buena ubicacion y dispone de un parking gratuito para los clientes. Las zonas comunes del interior estan decoradas con mucho gusto. Las habitaciones son grandes, comodas y no les falta detalle. En el bano una buena ducha muy amplia. Dispone de una zona exterior ajardinada y con una piscina de uso privado para clientes. La anfitriona nos preparo un estupendo desayuno con productos de la zona, sin echar nada en falta. Yo soy diabetico y en todo momento me aconsejo lo que comer y lo que no. Resumiendo, un hotel moderno, con toque rural en el que se puede desconectar y donde reina el silencio.
review_translated_text: Charming hotel located in the town of Trespaderne. It has a good location and has free parking for customers. The common areas inside are tastefully decorated. The rooms are large, comfortable and do not lack detail. In the bathroom a good, very large shower. It has an outdoor garden area and a swimming pool for private use for clients. The hostess prepared us a wonderful breakfast with local products, without missing anything. I am diabetic and at all times he advises me what to eat and what not to eat. In short, a modern hotel, with a rural touch where you can disconnect and where silence reigns.

review_text:
Hotel de diseno precioso. La decoracion y la reconstruccion que han hecho de un edificio del siglo XVI es fantastica.

review_translated_text:
Beautiful design hotel. The decoration and reconstruction that they have done of a 16th century building is fantastic.
The only drawback is the "strict rules" regarding schedules. Check out at 11. Breakfast from 9 to 10.

review_text:

Very peaceful and an unbeatable stay.
Very well looked after by Dora and Getta, two charming and attentive women.
Brilliant in every way.

name: Marisa Prego pego
review_text: Merece la pena ya solo por la decoracion y los detalles, Ademas el trato es muy bueno y amable. Las habitaciones amplias, cama comoda, la limpieza impecable, el desayuno rico... Las vista de la terraza a las montanas y los jardines bien cuidados. Es una casa 10. Muy acogedora, muy recomendable

The spacious rooms, comfortable bed, impeccable cleanliness, delicious breakfast... The terrace views of the mountains and the well-kept gardens. It is a house 10. Very cozy, highly recommended

name: Natalia Herrera Montoya
review_text:
El hotel rural se localiza en la antigua casa del priorato del pueblo. Tras un incendio lo reformaron y decoraron con muchisimo gusto y conocimiento de diseno.

Las instalaciones son preciosos y calidas. Los cuartos principales acogedores.

Sobre todo destacar la labor de Dora, quien nos recibio y nos gestiono la reserva. Todas las manana nos saludaba y nos ofrecia desayuno, preparado al milimetro. Con un ojo en cada detalle, trata a todos los huespedes con carino y mimo, sabiendo un poco de todos nosotros y cuidandonos como si fueramos de la familia.

Muy recomendable, !gracias Dora por el trato!
review_translated_text:
The rural hotel is located in the village's former priory house. After a fire, it was renovated and decorated with great taste and design expertise.

The facilities are beautiful and warm. The main rooms are cozy.

Above all, we must highlight the work of Dora, who welcomed us and arranged our reservation. Every morning she greeted us and offered us breakfast, prepared to the last detail. With an eye for every detail, she treats all guests with love and care, knowing a little about each of us and caring for us as if we were family.

Highly recommended. Thank you Dora for your hospitality!

name: Germelina Masa Cabrero
review_text: Un sitio precioso, nos encanto y seguro que volveremos, en la zona hay muchos chorros y cascadas que ver, junto a  sus  pueblos que son muy bonitos
response_from_owner_text:
Muchas gracias Germelina por tus comentarios y por aportar fotos de la zona. 

Estaremos encantados de volver a recibiros. 

Un saludo. 

El equipo del Priorato
review_translated_text: A beautiful place, we loved it and we will surely return, in the area there are many jets and waterfalls to see, along with its towns that are very beautiful
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Thank you very much, Germelina, for your comments and for sharing photos of the area.

We look forward to welcoming you back.

Best regards.

The Priorato team

name: Ma Victoria Garabal
review_text: Nos hemos alojado tres dias en el hotel. Es un hotel muy tranquilo y el trato de sus duenos, Arancha y Jose, inmejorable. Nos asesoraron con posibles visitas a realizar por la zona y sus alrededores y todas fueron un acierto. El menu de las cenas es variado, abundante y de buena elaboracion y  calidad de la materia prima. La atencion tambien de la camarera Haizea ha sido excelente. Es un hotel muy familiar y muy bien ubicado para conocer y desplazarte por los alrededores. Totalmente recomendable.
review_translated_text: We stayed three days at the hotel. It is a very quiet hotel and the treatment of its owners, Arancha and Jose, is unbeatable. They advised us on possible visits to make in the area and its surroundings and they were all a success. The dinner menu is varied, abundant and of good preparation and quality of raw materials. The service from the waitress Haizea has also been excellent. It is a very familiar hotel and very well located to get to know and get around the surroundings. Totally recommended.

name: Luis Medina
review_text:
Habitacion grande y completa, incluso con nevera, muy limpio todo y colchon comodo.
Desayuno buffet bastante completo y muy bueno.

No me gusto el comentario del senor en el bar, al pedir un descafeinado a su companera y decirle que no me echara el sobre, a lo que le comento: << como si se lo irias a echar>>,
Esos son los detalles que definen a una persona, y que un profesional creo que debe abstenerse de comentar.

Sin embargo la senora de admision a la salida, nada que ver con este personaje, todo lo contrario, super amable y servicial y con educacion maxima.

En resumen, un buen sitio donde descansar en el camino con un buen servicio de restauracion (segun su carta, yo solo desayune) y unos precios ajustados, donde repetiria sin duda intentando evitar al senor descrito o si es oportuno diciendole un par de palabras.
response_from_owner_text:
Muy amable Luis, agradezco tu descripcion y comentario, debemos aprender de todo.
Un saludo,
review_translated_text:
Large and complete room, even with refrigerator, everything very clean and comfortable mattress.
Quite complete and very good buffet breakfast.

I didn't like the man's comment at the bar, when he asked his colleague for a decaffeinated drink and told him not to throw the envelope at me, to which he commented: "How could you throw it at him?"
Those are the details that define a person, and that I believe a professional should refrain from commenting on.

However, the admission lady at check-out had nothing to do with this character, quite the opposite, super friendly and helpful and with maximum education.

In short, a good place to rest on the road with a good restaurant service (according to your menu, I only had breakfast) and reasonable prices, where I would repeat without a doubt trying to avoid the man described or if appropriate saying a couple of words.
response_from_owner_translated_text:
Very kind of you, Luis. I appreciate your description and comment. We should learn from everything.
Best regards,

name: cristina salazar
review_text: Trato pesimo, sucio, fumamos un cigarro en la ventana y nos amenazaron en prohibirnos la entrada en cualquier hotel de las merindades. De los peores desayunos que hemos probado. Se nos olvido la llave dentro y en vez de dejarnos otra ,tubo que subir el personal a abrirnos y asi poder usmear en la habitacion. Nunca repetiremos y nos encargaremos de que Nadie de nuestro entreno tampoco. 0 recomendable

Dos dias en pleno verano tuvimos que dejar habitacion bloqueada por el intenso olor de lo que habiais fumado, a parte del trabajo de limpieza de una persona en exclusiva. Desviar a clientes a otros alojamientos porque pasado el primer dia seguia siendo insoportable. Es intolerable tu falta de respeto hacia el resto de clientes y hacia el establecimiento. Los carteles de prohibido fumar que hay por todo el hotel son para que se respeten.
review_translated_text: Terrible service, dirty. We smoked a cigarette by the window and were threatened with being banned from any hotel in the Merindades. One of the worst breakfasts we've ever had. We forgot our key inside, and instead of giving us another one, the staff had to come up and let us in so we could look around the room. We'll never go back, and we'll make sure no one from our training camp does either. 0 recommended.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Dear Cristina, I too appreciate not having the unpleasant experience of staying at my hotel. Two days in the middle of summer, we had to leave our room blocked due to the intense smell of what you had smoked, in addition to the cleaning work of a dedicated person. You diverted guests to other accommodations because after the first day, it was still unbearable. Your lack of respect for other guests and the establishment is intolerable. The no-smoking signs posted throughout the hotel are meant to be respected.

review_text: He estado alojada tres dias en este hotel, el trato de los duenos Jose y Aranzazu, excepcional, te indican las rutas que se pueden hacer por la zona, que ver en Medina de Pomar, y siempre te atienden con una sonrisa, o como en el caso de Jose con carcajadas, es majisimo. Las camareras muy simpaticas y las senoras que se encargan de la limpieza de las habitaciones muy amables tambien. review_translated_text: I stayed at this hotel for three days. The owners, Jose and Aranzazu, were exceptional. They showed you the best routes to take in the area and what to see in Medina de Pomar. They always greeted you with a smile, or, as in Jose's case, with laughter. They're incredibly kind. The rooms are very clean and spacious, and the one I had faced the back, allowing me to see the mountains every morning. The breakfast buffet is delicious, and Jose is always there to assist you. They offer everything from sweet to savory, and fruit. We had dinner there one night, and everything was delicious and reasonably priced. The waitresses were very friendly, and the ladies who cleaned the rooms were also very helpful. There are play areas for children and an area with animals. Es como si tienes una piscina olimpica y la llenas con 4 dedos de agua. No sirve para nada. Si has de trabajar via Internet es complicado.

Solo tiene calefaccion. No dispoNe de aire acondicionado. Los meses de calor es insoportable estar en la habitacion.

Las habitaciones son amplias, y tienen una pequena nevera, aunque si esta enchufada hace ruido, el bano muy correcto con banera grande y el. Personal bastante atento y amable. Es por eso que le doy dos estrellas.

It's like if you have an Olympic-size swimming pool and you fill it with 4 fingers of water. It's useless. If you have to work via the Internet it is complicated.

It only has heating. It does not have air conditioning. During the hot months it is unbearable to be in the room.

The rooms are spacious, and have a small refrigerator, although if it is plugged in it makes noise, the bathroom is very correct with a large bathtub and the. Quite attentive and friendly staff. That's why I give it two stars.

No hay ningun control por parte de algun empleado. Nosotros madrugabamos para que nadie hubiese tocado nada antes.

Nos solicito poder desayunar fuera de nuestro horario de atencion al publico de desayuno, para ese efecto y darles esa facilidad, les dejamos libre acceso  al comedor confiando en su responsabilidad, cuestion que veo  no han agradecido en absoluto.
Por ultimo siento que el wifi no funcionara como se desea, se reclamo y la empresa ya ha instalado una solucion nueva mas eficiente.

From Sunday afternoon until Tuesday, the cafeteria and restaurant are closed for staff rest, you cannot have even a sad soda. Good tap water in the room. If the client has a problem, they have to call a phone number and it will be the person they have to carry out all kinds of tasks who will help you, good or not, as was our case, well, he helped us but he didn't solve anything.
Wifi is free, very true because it does not exist, but there is practically no coverage, unacceptable in the times we live in.
Regarding current health measures, the owners of the hotel-restaurant seem not to know the protocol to follow.
In the breakfast room everyone can touch whatever they want,
Let me explain, the bad office type coffee maker, everyone touches it, the cutlery the same, the napkins and other utensils exactly the same, everyone has access to the sausage plates. There is no control by any employee. We got up early so that no one had touched anything before.
CURRENT OWNERS, BEFORE MAKING A RESERVATION PLEASE LET YOUR FUTURE CUSTOMERS KNOW THE CONDITIONS OF THE ESTABLISHMENT THAT YOU RUN.

Las Merindades, a beautiful area to visit with forests and water areas to fully enjoy nature.

review_text: El hotel es espectacular. Cuenta con parking propio, columpios y coas para ninos, un estanque con peces, jardines, nandues y otras aves... El restaurante esta muy bien, buen precio en menu y carta, terraza, y el trato es como estar en casa. A mi hijo le dolio la tripa y en seguida se ofrecieron a hacerle una tortilla francesa o lo que quisiera. Los jardines muy cuidados, y el dueno un encanto. Volveremos.
response_from_owner_text: Gracias  a todos, nos ayudais mucho.
review_translated_text: The hotel is spectacular. It has its own parking lot, swings and playground, a fish pond, gardens, rheas, and other birds... The restaurant is very good, with good prices on the menu and a la carte menu, a terrace, and the service is just like being at home. My son had a stomach ache, and they immediately offered to make him an omelet or whatever he wanted. The gardens are very well-kept, and the owner is a delight. We'll be back.

El desayuno es para todos los gustos: distintos tipos de pan, cereales, galletas, fiambres, bizcocho casero, zumos varios, maquina de cafe ... Todo perfecto. Cenamos alli poco y nos quedamos con las ganas de comer ... Menu diario y a la carta, parrilladas. Promete mucho. Recomendando 100% .

review_translated_text: A simple but clean and cozy triple room. Breakfast is included in the room rate if booked on the hotel's website. The staff is charming, and the hotel's surroundings are like a fairytale. The birds in the zoo are a fascinating source of entertainment for the children. The breakfast caters to all tastes: different types of bread, cereal, cookies, cold cuts, homemade cake, various juices, a coffee machine... Everything was perfect. We had a quick dinner there and were left wanting more... The daily menu includes a la carte menu and grills. It's very promising. 100% recommended.
response_from_owner_translated_text: This comment is doubly appreciated, it's summer and we're very busy, and it seems like everything is working out well.

review_translated_text: We stayed last weekend, from March 28th to March 2nd. We were three people, two adults and a child, and we truly had a fantastic time. The hostel is a quiet, very cozy place, and what surprised me most was how tidy and clean everything is. It's also very nicely decorated. Some rooms overlook a small square, while others overlook the river. For breakfast, we had toast, cake, coffee, and packaged juice. Ramon, the owner, was very kind to us. He offered my daughter the option of having a glass of milk at night if she wanted. So if we come back for the afternoon snacks, which we will, we'll stay there.

review_text:
Simpatica combinacion entre hostal y casa rural.
Las habitaciones modernas , espaciosas muy confortables y limpieza exquisita.
Lo que hace muy especial este establecimiento es su planta baja. Una elegante combinacion de recepcion, comedor, salon y cocina en el mismo espacio. Si, la cocina se encuentra integrada en el unico espacio comun del hostal y ademas es de libre acceso para todos los huespedes (+/- 10 habitaciones ??). Esta orientada al desayuno y dispone de cafe, leche, mantequilla, bizcocho casero, pan, microondas, tostadora, azucar... etc. Sorprendentemente, los huespedes se comportan correctamente y el espacio se mantiene limpio y en perfectas condiciones. Supongo que Ramon tendra algo que ver en todo esto. Muy centrico y a la vez apartado a la orilla del rio.

Muy recomendable.

P.d:
!!El bizcocho es casero!!!
response_from_owner_text: Muchas gracias,Jose.Con jente como tu,mis objetivos estan cumplidos.No puedo estar mas de acuerdo con tus sinceras apreciaciones.
review_translated_text:
Nice combination between hostel and rural house.
The modern, spacious rooms are very comfortable and exquisitely clean.
What makes this establishment very special is its ground floor. An elegant combination of reception, dining room, living room and kitchen in the same space. Yes, the kitchen is integrated into the only common space of the hostel and is also freely accessible to all guests (+/- 10 rooms?). It is oriented towards breakfast and has coffee, milk, butter, homemade cake, bread, microwave, toaster, sugar... etc. Surprisingly, the guests behave properly and the space is kept clean and in perfect condition. I guess Ramon has something to do with all this. Very central and at the same time secluded on the river bank.

Highly recommended.

P.S:
The cake is homemade!!!

Al lado del rio, con unas vistas en la parte de atras muy chulas, se escucha el murmullo que ayuda a dormir. La cama y la almohada en perfecto estado. En mi caso, como no me gustan las almohadas modernas porque son muy duras y altas para mi gusto, le dije que me diera otra mas bajita, y me dio una perfecta.
En mi opinion, muy recomendable.

review_translated_text:
A super cool rural hotel. meticulous attention to detail and very clean. The owner is very attentive and prepares first-class breakfasts. It's not located in the city center, so the peace and quiet are appreciated. Even so, since the town isn't very large, you can walk everywhere. It's next to the river, with very nice views in the background, and you can hear the murmur of the river, which helps you sleep. The bed and pillow are in perfect condition. In my case, since I don't like modern pillows because they're too firm and high for my taste, I asked him to give me a shorter one, and he gave me a perfect one.
In my opinion, highly recommended.

Saludos.
La gerencia.

We don't usually respond to criticism, but this one deserves it.

We are dedicated to trying to create a moment of happiness (if they let us) for all those who request our services, as shown by the rest of our clients' reviews and the 12 years of work that guarantee us.

Greetings.
The management.

name: Laura Amaya
review_text:
Calidad precio inmejorable, es un hospedaje en el propio monasterio, los apartamentos son amplios, cuidan el minimo detalle, todo esta bien cuidado.

Las habitaciones cuentan con todo lo necesario, la cocina esta completa para poder cocinar: microondas, nevera, utensilios de cocina, cafetera..

Nosotros estuvimos en una habitacion con bastante amplitud, una zona de estar, que contaba con sofa y mesa con sillas.

El entorno es tranquilo y cuenta con zona de parking en el exterior. Ademas, esta bien ubicado porque puedes ir al centro.
Nosotros escogimos este sitio recomendado y fue todo un acierto , ya que esta bien ubicado para poder visitar todos los sitios turisticos y pueblos de alrededor.

Lo unico que no tienen es ascensor para poder subir el carrito de bebe o silla de ruedas.

Sin duda , para visitar la zona, volveria a repetir el mismo hospedaje por todo lo anteriormente, dicho y por el servicio excepcional que nos dieron.
review_translated_text:
Unbeatable value for money. It's a place to stay in the monastery itself. The apartments are spacious, attention to detail, and everything is well maintained.

The rooms have everything you need. The kitchen is fully equipped for cooking: microwave, refrigerator, kitchen utensils, coffee maker...

We had a fairly spacious room with a seating area, including a sofa and table with chairs.

The surroundings are quiet and have outdoor parking. It's also conveniently located for easy access to the city center.
We chose this recommended place, and it was a great choice, as it's well located for visiting all the surrounding tourist sites and towns.

The only thing they don't have is an elevator to accommodate a stroller or wheelchair.

Without a doubt, if I were to visit the area, I would stay there again, given all the reasons I've mentioned above and the exceptional service we received.

review_text:
?Necesitas paz y tranquilidad para relajarte del ajetreo diario y descansar? La Hospederia del Monasterio de Santa Clara, en Medina de Pomar, es el lugar adecuado.

?Quieres conocer a fondo la comarca de las Merindades siguiendo las rutas de "Los caminos del agua"? Medina de Pomar esta en el mismisimo centro de la comarca, y La Hospederia del Monasterio de Santa Clara es el sitio perfecto donde alojarse.

Muchas gracias, Juncal, por tu amabilidad y por toda la informacion que nos has proporcionado, que nos ha servido para planificar nuestros dias de vacaciones.

!Y tampoco nos olvidamos de los dulces que elaboran las hermanas en el Monasterio!
review_translated_text:
Do you need peace and quiet to relax from the daily hustle and bustle and unwind? The Hospederia del Monasterio de Santa Clara, in Medina de Pomar, is the perfect place.

Do you want to explore the Merindades region in depth by following the "Water Paths" routes? Medina de Pomar is in the very center of the region, and the Hospederia del Monasterio de Santa Clara is the perfect place to stay.

Thank you so much, Juncal, for your kindness and for all the information you provided, which helped us plan our vacation.

And we can't forget the sweets the sisters make at the Monastery!

review_text: He disfrutado de una estancia de varios dias en un apartamento para 2 y ha sido fantastica: sencillo, pero perfectamente equipado, comodo, acogedor, tranquilo y en un entorno precioso. review_translated_text: I enjoyed a several-day stay in an apartment for two, and it was fantastic: simple but perfectly equipped, comfortable, cozy, quiet, and in a beautiful setting. I'll be back to explore Las Merindades, which has many secrets waiting to be discovered.

review_text: Nos alojamos en esta vivienda durante 8 dias. Somos un matrimonio con una nina. Todo muy limpio, tranquilo y acogedor. Hemos estado muy bien. Luis es una persona muy amable. Repetiremos.
response_from_owner_text: Muchisimas gracias familia, nos alegramos muchisimo de que estariais tan a gusto. Para nosotros ha sido tambien un placer teneros en nuestra casa. Encantados de recibiros de nuevo cuando querais volver por la zona. Un abrazo.
review_translated_text: We stayed in this apartment for eight days. We are a couple with a daughter. Everything was very clean, quiet, and cozy. We had a great time. Luis is a very kind person. We will definitely stay there again.
response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much, family. We're so glad you felt so comfortable. It was also a pleasure for us to have you in our home. We're delighted to welcome you back whenever you want to come back to the area. Best regards.
